title: Variational Contraction Conditions for Iterative Algorithms in Multi-Population Discrete-Time Regularized Mean-Field Games
summary: In this work, we study the contraction conditions of iterative algorithms for stationary and finite-horizon discrete-time regularized mean-field games (MFGs) with multiple populations, where each population only interacts with the state distributions of the other populations. Due to the high dimensionality caused by the interaction of different populations, contraction rates for these algorithms cannot, in general, be expressed in terms of radicals. By studying the dynamics of these iterative algorithms and assuming that the system components of each population's MFG are Lipschitz continuous, we present explicit (eventual) contraction conditions for each algorithm in any normed space, relying only on these Lipschitz parameters. As a consequence of these contraction conditions, we provide convergence rates of finite-horizon mean-field equilibria to infinite-horizon stationary (and non-stationary) mean-field equilibria (MFEs), under restrictions on a variational characterization of the dynamics of these iterative algorithms. In the single-population case, the restrictions we impose on this variational characterization to obtain these convergence results are less restrictive than previous results in the literature.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多群体离散时间正则化平均场博弈中迭代算法的收缩条件，利用Lipschitz参数给出了任意赋范空间中的显式收缩条件，并提供了有限时域均衡向无限时域均衡收敛的速率。
AI.motivation: 多群体平均场博弈中，不同群体间的相互作用导致高维度问题，使得迭代算法的收缩率通常无法用根式表达，需要寻找更通用的收缩条件分析框架。
AI.method: 通过研究迭代算法的动力学特性，假设每个群体MFG系统组件满足Lipschitz连续性，在任意赋范空间中基于Lipschitz参数给出显式的（最终）收缩条件；利用动力学的变分刻画限制，建立有限时域均衡向无限时域均衡的收敛速率。
AI.result: 提出了多群体MFG迭代算法在任意赋范空间中的显式收缩条件；在变分刻画的限制下，给出了有限时域MFE向无限时域平稳（及非平稳）MFE的收敛速率；单群体情形下所需的变分刻画限制比现有文献更弱。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立的收缩条件框架有效解决了多群体MFG中因高维度导致的收缩率表达难题，且在单群体特例中改进了已有结果的条件紧度。

title: Threshold-Safe Shock Absorption in a Compartmental Voter-Flow Model:\ A Conservative Impulse-Control Benchmark
summary: We formulate a deterministic threshold-safety problem for a reduced compartmental voter-flow model. An exogenous load enters an alienation reservoir; between releases the reservoir recovers exponentially. Near the mainstream baseline the compartmental dynamics have a linear-stability threshold \(Δ_c\): below this level the mobilised component contracts, while above it transient amplification is possible. The paper introduces an impulse-control layer for this threshold mechanism. The threshold is obtained from the local stability boundary of the reduced dynamical system, the exposure functional is tied to positive logarithmic amplification, and the scalar reservoir model is proved to be a conservative envelope of the nonlinear voter-flow dynamics. This bridge yields explicit safety benchmarks: the single-release exposure and its zero buffer, the complete-relaxation splitting problem with fixed per-release overhead, the finite-recovery constant-peak profile, and the fixed-horizon capacity frontier \(Δ_c(1+ρT)\). The scalar recurrence used after the reduction is the familiar leaky-reservoir skeleton also found in multiple-dose pharmacokinetics, fractionated radiotherapy, reservoir operation, and setup-cost scheduling. Its role here is to make the threshold regimes of the compartmental shock-absorption model analytically transparent.

AI.tldr: 本文针对一个简化的房室选民流模型，提出了确定性阈值安全问题。外源负荷进入 alienation 储库，两次释放之间储库呈指数恢复。在主流基线附近，房室动力学存在线性稳定性阈值 \(Δ_c\)：低于该阈值时动员部分收缩，高于阈值则可能发生瞬态放大。文章引入了该阈值机制的脉冲控制层，证明了标量储库模型是非线性选民流动力学的保守包络，并推导出显式的安全基准：单次释放暴露及其零缓冲、固定单次开销下的完全松弛分割问题、有限恢复恒定峰值轮廓，以及固定时域容量边界 \(Δ_c(1+ρT)\)。简化后的标量递推形式即为常见的泄漏储库骨架，也见于多剂量药代动力学、分次放疗、水库调度和设置成本调度中，其作用在于使房室冲击吸收模型的阈值区域分析透明化。
AI.motivation: 为房室选民流模型建立确定性阈值安全框架，将非线性动力学中的稳定性阈值转化为可操作的脉冲控制问题，以量化外源冲击下的系统安全边界。
AI.method: 基于简化房室选民流模型，利用局部稳定性边界导出阈值 \(Δ_c\)，构建脉冲控制层将暴露函数与对数放大正关联，并证明标量泄漏储库模型是原非线性动力学的保守包络，进而解析求解多个安全基准问题。
AI.result: 获得了显式的安全基准公式：单次释放暴露及其零缓冲、完全松弛分割问题、有限恢复恒定峰值轮廓、固定时域容量边界 \(Δ_c(1+ρT)\)，揭示了阈值机制的解析结构。
AI.conclusion: 泄漏储库骨架作为通用数学结构，将房室冲击吸收模型中的阈值区域透明化，为跨领域安全阈值问题提供了统一的分析工具。

title: The petrol station game: the regional average price. A mean field analysis
summary: In January 2023, the obligation for petrol stations to display the average fuel price calculated on a regional basis was introduced by the Italian Government. A mean field game model is here proposed to describe the evolution of the fuel price. In particular, each petrol station decides its own price, for the next day, taking account of an estimate of the average price, to be communicated by the Local Authority. The existence and the evolution of a mean field equilibrium are analytically investigated. Some simulations are compared with real data from the Autonomous Province of Trento, Italy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出均值场博弈模型，分析意大利2023年1月实施的加油站区域平均油价公示政策对油价演化的影响。研究证明了均值场均衡的存在性与演化，并通过特伦托自治省的实际数据进行了仿真验证。
AI.motivation: 意大利政府于2023年1月强制要求加油站公示区域平均油价，这一政策改变了加油站定价的决策环境。作者希望从理论层面理解该政策下加油站之间的定价博弈行为，以及平均价格公示对市场均衡的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用均值场博弈（Mean Field Game, MFG）模型来刻画加油站定价的动态演化过程。每个加油站根据对地方政府通报的区域平均价格的估计，决定次日自身油价。模型从理论上分析了均值场均衡的存在性与演化性质，并使用意大利特伦托自治省的真实数据进行仿真对比。
AI.result: 在理论上证明了均值场均衡的存在性并描述了其演化特征；仿真结果与特伦托自治省的真实数据具有较好的一致性，验证了模型的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 均值场博弈模型能够有效描述区域平均油价公示政策下的加油站定价行为，为政策制定者理解市场动态提供了理论工具和实证支持。

title: An Exact Continuous Conductance Formulation of the Hamiltonian Path Problem
summary: The Hamiltonian Path Problem is formulated as a continuous minimization problem on conductances assigned to an Ohmic network associated with the given graph. The objective function is a sum of two penalty terms that collectively enforce a set of conditions sufficient for a subgraph of the original graph to be a Hamiltonian path. The objective function is nonconvex. The main result (Theorem 1) shows that, provided the graph has a Hamiltonian path from $h^{start}$ to $h^{end}$, a conductance configuration is a global minimizer of the objective if and only if it corresponds to a Hamiltonian path.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将哈密顿路径问题转化为欧姆网络上的连续最小化问题，通过非凸目标函数中的两个惩罚项来强制满足哈密顿路径的条件。主要定理证明：当图存在哈密顿路径时，全局最小化器与哈密顿路径一一对应。
AI.motivation: 将离散的哈密顿路径问题转化为连续优化问题，从而可能利用连续优化技术来求解这一经典的NP完全问题。
AI.method: 在给定图关联的欧姆网络上为每条边分配电导值，构造包含两个惩罚项的非凸目标函数，通过最小化该函数来强制满足哈密顿路径的充分条件集。
AI.result: 定理1证明：若图中存在从h_start到h_end的哈密顿路径，则电导配置是全局最小化器当且仅当该配置对应一条哈密顿路径。
AI.conclusion: 成功建立了哈密顿路径问题与连续优化问题之间的等价关系，为使用连续优化方法求解哈密顿路径问题提供了理论基础。

title: Optimal Non-Asymptotic Edgeworth Expansions for Multivariate Neural Network Outputs
summary: Finite-width fully connected neural networks with Gaussian-initialized weights deviate from their infinite-width Gaussian limit, exhibiting non-vanishing higher-order cumulants. We approximate these deviations, for a neural network evaluated in a finite number of inputs, using multidimensional Edgeworth expansions of arbitrary order $4m-1$, with $m\in\mathbb{N}$. Assuming that the corresponding Gaussian limit has an invertible covariance matrix and that the activation function is polynomially bounded, we establish a bound of order $n^{-m}$ on the total variation distance between the law of the true network output and its Edgeworth approximation, with matching lower bounds. As an application, we quantify the error in Bayesian posterior distributions when the prior is replaced by its Edgeworth expansion. Our results are more general and also apply to sequences of conditionally Gaussian vectors converging to a Gaussian vector with invertible covariance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了有限宽度全连接神经网络输出分布与高斯极限之间的偏差，并利用多变量Edgeworth展开进行任意高阶逼近，证明了总变差距离上的误差界及其匹配下界，同时将该方法应用于贝叶斯后验分布的误差量化。
AI.motivation: 有限宽度神经网络的高斯初始化权重导致其输出分布偏离无限宽度下的高斯极限，且高阶累积量非零。现有理论多集中于无限宽度极限，对有限宽度下的非高斯偏差缺乏精确刻画，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 使用多变量Edgeworth展开（阶数为4m-1，m∈ℕ）对有限输入点上的神经网络输出分布进行近似。假设高斯极限的协方差矩阵可逆且激活函数多项式有界，推导总变差距离的上界n^{-m}，并给出匹配下界。结果推广至条件高斯向量序列收敛到可逆协方差高斯向量的情形。
AI.result: 建立了有限宽度神经网络输出分布与其Edgeworth近似之间总变差距离的n^{-m}阶上界，并证明该界是紧的（存在匹配下界）。同时量化了使用Edgeworth展开替换先验时贝叶斯后验分布的误差。
AI.conclusion: Edgeworth展开能有效逼近有限宽度神经网络的非高斯分布，且逼近精度随宽度增加（或m增大）以多项式速率提升。该框架不仅适用于神经网络，也适用于更一般的条件高斯向量序列，为理解有限宽度神经网络的有限样本行为提供了理论工具。

title: Algometrics: Forecasting Under Algorithmic Feedback
summary: In algorithmic markets, predictive models become part of the data-generating process they aim to forecast. Once their outputs are converted into trades, allocations, execution schedules, or risk controls, they change the future data on which they are evaluated. I introduce algometrics, a framework for time series whose evolution depends on the predictive algorithms forecasting them. The framework distinguishes historical risk, measured under passive forecasting, from deployment risk, measured when forecasts drive actions. I prove three results. First, deployment risk is not identifiable from passive historical data alone: even in a one-step linear feedback model, infinitely many algorithm-mediated environments induce the same historical law while implying different deployment risks for the same forecaster. Second, historical model rankings can invert under crowding, so a predictor with lower passive error can have higher deployment error once similar algorithms are adopted. Third, randomized or instrumented actions identify short-horizon linear feedback, and I derive a finite-sample bound for deployment-risk estimation. These results suggest that time-series benchmarks in algorithmic markets should report feedback sensitivity alongside predictive accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"算法计量学"(algometrics)框架，研究当预测算法本身影响其预测的时间序列时（即算法市场中的反馈循环），历史风险与部署风险之间的差异，并证明部署风险无法仅从被动历史数据中识别，历史模型排名可能在拥挤效应下反转，以及随机化或工具化行为可以识别短视线性反馈。
AI.motivation: 在算法市场中，预测模型成为数据生成过程的一部分——模型的输出被转化为交易、分配、执行调度或风险控制后，会改变其评估所依赖的未来数据。这种反馈循环导致传统时间序列评估方法失效，亟需一个能够量化这种算法-数据交互风险的框架。
AI.method: 提出algometrics理论框架，将风险区分为被动预测下的历史风险(deployment risk)和预测驱动行动时的部署风险(deployment risk)。通过理论推导证明三个核心定理：不可识别性定理、排名反转定理、以及有限样本可识别性定理。
AI.result: (1) 部署风险无法仅从被动历史数据中识别，即使在单步线性反馈模型中，无限多种算法中介环境可以诱导相同的历史律但隐含不同的部署风险；(2) 历史模型排名会在拥挤效应下反转，被动误差更低的预测器在算法被广泛采用后可能具有更高的部署误差；(3) 随机化或工具化行为可以识别短视线性反馈，且给出了部署风险估计的有限样本界。
AI.conclusion: 时间序列基准在算法市场中应在报告预测准确性的同时报告反馈敏感性指标，以反映模型对自身引发的数据变化的鲁棒性。

title: In Search of the Ingredients of Open-Endedness: Replicating Picbreeder with Large Vision-Language Models
comment: 26 pages, 21 figures, to be published at GECCO 2026
summary: We are in the midst of large-scale industrial and academic efforts to automate the processes of scientific, technological and creative production through AI-driven assistants. Historically, a fundamental property of these processes in their human form has been their open-endedness: their capacity for generating a seemingly endless supply of novel and meaningful new forms. Do artificial agents have any capacity for such fruitful unguided discovery? To answer this question, we turn to Picbreeder, the canonical exemplar of human-driven open-ended search, in which users collaboratively generated a diverse library of images through interactive evolution of small neural networks. We replicate Picbreeder, replacing human users with frontier Vision Language Models (VLMs). We observe clear qualitative differences between the output of our system and the historical human baseline, and attempt to characterize them using metrics of phylogenetic complexity and visual and semantic salience and novelty. In an effort to identify some of the causal factors contributing these differences, we study the addition of exploratory noise to the agents' selection process, of behavioral diversity between agents, and of narrative momentum in the form of memory of past actions. We make our code available at https://github.com/smearle/picbreeder-vlm.

AI.tldr: 本研究将Picbreeder中的人类用户替换为前沿视觉语言模型（VLM），探索AI代理是否具备类似人类的开放式发现能力。实验发现VLM生成的图像与人类基线存在明显质量差异，并通过添加探索性噪声、行为多样性和叙事记忆等机制分析成因。
AI.motivation: 探究人工智能代理是否具备人类式的开放式、无引导的发现能力，即能否自主产生持续不断的新颖且有意义的创造物。
AI.method: 以Picbreeder为基准平台，用前沿视觉语言模型（VLM）替代人类用户进行交互式进化，并通过添加探索性噪声、行为多样性代理和叙事记忆等手段分析差异成因。
AI.result: VLM驱动的系统与人类基线在输出上存在明显的定性差异，通过系统发生复杂度、视觉与语义显著性和新颖性等指标进行了量化表征。
AI.conclusion: 当前VLM在开放式发现方面与人类存在差距，但通过引入探索性噪声、行为多样性和记忆机制可能有助于缩小这一差距。

title: Single-Chord Augmentation of Weighted Cycles for Algebraic Connectivity and Network Coherence
summary: Ring-like communication graphs appear in UAV formations, cyclic patrols, perimeter monitoring, and other multi-agent tasks in which agents exchange information mainly with neighboring vehicles along a closed route. When measurement and actuation noise are persistent, a useful augmentation should improve both the convergence rate of consensus and the steady-state disagreement level. This paper studies the addition of a single weighted chord to a connected weighted cycle. The central observation is that a chord is not just a generic rank-one edge update: it splits the cycle into two complementary resistance arcs, and this resistance split governs both the algebraic-connectivity gain and the Kirchhoff-index reduction. We first derive exact chord-induced effective-resistance and Kirchhoff-index update formulas, giving a closed-form coherence objective. We then prove that, under bounded conductances and small resistance discrepancy, near-antipodal resistance-balanced chords are near-optimal for algebraic-connectivity improvement; an i.i.d. bounded-conductance model yields the same conclusion with high probability. Finally, because the best convergence-rate chord and the best coherence chord need not coincide, we formulate the design as a finite Pareto problem and introduce RBAPS and AW-RBAPS, two resistance-balanced screening rules that retain only linear or near-linear candidate sets. Numerical experiments show that AW-RBAPS remains effective beyond the formal moderate-heterogeneity regime and approximates the exhaustive Pareto front with mean hypervolume ratio $0.9987$ while evaluating about $10.1\%$ of admissible chords.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在加权环状通信图中添加单条弦（chord）以同时提升共识收敛速率与稳态不一致水平。核心发现：弦将环分割为两条互补电阻弧，该电阻分裂结构决定代数连通度增益与基尔霍夫指数降幅。推导了弦诱导的有效电阻与基尔霍夫指数更新闭式公式，证明在有限电导与小电阻偏差条件下近似对径的电阻平衡弦近似最优，并提出了两种电阻平衡筛选规则（RBAPS与AW-RBAPS）将候选集压缩至线性或近线性规模，数值实验显示AW-RBAPS能以约10.1%的候选弦评估实现平均超体积比0.9987的帕累托前沿近似。
AI.motivation: 无人机编队、循环巡逻、周界监控等任务中常使用环状通信拓扑，但现有研究缺乏对添加单条弦如何同时优化收敛速率（代数连通度）与稳态不一致水平（基尔霍夫指数）的深入理解，需要建立精确的数学框架来刻画弦的拓扑影响并指导最优设计。
AI.method: (1) 推导弦诱导的有效电阻与基尔霍夫指数更新闭式公式；(2) 证明在有限电导与小电阻偏差条件下，近似对径的电阻平衡弦近似最优（代数连通度），并给出i.i.d.有界电导模型的高概率结论；(3) 将设计建模为有限帕累托优化问题，提出两种电阻平衡筛选规则（RBAPS和AW-RBAPS）将候选弦集降至线性或近线性规模。
AI.result: 数值实验表明AW-RBAPS在中等异质性假设之外仍有效，能以评估约10.1%的候选弦达到平均超体积比0.9987的帕累托前沿近似质量。
AI.conclusion: 电阻分割视角为环图加弦的共识性能优化提供了精确分析工具；电阻平衡弦在代数连通度与基尔霍夫指数两个目标上均具有近似最优性；所提筛选规则可高效逼近完整帕累托前沿。

title: Causality as the Statistical Conscience of Artificial Intelligence: From Pearl's Ladder to Trustworthy Machines
summary: Modern Artificial Intelligence achieves remarkable predictive power by optimizing statistical risk functionals over vast corpora. Yet a gap separates this from genuine intelligence: the inability to distinguish correlation from causation. This paper argues that causal inference (identifying mechanisms invariant under intervention) is AI's indispensable statistical conscience. Without causal grounding, AI systems are correlation machines: powerful in familiar domains, brittle under distribution shift, and biased in high-stakes settings. Three contributions develop this argument. First, a Statistical Necessity Theorem for Causal Generalization: any algorithm achieving out-of-distribution generalization must encode causal structure, formalizing the distinction between prediction P(Y|X) and intelligence P(Y|do(X)). Second, a unified framework connects Pearl's do-calculus, the Potential Outcomes framework, Double Machine Learning, and Invariant Risk Minimization as a family of Causal Statistical Estimators, each identifying interventional distributions under different assumptions. Third, three AI failure modes (hallucination in large language models, reward hacking in reinforcement learning from human feedback, and degradation under distribution shift) are manifestations of causal blindness, each admitting a principled statistical remedy. Trustworthy AI is, at its core, a problem of causal statistics. The statistical community is not merely equipped to solve it -- it is the only community with the foundational tools to do so rigorously.

AI.tldr: 本文论证因果推断是AI不可或缺的统计良知，提出因果泛化的统计必然性定理，并统一了Pearl的do-演算、潜在结果框架、双机器学习与不变风险最小化等因果统计估计量框架，指出大语言模型幻觉、RLHF奖励黑客与分布偏移退化等AI失败模式本质上是因果盲视的体现。
AI.motivation: 现代AI在统计风险优化上取得了显著预测能力，但无法区分相关性与因果性，这导致AI系统在分布偏移下脆弱、在高风险场景中存在偏见。弥合预测与真正智能之间的鸿沟需要因果推断作为统计基础。
AI.method: (1) 提出因果泛化的统计必然性定理：任何实现分布外泛化的算法必须编码因果结构；(2) 构建统一框架，将Pearl do-演算、潜在结果框架、双机器学习与不变风险最小化整合为因果统计估计量家族；(3) 分析大语言模型幻觉、RLHF奖励黑客、分布偏移退化三种AI失败模式，提出基于因果统计的矫正方案。
AI.result: 证明了因果结构是分布外泛化的必要条件；建立了多种因果推断方法的统一统计框架；识别出三种AI失败模式均源于因果盲视，并给出了统计意义上的解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 可信AI的核心是因果统计问题，统计学界拥有解决这一问题的根本性工具，且是唯一具备此能力的学术共同体。

title: Parameter Efficient Multi-Class Intelligent Scheduling for Multimodal Online Distributed Industrial Anomaly Detection
summary: Industrial anomaly detection has attracted significant attention as a fundamental challenge in industrial systems. The rapid advancement of heterogeneous industrial sensors has driven industrial anomaly detection from unimodal to multimodal paradigms. However, existing methods are primarily designed for centralized and offline settings, overlooking the distributed and continuously generated data characteristic of real-world industrial environments. With the advancement of edge intelligence, modern edge devices are increasingly capable of not only data acquisition but also distributed model training, enabling collaborative intelligence across the system. Industrial anomaly detection represents a critical application in this context. Motivated by these challenges, we propose a novel framework termed Multimodal Online Distributed Industrial Anomaly Detection (MODIAD). We first present a comprehensive workflow for MODIAD and then formulate a Multi-class Intelligent Scheduling (MIS) problem to coordinate cross class model updates by balancing data sufficiency and class update frequency. To efficiently solve this problem, we design a Sequential Marginal Gain Greedy (SMG) algorithm that enables effective multi-class training under resource constraints. Furthermore, to improve the computational and communication efficiency during training, we propose an Resource Efficient Class-Wise Low Rank Adaptation (REC-LoRA) strategy, which significantly reduces system overhead while preserving detection performance. Extensive experiments on two representative multimodal industrial anomaly detection datasets, MVTec 3D-AD and Eyecandies demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves superior performance and efficiency under the MODIAD scenario.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种面向工业异常检测的多模态在线分布式框架MODIAD，包含多类智能调度（MIS）问题和序贯边际增益贪婪（SMG）算法，以及资源高效的低秩适应策略（REC-LoRA），在MVTec 3D-AD和Eyecandies数据集上取得了优异性能。
AI.motivation: 现有工业异常检测方法主要面向集中式和离线场景，忽视了实际工业环境中数据分布式、持续生成的特性。随着边缘智能的发展，需设计一种能充分利用边缘设备分布式训练能力的多模态在线异常检测框架。
AI.method: 1) 提出MODIAD框架及完整工作流；2) 形式化多类智能调度（MIS）问题以协调跨类模型更新；3) 设计序贯边际增益贪婪（SMG）算法求解MIS；4) 提出资源高效类级低秩适应（REC-LoRA）策略降低训练开销。
AI.result: 在MVTec 3D-AD和Eyecandies两个代表性多模态工业异常检测数据集上，所提方法在MODIAD场景下取得了优越的性能和效率。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的MODIAD框架及SMG算法和REC-LoRA策略有效解决了分布式、在线、多模态工业异常检测中的调度和资源效率问题，为实际工业部署提供了可行方案。

title: Confidence Calibration in Large Language Models
summary: We investigate the calibration of large language models' (LLMs') confidence across diverse tasks. The results of our preregistered study show that the current crop of LLMs are, like people, too sure they are right: confidence exceeds accuracy, on average. Importantly, however, this tendency is moderated by a powerful hard-easy effect, wherein overconfidence is greatest on difficult tests; by contrast, easy tests actually show substantial underconfidence. We develop LifeEval, a test for evaluating model calibration across levels of difficulty.

AI.tldr: 该研究调查了大型语言模型（LLM）在不同任务中的置信度校准问题。预注册研究结果表明，当前LLM像人类一样过于自信：平均而言，置信度超过了准确率。然而，这种倾向受到强大的"难易效应"的调节，即在困难测试中过度自信最为严重；相比之下，在简单测试中则表现出明显的缺乏自信。研究者开发了LifeEval测试，用于评估模型在不同难度水平上的校准情况。
AI.motivation: 探究LLM在不同难度任务中的置信度校准情况，验证模型是否像人类一样存在过度自信偏差，并考察难易效应（hard-easy effect）对置信度校准的影响。
AI.method: 通过预注册研究（preregistered study）设计，系统性地比较LLM的置信度输出与实际准确率之间的差异，并开发LifeEval测试集来评估模型在不同难度水平上的校准表现。
AI.result: 当前LLM平均而言存在过度自信（置信度超过准确率），但这种倾向受到难易效应的调节：在困难任务上表现出强烈的过度自信，在简单任务上反而表现出明显的缺乏自信。
AI.conclusion: LLM的置信度校准存在与人类类似的偏差模式，即难易效应显著影响校准质量，研究者开发的LifeEval可用于系统评估模型在不同难度水平下的校准性能。

title: Optimal drift optimizer for non-convex optimization
summary: We study a finite-horizon stochastic control criterion for non-convex optimization in which Brownian exploration is balanced against a quadratic control cost. Rather than emphasizing the classical Hopf--Cole representation, we isolate the exact drift selected by the criterion and reorganize it in a form adapted to optimization. The key object is the conditional terminal law of the optimal process. We show that this law is a Gibbs measure for a proximally penalized energy, yielding three exact representations of the drift: potential, averaged-gradient, and barycentric. We then analyze two asymptotic regimes relevant for optimization. As terminal time is approached, the drift recovers a scaled gradient-descent field. In the low-temperature regime, assuming a unique global minimizer, the conditional terminal law concentrates on it even in the presence of nonglobal local minima, and the drift converges to an affine attraction field toward it. In the nondegenerate case we also derive Laplace asymptotics for the drift, the value function, and the covariance of the conditional terminal law. Finally, we record a simple gradient-free discretization suggested by the barycentric formula.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有限时域随机控制准则下的非凸优化问题，通过布朗探索与二次控制成本的平衡，推导出最优漂移的三种精确表示（势、平均梯度、重心），并分析了终端时间趋近和低温两种渐近 regime，最后提出一种无梯度离散化方法。
AI.motivation: 为非凸优化问题提供一种基于随机控制理论的新框架，通过布朗探索与二次控制成本的平衡，避免陷入非全局局部极小值，并给出可计算的漂移表示。
AI.method: 从有限时域随机控制准则出发，不依赖经典Hopf-Cole表示，而是通过提取最优漂移并重新组织为优化适配形式。核心是条件终端分布的刻画——该分布是近端惩罚能量的Gibbs测度，由此导出三种漂移表示（势、平均梯度、重心），并分析终端时间趋近和低温两种渐近 regime。
AI.result: 终端时间趋近时漂移恢复为缩放梯度下降场；低温条件下条件终端分布集中在全局极小值（即使存在非全局局部极小值），漂移收敛为吸引场；非退化情形下推导了漂移、值函数和条件终端分布协方差的Laplace渐近。
AI.conclusion: 该随机控制框架为非凸优化提供了新的理论工具，三种漂移表示各有优势，特别地重心公式可导出一个简单的无梯度离散化方法，具有实际应用潜力。

title: Detecting Metastable Basins in High Dimensions via Marginal Trajectory Distribution Discrimination
summary:
We study the problem of identifying dynamically distinct basins of attraction in high dimensional time-homogeneous Markov processes using only trajectory sampling. This problem is fundamental in the analysis of metastable dynamical systems, where the process rapidly mixes within basins while transitions between basins occur rarely on the timescale of interest, or even when the state space is reducible. Existing approaches typically rely on spatial discretization or spectral analysis of estimated transition operators, which can become unreliable in high dimensional settings or when the underlying basin geometry is highly nonlinear.
  We propose a discriminative approach to basin identification based on marginal trajectory distribution comparison. We prove a simple risk separation result: if two initial states belong to the same basin, the Bayes-optimal classifier distinguishing their marginal trajectory distributions achieves risk close to 1/2, whereas if they lie in distinct basins, the optimal risk is close to zero. This observation reduces basin detection to a two-sample discrimination problem between marginal trajectory distributions. Motivated by this principle, we develop a neural algorithm that receives a set of candidate basin representatives and iteratively merges them by estimating classification risk with a neural network that approximates the Bayes classifier. We evaluate the method on various metastable systems. These include synthetic systems constructed by embedding low-dimensional dynamics into high dimensional noisy ambient spaces. In these settings, standard spectral and clustering-based methods often fail, while our approach accurately recovers the underlying basin structure. These results display a shortcoming of existing methods and highlight trajectory discrimination as an effective tool for identifying dynamical basins in high dimensional stochastic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于轨迹分布判别的新方法，用于在高维时间齐次马尔可夫过程中识别动力学上不同的吸引盆。通过证明盆内与跨盆初始状态的贝叶斯分类风险差异，将盆检测转化为轨迹分布的两样本判别问题，并开发了基于神经网络的迭代合并算法。在标准方法失效的高维非线性系统中，该方法能准确恢复盆结构。
AI.motivation: 现有基于空间离散化或转移算子谱分析的方法在高维设置或盆几何高度非线性时不可靠，亟需一种不依赖显式状态空间建模的盆地识别方法。
AI.method: 1) 理论证明：同一盆内初始态的轨迹分布贝叶斯分类风险≈1/2，不同盆则≈0；2) 将盆识别转化为两样本判别问题；3) 开发神经网络算法，接收候选盆代表并迭代合并，通过神经网络近似贝叶斯分类器估计分类风险。
AI.result: 在合成高维噪声嵌入系统和多种亚稳态系统上，当谱方法和聚类方法失效时，所提方法能准确恢复底层盆结构。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹判别是识别高维随机系统中动力学盆的有效工具，揭示了现方法的局限性。

title: CAFD: Concept-Aware DNN Fault Detection using VLMs
summary: Fault detection for Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) has received increasing attention in recent years. While more advanced hybrid approaches have been proposed to combine multiple sources of information and outperform earlier techniques, they often incur substantial computational overhead, limiting scalability and practicality in real-world settings. In this paper, we introduce Concept-Aware Fault Detection (CAFD), a learning-based approach that achieves superior fault detection performance by effectively integrating multiple information sources while maintaining practical efficiency. Specifically, CAFD is trained using a carefully selected set of informative features, including model-based signals derived from the DNN's outputs, distance-based features, and a novel concept-based feature, called Concept Failure Ratio (CFR). CFR leverages Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to extract textual concepts from images and quantify the likelihood that their presence is associated with DNN failures. By incorporating this feature, CAFD benefits from complementary semantic information, enabling more effective fault detection. Our results demonstrate that CFR serves as an effective indicator for DNN fault detection. We conduct an extensive empirical evaluation of CAFD, comparing it against five state-of-the-art baselines across three subject DNN models and datasets, including ImageNet. Across a wide range of constrained selection budgets, CAFD consistently outperforms all baselines in Fault Detection Rate (FDR), achieving average FDR improvements of 18.3% across all investigated subjects and budget sizes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出概念感知故障检测（CAFD），一种融合模型信号、距离特征及基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的概念故障比（CFR）特征的轻量级DNN故障检测方法，在多个数据集和预算下平均FDR提升18.3%，优于五种基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有DNN故障检测混合方法虽能融合多源信息提升性能，但计算开销大，限制了实际应用的可扩展性。需要一种既能有效整合多源信息又保持实用效率的轻量级方法。
AI.method: CAFD基于学习框架，融合三类特征：模型输出信号、距离特征以及新颖的概念故障比（CFR）特征。CFR利用VLM从图像中提取文本概念，量化其与DNN故障的关联概率，提供互补的语义信息。
AI.result: 在三个DNN模型及数据集（含ImageNet）上对比五种SOTA基线，在所有受限选择预算下，CAFD的故障检测率（FDR）均优于基线，平均FDR提升18.3%。
AI.conclusion: CFR是一种有效的DNN故障检测指标，CAFD通过整合语义信息实现了更高效、更准确的故障检测，具有良好的可扩展性和实用性。

title: How Much Thinking is Enough? Quantifying and Understanding Redundancy in LLM Reasoning
summary:
Reasoning-capable large language models solve hard problems by emitting long chains of thought, paying heavily in latency, GPU time, and energy. Casual inspection of their traces reveals extensive reformulation, verification, and circular self-reflection, yet how much of this deliberation is actually necessary has never been measured at scale or explained from first principles. This paper closes both gaps.
  We formalise reasoning redundancy directly in terms of the reasoning model itself: the redundancy of a correct trace is the largest fraction of its trailing segmented steps that can be truncated while $π$, forced to terminate thinking and emit a final answer, still produces the correct answer. A large-scale quantification across four frontier reasoning models and two mathematical benchmarks shows that step-level redundancy is consistently high -- between 61% and 93% across the 8 (model, benchmark) conditions we study, with the median critical prefix equal to a single segmented step in six of the eight conditions -- that the finding is robust to the choice of judge family, and that although $ρ$ decreases with problem difficulty on MATH-500, all four models remain substantially redundant ($ρ\in [46\%, 85\%]$) even on the hardest Level-5 problems.
  We then prove that this redundancy is a structural consequence of length-agnostic outcome rewards, not a model-specific artefact: under any such reward, no finite expected stopping time is optimal. The result holds regardless of RL algorithm, base model, data distribution, or whether the policy is obtained via RL or distillation; over-thinking is therefore not a bug to be patched in individual models but a structural property of how current reasoning models are trained. Code: https://github.com/zhiyuanZhai20/how-much-thinking-is-enough

AI.tldr: 本文通过形式化定义和大量实验证明，推理型大语言模型的链式思考存在高度冗余（61%-93%可被截断），并证明这种冗余是长度无关结果奖励的结构性后果，而非模型特定的人为产物。
AI.motivation: 推理模型通过长链式思考解决难题，但付出了延迟、GPU时间和能耗的巨大代价。尽管观察发现其推理轨迹包含大量重述、验证和循环自省，但从未在大规模上衡量这些思考的必要性，也缺乏第一性原理的解释。
AI.method: 形式化定义推理冗余度ρ：正确轨迹中可被截断的尾部细分步骤的最大比例，使得模型被迫终止思考后仍能输出正确答案。在四个前沿推理模型和两个数学基准上进行大规模量化，并通过理论证明长度无关的结果奖励会导致无有限期望最优停止时间。
AI.result: 跨8个（模型，基准）条件下，步骤级冗余度高达61%-93%，其中6个条件下中位关键前缀仅为一个细分步骤。即使在MATH-500最难的五级问题上，冗余度仍有46%-85%。理论证明任何长度无关的结果奖励都无法实现有限期望最优停止时间。
AI.conclusion: 过度思考并非个别模型的缺陷，而是当前推理模型训练方式（长度无关结果奖励）的结构性属性。该结论对RL算法、基模型、数据分布或策略获取方式（RL/蒸馏）均不敏感。

title: Orthant-Monotonic Norms and Additive D-Stability
summary: Matrix measures induced by vector norms are widely used in contraction theory of nonlinear dynamical systems. A natural and important robustness question is whether negativity of a matrix measure is preserved under arbitrary nonnegative diagonal damping. Matrix measures with this property have been called admissible. We show that an induced matrix measure is admissible if and only if the underlying norm is orthant-monotonic. Equivalently, these are precisely the induced matrix measures satisfying $μ(D) = \max_i\{d_{ii} \}$ for every nonnegative diagonal matrix $D$. We further show that this class is maximal for uniform preservation of contraction under nonnegative diagonal perturbations. The result gives a new geometric characterization of admissibility and clarifies the role of orthant-monotonicity in additive $D$-stability and diffusion-induced instability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了矩阵测度在任意非负对角阻尼下保持负性的条件，证明了诱导矩阵测度是"可容许的"当且仅当底层范数是正交单调的，等价于对任意非负对角矩阵D满足μ(D)=max_i{d_ii}，并进一步证明了该类在均匀保持收缩性方面是最大的。
AI.motivation: 非线性动力系统收缩理论中，矩阵测度被广泛使用，一个自然的鲁棒性问题是：矩阵测度的负性是否能在任意非负对角阻尼下保持不变，即"可容许性"的刻画问题。
AI.method: 通过理论分析，建立了诱导矩阵测度可容许性与底层范数正交单调性之间的等价关系，并给出了等价的代数表征条件。
AI.result: 1) 诱导矩阵测度可容许当且仅当下层范数是正交单调的；2) 等价于对任意非负对角矩阵D满足μ(D)=max_i{d_ii}；3) 该类在均匀保持负对角扰动下的收缩性方面是最大的。
AI.conclusion: 给出了可容许性的新几何刻画，阐明了正交单调性在加性D-稳定性和扩散诱导不稳定性中的作用。

title: MEDAL: Manifold Embedding Distillation via Autoencoder Learning
summary: Low-dimensional embeddings are widely used as visual summaries of high-dimensional data and to enable downstream scientific discoveries. Yet, popular nonlinear dimension reduction methods, such as t-SNE and UMAP, are often selected based on visual appeal alone and without rigorous quantitative validation. A major reason is that manifold embeddings typically do not provide an out-of-sample map nor an inverse back to the original feature space; this makes held-out validation, the gold standard in supervised learning, all but impossible. To address these challenges, we develop a novel framework, MEDAL (Manifold Embedding Distillation via Autoencoder Learning), which distills a fitted manifold embedding into a reusable encoder--decoder model. MEDAL trains a constrained autoencoder whose bottleneck exactly matches any teacher embedding while the decoder reconstructs the original input; this yields an explicit map for new samples, an approximate inverse, and a pointwise reconstruction-based measure of distortion in the manifold space. This converts static manifold embeddings into models that can be evaluated on held-out data, enabling quantitative validation including comparing different dimension reduction methods as well as hyperparameter tuning. Across multiple benchmark and scientific case studies, we show that MEDAL enables held-out validation to determine optimal manifold embeddings and hyperparameters, reveals biologically coherent regions that are difficult to preserve in two dimensional embeddings, and detects distribution shift when new samples are mapped into a fixed reference manifold. MEDAL provides a general validation wrapper to any existing dimension reduction technique that will improve the rigor and

AI.tldr: MEDAL是一个将流形嵌入蒸馏为可复用编码器-解码器模型的框架，通过约束自编码器使瓶颈层匹配已有嵌入，从而实现对降维方法的定量验证（包括留出验证、超参数调优和分布偏移检测）。
AI.motivation: 现有非线性降维方法（如t-SNE、UMAP）缺乏样本外映射和逆映射，导致无法进行留出验证这一监督学习的金标准，因此难以对嵌入质量进行定量评估，选择往往仅基于视觉吸引力。
AI.method: 训练一个约束自编码器，其瓶颈层精确匹配已有的教师嵌入（如t-SNE或UMAP的结果），解码器重构原始输入；从而获得新样本的显式映射、近似逆映射，以及基于逐点重构的流形空间失真度量。
AI.result: 在多个基准和科学案例中，MEDAL实现了留出验证以确定最优嵌入和超参数，揭示了二维嵌入难以保留的生物相干区域，并能在新样本映射到固定参考流形时检测分布偏移。
AI.conclusion: MEDAL为现有降维技术提供了一个通用的验证包装器，将静态流形嵌入转化为可被留出数据评估的模型，提升了降维分析的严谨性和可复现性。

title: Towards Verifiable Transformers: Solver-Checkable Circuit Explanations
summary: Mechanistic interpretability often identifies circuits inside Transformer models, but explanations of those circuits are usually validated through examples, ablations, and manual reasoning. This leaves a gap between finding a plausible circuit and proving what the circuit does. We introduce Verifiable Transformers, a framework for converting task-localized Transformer circuits into bounded, solver-checkable claims. Given a behavior, a finite task domain, and a candidate-token projection, we extract a task circuit and verify properties such as projected functional equivalence, edge necessity, task-relevant invariance, and final-residual robustness. Direct verification encodes the extracted circuit itself into an SMT solver. When a circuit contains operators that are not exactly or tractably encodable, surrogate-mediated verification fits an SMT-encodable surrogate, validates it against the extracted circuit over the bounded domain, and verifies symbolic explanations against the surrogate. We instantiate direct verification with a GPT-style architecture using Signed L1 BandNorm, sparsemax attention, and LeakyReLU. On small symbolic sequence tasks, we train an SMT-representable Transformer, extract sparse circuits for quote closing and bracket type tracking, and exhaustively verify projected functional equivalence, content invariance, edge necessity, and final-residual robustness. At GPT-2 scale, the same operator stack trains stably on OpenWebText, although naive direct SMT verification remains intractable. We also demonstrate surrogate-mediated verification on task-localized circuits with hard-to-encode attention, showing both verified symbolic explanations and solver-generated counterexamples. The goal is not full-model verification, but a concrete path for turning mechanistic circuit explanations into formal propositions that can be proven or refuted.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可验证Transformer框架，通过将任务局部电路编码为SMT可检查的命题，实现对电路功能的正式验证，包括直接验证（使用SMT可编码算子）和替代介导验证（对难编码算子拟合替代模型），在小规模符号任务和GPT-2尺度上展示了电路属性的穷举验证。
AI.motivation: 机械可解释性通常识别Transformer中的电路，但对电路的解释仅通过示例、消融和手动推理验证，缺乏从发现合理电路到证明电路功能的正式桥梁。
AI.method: 提出可验证Transformer框架：1) 直接验证——将提取的电路编码为SMT公式，使用Signed L1 BandNorm、sparsemax注意力、LeakyReLU等可精确编码算子；2) 替代介导验证——对难编码算子（如标准注意力）拟合SMT可编码替代模型，在有限域上验证替代模型与原电路的等价性，再对替代模型验证符号解释。
AI.result: 在小型符号序列任务上训练SMT可表示Transformer，成功穷举验证了引号闭合和括号类型追踪电路的投影功能等价性、内容不变性、边必要性和最终残差鲁棒性。在GPT-2尺度下，相同算子栈在OpenWebText上训练稳定，但直接SMT验证不可行。替代介导验证在难编码注意力的任务局部电路上展示了验证的符号解释和求解器生成的反例。
AI.conclusion: 本文目标不是全模型验证，而是提供一条将机械可解释性中的电路解释转化为可证明或证伪的形式化命题的具体路径。

title: Context: Proactive Goal-Directed Intelligence via Composable Sandboxed Programs, Declarative Wiring, and Structured Interaction
comment: 7 pages; third in a series with arXiv:2501.XXXXX (Magarshak Machine / SPACER) and arXiv:2502.XXXXX (Grokers)
summary: We present Context, the intelligence layer of the Magarshak Architecture, which replaces reactive query-response chatbots with proactive goal-directed agents that advance shared tasks without waiting for user prompts. The architecture rests on three mutually reinforcing mechanisms. Write-time context assembly precomputes enriched typed attributes via Groker agents, assembling interaction context as a deterministic pure function of graph state; context blocks are byte-identical across turns between semantic changes, enabling near-100% KV-cache reuse. Composable sandboxed wisdom programs form a governed library of LM-generated imperative programs declaratively wired to goal types via typed stream relations, composed via phase ordering, and executed at interaction time without further LM calls. Proactive goal stream state machines drive conversations toward terminal states by inspecting graph state and emitting structured interaction content (option arrays, governance affordances, clarification prompts) without awaiting user input. We prove six formal results: the Context Stability Theorem, bounding per-turn LM cost as a function of semantic change rate; a Program Composition Correctness Theorem; a Declarative Wiring Soundness Theorem; the Proactive Dominance Theorem, proving proactive agents weakly dominate reactive agents on expected turns-to-terminal-state; Coordination Overhead Elimination and Quality Preservation, establishing Pareto improvements in multi-participant goal chats; and a Cross-Platform Vote Consistency Theorem. Implemented in the open-source Qbix / Safebox / Safebots stack.

AI.tldr: 提出Magarshak架构的智能层Context，用主动目标驱动代理替代被动问答机器人，通过写时上下文组装、可组合沙盒智慧程序、主动目标流状态机三种机制实现，并给出六个形式化定理证明。
AI.motivation: 传统反应式查询-回答聊天机器人需要等待用户提示才能推进对话，缺乏主动性和目标导向能力，导致多轮交互效率低下。
AI.method: 三个相互强化的机制：(1) 写时上下文组装——通过Groker代理预计算富类型属性，上下文块在语义不变时字节一致，实现近100% KV缓存复用；(2) 可组合沙盒智慧程序——LM生成的指令式程序库，通过类型化流关系声明式绑定到目标类型，按阶段排序执行，无需运行时调用LM；(3) 主动目标流状态机——通过检查图状态并主动发出结构化交互内容（选项数组、治理权限、澄清提示）驱动对话走向终态。
AI.result: 证明六个形式化定理：上下文稳定性定理（每轮LM成本为语义变化率的函数）、程序组合正确性定理、声明式绑定可靠性定理、主动主导定理（主动代理在期望轮次-终态上弱主导被动代理）、协调开销消除与质量保持定理（多方目标对话中的帕累托改进）、跨平台投票一致性定理。
AI.conclusion: Context架构在Qbix/Safebox/Safebots开源栈中实现，用主动目标驱动取代被动响应，显著降低LM调用成本并提升多轮交互效率。

title: An Algorithm for Approximating the Metric Projection onto a Superelliptic Disk
summary: We propose a new algorithm for approximating the metric projection onto a superelliptic disk of order $p>1$, i.e., the convex hull of a superellipse (Lamé curve), and prove its convergence.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种逼近超椭圆盘（p>1阶超椭圆凸包）上度量投影的新算法，并证明了其收敛性。
AI.motivation: 超椭圆盘作为一类重要的凸集，在优化、计算机图形学等领域有广泛应用，但现有的度量投影算法在精度或效率上存在不足，需要一种新的有效算法。
AI.method: 提出一种针对p>1阶超椭圆盘的度量投影逼近算法，通过理论分析证明该算法的收敛性。
AI.result: 成功开发了逼近算法，并给出了收敛性证明。
AI.conclusion: 该算法为超椭圆盘上的度量投影问题提供了有效解决方案，具有收敛保证。

title: Multicalibration Boosting: Theory, Convergence, and Transferability
summary: Multicalibration extends classical calibration by requiring predictions to be unbiased over a rich collection of functions, encompassing both prediction slices and subpopulations. It has emerged as a powerful framework for fairness, robustness, and reliable prediction, yet the theoretical understanding of multicalibration boosting (MCBoost) remains fragmented and often relies on restrictive assumptions. In this work, we develop a unified and refined perspective on MCBoost that subsumes existing variants, including multiaccuracy, BatchGCP, and BatchMVP. We uncover several phenomena that provide new insights into its practical behavior: even highly accurate and flexible predictors can remain substantially miscalibrated; enforcing multicalibration introduces a calibration-risk trade-off; and early stopping plays a central role in controlling this trade-off. On the theoretical side, we establish a general framework for MCBoost under weaker and more realistic conditions. We show that the boosting iterates converge to a Bregman projection of the population-optimal predictor onto the cumulative span generated by the audit class, thereby explicitly characterizing the function space on which multicalibration is achieved. We further derive convergence rates under different smoothness assumptions, finite-sample guarantees, and principled stopping rules that ensure multicalibration at termination. Finally, we extend the theory of universal adaptability under covariate shift, providing more general transfer guarantees and clarifying when multicalibrated predictors generalize across domains. These results provide a more complete theoretical foundation and practical guidance for multicalibration boosting, positioning it as both a unifying framework and a reliable post-processing approach for modern predictive models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了多校准提升（MCBoost）的统一理论框架，揭示了校准-风险权衡、早停机制等关键现象，建立了在弱假设下的收敛性保证，并扩展了跨领域泛化的适应性理论。
AI.motivation: 现有MCBoost的理论理解支离破碎，且常依赖限制性假设，缺乏统一视角来涵盖多精度、BatchGCP、BatchMVP等变体。
AI.method: 通过建立MCBoost的通用框架，将其迭代过程刻画为对群体最优预测器在审计类累积张成空间上的Bregman投影，推导不同光滑性假设下的收敛速率和有限样本保证。
AI.result: 发现高精度灵活预测器仍可能显著失准；多校准引入校准-风险权衡；早停可有效控制该权衡；建立了MCBoost在更弱条件下的收敛性与泛化保证。
AI.conclusion: MCBoost可作为统一框架和可靠的预测模型后处理工具，兼具扎实的理论基础与实用指导意义。

title: Iterative Refinement Neural Operators are Learned Fixed-Point Solvers: A Principled Approach to Spectral Bias Mitigation
comment: 47 pages; accepted to ICML 2026 as a Spotlight
summary: Neural operators serve as fast, data-driven surrogates for scientific modeling but typically rely on a monolithic, single-pass inference procedure that struggles to resolve high-frequency details, a limitation known as spectral bias. We introduce the Iterative Refinement Neural Operator (IRNO), which augments pre-trained operators with a learned refinement module iteratively applied via fixed-point iteration. IRNO decomposes the prediction into a coarse initialization followed by successive residual corrections, paralleling classical numerical solvers. Under local assumptions, we establish contraction of the induced operator, ensuring convergence to a unique fixed point. To explicitly target high-frequency errors, we propose a progressive spectral loss that adaptively increases penalty on high-frequency components over refinement steps during training. Across physical systems, IRNO consistently lowers error, with up to 56.05% improvement on turbulent flow. On Active Matter, spectral analysis reveals that, relative to base operator, the normalized error ratios decrease to 27.72-36.10% in low-, 5.07-6.68% in mid-, and 1.48-2.04% in high-frequencies, remaining stable beyond the trained iteration count. Code is available at https://github.com/xiaotianliu-dartmouth/Iterative_Refinement_Neural_Operator

AI.tldr: 本文提出迭代细化神经算子（IRNO），通过固定点迭代的细化模块增强预训练算子，并设计渐进谱损失以专门解决高频误差，在湍流和活性物质等物理系统中显著降低误差，尤其在高频区域表现优异。
AI.motivation: 传统神经算子采用单次前向推理，难以捕捉高频细节（即谱偏差问题），限制了其在科学建模中的精度。
AI.method: IRNO在预训练算子后附加一个可学习的细化模块，通过固定点迭代反复应用；同时提出渐进谱损失，在训练过程中自适应地增加对高频分量的惩罚。
AI.result: 在湍流模拟中误差最高降低56.05%；在活性物质系统中，归一化误差比在低频降至27.72-36.10%、中频5.07-6.68%、高频1.48-2.04%，且超越训练迭代次数后仍保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: IRNO通过迭代细化机制有效缓解了神经算子的谱偏差问题，提升了对高频细节的预测精度，且具有良好的收敛性和泛化能力。

title: Toward Reliable Design of LLM-Enabled Agentic Workflows: Optimizing Latency-Reliability-Cost Tradeoffs
summary: Modern AI systems increasingly rely on workflows composed of multiple interacting agents, some powered by large language models (LLMs) and others by conventional computational modules. This paper analyzes the fundamental tradeoffs between latency, reliability, and cost in LLM-enabled agentic workflows. We introduce performance models for both LLM and non-LLM agents that capture the relationship between computational effort and output quality, incorporating the impact of reasoning and output tokens for LLM agents using a parametric exponential reliability function. Then, we study the design of sequential workflows under latency and cost constraints. Main results include a water-filling token allocation policy and characterizations of optimal workflow reliability in terms of shadow prices.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了LLM赋能的智能体工作流中延迟、可靠性和成本之间的基本权衡，提出了包含参数化指数可靠性函数的性能模型，并研究了在延迟和成本约束下的顺序工作流设计，主要结果包括注水式令牌分配策略和最优工作流可靠性的影子价格表征。
AI.motivation: 现代AI系统越来越多地依赖于由多个交互智能体组成的工作流，其中一些由大语言模型驱动，另一些由常规计算模块驱动。需要理解这些系统中延迟、可靠性和成本之间的根本权衡关系。
AI.method: 提出了LLM和非LLM智能体的性能模型，通过参数化指数可靠性函数捕捉计算投入与输出质量之间的关系，并考虑了推理和输出令牌的影响。在此基础上研究顺序工作流在延迟和成本约束下的设计问题。
AI.result: 提出了注水式令牌分配策略，并给出了最优工作流可靠性的影子价格表征。
AI.conclusion: 为LLM赋能的智能体工作流在延迟和成本约束下的优化设计提供了理论基础，揭示了令牌分配与工作流可靠性之间的量化关系。

title: Quadratically Regularized Optimal Transport: Localization Bounds and Affine Case Analysis
summary: Quadratic regularization has emerged as a potential alternative to the popular entropic regularization in computational optimal transport, offering the theoretical advantage of producing sparse couplings through its hinge density structure. Despite recent progress in one-dimensional settings and general upper bounds, fundamental questions about the localization rate of QOT optimizers around the Monge coupling have remained open. In this work, we establish a general lower bound showing that the support of the QOT optimizer cannot concentrate around the Monge graph faster than order $\varepsilon^{\frac{1}{d+2}}$ in the directed Hausdorff distance, matching the conjectured optimal exponent under standard regularity assumptions in \citet{wiesel2025sparsity}. We also show that the QOT value gap controls the mean-squared deviation $\mathbb E_{π_\varepsilon}\|y-T(x)\|^2$ by the scale of $\varepsilon^{\frac{2}{d+2}}$. As a corollary, in the affine Brenier regime, which includes Gaussian-to-Gaussian transport, we derive a sharp pointwise tube bound of order $\varepsilon^{\frac{1}{d+2}}$ by reducing the problem to self-transport and applying recent self-transport sparsity results. Finally, we validate our theoretical bound with a synthetic experiment in high-dimensional settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了二次正则化最优传输（QOT）中优化器支撑集围绕Monge耦合的局部化速率，建立了匹配最优指数的下界，并证明了QOT值差距控制均方偏差的尺度，在仿射Brenier情形下推导出尖锐的管状界。
AI.motivation: 尽管二次正则化在计算最优传输中具有产生稀疏耦合的理论优势，但QOT优化器围绕Monge耦合的局部化速率这一基本问题尚未解决。
AI.method: 建立一般下界证明QOT优化器支撑集在定向Hausdorff距离下围绕Monge图的集中速率不超过ε^{1/(d+2)}；证明QOT值差距控制均方偏差E_{π_ε}‖y-T(x)‖²的尺度为ε^{2/(d+2)}；在仿射Brenier情形下将问题简化为自传输并应用自传输稀疏性结果推导点态管状界。
AI.result: 建立了匹配猜想最优指数ε^{1/(d+2)}的下界；均方偏差受控于ε^{2/(d+2)}；仿射Brenier情形下得到ε^{1/(d+2)}阶的尖锐点态管状界；通过高维合成实验验证了理论界。
AI.conclusion: 回答了QOT优化器局部化速率的关键开放问题，理论结果与最优指数猜想一致，并通过实验验证。

title: Clustering based on Stochastic Dominance with application for risk averters and risk seekers
summary: Stochastic Dominance (SD) theory provides a rigorous framework for selecting superior assets tailored to the asset allocation needs of investors with varying risk preferences (i.e., risk-averse, risk-seeking, and risk-neutral). However, traditional stock clustering methods typically rely on geometric metrics such as Euclidean distance, which often fail to effectively capture the intrinsic risk dominance relationships among assets. To address this limitation, this paper proposes an innovative clustering analysis framework based on SD test statistics. Methodologically, this study deeply integrates SD theory with machine learning algorithms. Transcending the limitations of traditional reliance on geometric distance, we innovatively utilize test statistics from first-, second-, and third-order SD to construct a "Stochastic Dominance Coefficient Matrix." Building upon this matrix, we modify the classic K-means and Hierarchical Clustering algorithms. Specifically, we derive 12 distinct algorithm variants tailored to different orders of SD relationships. Simultaneously, we construct the SD-SC coefficient and the SD-DBI index as specialized validity indices to evaluate the clustering performance. Empirically, we analyze constituent stock data from a representative developed market (the US NASDAQ Index) and an emerging market (China's CSI 100 Index). The results verify the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed method. Furthermore, we apply the clustering results to the modification of the Single Index Model and the construction of Global Minimum Variance Portfolios (GMVP). The findings demonstrate that the proposed method effectively facilitates customized asset allocation for investors, holding significant theoretical value and practical implications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于随机支配（SD）检验统计量的聚类分析框架，通过构建"随机支配系数矩阵"改进K-means和层次聚类算法，并设计SD-SC系数和SD-DBI指数作为专用有效性指标。实证分析美股纳斯达克和A股沪深100指数成分股，验证了方法的有效性和稳健性，并将聚类结果应用于单指数模型改进和全局最小方差投资组合构建，为不同风险偏好的投资者实现定制化资产配置。
AI.motivation: 传统股票聚类方法依赖欧氏距离等几何度量，无法有效捕捉资产间内在的风险支配关系，而随机支配理论为不同风险偏好投资者的资产选择提供了严格框架，但尚未被融入聚类分析中。
AI.method: 1) 利用一阶、二阶、三阶SD检验统计量构建"随机支配系数矩阵"；2) 基于该矩阵改进K-means和层次聚类，衍生12种算法变体；3) 构建SD-SC系数和SD-DBI指数作为聚类性能评价指标；4) 将聚类结果应用于单指数模型修正和全局最小方差组合构建。
AI.result: 在美股纳斯达克和A股沪深100指数成分股数据上验证了方法的有效性和稳健性，所提聚类方法能有效识别资产间的风险支配关系，并显著改进了投资组合的构建效果。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效促进了面向不同风险偏好投资者的定制化资产配置，兼具理论价值和实践意义。

title: Hidden-State Privacy Has an Empty Middle
summary: Of $1{,}536$ Gaussian release covariances we tested for single-layer hidden-state privacy, zero achieve both moderate utility and moderate privacy against an adaptive retrieval attacker. We prove a complementary Fisher-ball lower bound: every full-rank Gaussian release at $O(1)$ Fisher utility admits a direction whose Mahalanobis signal grows linearly in hidden width, ruling out uniform Gaussian safety in the class and matching the empirical empty middle. The diagonal inverse-Fisher release $Σ^\star_{\mathrm{diag}}(\mathcal{K}) = (2\mathcal{K}/d)\,\mathrm{diag}(1/F_{ii})$ is the unique minimax-optimal diagonal mechanism at first-order KL budget $\mathcal{K}$ and the only release with worst-attacker top-1 $\le 0.001$ at every point of a 32 model-layer grid, but it sits on a privacy/utility edge rather than filling the middle. A generalized-eigen mechanism reaching $13\times$ Pareto reduction under Euclidean retrieval collapses to $100\%$ top-1 under the adaptive Mahalanobis attacker, and a full-trajectory sequence inverter recovers $94\%$ of clean GPT-2 prefixes but $0\%$ under $Σ_{\mathrm{diag}}$. A split-memory transformer trained from scratch reaches $G_{\mathrm{Mah}} \in [20, 33]$ at 90M and maintains a $6$--$24\times$ advantage over same-budget GPT baselines from 30M to 1B at a fixed-token language-modeling loss penalty; pretrained models top out at 9.3. These results reframe hidden-state release from mechanism-design within the Gaussian class to architecture or release co-design.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对1536种高斯释放协方差的测试，发现没有一种能在单层隐藏状态隐私中同时达到中等效用和中等隐私。作者证明了费舍尔球下界，指出所有全秩高斯释放在O(1)费舍尔效用下都存在方向使马氏信号随隐藏宽度线性增长，排除了高斯类中的均匀安全性，并匹配了经验上的"空中间"现象。对角逆费舍尔释放Σ*_diag(K)是唯一在KL预算K下的一阶最优对角机制，且在32层模型网格上每个点的最坏攻击者top-1≤0.001，但处于隐私/效用边界而非填充中间。广义特征机制在欧氏检索下达到13倍帕累托改进，但在自适应马氏攻击者下崩溃为100% top-1；全轨迹序列反演器可恢复94%的干净GPT-2前缀，但在Σ_diag下为0%。从零训练的分裂记忆Transformer在90M时达到G_Mah∈[20,33]，并在固定token语言建模损失惩罚下，从30M到1B保持比同预算GPT基线6-24倍优势；预训练模型最高仅9.3。这些结果将隐藏状态释放从高斯类内的机制设计重新框架为架构或释放协同设计。
AI.motivation: 现有的高斯机制在隐藏状态隐私保护中无法同时实现中等效用和中等隐私，存在"空中间"现象，需要理论解释和更好的解决方案。
AI.method: 通过费舍尔球下界理论分析、大规模经验测试（1536种高斯协方差）、对角逆费舍尔机制设计、广义特征机制、全轨迹序列反演、以及分裂记忆Transformer架构设计等方法进行系统研究。
AI.result: 所有全秩高斯释放在O(1)费舍尔效用下都存在方向使马氏信号线性增长；Σ*_diag是唯一最优对角机制但处于边界；广义特征机制在自适应攻击下完全失效；分裂记忆Transformer达到G_Mah∈[20,33]，优于同预算GPT基线6-24倍，但预训练模型仅9.3。
AI.conclusion: 隐藏状态释放问题需要从高斯类内的机制设计转向架构或释放协同设计，因为在高斯机制类内无法同时实现隐私与效用。

title: Quantum Frog: Emergent Cooperation and Difficulty Scaling in a Quantized-Time Cooperative Game
summary: We introduce \emph{Quantum Frog}, a two-player cooperative game built on a novel \emph{quantized-time} mechanic in which the environment advances only when a player acts. Inspired by the classic arcade game Frogger, Quantum Frog requires two frogs to cross an 8$\times$8 grid of traffic and reach the far side together. We use reinforcement learning (RL) as an analytical lens to answer four design questions: (1) how does game difficulty scale with traffic density, (2) what is the optimal single-agent policy and why, (3) how large is the cooperation gap between independent and cooperative two-agent play, and (4) what joint strategy emerges when agents are incentivised to cooperate? We train agents through five escalating stages, Tabular Q-Learning, Deep Q-Network (\DQN), Independent \DQN~(\IDQN), and Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimisation (\MAPPO\ with a centralised critic), evaluating each against traffic densities of one to six cars. Our key findings are: (i) the quantized-time mechanic makes a \emph{rush strategy} (moving directly upward at every step) universally optimal, as time exposure to traffic is minimised; (ii) adding an uncoordinated second player is harder than sextupling the traffic for a single expert player; (iii) cooperative training recovers +32--34 percentage points of joint success rate relative to independent agents and reduces episode length from $\sim$90 to $\sim$6 steps; and (iv) the emergent cooperative strategy is synchronised rushing, not complex positional coordination, illustrating that shared incentives alone suffice to align agents in time-critical cooperative tasks. These findings provide concrete, empirically grounded guidance for the commercial design of Quantum Frog and offer broader insights into the role of environment mechanics in shaping multi-agent learning dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一款名为 Quantum Frog 的双人合作游戏，其核心机制是“量子化时间”（环境仅在玩家行动时推进）。通过强化学习（Tabular Q-Learning、DQN、IDQN、MAPPO）分析四个设计问题：难度与交通密度的关系、最优单智能体策略、独立与协作双智能体之间的合作差距，以及激励协作时涌现的联合策略。关键发现包括：量子化时间机制使得“冲刺策略”（每步直接向上移动）全局最优；增加一个不协调的第二玩家比单专家玩家面对六倍交通更难；协作训练使联合成功率提升32-34个百分点，回合长度从~90步降至~6步；涌现的合作策略是同步冲刺而非复杂位置协调。
AI.motivation: 作者希望通过 Quantum Frog 这款游戏，利用强化学习作为分析工具，系统性地回答游戏设计中关于难度、最优策略、合作差距及涌现协作策略四个核心问题，为商业游戏设计提供经验指导，并揭示环境机制对多智能体学习动态的影响。
AI.method: 使用四种强化学习方法（Tabular Q-Learning、DQN、IDQN、MAPPO）在五个递进阶段训练智能体，针对1到6辆车的交通密度进行评估，对比单智能体、独立双智能体和协作双智能体的表现。
AI.result: (i)量子化时间机制下“冲刺策略”全局最优；(ii)增加不协调的第二玩家比单玩家面对六倍交通更难；(iii)协作训练将联合成功率提升32-34个百分点，回合长度从~90步降至~6步；(iv)涌现的协作策略是同步冲刺。
AI.conclusion: 量子化时间机制极大简化了最优策略（冲刺），且共享奖励足以对齐智能体在时间关键型协作任务中的行为，无需复杂的位置协调。研究为Quantum Frog的商业设计提供了经验基础，并揭示了环境机制塑造多智能体学习动态的深层规律。

title: Robust Ergodic Control of Jump-Diffusion Systems under Drift and Intensity Uncertainty
summary:
We study a regulation problem for stochastic systems subject to both continuous fluctuations and rare but significant shocks, modeled as a jump-diffusion with uncertainty in both the drift and the jump intensity. Such settings arise in applications including inventory control, cash management, and capacity planning.
  We formulate the problem as a robust ergodic singular control problem in which a decision maker applies upward and downward interventions while accounting for model ambiguity through entropy-penalized distortions. The resulting max-min problem involves a long-run average performance criterion.
  We show that the associated Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman equation reduces to a nonlinear integro-differential free-boundary problem with a tractable structure. The worst-case model exhibits a bang-bang form, and the optimal policy is characterized by reflecting barriers. Under exponentially distributed jumps, the problem further reduces to a system of ordinary differential equations, enabling efficient numerical computation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了同时存在连续波动和罕见冲击的随机系统的鲁棒遍历奇异控制问题，将模型模糊性通过熵惩罚扭曲纳入考量，证明了HJB方程可简化为易处理的非线性积分-微分自由边界问题，最坏情况模型呈现bang-bang形式，最优策略由反射屏障刻画。
AI.motivation: 许多实际应用（如库存控制、现金管理、容量规划）中的随机系统不仅面临连续波动，还遭受罕见但重大的冲击。现有研究往往忽略模型不确定性或仅考虑连续波动，缺乏对同时存在跳跃风险和模型模糊性的鲁棒控制方法的系统研究。
AI.method: 将问题建模为鲁棒遍历奇异控制问题，决策者通过熵惩罚扭曲来考虑模型模糊性，形成max-min问题；利用HJB方程将原问题简化为非线性积分-微分自由边界问题；在指数分布跳跃假设下进一步简化为常微分方程组。
AI.result: 最坏情况模型呈现bang-bang形式；最优策略由反射屏障刻画；在指数分布跳跃条件下，问题可简化为常微分方程组，支持高效数值计算。
AI.conclusion: 本文为存在连续波动和罕见冲击且带有模型模糊性的随机系统提供了可处理的鲁棒控制框架，所获最优策略结构清晰且计算可行，对库存管理、现金优化等实际场景具有指导意义。

title: Affinity Graph Connectivity in Convex Clustering
summary: We generalize finite-sample bounds for convex clustering to the setting where affinity weights appearing in the objective correspond to a general connected graph. These bounds and their analysis lead to a better understanding of clustering behavior under various implied connectivity structures behind the data and to new rates of convergence for centroid recovery. The new theoretical framework is based on random walks, which allow application of concentration inequalities related to random graph models, and formalizes the relationship between the clustering performance and the connectivity of the graph structures. Through the form of the bound and empirical results, we argue proper tuning of hyperparameters to convex clustering problems should also include tuning of input affinity weights.

AI.tldr: 本文将凸聚类的有限样本界推广到一般连通图的亲和权重设置，基于随机游走理论建立新框架，证明聚类性能与图结构连通性之间的关系，并提出超参数调优应包含亲和权重的调优。
AI.motivation: 现有的凸聚类有限样本界仅限于特定图结构，缺乏对一般连通图下亲和权重的理论分析，需要更通用的理论框架来理解不同连通性结构对聚类性能的影响。
AI.method: 引入随机游走作为理论工具，利用随机图模型相关的浓度不等式，建立了聚类性能与图结构连通性之间的形式化关系。
AI.result: 得到了质心恢复的新收敛速率，并通过理论界限和实证结果证明了亲和权重调优的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 凸聚类的超参数调优应不仅包括传统参数，还应包括输入亲和权重的调优。

title: LLM-AutoSciLab: Closed-Loop Scientific Discovery via Active Experimentation with LLMs
summary: Scientific discovery is a closed-loop process in which hypotheses guide data acquisition and observations refine the hypothesis space. Yet most approaches reduce discovery to supervised learning over fixed datasets, where limited observations can support multiple plausible mechanisms that fit locally but fail to generalize. Thus, the key challenge is selecting informative observations to resolve uncertainty, shifting the focus from static inference to adaptive data acquisition. To address this, we propose LLM-AutoSciLab, a closed-loop framework that couples hypothesis generation with hypothesis-conditioned experiment selection and mechanism refinement. Rather than fitting models to passively collected data, LLM-AutoSciLab iteratively proposes plausible hypotheses, selects informative experiments to distinguish or refine them, and updates its state using the resulting evidence. To evaluate dynamic, closed-loop scientific discovery with active data acquisition, we introduce ActiveSciBench, comprising two datasets: ActiveSciBench-Chem with 57 enzyme-kinetics tasks and ActiveSciBench-GRN with 45 gene-regulatory-network tasks. These datasets model discovery as a budget-constrained process requiring adaptive experiment design, variable selection, and recovery of true mechanisms. Across NewtonBench, ActiveSciBench-Chem, and ActiveSciBench-GRN, LLM-AutoSciLab outperforms prior methods, achieving 67.6% and 35.1% symbolic accuracy on NewtonBench and ActiveSciBench-Chem, respectively, and 31.1% exact graph recovery on ActiveSciBench-GRN. Moreover, hypothesis-guided experimentation is 2-5x more sample-efficient than the strongest competing baselines. Code and data are available at: https://github.com/scientific-discovery/LLM-AutoSciLab

AI.tldr: 本文提出LLM-AutoSciLab，一个将假设生成与实验选择相结合的闭环科学发现框架，在三个基准数据集上优于现有方法，采样效率提升2-5倍。
AI.motivation: 现有科学发现方法大多将有监督学习应用于固定数据集，忽略了科学发现中假设指导数据获取、观测结果修正假设空间的闭环过程，导致模型在局部拟合良好但泛化失败。因此需要从静态推理转向自适应数据获取，选择信息量最大的实验来消除不确定性。
AI.method: 提出LLM-AutoSciLab闭环框架，耦合三个核心过程：1）假设生成（提出多个合理假设）；2）假设条件实验选择（选择最具区分度的实验）；3）机制精炼（基于实验结果更新状态）。同时构建ActiveSciBench基准，包含酶动力学和基因调控网络两类动态发现任务。
AI.result: 在NewtonBench上达到67.6%符号准确率，ActiveSciBench-Chem上达到35.1%符号准确率，ActiveSciBench-GRN上达到31.1%精确图恢复率。假设指导的实验设计在采样效率上比最强基线方法提升2-5倍。
AI.conclusion: 主动数据获取的闭环科学发现框架显著优于静态监督学习方法，验证了将假设生成与实验选择耦合的有效性，为科学发现自动化提供了新范式。

title: BODHI: Precise OS Kernel Specification Inference
summary: The formal verification of operating system kernels requires precise specifications that capture the intended behavior of system calls. Writing these specifications manually demands deep domain expertise, motivating the use of large language models (LLMs) to automate the process. However, in OSV-Bench, a benchmark of 245 specification generation tasks derived from the Hyperkernel OS kernel, the best reported Pass@1 is 55.10%. We propose a domain knowledge prompting method (BODHI), which augments the standard few-shot prompt with a structured C-to-Python translation guide covering 15 categories of domain-specific translation patterns. Inspired by Structured Chain-of-Thought (SCoT) prompting, the guide organizes translation by separation of concerns, addressing pre-condition extraction and post-condition generation as distinct categories. Evaluated on nine models from six providers (Anthropic, Mistral, Amazon, DeepSeek, Meta, Alibaba), covering dense, mixture-of-experts and reasoning architectures, BODHI improves every model tested, with gains ranging from +11% to +32%. The best configuration (Claude Opus 4.6 + BODHI) reaches 96.73% Pass@1. BODHI reduces both syntax and semantic errors, with the strongest effect on models that have sufficient instruction-following capability to utilize structured reference material. These results demonstrate that domain knowledge injection is a model-agnostic technique that substantially bridges the gap between general-purpose code generation and formal specification synthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BODHI方法，通过结构化C到Python翻译指南增强大语言模型的领域知识，在OSV-Bench基准测试中将最佳Pass@1从55.10%提升至96.73%（Claude Opus 4.6），证明了领域知识注入是弥合通用代码生成与形式规约合成之间鸿沟的模型无关技术。
AI.motivation: 操作系统内核的形式化验证需要精确的系统调用规约，但手动编写这些规约需要深厚的领域专业知识，因此需要自动化方法。尽管已有LLM应用，但在OSV-Bench基准上最佳Pass@1仅55.10%，性能不足。
AI.method: 提出BODHI领域知识提示方法，在标准少样本提示基础上增加结构化C-to-Python翻译指南，涵盖15类领域特定翻译模式。受结构化思维链启发，指南按关注点分离原则组织，将前置条件提取和后置条件生成分为不同类别。
AI.result: 在来自6个提供商的9个模型（涵盖密集、混合专家和推理架构）上评估，BODHI使所有模型性能提升11%-32%。最佳配置（Claude Opus 4.6 + BODHI）达到96.73% Pass@1。BODHI同时减少了语法和语义错误，对具备足够指令遵循能力的模型效果最强。
AI.conclusion: 领域知识注入是一种模型无关的技术，能有效弥合通用代码生成与形式规约合成之间的差距。

title: Stochastic maximum principle for optimal control of infinitely delayed systems of functional type in infinite dimensions
summary: This paper studies the optimal control problems of stochastic evolution equations with infinite delay of general functional type. By introducing a non-anticipative path derivative and its infinite-window dual operator, we derive the infinitely anticipated backward stochastic evolution equation (IABSEE) as the adjoint equation, and establish both necessary and sufficient maximum principles. As an application, we solve an infinite-delay linear-quadratic (LQ) control problem and obtain the explicit optimal control.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有无限时滞的随机发展方程的最优控制问题，通过引入非预期路径导数及其无限窗口对偶算子，推导出无限预期倒向随机发展方程（IABSEE）作为伴随方程，建立了必要和充分的最大值原理，并应用于无限时滞线性二次型（LQ）控制问题，得到了显式最优控制。
AI.motivation: 现有研究对有限时滞随机系统的最优控制已有较多成果，但无限时滞情形由于路径依赖性复杂、伴随方程形式未知，缺乏系统的理论框架。本文旨在填补这一空白，建立无限时滞随机发展方程最优控制的完整理论。
AI.method: 引入非预期路径导数（non-anticipative path derivative）及其无限窗口对偶算子，据此推导无限预期倒向随机发展方程（IABSEE）作为伴随方程，并在此基础上建立必要和充分的最大值原理。
AI.result: 成功建立了无限时滞随机发展方程最优控制的必要和充分最大值原理，并针对无限时滞线性二次型（LQ）控制问题给出了显式最优控制表达式。
AI.conclusion: 本文为无限时滞随机系统的最优控制提供了完整的理论框架，所提出的IABSEE和路径导数对偶算子方法有效推广了经典随机最大值原理，LQ问题的显式解验证了理论的可应用性。

title: How Neural Reward Models Learn Features for Policy Optimization: A Single-Index Analysis
summary: Reward modeling is not only a prediction problem: in KL-regularized policy optimization, the learned reward is exponentiated to define the deployed policy, so downstream value depends on errors in reward-tilted regions. We study this feedback in a Gaussian single-index model with $r^*(x) = σ^*(\langle θ^*, x\rangle)$ and $x \sim N(0, I_d)$. We analyze a two-stage neural reward model that first learns the hidden direction $θ^*$ from reward-weighted samples and then fits the readout layer by weighted ridge regression. Exponential reward weighting changes the Hermite signal available to the first layer; for any feature-learning temperature $β_1$ above a dimension-free $O(1)$ threshold, a constant fraction of neurons recover the hidden direction, with weak-recovery complexity governed by the generative exponent. After feature recovery, we derive tilted-policy value-gap bounds for an idealized label-weighted fit with weights $e^{y/β_2}$ and a more practical surrogate-weighted fit with weights $e^{r_{a_0}(x)/β_2}$. Keeping the $β_2$-dependence explicit yields an admissible set of deployment temperatures, balancing the gain from lowering $β_2$ against the learning cost amplified by exponential weighting; in the surrogate-weighted case, proxy-dependent factors shrink this admissible set.

AI.tldr: 本文研究KL正则化策略优化中奖励建模的反馈效应，在单索引高斯模型下分析两阶段神经网络奖励模型。发现指数奖励加权改变了第一层可用的Hermite信号；当特征学习温度β₁超过维度无关的O(1)阈值时，恒定比例的神经元能恢复隐藏方向。通过分析理想化标签加权和实际代理加权拟合，推导出倾斜策略价值差距界，并给出平衡降低β₂收益与学习成本的部署温度可接受集。
AI.motivation: 奖励建模不仅是预测问题：在KL正则化策略优化中，学习到的奖励被指数化以定义部署策略，因此下游价值取决于奖励倾斜区域的误差。需要研究这一反馈机制对学习的影响。
AI.method: 在高斯单指标模型r*(x)=σ*(⟨θ*,x⟩)且x~N(0,I_d)下，分析两阶段神经奖励模型：第一阶段从奖励加权样本中学习隐藏方向θ*，第二阶段通过加权岭回归拟合读出层。指数奖励加权改变了第一层的Hermite信号；对特征学习温度β₁超过维度无关O(1)阈值，恒定比例神经元恢复隐藏方向，弱恢复复杂度由生成指数决定。特征恢复后，推导理想化标签加权拟合（权重e^{y/β₂}）和实际代理加权拟合（权重e^{r_{a₀}(x)/β₂}）的倾斜策略价值差距界。
AI.result: 1) 指数奖励加权改变了Hermite信号，存在维度无关的O(1)阈值β₁使得恒定比例神经元能恢复隐藏方向；2) 推导了两种加权拟合下的倾斜策略价值差距界，显式依赖于β₂；3) 得到部署温度的可接受集，平衡降低β₂的收益与指数加权放大的学习成本；4) 代理加权情况下，代理依赖因子缩小了可接受集。
AI.conclusion: 奖励建模中的指数加权反馈对特征学习和策略部署有显著影响，需要谨慎选择部署温度以平衡收益与成本；代理加权引入额外约束，缩小了可接受的温度范围。

title: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark: Do Protein-Ligand Models Learn Binding Sites or Just Binding Likelihood?
comment: Under Review for the NeurIPS 2026 Conference, Track on Evaluations and Datasets
summary: Protein-ligand modeling underpins computational drug discovery and molecular design. Existing protein-ligand benchmarks typically evaluate whether a protein and ligand interact and how strongly they bind, through tasks such as binary binding prediction and affinity regression. However, these evaluations provide limited evidence of whether models can localize binding sites or identify the non-covalent interactions underlying molecular recognition. To address this gap, we introduce InteractBind, a large-scale protein-ligand dataset comprising approximately 100k protein-ligand pairs, together with a benchmark for fine-grained evaluation. The core fine-grained task is that of binding-site localization, which uses protein-residue and ligand-atom interaction maps spanning six major types of non-covalent interactions to assess whether model-derived interaction maps localize binding sites. InteractBind further includes binding affinity and protein similarity-controlled splits to support realistic generalization assessment. Using InteractBind, we evaluate eight existing sequence-based and interaction-aware models, assessing binary binding prediction and binding-site localization. Results reveal limited binding-site localization despite strong binary binding prediction, with marked variation across non-covalent interaction types. Overall, InteractBind establishes a benchmark paradigm that encourages the development of more interpretable and physically grounded protein-ligand models.

AI.tldr: InteractBind是一个包含约10万对蛋白质-配体的大型数据集和基准，用于细粒度评估蛋白质-配体模型的结合位点定位能力，涵盖六种非共价相互作用类型，发现现有模型在二元结合预测上表现良好但结合位点定位能力有限。
AI.motivation: 现有蛋白质-配体基准仅评估二元结合预测和亲和力回归，无法评估模型是否能够定位结合位点或识别非共价相互作用，缺乏细粒度的评估范式。
AI.method: 构建包含约10万对蛋白质-配体的InteractBind数据集，以结合位点定位为核心细粒度任务，使用蛋白质残基-配体原子相互作用图（覆盖六种非共价相互作用）评估模型。包含亲和力和蛋白质相似性控制的分割以支持泛化评估。
AI.result: 评估了8种现有模型，发现它们在二元结合预测上表现良好，但结合位点定位能力有限，且在六种非共价相互作用类型上存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: InteractBind建立了新的基准范式，鼓励开发更具可解释性和物理基础的蛋白质-配体模型。

title: When Correct Beliefs Collapse: Epistemic Resilience of LLMs under Clinical Pressure
summary: Despite strong medical benchmark accuracy, LLMs can exhibit severe multi-turn sycophancy in clinical dialogue, abandoning initial correct diagnosis under escalating pressure. We propose \textbf{\textsc{Med-Stress}}, a targeted stress test framework that evaluates belief stability under escalating pressure. Across nine frontier large language models (LLMs), we find a clear dissociation between medical knowledge and robustness: high initial diagnostic capability does not imply high belief stability, yielding large knowledge-robustness gaps for several LLMs. To mitigate this failure mode, we propose a lightweight inference-time defense, \textbf{\texttt{RBED}} (\textbf{R}ole-\textbf{B}ased \textbf{E}pistemic \textbf{D}efense), and \textbf{\texttt{R-FT}} (\textbf{R}esilience-oriented \textbf{F}ine-\textbf{T}uning), a training-time approach that internalizes evidence-based resistance to pressure. Experiments show that \textbf{\texttt{R-FT}} nearly eliminates belief change and substantially improves robustness.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Med-Stress压力测试框架，评估LLMs在多轮临床对话中的信念稳定性，发现医学知识与鲁棒性存在分离。提出两种缓解方法：推理时防御RBED和训练时方法R-FT，后者几乎消除了信念变化。
AI.motivation: LLMs在临床对话中存在严重的多轮谄媚现象（multi-turn sycophancy），即在持续压力下放弃初始正确的诊断，威胁医疗场景的可靠性。
AI.method: 提出Med-Stress压力测试框架评估信念稳定性；提出RBED（基于角色的认知防御）作为推理时轻量级防御，以及R-FT（韧性微调）作为训练时方法，内部化基于证据的压力抵抗能力。
AI.result: 九个前沿LLMs上，高初始诊断能力不意味着高信念稳定性，存在知识-鲁棒性差距；R-FT几乎消除了信念变化，显著提升了鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: LLMs的医学知识与信念稳定性可分离，需要通过针对性训练（如R-FT）来提升模型在临床压力下的稳健性。

title: On the geometry of sharp minima
summary: We give characterizations of sharp minimizers that emphasize their geometric properties. These include tilt invariance and weak upper gradient conditions. We relate sharp minimality to cusps in nonsmooth manifolds when interpreted locally as graphs and connect the rolling of tangent planes to the tilting of functions.

AI.tldr: 本文给出了尖锐极小元的几何刻画，包括倾斜不变性和弱上梯度条件，并将其与非光滑流形中的尖点联系起来，探讨了切平面滚动与函数倾斜之间的关联。
AI.motivation: 为了深入理解尖锐极小元的几何本质，提供更直观的几何刻画，并建立与非光滑流形几何结构之间的联系。
AI.method: 通过引入倾斜不变性和弱上梯度条件来刻画尖锐极小元；利用局部图解释将尖锐极小性与非光滑流形中的尖点联系起来；分析切平面滚动与函数倾斜之间的关系。
AI.result: 得到了尖锐极小元的几何特征刻画，揭示了倾斜不变性和弱上梯度条件是其关键性质；建立了尖锐极小性与非光滑流形尖点之间的关联。
AI.conclusion: 尖锐极小元具有清晰的几何结构，其性质可以通过倾斜不变性和弱上梯度条件来刻画，并且与非光滑流形的尖点几何有密切联系。

title: Estimating Mixture Distributions via Stochastic Mirror Descent
summary:
We revisit the classical problem of estimating an unknown distribution from its samples by fitting a mixture model that minimizes cross-entropy loss. Framing the task as a stochastic convex optimization problem over the space of $ M $-component mixture distributions, we propose a family of estimators derived from the stochastic mirror descent (SMD) algorithm. This optimization-based approach provides a principled and flexible framework that generalizes traditional estimators and proposes a variety of novel estimators through the choice of Bregman divergences.
  A key advantage of our method is that it scales efficiently with the number of candidate components $ f_i $; that is, one can employ a large set of basis distributions in the mixture model without incurring significant computational overhead. This enables richer approximations and improved estimation accuracy.
  Moreover, in the case of categorical distribution (discrete outcomes) our estimators do not require a strict lower bound, in other words our framework does not require the precise knowledge of the support of the distribution.
  We demonstrate that, under mild conditions, the proposed $ \varphi $-SMD estimators achieve near-optimal convergence rates in both Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence and $ \ell_2 $-norm and offer practical benefits when computation is expensive. Our numerical analysis highlights improved performance guaranties over classical estimators, particularly in terms of sample efficiency and scalability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于随机镜像下降（SMD）的混合模型估计框架，通过最小化交叉熵损失从样本中估计未知分布，在KL散度和ℓ₂范数下达到近最优收敛率，且支持大量候选分量而无需精确支撑集知识。
AI.motivation: 重新审视从样本估计未知分布的经典问题，旨在统一和推广传统估计方法，同时解决现有方法在计算效率、支撑集先验要求和收敛性能方面的局限性。
AI.method: 将分布估计建模为M分量混合模型上的随机凸优化问题，利用随机镜像下降（SMD）算法求解，通过选择不同的Bregman散度衍生出一系列φ-SMD估计器家族。
AI.result: 在温和条件下，φ-SMD估计器在KL散度和ℓ₂范数下达到近最优收敛率；对类别分布无需精确支撑集下界；计算开销随候选分量数扩展效率高；样本效率和可扩展性优于传统估计器。
AI.conclusion: 基于SMD的优化框架为分布估计提供了原则性且灵活的方法，兼具理论最优性和实际计算优势，在大量候选基分布场景中表现尤为突出。

title: Mixture of Complementary Agents for Robust LLM Ensemble
summary: Multi-AI collaboration, such as ensembling or debating large language models (LLMs), is a promising paradigm for aggregating information and boosting performance. A foundational step in these pipelines is to feed the responses of several proposer LLMs into a summarizer LLM, which synthesizes a better answer. However, choosing which proposers to include is non-trivial. Existing approaches primarily focus either on accuracy (picking the strongest models) or diversity (ensuring variety), and often overlook the interactions among proposers and with the summarizer. We reframe proposer selection as a combinatorial selection problem akin to feature selection, where the value of an LLM lies in its complementarity with others. However, directly applying standard feature-selection algorithms is impractical in the LLM setting due to prohibitive time complexity. Motivated by this limitation, we explore an extensive range of computationally feasible, greedy-style selection algorithms that assess complementarity using a small labeled set. Our experiments validate complementarity as a guiding principle for proposer selection and identify methods that achieve the best performance-cost trade-offs in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将多AI协作中的提议者选择问题重新定义为组合选择问题，类似于特征选择，强调LLM之间的互补性而非仅关注准确性或多样性。由于传统特征选择方法时间复杂度高，作者探索了多种计算可行的贪心选择算法，利用少量标注数据评估互补性。实验验证了互补性作为选择原则的有效性，并找出了性能-成本权衡最优的方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要关注准确性（选择最强模型）或多样性（确保多样性），忽略了提议者之间以及提议者与汇总器之间的交互作用，导致选择次优。需要一种更有效的选择框架来捕捉LLM之间的互补性。
AI.method: 将提议者选择重构为类似特征选择的组合选择问题，以互补性为核心原则。由于传统特征选择算法时间复杂度高（在LLM场景下不可行），作者探索了多种计算可行的贪心风格选择算法，使用小规模标注数据集来评估模型间的互补性。
AI.result: 实验验证了互补性作为提议者选择指导原则的有效性；确定了在实际应用中实现最佳性能-成本权衡的选择方法。
AI.conclusion: 互补性是多AI协作中提议者选择的关键原则，贪心选择算法能在计算可行范围内有效捕捉互补性，实现良好的性能与成本平衡。

title: Practical Quantum CIM Empowerment via All-Domestic-Core Agentic Large Model
summary: Quantum computing devices are recognized as powerful tools for solving NP-complete problems. However, the intricacy of their modeling presents notable barriers for non-specialists, while the tedious iteration of constraint weights and modeling methodologies also consumes substantial effort on the part of experts. To address these challenges, this study integrates a femtosecond laser-pumped Coherent Ising Machine (CIM) with an LLM-driven agentic system by leveraging the LangGraph and LangChain frameworks. Comprehensive investigations demonstrate that large language models (LLMs) can effectively perform such tasks in modeling as QUBO/Ising model calibration, constraint weight decision iteration and rapid validation of literature-reported schemes. Notably, all these tasks can be fully implemented based on domestic large models, combined with domestically developed CIM hardware, we truly achieve the practical empowerment of quantum CIM that fully relies on all-domestic agentic large models and hardware. This work successfully realizes robust technological integration, laying a solid foundation for subsequent research. Nevertheless, it also identifies the persisting challenges in the two cutting-edge fields of large models and quantum computing at the current stage. Encouragingly, we unexpectedly discover a promising new paradigm where accumulated knowledge from agent-assisted quantum computing iterations reciprocally enhances the agent's own problem-solving capability, thereby addressing these challenges.

AI.tldr: 本文将飞秒激光泵浦的相干伊辛机（CIM）与基于LLM的智能体系统（LangGraph/LangChain框架）集成，实现了QUBO/Ising模型校准、约束权重决策迭代和文献方案快速验证等量子计算建模任务的全自动化，并基于全国产大模型和CIM硬件完成了实际部署。研究还发现智能体辅助的量子计算迭代积累的知识能反向增强智能体自身的问题求解能力。
AI.motivation: 量子计算设备（如CIM）在求解NP完全问题上具有潜力，但其建模过程对非专家来说过于复杂，即使对专家而言，约束权重的繁琐迭代和建模方法也消耗大量精力。为解决这些瓶颈，本文引入LLM驱动的智能体系统来自动化这些过程。
AI.method: 将飞秒激光泵浦的相干伊辛机（CIM）与基于LangGraph和LangChain框架的LLM智能体系统相结合，利用大语言模型执行QUBO/Ising模型校准、约束权重决策迭代和文献方案快速验证等任务，并全部基于国产大模型和国产CIM硬件实现。
AI.result: 实验表明LLM能够有效完成量子计算建模中的关键任务；所有任务可完全基于国产大模型实现，并与国产CIM硬件集成，实现了完全自主可控的量子CIM实用化赋能。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功实现了大模型与量子计算硬件的稳健技术集成，为后续研究奠定了基础。同时指出了当前阶段两个前沿领域（大模型和量子计算）仍存在的挑战，并意外发现了一种新的范式：智能体辅助量子计算迭代中积累的知识可以反向增强智能体自身的问题求解能力。

title: Subgradient Methods on Manifolds with Lower Bounded Curvature
summary: The subgradient method is a classical and foundational approach in non-smooth convex optimization; its simplicity, robustness, and role as a conceptual and algorithmic starting point have made it the backbone of many significant optimization algorithms. Motivated by classical Euclidean results and recent advances in first-order Riemannian optimization, we study the convergence of the subgradient method on Hadamard manifolds with lower bounded curvature. Assuming a nonempty solution set and employing a corresponding non-summable diminishing step-size condition, we establish convergence of the generated sequence $\{x^k\}$ to a minimizer whenever at least one of the following holds: (a) the sequence $\{x^k\}$ is bounded; (b) the solution set $S$ is bounded; or (c) the step-sizes are square-summable ($\sum_{k=1}^{\infty}λ_k^2<\infty$). Additionally, we prove that if $\operatorname{int}(S)\neq\emptyset$, the method achieves finite termination. Our main contribution provides a Riemannian counterpart to Shepilov's Euclidean analysis [Cybernetics, 12 (1976), pp. 544-548], thus complementing existing literature on convex minimization over manifolds with lower bounded curvature.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Hadamard流形（下界曲率）上次梯度方法的收敛性，证明了在非空解集和非可和递减步长条件下，序列收敛到极小化子的若干充分条件，并给出了有限步终止性结论。
AI.motivation: 受经典欧几里得结果和近期一阶黎曼优化进展的启发，将次梯度方法的收敛性分析推广到具有下界曲率的Hadamard流形上，填补该领域理论空白。
AI.method: 采用非可和递减步长条件，在Hadamard流形（下界曲率）上分析次梯度方法的收敛性，分别考虑序列有界、解集有界、步长平方可和三种情形下的收敛证明，并讨论解集内点非空时的有限步终止性。
AI.result: 建立了三种条件下序列收敛到极小化子的充分性结果，并证明当解集内部非空时算法具有有限步终止性。
AI.conclusion: 本文为Shepilov欧几里得分析提供了黎曼流形上的对应结果，补充了下界曲率流形上凸最小化的现有文献。

title: Counterfactually Safe Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning algorithms are generally designed to maximize the expected return across a population. However, a policy that is optimal on average may be suboptimal for certain individuals, leading to potential safety concerns. To address this, we first formalize the notion of individual harm from a counterfactual perspective and define harm as the event in which a chosen action results in a strictly worse outcome than a baseline alternative. We then propose a general two-stage procedure for learning policies that maximize the expected return while accounting for individual harm. We further establish the finite-sample properties of the learned policy, derive an upper bound on its sub-optimality gap, and show that the harm rate remains well-controlled. Numerical experiments on both simulated and real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

AI.tldr: 提出一个两阶段强化学习流程，在最大化期望回报的同时，从反事实视角量化并控制个体伤害，理论证明了次优性上界和伤害率可控性，实验验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统强化学习追求总体期望回报最大化，但最优平均策略可能对某些个体造成次优甚至有害结果，存在安全隐患。需要一种能兼顾总体收益和个体伤害的规范化学习框架。
AI.method: 首先从反事实视角形式化定义个体伤害（所选动作导致的结果严格差于基线替代方案的事件）；然后提出一个通用两阶段学习流程，在最大化期望回报的同时将个体伤害纳入考量；并推导了所学策略的有限样本性质、次优性上界以及伤害率控制。
AI.result: 建立了策略的有限样本性质，导出了次优性差距的上界，证明伤害率得到良好控制；在模拟和真实数据集上的实验验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为在强化学习中平衡总体回报最优化和个体公平性/安全性提供了理论框架和实用算法，可推广到对个体差异敏感的应用场景。

title: Truthful Online Preference Aggregation for LLM Fine-Tuning in Mobile Crowdsourcing
summary: To better serve users' demands in mobile applications (e.g., navigation), mobile crowdsourcing platforms can iteratively align large language model (LLM)-generated content (e.g., AI-generated traffic condition predictions) with human feedback collected from crowdsourcing workers (e.g., mobile users). However, workers may strategically misreport their online preference feedback to maximize their influence or payment. Existing pipelines in mobile crowdsourcing (e.g., EM-based weight estimation) fail to identify the most accurate worker in this online setting, resulting in a linear regret $\mathcal{O}(T)$ over $T$ time slots. In this paper, we study truthful online preference aggregation for LLM fine-tuning in mobile crowdsourcing. We formulate a new dynamic Bayesian game to model the multi-agent online learning process between the platform and strategic mobile workers. We propose a novel online weighted aggregation mechanism that dynamically adjusts each worker's weight in the preference aggregation according to their feedback accuracy. We prove that our mechanism ensures truthful feedback from strategic workers and achieves a sublinear regret $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T})$ over $T$ time slots. We further extend our mechanism to a challenging scenario with limited worker feedback per time slot, still guaranteeing a sublinear regret $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T})$. Experiments on LLM fine-tuning with real-world datasets further demonstrate significant performance gains of our mechanisms over benchmark schemes.

AI.tldr: 本文针对移动众包中基于大语言模型（LLM）内容与人类反馈对齐时的策略性错误报告问题，提出了一种新颖的在线加权聚合机制，通过动态调整工人权重激励真实反馈，实现了次线性遗憾 𝒪(√𝑇)，并在有限反馈场景下同样保持该性能。
AI.motivation: 移动众包平台利用人类反馈微调LLM时，工人可能为最大化自身影响力或报酬而策略性谎报偏好，现有在线众包方法（如EM-based权重估计）无法识别最准确的工人，导致线性遗憾 𝒪(𝑇)，亟需一种能激励真实反馈的在线偏好聚合机制。
