AI.method: 首先建立动态贝叶斯博弈模型描述平台与策略性工人间的多智能体在线学习过程；然后提出在线加权聚合机制，根据工人反馈准确性动态调整其在偏好聚合中的权重；并通过理论证明确保机制下工人真实反馈为占优策略。
AI.result: 理论证明所提机制能激励工人真实反馈，实现次线性遗憾 𝒪(√𝑇)；在每时隙工人反馈有限场景下仍保证 𝒪(√𝑇) 次线性遗憾；基于真实数据集的LLM微调实验表明性能显著优于基准方案。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的在线加权聚合机制有效解决了移动众包中LLM微调时的策略性谎报问题，在理论保证和实验性能上均优于现有方法，为移动众包中的真实偏好聚合提供了新思路。

title: Operationalizing Reconstructive Authority: Runtime Construction, Dependency Resolution, and Execution Gating in Autonomous Agent Systems
comment: Agent Governance Series, Paper P6. Companion papers on arXiv: P0 (2604.17511), P1 (2603.18829), P2 (2604.17517). P3/4 and P5 submitted concurrently (pending arXiv IDs). Zenodo: 10.5281/zenodo.19699460
summary:
Autonomous agent systems fail not only due to incorrect decisions, but due to executing decisions whose authority no longer holds at runtime. Prior work defined Reconstructive Authority (RAM) as a condition for valid execution: actions are permitted only if authority can be constructed from current state.
  This paper addresses enforcement at runtime: how to enforce this condition in a running system.
  We introduce a runtime execution model in which authority is evaluated at action time and execution is conditioned on its constructibility. This extends the execution state space beyond admit/deny with a third state, halt, representing cases where authority is undefined due to incomplete or uncertain observability.
  We define a concrete execution protocol including dynamic dependency resolution, authority reconstruction, and explicit decision semantics. We further introduce a Recovery Loop that integrates drift detection (IML) with execution control (ACP), allowing the system to suspend execution, acquire missing information, and re-attempt authority reconstruction.
  We show that this model guarantees safety -- no action is executed without constructible authority -- and conditional liveness: execution resumes when authority-defining variables become observable.
  This work operationalizes reconstructive authority as a runtime enforcement mechanism, providing the execution semantics required to apply RAM in real systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种运行时执行模型，在动作执行时评估权威的可构造性，引入"暂停"作为第三种执行状态，并通过恢复循环（结合漂移检测与执行控制）实现安全性和有条件活性。
AI.motivation: 自主智能体系统不仅因错误决策而失败，还因执行了运行时权威已不再成立的动作而失败。现有工作定义了可重构权威（RAM）作为有效执行的条件，但缺乏运行时执行层面的保障机制。
AI.method: 提出运行时执行模型，在动作执行时评估权威；将执行状态空间扩展为允许/拒绝/暂停三态；定义包含动态依赖解析、权威重构和显式决策语义的执行协议；引入恢复循环，集成漂移检测（IML）与执行控制（ACP），允许系统暂停执行、获取缺失信息并重新尝试权威重构。
AI.result: 该模型保证安全性——无动作可在无可构造权威的情况下执行；保证有条件活性——权威定义变量变得可观测时恢复执行。
AI.conclusion: 本文将可重构权威操作化为运行时执行机制，提供了在真实系统中应用RAM所需的执行语义。

title: Lifted Schrödinger Bridges for Gaussian Mixture Endpoints: Projection Gaps and Path-Space Obstructions
comment: 35 pages. Submitted to a journal; comments are welcome
summary: We study stochastic density control between Gaussian-mixture endpoint distributions under Brownian prior dynamics. Since the direct Schrödinger bridge between Gaussian mixtures is generally not available in closed form, we introduce a lifted path-space construction in which each trajectory is augmented with a source--target component label. Consequently, the problem decomposes into Gaussian component-to-component Schrödinger bridges with explicit marginal, drift, and cost formulas, while the mixture-level assignment reduces to a finite-dimensional entropic coupling problem with a Sinkhorn scaling form. We then analyze the projection obtained by discarding or forgetting the label. By construction, the projected law satisfies the original Gaussian-mixture endpoint constraints, but its relative entropy generally differs from the lifted relative entropy by a nonnegative conditional label-information gap. This gap reveals a path-space obstruction: the lifted optimizer cannot, in general, be identified with the direct unlabeled Schrödinger bridge after projection. We also derive the posterior-averaged Markov drift associated with the projected marginal flow, prove a kinetic-energy upper bound, and identify a common path-potential condition under which the projection gap vanishes. Several numerical illustrations showing density and shape control are recorded for a self-contained exposition.

AI.tldr: 本文针对高斯混合端点分布下的随机密度控制问题，提出了一种提升路径空间构造方法，通过引入源-目标分量标签将问题分解为高斯分量间的薛定谔桥，并分析了投影后相对熵的标签信息差距及其消失条件。
AI.motivation: 高斯混合端点分布下的直接薛定谔桥通常无法获得闭式解，需要寻找可处理的近似或分解方法。
AI.method: 引入提升路径空间构造，为每条轨迹附加源-目标分量标签；将问题分解为高斯分量间薛定谔桥（显式边际、漂移和代价公式）和混合层级的有限维熵耦合问题（Sinkhorn缩放形式）；通过丢弃标签进行投影分析。
AI.result: 导出了投影后条件标签信息差距（非负），证明提升优化器在投影后一般无法等同于直接的无标签薛定谔桥；推导了投影边际流的后验平均马尔可夫漂移，证明了动能上界，并识别了投影差距消失的公共路径势条件。
AI.conclusion: 提升路径空间构造为高斯混合薛定谔桥问题提供了可解的分解框架，但标签信息差距揭示了路径空间上的本质障碍；数值实验展示了密度与形状控制效果。

title: Nyström Kernel Stein Discrepancy Tests
summary: Kernel Stein discrepancy (KSD) is among the most popular goodness-of-fit (GoF) measures on general domains with a large number of successful deployments. One of the main applications of KSD is in constructing powerful GoF tests. However, tests relying on the classical U-/V-statistic-based KSD estimators have two major drawbacks. (i) Their runtime scales quadratically in the number of samples. (ii) Their asymptotic null distribution is computationally intractable in most cases, typically handled by bootstrapping. While it is known that the Nyström method permits accelerating KSD estimation with no loss of statistical accuracy under mild conditions, to the best of our knowledge, the fundamental question of its impact on bootstrap-based GoF testing is open; resolving this question is the focus of the current paper. In particular, we prove that the key properties of the quadratic-time bootstrapped KSD-based GoF test (asymptotic level and local consistency) are preserved by its Nyström acceleration. We numerically demonstrate the efficiency of the accelerated KSD estimator and bootstrap in the context of GoF testing of spherical and functional data. Our numerical results show that the Nyström-accelerated method performs statistically on-par with the quadratic-time approach, while requiring substantially smaller runtime.

AI.tldr: 本文证明Nyström加速方法能够在保持核Stein散度（KSD）拟合优度检验的渐近水平和局部一致性的前提下，将计算复杂度从二次降至线性，并通过球面数据和函数数据的数值实验验证了其与二次时间方法统计性能相当但运行时间大幅降低。
AI.motivation: 传统基于U-/V-统计量的KSD拟合优度检验存在两个主要缺点：(i) 计算复杂度随样本量二次增长；(ii) 渐近零分布计算困难，通常需要bootstrap重采样，进一步增加计算负担。虽然Nyström方法已被用于加速KSD估计且不损失统计精度，但其对基于bootstrap的拟合优度检验的影响尚不明确，本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 本文从理论上证明了Nyström加速的KSD拟合优度检验保持了二次时间bootstrap检验的两个关键性质：渐近水平和局部一致性。数值实验在球面数据和函数数据上进行，对比了Nyström加速方法与标准二次时间方法在统计性能和运行时间上的表现。
AI.result: 理论结果表明，Nyström加速的bootstrap KSD检验与原始二次时间检验具有相同的渐近水平和局部一致性。数值实验表明，加速方法在统计性能上与二次时间方法相当，但运行时间显著降低。
AI.conclusion: Nyström加速是解决KSD拟合优度检验计算瓶颈的有效方案，能够在保持统计精度的前提下大幅提升计算效率，为大规模数据的分布检验提供了实用工具。

title: Cascade-KDE: Robust Time-Series Restoration under Out-of-Distribution Impulse Corruptions
summary: Real-world time-series data in industrial sensing, healthcare, and energy systems is often corrupted by a mixture of Gaussian noise and occasional large-magnitude impulse outliers. For tasks that depend on local shape, such as ECG morphology analysis and battery degradation monitoring, the main requirement is not only low reconstruction error but also preservation of derivative peaks and task-critical features. We propose Cascade-KDE, a training-free restoration framework for corrupted time series. The method first estimates a two-dimensional temporal-amplitude density, then applies a Density-Truncated Robust Expectation to limit the influence of distant abnormal points, and finally refines the sequence through an exponential cascade with adaptive stopping. This design aims to improve robustness under out-of-distribution impulse corruptions while keeping the restored trajectory close to the original local structure. Across several benchmark datasets, the proposed method shows consistent gains over classical filters and representative learning-based baselines on curve fidelity, derivative preservation, downstream classification, and runtime efficiency. These results suggest that bounded density-based restoration is a practical option for feature-preserving preprocessing in noisy time-series pipelines.

AI.tldr: 提出Cascade-KDE，一种无需训练的时序恢复框架，通过二维时空密度估计、密度截断鲁棒期望和指数级联自适应停止，在保留局部导数特征的同时鲁棒处理混合噪声（高斯+脉冲），在多个基准上优于经典滤波器和学习基线。
AI.motivation: 真实工业、医疗和能源时序数据常被高斯噪声和大尺度脉冲异常值污染，现有方法在保持局部导数峰值和任务关键特征方面不足，需要一种既能低重构误差又能保留导数峰值的训练无关恢复方法。
AI.method: 1. 估计二维时幅密度；2. 应用密度截断鲁棒期望限制远距离异常点影响；3. 通过指数级联与自适应停止精化序列。整个流程无需训练。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，曲线保真度、导数保持、下游分类性能和运行效率均一致优于经典滤波器和代表性学习基线。
AI.conclusion: 有界密度恢复是含噪时序管线中保留特征预处理的一种实用选择。

title: Fuzzy, Neutrosophic, and Uncertain Graph Theory: Properties and Applications
comment: 326 pages. Publisher: Neutrosophic Science International Association (NSIA) Publishing House. ISBN: 978-197250204-4
summary: This book presents a comprehensive and systematic survey of graph theory under uncertainty, with particular emphasis on the unifying role of the uncertain graph framework. It reviews fundamental concepts, structural properties, graph classes, and graph parameters within fuzzy, neutrosophic, and related models, while also introducing a wide range of extensions such as uncertain digraphs, hypergraphs, superhypergraphs, and dynamic graphs. In addition to theoretical developments, the book explores practical applications, including uncertain molecular graphs, decision-making systems, graph neural networks, knowledge graphs, and cognitive maps. By organizing diverse uncertainty-aware graph models within a common perspective, this work provides a coherent framework for understanding their relationships, capabilities, and applications in complex systems.

AI.tldr: 本书全面系统地综述了不确定性下的图论，以不确定图框架为核心，涵盖模糊图、直觉模糊图、中智图等模型，以及有向图、超图、超超图、动态图等扩展，并探讨了在分子图、决策系统、图神经网络、知识图谱和认知图等领域的应用。
AI.motivation: 现有不确定性图模型分散且缺乏统一视角，需要建立一套连贯的框架来理解不同不确定性图模型之间的关系、能力和应用。
AI.method: 以不确定图框架为统一视角，系统综述各类不确定性图模型（模糊图、中智图等），涵盖基本概念、结构性质、图类和图参数，并扩展到有向图、超图、超超图和动态图等。
AI.result: 建立了统一的不确定图框架，组织了多种不确定性图模型，并展示了在分子图、决策系统、图神经网络、知识图谱和认知图等复杂系统中的应用。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为理解和应用不确定性图论提供了连贯框架，有助于处理复杂系统中的不确定性问题。

title: Random-Subspace Frank--Wolfe over Strongly Convex Sets
summary: Frank--Wolfe methods avoid projections, but over curved feasible regions the full-space linear minimization oracle (LMO) can itself become the computational bottleneck. We introduce random-subspace Frank--Wolfe (RSFW), the first Frank--Wolfe framework, to our knowledge, that replaces the ambient LMO by exact LMOs over random low-dimensional affine sections of a general feasible set, while preserving feasibility in the original space. For smooth convex objectives over compact strongly convex feasible sets, we prove a dimension-explicit approximate-oracle inequality and derive the standard \(O(1/k)\) open-loop rate, with high-probability and almost-sure counterparts. Under short steps and a gradient lower bound, the same geometric control yields linear convergence, and we extend the sublinear theory to finite-sum stochastic gradients. We also show that random sections can improve the local curvature model controlling short steps: for smooth objectives, the quadratic model along a sampled section is governed by the compressed Hessian, yielding computable \(d\times d\) curvature constants for quadratic objectives over balls and ellipsoids. These results provide a geometric theory of oracle-side randomization in projection-free optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出随机子空间Frank-Wolfe（RSFW）方法，用低维随机仿射截面上的精确线性最小化预言机替代全空间预言机，在保持原始空间可行性的同时，为强凸可行集上的光滑凸优化建立了O(1/k)开环收敛率和线性收敛率，并推导了压缩Hessian控制的曲率模型。
AI.motivation: 传统的Frank-Wolfe方法在弯曲可行区域上，全空间线性最小化预言机（LMO）可能成为计算瓶颈。为了降低每次迭代的计算成本，需要一种能够用低维随机截面上的LMO替代全空间LMO的框架。
AI.method: 提出随机子空间Frank-Wolfe（RSFW）框架，将全空间LMO替换为随机低维仿射截面上的精确LMO。在紧致强凸可行集上，利用几何控制推导维度显式的近似预言机不等式，建立O(1/k)收敛率（高概率和几乎必然）；在短步长和梯度下界条件下证明线性收敛；扩展到有限和随机梯度情形；并分析随机截面如何通过压缩Hessian改进局部曲率模型。
AI.result: 对于光滑凸目标函数和强凸可行集，RSFW达到标准O(1/k)开环收敛率（高概率及几乎必然）；在短步长和梯度下界条件下实现线性收敛；随机梯度变体保持次线性收敛；对于球和椭球上的二次目标，压缩Hessian提供可计算的d×d曲率常数。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了投影自由优化中预言机端随机化的几何理论，证明了随机子空间LMO可以在保持收敛率的同时显著降低每次迭代的计算复杂度。

title: Choosing Online Experiment Designs under Interference in Ads, Recommendations, and Member-Experience Systems
summary: Online experiments in ads, recommendation, and member-experience systems are often planned before the dominant interference mechanism is known. A treatment may propagate through budgets, inventory, producer exposure, graph spillovers, or temporal carryover, making the randomization design itself a statistical decision. We formulate this problem as robust design selection over uncertain exposure mechanisms. Given a finite catalog of six implementable designs, the selector compares each design by worst-case planning risk over an ambiguity set. The risk combines exposure bias, assignment-unit variance, minimum detectable effect, contamination or carryover, operational cost, and estimand mismatch. For theoretical justification, the paper develops a geometry-aware guarantee, stating that design bias is bounded by Wasserstein distance to the launch exposure distribution, and this penalty is minimax tight under Lipschitz exposure response. We also prove finite-catalog approximation and a robust selector theorem with excess-risk control, exact recovery under separation, and certified shortlists when the risk surface is flat. Empirically, the same selector gives different recommendations across samples from public datasets. It selects user-randomization on Criteo ads with dimensionless robust risk 1.295, switchbacks on Open Bandit-bts/men with risk 2.105, and cluster-randomization on KuaiRand with risk 2.240. The Open Bandit case stresses known but uneven logging support, with propensities from 0.00006 to 0.594 and a 5.17% IPS effective-sample share. Overall, the paper contributes an interference-aware experiment design framework based on mechanism-robust design decisions, where the output is either a justified design choice or an uncertainty shortlist.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于机制鲁棒性的实验设计选择框架，通过最坏情况规划风险在有限设计目录中选择最优随机化方案，并提供了几何感知的理论保证和经验验证。
AI.motivation: 在线实验（广告、推荐、用户体验系统）中，处理效应常通过预算、库存、图溢出、时间携带等未知干扰机制传播，导致随机化设计本身成为一个统计决策问题。现有方法缺乏对不确定暴露机制的鲁棒性考量。
AI.method: 构建一个包含六种可实施设计的有限目录，通过模糊集上的最坏情况规划风险进行设计选择。风险函数整合暴露偏差、分配单元方差、最小可检测效应、污染/携带效应、运营成本和估计量不匹配。理论部分建立了几何感知保证（设计偏差由Wasserstein距离界定且极小极大紧致）、有限目录近似定理、鲁棒选择器定理（超额风险控制、分离条件下的精确恢复、风险平坦时的认证短名单）。
AI.result: 在Criteo广告数据上选择用户随机化（鲁棒风险1.295），Open Bandit-bts/men上选择switchbacks（风险2.105），KuaiRand上选择聚类随机化（风险2.240）。Open Bandit案例暴露了已知但不均匀的日志支持（倾向性0.00006-0.594，IPS有效样本占比5.17%）。
AI.conclusion: 贡献了一个干扰感知的实验设计框架，输出要么是合理的单一设计选择，要么是不确定性短名单，适用于存在多种未知干扰机制的在线实验场景。

title: Feature Lottery? A Bifurcation Theory of Concept Emergence
summary: Neural networks acquire structured representations at specific moments during training, yet identifying these transitions typically relies on retrospective, label-dependent metrics. We introduce a bifurcation theory of representation dynamics to detect these moments in real time. Analyzing a passive GMM probe attached to the evolving encoder, we show the onset of structure corresponds to a supercritical pitchfork bifurcation driven by the loss Hessian. The system exhibits a theoretically predictable zero-crossing ($β_c$) that, compared to the network's current state ($β$), yields a dynamic ratio $β(t)/β_c(t)$: a universal, label-free phase coordinate for representation dynamics, computable entirely from hidden states. We empirically validate four distinct transition regimes predicted by this coordinate across diverse settings: SAEs on language models (Pythia), SSL (CIFAR), and grokking (modular arithmetic). Crucially, under finite dissipation, macroscopic symmetry-breaking can lag the initial zero-crossing by orders of magnitude, which providing a rigorous dynamical account of the delayed escape observed in grokking. Microscopically, the bifurcation creates a shared unstable subspace, forcing collective symmetry breaking. We term this the "feature lottery" in SAE training: a feature's terminal interpretability becomes predictable remarkably early. By only 5% of training, early atom purity robustly predicts final convergence purity, with top-decile early atoms achieving over 12x the baseline purity at convergence. Beyond explaining concept emergence, $β/β_c$ provides a practical early-warning indicator for training health, detecting the onset of usable structure, the crystallization of feature identity, and representational collapse epochs before downstream metrics react.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于分岔理论的表示动力学实时检测方法，通过计算隐藏状态的β(t)/β_c(t)比率作为通用、无标签的相位坐标，能够早期预测表征结构涌现、特征晶化和表示坍塌等关键转变，并在SAEs、SSL和grokking等多种设置中验证了四个不同的转变阶段，特别揭示了grokking中延迟逃逸的动力学机制以及SAE训练中"特征彩票"现象——早期原子纯度即可可靠预测最终收敛纯度。
AI.motivation: 神经网络在训练过程中会在特定时刻获得结构化表示，但现有方法通常依赖事后（retrospective）的、需要标签的指标来识别这些转变。本文旨在开发一种能够在训练过程中实时检测表示结构涌现时刻的方法，而不依赖于标签信息。
AI.method: 引入表示动力学的分岔理论，分析附着在演化编码器上的被动高斯混合模型（GMM）探针，证明结构涌现对应于由损失Hessian矩阵驱动的超临界叉形分岔。系统存在理论可预测的零交叉点β_c，通过计算当前状态β与β_c的动态比率β(t)/β_c(t)，得到通用的、无标签的表示动力学相位坐标。
AI.result: 在多种实验设置（语言模型SAEs、自监督学习CIFAR、模算术grokking）中验证了该坐标预测的四个不同转变阶段。发现有限耗散下宏观对称性破缺可能滞后于初始零交叉点数个数量级，为grokking中的延迟逃逸提供了严格的动力学解释。在SAE训练中观察到"特征彩票"现象：仅需5%的训练，早期原子纯度即可稳健预测最终收敛纯度，最高十分位早期原子纯度达到基线12倍以上。
AI.conclusion: β/β_c提供了一个实用的训练健康早期预警指标，能够在下游指标反应之前就检测到可用结构的涌现、特征身份的晶化以及表示坍塌。该框架不仅解释了概念涌现，还为训练监控提供了实用工具。

title: BoxLitE: A Faithful Knowledge Base Embedding Based on Convex Optimization
comment: 28 pages. Full version of paper accepted to KR 2026 (23nd International Conference on Principles of Knowledge Representation and Reasoning). Track: KR meets Machine Learning and Explanation
summary: Knowledge base (KB) embeddings aim at combining the capability of classical knowledge graph embeddings to generalize the information present in facts, the ABox, with conceptual knowledge represented in an ontology language, the TBox. Several authors have recently explored the idea of mapping concepts to convex regions in a vector space. This is useful to represent hierarchies, typically present in TBoxes, since more general concepts can be mapped to larger regions, containing those regions associated with more specific concepts. However, the power of convexity is rarely leveraged during the actual learning tasks. Here, we introduce BoxLitE, a KB embedding model for DL-Lite$^{\mathcal{H}}$ that allows for convex optimization. We show that for any satisfiable DL-Lite$^{\mathcal{H}}$ KB, there is a BoxLitE embedding that is a weakly faithful model. As a proof of concept, we show how to formulate the KB embedding task as a convex optimization problem and how to obtain embeddings with such desirable faithfulness properties.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BoxLitE，一种用于DL-Lite$^{\mathcal{H}}$知识库的凸嵌入模型，将ABox事实与TBox概念层次结构映射为向量空间中的凸区域，并证明可满足性知识库存在弱忠实嵌入，同时将知识库嵌入任务转化为凸优化问题。
AI.motivation: 现有知识图谱嵌入方法虽能将概念映射为凸区域以表示TBox层次结构，但凸性能力在实际学习任务中很少被充分利用，缺乏对凸优化特性的理论保障。
AI.method: 提出BoxLitE模型，将DL-Lite$^{\mathcal{H}}$知识库中的概念映射为向量空间中的凸区域（盒状区域），通过凸优化框架进行嵌入学习，并理论证明任何可满足的DL-Lite$^{\mathcal{H}}$知识库均存在弱忠实嵌入。
AI.result: 证明了BoxLitE对任意可满足的DL-Lite$^{\mathcal{H}}$知识库存在弱忠实嵌入；作为概念验证，展示了如何将知识库嵌入任务形式化为凸优化问题并获得具有忠实性属性的嵌入。
AI.conclusion: BoxLitE实现了知识库嵌入中的凸优化，为ABox事实与TBox概念层次的联合嵌入提供了理论保障，证明凸区域映射方法可以获得弱忠实性。

title: Default Contagion, Matrix Approximation, and Control in Sparse Financial Networks
summary: We study systemic default contagion in sparse financial networks and develop a framework for deciding when aggregate exposure matrices are reliable and when node-level network information changes tail risk and control design. The first contribution is a multi-population McKean-Vlasov foundation for distance-to-default dynamics with common noise, bounded state-dependent killing, loss feedback, sparse weighted exposures, and regulatory intervention, including quantitative convergence, propagation of chaos, stability in contagion matrices, controlled well-posedness, a two-population HJB characterization, and a steep-killing bridge to absorbing-boundary contagion. The second contribution is a set of computable matrix-approximation diagnostics: finite-grid bounds driven by row-exposure dispersion and square-edge spread, constructive tail-loss gaps for networks sharing the same aggregate matrix, and a spectral-radius criterion for local cascade onset. The third contribution is an information-value theory for control, showing that node-level graph pressure has strictly positive value when within-type pressure variation interacts with nonsaturated marginal killing reduction. Matched sparse-graph and matrix experiments, common-noise tests, HJB feedback diagnostics, fixed-budget control comparisons, and EBA/Pillar 3-calibrated synthetic networks validate the framework. The main conclusion is that finite-type matrices are effective in regular-mixing regimes, whereas concentrated sparse exposures generate tail-risk and intervention effects that require local-pressure diagnostics and network-aware control.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了稀疏金融网络中的系统性违约传染问题，提出了一个基于多总体McKean-Vlasov过程的距离违约动力学框架，开发了可计算的矩阵近似诊断工具，并建立了节点级网络信息对控制具有正价值的信息价值理论。主要结论是：在正则混合体制下，有限类型聚合矩阵是有效的；而集中稀疏暴露会产生尾部风险和干预效应，需要局部压力诊断和网络感知控制。
AI.motivation: 解决稀疏金融网络中聚合暴露矩阵在何种情况下可靠、何时需要节点级网络信息以准确评估尾部风险和控制设计的问题。
AI.method: 1) 构建多总体McKean-Vlasov基础框架，包含共同噪声、有界状态依赖杀伤、损失反馈、稀疏加权暴露和监管干预；2) 开发矩阵近似诊断工具，包括有限网格界、尾部损失缺口和谱半径准则；3) 建立控制的信息价值理论，证明节点级图压力在特定条件下具有严格正价值。
AI.result: 通过匹配稀疏图和矩阵实验、共同噪声测试、HJB反馈诊断、固定预算控制比较以及EBA/Pillar 3校准的合成网络验证了框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 有限类型矩阵在正则混合体制下有效，但集中稀疏暴露会产生尾部风险和干预效应，必须使用局部压力诊断和网络感知控制。

title: Learning manifold diffusion semigroups from graph transition matrices
summary: We consider graph diffusion processes constructed from finite i.i.d. samples drawn from an unknown manifold embedded in ambient Euclidean space, where the graph affinity is defined by an ambient Gaussian kernel matrix. We show that the manifold heat semigroup $Q_t = e^{tΔ}$ can be approximated directly by iterating the graph transition matrix $P$, under only low regularity assumptions on the test function $f$, including the case $f \in L^\infty$. We bound $\| P^n f - Q_t f \|$ in $\infty$-norm, with the operator application to $f$ properly defined, and we recover the classical graph-Laplacian pointwise rate $O(N^{-2/(d+6)})$ up to logarithmic factors, for diffusion times $t $ up to $O(1)$ and longer. The rate holds for in-sample error as well as out-of-sample generalization, where the estimator of $Q_t f$ at a new point is defined via kernel convolution. To handle non-uniform sampling densities on the manifold, we introduce a right-normalization of the graph transition matrix; under the assumption that the sampling density $p$ is $C^3$ and bounded away from zero, the same convergence rates hold. We numerically demonstrate the performance of the proposed estimator on simulated data.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了从未知流形有限样本构建的图扩散过程，其图转移矩阵的迭代可以直接逼近流形热半群，在低正则性假设下获得了$O(N^{-2/(d+6)})$的逐点收敛率，并引入了右归一化图转移矩阵以处理非均匀采样密度。
AI.motivation: 现有流形学习中的图拉普拉斯方法通常要求测试函数具有较高正则性（如Lipschitz或C^2），本文旨在放宽这一假设，在仅需$f \in L^\infty$的低正则条件下建立图扩散过程对热半群的逼近理论，同时处理非均匀采样密度问题。
AI.method: 1) 利用环境高斯核矩阵构建图亲和度，定义图转移矩阵$P$；2) 对非均匀采样引入右归一化图转移矩阵；3) 在$L^\infty$范数下分析$P^n f$与$Q_t f$的逼近误差，将算子作用于$f$进行适当定义；4) 分别处理in-sample误差和out-of-sample泛化（新点通过核卷积估计）。
AI.result: 在正则性仅需$f \in L^\infty$的条件下，获得了$O(N^{-2/(d+6)})$（忽略对数因子）的逐点收敛率，适用于扩散时间$t$达到$O(1)$及更长。对于采样密度$p \in C^3$且远离零的情况，右归一化方法保证了相同的收敛率。
AI.conclusion: 本文在低正则性假设下建立了图扩散过程对流形热半群的有效逼近，理论结果涵盖了非均匀采样场景，并通过数值实验验证了所提方法的有效性。

title: Signs Beat Floats: Low-Rank Double-Binary Adaptation for On-Device Fine-Tuning
summary: On-device adaptation of large language models commonly keeps a quantized base model frozen while training and deploying a small, task-specific LoRA adapter. In the unmerged adapter-mode setting, however, the adapter is more than a compact storage module; it introduces an additional dense floating-point branch, maintains a trainable state for local updates, and acts as a unit of communication and hot-swapping.We introduce LoRDBA, a LoRA-compatible adapter that replaces both low-rank factors with binary sign carriers while representing magnitudes through lightweight, channel-wise scales, converting the dense adapter branch into two sign-accumulation matrix multiplications interleaved with channel-wise scaling. A finite-sample analysis shows that reconstruction quality is governed by the residual-to-magnitude ratio of the original LoRA factors. In adapter-mode experiments, LoRDBA outperforms low-bit baselines at matched model sizes while matching fp16 LoRA quality in selected regimes. The unmerged adapter incurs at most 8% prefill latency overhead at matched rank r=16 despite an over 10x reduction in adapter footprint, with moderate training memory overhead of approximately 1.6x that of fp16 LoRA.

AI.tldr: LoRDBA是一种将LoRA适配器的低秩因子替换为二进制符号载体和通道级缩放的轻量化方法，在保持适配器模式部署效率的同时大幅降低存储开销，并在特定场景下匹配fp16 LoRA的质量。
AI.motivation: 在设备端大语言模型适配场景中，未合并的适配器模式虽便于热切换和本地更新，但引入的密集浮点分支增加了存储和计算开销。现有低比特量化方法在适配器模式下性能损失较大，需要一种更高效的替代方案。
AI.method: LoRDBA将LoRA的两个低秩因子替换为二进制符号载体，并通过轻量级的通道级缩放表示幅度信息，将密集适配器分支转化为两个符号累加矩阵乘法与通道级缩放的交替运算。通过有限样本分析，论文证明了重建质量受原始LoRA因子的残差与幅度比控制。
AI.result: 在相同模型规模下，LoRDBA优于低比特基线方法；在特定条件下匹配fp16 LoRA的质量。在秩r=16时，适配器存储占用降低超过10倍，预填充延迟开销最多8%，训练内存开销约为fp16 LoRA的1.6倍。
AI.conclusion: LoRDBA在保持LoRA兼容性的同时，通过二值化加通道缩放的设计，在模型质量、存储效率和推理延迟之间取得了良好的平衡，特别适用于设备端适配器模式的部署场景。

title: Authority Inversion in LLM-Mediated Ubiquitous Systems: When Models Trust Users Over Sensors
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly fuse heterogeneous inputs in ubiquitous systems. Yet, how LLMs implicitly allocate authority when sensor measurements and user claims conflict remains unexamined, raising critical reliability concerns for deployments where physical sensing must retain priority. Unlike explicit traditional fusion, LLMs bury authority allocation within learned representations. We discover this allocation is severely format-dependent: numerical sensor data fails to integrate into answer-relevant model directions, allowing natural-language claims to dominate the final decision, a phenomenon we term \textbf{Authority Inversion}.To diagnose and mitigate this, we develop a geometric framework of context integration, introduce two computable audit metrics, specifically the Context Integration Ratio (CIR) and Authority Alignment Index (AAI), and propose Geometric Authority Calibration (GAC), an inference-time layer-level intervention to suppress misplaced user authority. Evaluating four models (4B to 35B parameters, three architectures) across four datasets totaling 576 conflict instances reveals extreme inversion: on numerical tasks, models exhibit near-zero sensor trust (AAI = -0.805, Cohen's d = -2.14), unaffected by model capacity. Validating our geometric framework, theory-guided causal injection flips 80.2\% of incorrect decisions (vs. <0.4\% for random controls). Practically, GAC improves HAR accuracy from 0 -- 1.6\% to 21.9 -- 27.5\%, outperforming prompting baselines. Ultimately, authority allocation in LLM-mediated systems must be explicitly audited and application-specifically configured rather than left implicit.

AI.tldr: LLM在多模态融合中存在"权威反转"现象：数值传感器数据因格式劣势被自然语言用户主张主导，导致决策严重偏差。本文提出几何框架、审计指标（CIR/AAI）和推理时层干预方法（GAC），成功将HAR准确率从0-1.6%提升至21.9-27.5%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM系统在融合异构输入（传感器测量值与用户主张冲突时）隐式分配权威的方式未被研究，物理传感数据需要保持优先级的场景存在关键可靠性隐患。
AI.method: 1) 构建上下文集成的几何框架；2) 提出两个可计算审计指标：上下文集成比(CIR)和权威对齐指数(AAI)；3) 提出几何权威校准(GAC)，一种推理时层级干预方法，抑制不当的用户权威。
AI.result: 在4个模型（4B-35B参数，3种架构）、4个数据集共576个冲突实例上：AAI=-0.805（Cohen's d=-2.14），理论引导因果注入翻转80.2%错误决策，GAC将HAR准确率从0-1.6%提升至21.9-27.5%。
AI.conclusion: LLM中介系统中的权威分配必须被显式审计并按应用场景配置，而非隐式处理。

title: An Infeasible Method with Feasibility Safeguard for Nonsmooth Composite Optimization Over Manifolds
summary: In this paper, we consider nonsmooth composite optimization over compact embedded submanifolds defined by nonlinear equality constraints. We propose a feasibility-safeguarded inexact proximal linearized method (FSIPL), which allows infeasible iterates while keeping them within a prescribed bounded neighborhood of the manifold. Each iteration approximately solves a strongly convex proximal linearized subproblem, performs a correction step to reduce constraint violation, and uses a merit-function-based nonmonotone backtracking line search to select stepsizes and accept trial iterates. The feasibility safeguard, incorporated into both correction and line search, controls infeasibility and makes the boundedness needed in the analysis a consequence of the algorithmic design. We prove finite termination of backtracking, subsequential convergence to stationary points, and an $O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ outer iteration complexity bound. Under a Kurdyka--Łojasiewicz assumption on a suitable auxiliary function, we further establish full-sequence convergence. Numerical results on sparse PCA and sparse spectral clustering illustrate its efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种可行性保护的非精确近端线性化方法（FSIPL），用于求解紧致嵌入子流形上的非光滑复合优化问题。该方法允许不可行迭代，通过校正步骤和基于罚函数的非单调回溯线搜索控制不可行性，并证明了回溯有限终止、子序列收敛到稳定点、$O(\varepsilon^{-2})$外迭代复杂度，以及在Kurdyka-Łojasiewicz假设下的全序列收敛性。数值实验验证了其在稀疏PCA和稀疏谱聚类中的有效性。
AI.motivation: 解决紧致嵌入子流形（由非线性等式约束定义）上的非光滑复合优化问题，现有方法在处理不可行迭代和约束违反控制方面存在不足。
AI.method: 提出FSIPL方法：每次迭代近似求解强凸近端线性化子问题，执行校正步骤减少约束违反，结合可行性保护机制与基于罚函数的非单调回溯线搜索选择步长并接受试验迭代点。
AI.result: 证明了回溯有限终止、子序列收敛到稳定点、$O(\varepsilon^{-2})$外迭代复杂度，以及在Kurdyka-Łojasiewicz假设下的全序列收敛性。数值实验在稀疏PCA和稀疏谱聚类中验证了效率。
AI.conclusion: FSIPL方法能有效处理紧致嵌入子流形上的非光滑复合优化，具有理论收敛保证和实际数值效率。

title: Mean-Shift PCA by Knockoff Mean
summary: Removing noise is difficult, but adding noise is easy. In this work, we show how to eliminate mean-shift noisy components from PCA by deliberately introducing knockoff mean-shift perturbation. Standard PCA is highly sensitive to shifts in the sample mean: a small fraction of samples from a shifted distribution can cause large deviations in the leading principal components. In high-dimensional regimes, existing Robust PCA approaches cannot handle the mean-shift contamination structure inherent in the mixture model. Using tools from Random Matrix Theory, we prove that the mean-shift spikes are spectrally separable from the stable eigenvalues of the original covariance. Furthermore, the original eigenspace remains asymptotically invariant to the contamination, independent of the mixture weight. Exploiting this spectral stability, we propose a simple, two-stage PCA algorithm by adding knockoff mean that identifies and removes the mean-shift component using only standard PCA operations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过故意添加“knockoff mean-shift”扰动来消除PCA中的均值偏移噪声。理论证明均值偏移尖峰与原始协方差稳定特征值在谱上可分离，且原始特征空间渐近不变。据此设计了两阶段PCA算法，仅用标准PCA操作即可识别并移除均值偏移成分。
AI.motivation: 标准PCA对样本均值偏移高度敏感，少量偏移样本会导致主成分严重偏离。现有鲁棒PCA方法在高维场景下无法处理混合模型中固有的均值偏移污染结构，亟需一种能有效应对该问题的方法。
AI.method: 利用随机矩阵理论工具，证明均值偏移尖峰在谱上与原始协方差的稳定特征值可分离，且原始特征空间渐近不受污染影响。基于这一谱稳定性，提出两阶段PCA算法：通过添加knockoff mean扰动，仅使用标准PCA操作即可识别并移除均值偏移成分。
AI.result: 理论证明了均值偏移尖峰与稳定特征值的谱可分离性，以及原始特征空间对污染的渐近不变性。算法仅需标准PCA操作即可有效去除均值偏移噪声。
AI.conclusion: 添加噪声比去除噪声更容易——通过主动引入knockoff均值扰动，可以逆向实现均值偏移噪声的消除，为高维PCA鲁棒性提供了新思路。

title: Spectral Probe-Circuits: A Three-Step Recipe for Identifying Attention-Head Circuits in Pretrained Transformers
summary: We present a three-step recipe for identifying attention-head circuits in pretrained transformers. A per-head spectral signal -- the time-integrated participation ratio of each head's attention output -- ranks heads doing sustained content-dependent computation without labels or attribution gradients. A task-pattern screen filters this general indicator into a task-specific candidate circuit, and group ablation against a matched-random control completes the causal claim. We validate across an 8x parameter range (51M to 1B-active / 7B-total), two architecture families (dense, mixture-of-experts), and four pretraining pipelines. The recipe ports: a 2-6 head induction circuit is causally necessary in every model tested, with a 94-100% drop in synthetic-induction top-1 after ablation. The spectral signal is predictive without supervision: on six independent seeds of a 51M-parameter probe model, the same computation identifies the seed-specific circuit on each seed. The fraction of heads doing identifiable specialized computation is conserved at 17-19% across the Pythia family (124M to 410M), while specific induction circuits stay 3-11 heads -- sublinear in total head count. This paper is the methodology anchor of a three-paper program; companion papers extend the recipe to developmental trajectories during pretraining and to composed-task circuits where pattern selectivity decouples from task-causal structure.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种三步法来识别预训练Transformer中的注意力头电路：基于谱信号的头部排序、任务模式筛选、以及组消融验证。该方法在多种规模（51M-1B活跃/7B总参）、架构（密集、MoE）和预训练流程上得到验证，发现2-6个头的归纳电路是因果必需的，且谱信号无需监督即可预测电路。
AI.motivation: 现有方法难以在没有标签或梯度信息的情况下，系统性地识别Transformer中哪些注意力头组成特定任务的因果电路，且缺乏跨规模、跨架构的验证。
AI.method: 三步法：(1) 计算每个注意力头输出的时间积分参与比作为谱信号，排序出头部的持续内容依赖计算能力；(2) 通过任务模式筛选将通用信号转化为任务特定的候选电路；(3) 使用组消融与匹配随机对照完成因果验证。
AI.result: 在51M到1B活跃参数、密集和MoE架构、四种预训练流程上验证有效。归纳电路仅需2-6个头，消融后准确率下降94-100%。谱信号无监督即可预测不同种子上的电路。可识别的专用计算头部比例保持在17-19%，而归纳电路规模（3-11个头）随总头数亚线性增长。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可作为通用工具来识别Transformer中的因果电路，且谱信号是一种无需监督的电路发现信号；该论文是三步曲的方法论锚点。

title: DRIVE: Modeling Skills at the Reasoning and Interaction Levels for Web Agents under Continual Learning
summary: Web agents require both high-level reasoning (for task decomposition) and low-level interactions (for page elements manipulation) to conduct different tasks. However, these knowledge types differ fundamentally: reasoning knowledge (e.g., booking a flight requires first searching for routes) is abstract and transferable across websites, while interaction knowledge (e.g., clicking the Search button at a specific coordinate on Site A) depends heavily on page-specific contexts. Existing methods store experiences uniformly. This creates a dilemma: abstract representations lose executability on concrete pages, while concrete representations fail to generalize across domains. This entanglement limits capability accumulation: on new websites, agents either fail to recognize reusable task logic due to surface-level differences or attempt infeasible actions from outdated page structures. To disentangle them, we propose DRIVE, a dual-level skill modeling framework separating historical experience into natural language reasoning skills, which capture transferable task logic, and programmatic interaction skills, grounding abstract actions to executable operations. A scene-aware coordination mechanism adaptively retrieves and invokes these dual-level skills based on task semantics. DRIVE also uses skill-level reflection to identify hierarchy-specific failure modes, enabling targeted skill library expansion and refinement. Experiments across five WebArena domains show DRIVE attains an average task success rate of 52.8%, exceeding the skill-free baseline by 7.3 percentage points. Further ablations show reasoning and interaction skills provide distinct, complementary benefits, supporting separation of transferable task logic from executable page-level operations.

AI.tldr: DRIVE提出了一种双层技能建模框架，将Web代理的经验分离为可迁移的自然语言推理技能和可执行的程序化交互技能，并通过场景感知协调机制和技能级反思，在WebArena五个域上实现52.8%的平均任务成功率，比无技能基线提升7.3个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有Web代理方法将推理知识（抽象、跨站点可迁移）与交互知识（页面特定、不可迁移）统一存储，导致抽象表示缺乏可执行性、具体表示难以跨域泛化，两种知识的纠缠限制了能力积累。
AI.method: 提出DRIVE框架：1) 双层技能建模——将历史经验分离为自然语言推理技能（捕获可迁移任务逻辑）和程序化交互技能（将抽象动作锚定到可执行操作）；2) 场景感知协调机制——基于任务语义自适应检索和调用双层技能；3) 技能级反思——识别层级特定失效模式，实现针对性技能库扩展与精炼。
AI.result: 在WebArena五个域上，DRIVE达到52.8%平均任务成功率，超越无技能基线7.3个百分点。消融实验表明推理技能和交互技能提供独立且互补的收益。
AI.conclusion: 分离可迁移任务逻辑与可执行页面操作是有效的，双层技能建模能更好地支持Web代理的能力积累与跨域泛化。

title: A note on the complexity of two-stage stochastic linear optimization with small second stage
summary: Two-stage stochastic linear optimization is known to be #P-hard when all involved random variables are independently and uniformly distributed over intervals, even with fixed recourse. We show that this problem is actually #P-hard in the strong sense. More surprisingly, this hardness persists when the random vector is one-dimensional, i.e., uniformly distributed over a single interval. To obtain this result, we show that computing the area of a two-dimensional polytope given by a compact extended formulation is strongly #P-hard. Furthermore, we obtain the same complexity result in case the number of second-stage constraints is fixed (for a problem in standard form), while fixing the number of second-stage variables leads to a weakly #P-hard problem. Finally, if both the dimension of the random vector and the number of second-stage constraints are fixed, the problem turns out to be tractable.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了二阶段随机线性优化问题即使在随机变量服从单区间均匀分布时也是强#P难的，并揭示了问题复杂度与随机变量维度、第二阶段约束/变量数之间的精确边界。
AI.motivation: 此前已知二阶段随机线性优化在随机变量独立均匀分布于区间时是#P难的，但本文希望进一步刻画其硬度边界——特别是能否在更弱条件下（如一维随机变量）仍保持困难，以及哪些参数固定后问题可解。
AI.method: 通过归约到计算二维多面体面积这一#P难问题，证明了问题的强#P难性；同时通过参数固定（第二阶段约束数、变量数、随机向量维度）分析，刻画了复杂度边界。
AI.result: (1) 即使随机变量是一维且均匀分布，问题仍是强#P难的；(2) 第二阶段约束数固定时仍为#P难，第二阶段变量数固定时为弱#P难；(3) 当随机向量维度和第二阶段约束数均固定时，问题可解。
AI.conclusion: 二阶段随机线性优化的#P难性不仅源于多变量交互，更本质地源于单变量情形下计算二维多面体面积的内在困难，参数固定能够有效降低问题复杂度。

title: Guided Flow Matching for Forward and Inverse PDE Problems with Sparse Observations: Algorithm and Theory
summary: Reconstructing PDE solutions from sparse observations is a core challenge in scientific computing. We present FM4PDE, a flow-matching generative framework that learns the joint distribution of PDE coefficients (or initial states) and solutions (or final states), enabling both forward simulation and inverse recovery with limited paired data. At inference, sampling is guided by a composite loss that enforces agreement with sparse measurements and reduces the PDE residual; we support deterministic, stochastic, and hybrid samplers. We provide error guarantees for these guided procedures. For the deterministic optimizer, a coercivity condition ensures trajectory boundedness and a phase-wise contraction yields logarithmic complexity in the target accuracy. For the stochastic sampler, we introduce adaptive guidance and assume dissipativity of the velocity field to obtain uniform moment bounds independent of the noise-floor parameter. This leads to polynomial-time error bounds, and a matching lower bound shows constant guidance induces an unavoidable positive bias, motivating adaptivity. A hybrid deterministic-stochastic analysis is also provided. Experiments on static and time-dependent benchmark PDEs demonstrate competitive accuracy and faster inference than diffusion-based generative models.

AI.tldr: 提出FM4PDE框架，利用流匹配生成模型学习PDE系数与解的联合分布，通过引导采样实现稀疏观测下的正向模拟与逆问题求解，并提供理论误差保证与实验验证。
AI.motivation: 从稀疏观测中重建PDE解是科学计算的核心挑战，现有的扩散生成模型推理速度慢，且缺乏理论保证。
AI.method: 采用流匹配生成框架学习PDE系数（或初态）与解（或终态）的联合分布；推理时通过复合损失（稀疏观测约束+PDE残差）引导采样，支持确定性、随机性和混合采样器，其中自适应引导用于随机采样。
AI.result: 确定性采样器在 coercivity 条件下保证轨迹有界且相位式收缩达到对数复杂度；随机采样器在耗散速度场假设下获得与噪声基底无关的一致矩界及多项式时间误差界，且匹配下界表明恒定引导会产生不可消除的正偏差；混合分析亦给出。实验在静态和时变PDE基准上取得竞争性精度并比扩散模型推理更快。
AI.conclusion: FM4PDE在稀疏观测PDE求解中兼具理论保证（误差界与复杂度分析）与实用效率（更快推理），自适应引导对随机采样至关重要。

title: Federated Learning over Human-Body Communication for On-Body Edge Intelligence: A Survey, Taxonomy, and BODYFED-HBC Scheduling Vignette
summary: Human-body communication (HBC) is a promising physical substrate for wearable body-area networks because it can localize communication around the body and reduce the burden of conventional radio links. Federated learning (FL) is a promising learning substrate because it can reduce raw-data centralization for physiological and behavioral sensing. Yet these two literatures remain weakly connected: FL for wearables usually abstracts the communication layer, whereas HBC research usually abstracts learning and model-update traffic. This article surveys the intersection of HBC, wireless body-area networks, wearable FL, Internet-of-Bodies privacy, and edge-intelligence optimization. We propose a taxonomy that distinguishes intra-body, body-hub, cross-user, and clinical-cloud FL deployments, and we identify the open problem of body-channel-aware FL: learning protocols whose client selection, update compression, and aggregation are controlled by posture-dependent HBC links, residual energy, sensor memory, and privacy risk. To make the research agenda concrete, we introduce BODYFED-HBC as a reference architecture and provide an optimization formulation and scheduling algorithm. We further specify a reproducible simulation vignette that combines public wearable datasets with empirical body-coupled-communication signal-loss models. The article concludes with open datasets, evaluation metrics, limitations, and research directions for computer scientists working above the hardware layer.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了人体通信（HBC）与联邦学习（FL）在可穿戴体域网中的交叉研究，提出了区分四种FL部署场景的分类法，并明确了“体信道感知联邦学习”这一开放问题。作者提出了BODYFED-HBC参考架构、优化调度算法及可复现仿真框架，为硬件层之上的计算机科学家提供了研究方向、开放数据集与评估指标。
AI.motivation: 现有可穿戴联邦学习研究通常抽象了通信层，而人体通信研究则通常抽象了学习与模型更新流量，两领域缺乏有效交叉。本文旨在弥合这一鸿沟，系统性地探索HBC与FL的结合点。
AI.method: 采用综述方法，提出区分四种FL部署场景（intra-body, body-hub, cross-user, clinical-cloud）的分类法；提出BODYFED-HBC参考架构；给出优化公式与调度算法；结合公开可穿戴数据集与经验性体耦合通信信号损耗模型，构建可复现仿真框架。
AI.result: 明确了体信道感知联邦学习这一开放问题，即需要设计由姿态相关的HBC链路、剩余能量、传感器内存和隐私风险共同控制的客户端选择、更新压缩与聚合的协议。提供了BODYFED-HBC架构及具体优化调度算法。
AI.conclusion: 文章总结了开放数据集、评估指标、局限性，并为工作在硬件层之上的计算机科学家指出了未来研究方向。HBC与FL的深度融合有望推动可穿戴边缘智能的隐私保护与通信效率提升。

title: Residual Drift Dominates Contradiction in Multi-Turn Constraint Reasoning
comment: Published at ICLR 2026 Workshop on Reasoning and Planning for LLMs. 18 pages. ICLR page: https://iclr.cc/virtual/2026/10017484 Code: https://github.com/kaons-research/drift-bench
summary: How do multi-turn reasoning systems fail? The expected answer is logical contradiction, in which the system's maintained state becomes unsatisfiable. We show that the dominant mode is instead satisfiable drift, where the internal state stays consistent while the returned answer silently violates prior commitments. We build DRIFT-Bench (Decomposing Reasoning Into Failure Types), a solver-instrumented benchmark of 816 test problems across three constraint domains, and evaluate four methods on it across four open-weight models (8B-120B parameters). MUS-Repair, which feeds minimal unsatisfiable subsets back to the generator, is strongest in every setting (+1.8 to +15.0 pp over the best non-MUS baseline). But the central finding is what repair leaves behind. After structured feedback, models rarely contradict themselves. They forget. Residual errors are 98-100% satisfiable drift across all settings, while contradiction drops to near zero. Reliable multi-turn systems must separately validate that the returned answer respects the maintained state. Code is available at https://github.com/kaons-research/drift-bench.

AI.tldr: 多轮推理系统的主要失败模式不是逻辑矛盾，而是"可满足漂移"（内部状态一致但回答违反先前承诺）。作者构建了DRIFT-Bench基准测试（816个问题，3个约束域），评估了4种方法在4个开源模型上的表现。MUS-Repair方法在所有设置中表现最强（+1.8至+15.0个百分点），但核心发现是：经过结构化反馈后，模型很少自相矛盾，而是遗忘——残留错误中98-100%是可满足漂移，矛盾几乎为零。
AI.motivation: 探究多轮推理系统的主要失败模式，挑战"逻辑矛盾是主要失败方式"的直觉假设，揭示更隐蔽的"可满足漂移"问题。
AI.method: 构建DRIFT-Bench基准测试（816个问题，覆盖三个约束域），使用求解器检测失败模式；提出MUS-Repair方法（将最小不可满足子集反馈给生成器）并与三种基线方法对比，在四个开源模型（8B-120B参数）上评估。
AI.result: MUS-Repair在所有设置中表现最优（比最佳非MUS基线高+1.8至+15.0个百分点）；残留错误中98-100%是可满足漂移，逻辑矛盾几乎消失。
AI.conclusion: 多轮推理系统的核心问题在于模型会"遗忘"而非自相矛盾；可靠的多轮系统需要单独验证返回答案是否尊重已维持的状态。

title: Safe Trajectory Tracking of the Stefan Problem with Second-Order Moving Boundary Dynamics
summary: This paper considers a safe trajectory tracking of the Stefan problem with a second-order moving boundary dynamics. The model is given by a parabolic Partial Differential Equation (PDE) defined on a time-varying domain of moving boundary governed by a second-order Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE) associated with the Neumann boundary condition. A feedforward control is designed by a series expansion approach to solve the inverse Stefan problem under given reference trajectory of the moving boundary, and the convergence of infinite series is proven. A trajectory tracking controller is derived based on an energy-shaping, which ensures the safety of the model constraint in the closed-loop system. The closed-loop system is also shown to be globally exponentially stable with respect to the tracking error by performing PDE backstepping transformation and Lyapunov analysis. Numerical simulation illustrates an effective tracking performance of the proposed method under a sinusoidal reference trajectory. Code is released at https://github.com/shumon0423/StefanTracking_ACC2026.git.

AI.tldr: 本文针对具有二阶移动边界动力学的Stefan问题，提出了一种安全的轨迹跟踪控制方法。通过级数展开法设计前馈控制解决逆Stefan问题，基于能量整形设计确保模型约束安全的轨迹跟踪控制器，并通过PDE反步变换和Lyapunov分析证明了闭环系统全局指数稳定性。数值仿真在正弦参考轨迹下验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 解决Stefan问题中移动边界在二阶动力学约束下的安全轨迹跟踪问题，即如何在保证物理模型约束（如边界位置或速度不超过安全阈值）的前提下，实现对给定参考轨迹的精确跟踪。
AI.method: 1) 采用级数展开法设计前馈控制器，求解逆Stefan问题；2) 基于能量整形方法设计轨迹跟踪控制器，确保模型约束的安全性；3) 利用PDE反步变换和Lyapunov稳定性分析，证明闭环系统跟踪误差的全局指数稳定性。
AI.result: 闭环系统在跟踪误差意义上全局指数稳定，且在正弦参考轨迹下数值仿真展示了有效的跟踪性能。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的前馈-反馈控制方法能够安全有效地实现Stefan问题中移动边界的轨迹跟踪，理论分析和数值仿真均验证了方法的有效性，且代码已开源。

title: From DPPs to $k$-DPPs: identifiability analysis via spectral decomposition
summary: We study the geometry of determinantal point processes (DPPs) through the spectral decomposition $L=UΛU^{\top}$. The spectrum $Λ$ governs the cardinality distribution via elementary symmetric polynomials, while the eigenspace orientation $U$ governs the conditional law within each fixed-cardinality stratum. Conditioning on cardinality $k$ yields the $k$-DPP, for which the identifiability structure changes fundamentally: the spectral parameter becomes identifiable only up to a common scale, and the eigenspace rotation parameter is identifiable only through squared minors of the eigenvector matrix. We characterize the identifiability gap precisely, via three explicit invariances (scale, sign similarity, and eigenspace rotation) and a dimension-counting theorem showing the existence of additional continuous non-identifiability whenever $\binom{N}{k}<N(N+1)/2$. In contrast, for the full DPP the non-identifiability comes only from the discrete sign similarity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了行列式点过程（DPP）通过谱分解 L=UΛU^T 的几何结构。谱 Λ 通过初等对称多项式控制基数分布，而特征空间方向 U 控制固定基数层内的条件分布。条件于基数 k 得到 k-DPP，其可识别性结构发生根本变化：谱参数仅可在共同尺度下识别，特征空间旋转参数仅可通过特征向量矩阵的平方子式识别。文章通过三种显式不变性（尺度、符号相似性和特征空间旋转）以及一个维数计数定理精确刻画了这一可识别性间隙，该定理表明每当 C(N,k) < N(N+1)/2 时存在额外的连续不可识别性。相比之下，完整 DPP 的不可识别性仅来自离散的符号相似性。
AI.motivation: 理解行列式点过程（DPP）及其条件变体 k-DPP 的几何结构和参数可识别性，揭示两种模型在参数可识别性上的本质差异。
AI.method: 通过谱分解框架分析 DPP 的几何结构，利用初等对称多项式、平方子式等数学工具，结合不变性分析和维数计数定理。
AI.result: 对于完整 DPP，不可识别性仅来自离散的符号相似性；对于 k-DPP，谱参数仅在共同尺度下可识别，特征空间旋转参数仅通过平方子式可识别，且在 C(N,k) < N(N+1)/2 时存在额外的连续不可识别性。
AI.conclusion: 完整 DPP 与 k-DPP 在参数可识别性上存在本质差异，k-DPP 具有更复杂的不可识别性结构，包括三种显式不变性和额外的连续不可识别性。

title: Generative Representation Learning on Hyper-relational Knowledge Graphs via Masked Discrete Diffusion
comment: 28 pages, 16 figures, 18 tables, 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: Hyper-relational knowledge graphs (HKGs) effectively represent complex facts. While inferring new knowledge in HKGs is a critical problem, current methods cast it as a simple link prediction, assuming that nearly all entities and relations within a fact are known, leaving only a single blank to be filled. However, this restricted assumption may not hold in real-world scenarios in which multiple, or even all, constituent components of a fact may be missing simultaneously. To bridge this gap, we introduce a task called fact generation: generating a valid hyper-relational fact from an arbitrarily masked query, i.e., completing a partially observed fact or generating a fact from scratch. We propose KREPE, the first generative representation learning method for HKGs that learns to model the probability distributions of missing components conditioned on the local fact components and global structure of HKGs via a masked discrete diffusion. KREPE models both the intra-fact dependencies by contextual message passing and inter-fact correlations by aggregating stochastically sampled contexts. KREPE seamlessly unifies link prediction and fact generation within a single training framework, achieving state-of-the-art performance on standard HKG link prediction benchmarks and outperforming LLM-based baselines in generating novel and correct facts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出事实生成任务，用于超关系知识图谱中任意掩码查询的缺失成分推理，并设计了基于掩码离散扩散的生成式表示学习方法KREPE，统一了链接预测与事实生成，在基准测试中达到SOTA表现。
AI.motivation: 现有超关系知识图谱方法仅聚焦于简单链接预测（单空白填充），无法处理真实场景中多个甚至全部成分同时缺失的复杂情况，需要更通用的生成式方法。
AI.method: 提出KREPE框架，通过掩码离散扩散模型学习缺失成分的条件概率分布，利用上下文消息传递建模事实内依赖关系，并通过随机采样上下文聚合建模事实间相关性。
AI.result: 在标准HKG链接预测基准上达到SOTA，且在生成新颖且正确的事实上优于基于LLM的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: KREPE通过统一的生成式框架有效解决了HKG中从局部观察到完全空白等任意程度的不完整事实推断问题，验证了扩散模型在知识图谱生成任务中的潜力。

title: MEMOR-E: In-Context and Fine-Tuned LLM Personalization for Alzheimer's Assistive Robotics
summary: Alzheimer's disease is a neurodegenerative disorder marked by progressive declines in memory and language that reduce independence in daily life, motivating socially assistive robotic support. This paper presents MEMOR-E, a mobile quadruped robot with an interactive tablet interface that assists patients and caregivers through medication reminders, routine guidance, memory oriented interactions, and companionship. We evaluated the feasibility of fine tuning large language models (LLMs) to emulate stage consistent cognitive behavior and interpret responses across standard neuropsychological language tasks, using audio transcriptions from 235 Alzheimer's patients and synthetically generated healthy controls. We also report findings on using in context learning (ICL) in LLMs, where a second LLM produced domain and severity level cognitive error summaries. Our results show that MEMOR-E can generate stage aware, non diagnostic cognitive summaries that support personalized assistive interactions, while explainable AI mechanisms translate model outputs into transparent, human readable evidence to enable caregiver oversight and trustworthy human robot interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MEMOR-E——一种结合四足机器人和平板界面的社交辅助机器人系统，通过微调大语言模型模拟不同阶段阿尔茨海默症患者的认知行为，并利用上下文学习生成认知错误摘要，实现个性化、可解释的人机交互辅助。
AI.motivation: 阿尔茨海默症导致患者记忆和语言能力进行性衰退，降低日常生活独立性，需要社交辅助机器人提供支持。
AI.method: 采用移动四足机器人MEMOR-E配合交互式平板界面；使用235名患者的音频转录和合成健康对照组数据微调LLM以模拟阶段一致的认知行为；利用第二个LLM通过上下文学习生成领域和严重级别的认知错误摘要。
AI.result: MEMOR-E能够生成阶段感知、非诊断性的认知摘要，支持个性化辅助交互；可解释AI机制将模型输出转化为透明、人类可读的证据，支持护理人员监督和可信的人机交互。
AI.conclusion: 微调LLM与上下文学习相结合的策略可以有效辅助阿尔茨海默症患者的日常照护，可解释性机制增强了人机信任和护理人员监管能力。

title: Price of Coupling in Multilevel Linear Programming
summary:
Multilevel programming is the standard framework for modeling hierarchical decision-making. In this paper, we characterize the computational complexity of deciding the existence of feasible and optimal solutions, as well as computing the optimal objective value in multilevel linear programming (LP). Our analysis considers various combinations of modeling assumptions, including the presence or absence of linking (coupling) constraints and whether all variables are bounded.
  In particular, we show the feasibility problem of $k$-level LP is $Σ^{p}_{k-1}$-complete for $k \ge 2$. Without linking constraints and unbounded variables, it is polynomial-time solvable for $k \le 4$ but becomes $Σ^{p}_{k-1}$-complete for $k \ge 5$, indicating a sharp jump in computational complexity assuming the polynomial hierarchy does not collapse. Combined with other results, one major implication is that no polynomial-time Turing machine can transform a bilevel LP instance with linking constraints into one without linking constraints while preserving feasibility unless P $=$ NP. In contrast, such machines exist for all $k \ge 5$.
  We observe similar phenomena with the decision of the existence of an optimal solution. In the bilevel case, feasibility and boundedness fully characterize the existence of an optimal solution, implying that the problem is DP-complete. However, these conditions are insufficient for $k \ge 3$ and the problem for $k \ge 3$ is $Δ^{p}_k$-complete. Similar to the feasibility problem, the problem becomes polynomially solvable for $k=2,3$ without linking constraints and unbounded variables. However, the problem is $Δ^{p}_k$-complete for $k \ge 4$, even with these simplifying assumptions. The computation of the optimal objective value is F$Δ^{p}_k$-complete for any $k \ge 2$, even without linking constraints and unbounded variables.

AI.tldr: 本文系统刻画了多级线性规划（k-level LP）在有无链接约束、变量是否有界等不同建模假设下的计算复杂度。主要发现包括：可行性问题在k≥2时为Σ^{p}_{k-1}-完全；无链接约束和变量无界时，k≤4可在多项式时间内求解，但k≥5时变为Σ^{p}_{k-1}-完全。最优解存在性问题在双层时为DP-完全，k≥3时为Δ^{p}_k-完全。最优目标值计算问题对任意k≥2均为FΔ^{p}_k-完全。
AI.motivation: 多级规划是建模层次化决策的标准框架，但其计算复杂度的精确刻画尚未完善。本文旨在系统性地分析不同建模假设下多级线性规划在可行性、最优解存在性及最优值计算三个核心问题上的计算复杂度边界。
AI.method: 采用多项式层次归约与复杂度分类理论，针对k级线性规划的不同变体（有无链接约束、变量是否有界），分别给出可行性、最优解存在性和最优值计算问题的精确复杂度特征（完全性结果），并通过归约建立复杂度上下界。
AI.result: (1) 可行性：k≥2时Σ^{p}_{k-1}-完全；无链接约束且变量无界时k≤4可多项式求解，k≥5则Σ^{p}_{k-1}-完全。(2) 最优解存在性：双层为DP-完全，k≥3为Δ^{p}_k-完全；无链接约束且变量无界时k=2,3可多项式求解，k≥4为Δ^{p}_k-完全。(3) 最优值计算：任意k≥2均为FΔ^{p}_k-完全。(4) 除非P=NP，否则不存在多项式时间图灵机将带链接约束的双层LP转化为不带链接约束的等价实例。
AI.conclusion: 多级线性规划的复杂度随层级数和建模假设呈现精确的跃变模式，在k=4→5和k=2→3等关键阈值处出现复杂度"陡升"现象。这些结果揭示了链接约束对问题本质复杂度的根本性影响，并为多级规划算法的设计提供了理论下限。

title: Rao-Blackwellized Score Matching on Manifolds
summary: We study denoising score matching (DSM) when the latent distribution is supported on a smooth embedded manifold $M \subset \mathbb{R}^D$. Under ambient Gaussian corruption, the tangent denoising target contains a singular normal-fiber noise channel whose variance diverges as $d/σ^2$ as $σ\to 0^+$. We show that conditioning on the nearest-point projection $π(X)$ canonically removes this singularity: the resulting conditional expectation is the unique $L^2$-optimal Rao-Blackwellized predictor of the tangent DSM target among all estimators depending only on the projected observation $π(X)$. We then compute the small-noise expansion of this canonical target and show that it equals the intrinsic Riemannian score up to an explicit order-$σ^2$ correction that decomposes into an intrinsic Tweedie term and an extrinsic curvature term involving the Weingarten and Ricci operators. In the flat case, the construction reduces exactly to ordinary lower-dimensional Gaussian DSM, while on $S^d$ the extrinsic correction simplifies to the scalar factor $(1-d/2)\nabla_M \log q$; this extrinsic $σ^2$ correction cancels identically on $S^2$, though the intrinsic Tweedie term remains.

AI.tldr: 本文研究流形上潜在分布的去噪分数匹配（DSM），发现切向去噪目标在σ→0⁺时存在奇异法向噪声通道。通过最近点投影条件化可消除该奇异性，得到Rao-Blackwellized最优预测器。小噪声展开揭示该目标等于本征黎曼分数加上显式的σ²阶修正项（含内禀Tweedie项和外蕴曲率项）。平面情形退化为标准高斯DSM，球面上外蕴修正简化为特定标量因子，S²上该修正项恒为零。
AI.motivation: 研究流形支撑的潜在分布下DSM的行为，特别关注切向去噪目标中出现的奇异法向噪声通道问题，并寻求通过投影条件化消除该奇异性。
AI.method: 使用最近点投影π(X)进行条件化来消除奇异法向噪声通道，推导小噪声展开，将目标分解为本征黎曼分数加上σ²阶修正项（Tweedie项和曲率项）。
AI.result: 条件化投影后的期望是L²最优的Rao-Blackwellized预测器；小噪声展开显示目标等于黎曼分数加σ²阶修正；平面情形退化为标准DSM；S^d上外蕴修正简化为(1-d/2)∇_M log q；S²上外蕴修正恒为零但内禀Tweedie项保留。
AI.conclusion: 通过投影条件化可系统性消除流形DSM中的奇异性，且得到的预测器具有最优性；修正项揭示了流形几何（曲率）对去噪分数匹配的影响，为高维流形数据的分数匹配提供了理论基础。

title: Not All Transitions Matter: Evidence from PPO
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to 2026 8th Asia Conference on Machine Learning and Computing (ACMLC 2026)
summary:
Training a reinforcement learning agent on-policy means collecting fresh experience at every update, and that experience comes with a hidden problem. Each state in a rollout is the direct output of the previous one, causally chained together by the agent's own actions. Because of this, consecutive transitions are never truly independent. They carry overlapping information, and the gradient signal the network receives ends up far more repetitive than the batch size suggests. The same directions get reinforced over and over, the value network struggles to keep up as the policy shifts, and training becomes quietly unstable in ways that reward curves alone rarely reveal.
  This paper asks whether that redundancy can simply be removed. We show that randomly dropping a fixed fraction of transitions from the rollout, at the right stage so the reward signal stays intact, is enough to break the repetitive gradient structure and stabilize training. The change is minimal: one sampling step, no new components, no modification to the core algorithm, and it works with any PPO implementation. Across five environments of increasing difficulty, CartPole-v1, Acrobot-v1, LunarLander-v2, HalfCheetah-v5, and Hopper-v5, the method matches vanilla PPO on reward while producing more consistent training dynamics across KL divergence, policy entropy, and value estimates. Dropping 25% of transitions turns out to be the sweet spot: enough to disrupt the redundancy, not enough to thin the batch.

AI.tldr: 本文发现on-policy强化学习中连续transition存在因果依赖性导致的梯度冗余问题，提出在PPO训练中随机丢弃25%的transition即可打破这种冗余结构、稳定训练，且无需修改核心算法。
AI.motivation: On-policy强化学习中，rollout内连续transition因agent自身动作因果链而产生信息重叠，导致梯度信号重复、价值网络不稳定、训练隐式不稳定，而奖励曲线难以揭示此问题。本文旨在探究能否简单去除这种冗余。
AI.method: 在PPO算法中，对收集到的rollout transition在保持奖励信号完整的前提下，随机丢弃固定比例（25%）的transition，仅增加一个采样步骤，不引入新组件、不修改核心算法。
AI.result: 在CartPole-v1、Acrobot-v1、LunarLander-v2、HalfCheetah-v5、Hopper-v5五个环境中，该方法在奖励上与vanilla PPO持平，但在KL散度、策略熵和价值估计上展现出更一致的训练动态。25%丢弃率为最佳阈值。
AI.conclusion: 随机丢弃固定比例的transition是一种极简但有效的策略，能够打破on-policy rollout中的梯度冗余结构、稳定训练，且与任何PPO实现兼容。

title: A Dynamical Framework for Cognitive Processes Based on Transformations and Semantic Equivalence
summary:
This paper proposes a structural and dynamical framework for modeling cognitive processes within a cybernetic perspective. Cognitive states are represented as elements of a state space evolving through an iterative update rule of the form
  \[
  X_{t+1} = π\big(F(f(X_t))\big),
  \]
  where $f$ describes internal transformations, $F$ represents interpretative mappings, and $π$ enforces semantic equivalence.
  The model is interpreted as a feedback system integrating transformation, observation, and stabilization. A categorical formulation is introduced to capture compositional structure, while the associated dynamics are analyzed through fixed-point arguments and contraction conditions ensuring stability.
  To demonstrate the operational character of the framework, a computational illustration is provided, together with a qualitative analysis of the induced dynamics. A concrete linguistic application shows how context-dependent interpretation can be modeled as a trajectory toward a stable semantic class.
  The proposed approach connects dynamical systems, category theory, and cognitive modeling, and provides a unified representation of cognition as a feedback-driven process evolving toward invariant interpretations.

AI.tldr: 本文从控制论视角出发，提出了一个结构化和动力学框架来建模认知过程，将认知状态表示为状态空间中的元素，通过迭代更新规则演化，并利用范畴论和不动点理论分析其稳定性，最终通过计算示例和语言应用展示了框架的操作性。
AI.motivation: 现有认知模型缺乏统一的数学框架来整合动力学系统、范畴论与认知建模，难以同时描述认知过程的变换、解释和稳定化机制。
AI.method: 提出迭代更新规则 X_{t+1} = π(F(f(X_t)))，其中 f 为内部变换，F 为解释性映射，π 为语义等价约束；引入范畴论刻画组合结构；通过不动点论证和压缩条件分析动力学稳定性；提供计算示例和语言学应用验证。
AI.result: 该框架能够将认知过程建模为反馈驱动、趋向不变解释的轨迹，在语言学应用中展示了上下文依赖解释如何收敛到稳定语义类别。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为认知建模提供了统一表示，将认知视为反馈驱动、趋于不变解释的演化过程，连接了动力学系统、范畴论和认知建模三个领域。

title: Boosted Stochastic Frank-Wolfe for Constrained Nonconvex Optimization
summary: The boosted Frank-Wolfe algorithm accelerates the classical Frank-Wolfe algorithm by better aligning the update direction with the negative gradient. Its analysis, however, has been limited to deterministic convex problems, with step sizes that require either line search or knowledge of the Lipschitz constant of the gradient. We develop a novel step size strategy that does not depend on the Lipschitz constant of the gradient, which allows us to extend the boosted Frank-Wolfe algorithm to the stochastic setting. We prove that boosting with this step size strategy can be combined with many modern gradient estimators, including SAGA, L-SVRG, SAG, Heavy Ball momentum, and zeroth-order estimators, among others, while retaining the worst-case convergence rates of ordinary stochastic Frank-Wolfe. Our analysis also yields the first convergence rates for boosted Frank-Wolfe on nonconvex and quasar-convex objectives, results which are new even for deterministic problems. Experiments on sparse logistic regression and quantum process tomography show that stochastic boosted Frank-Wolfe achieves faster convergence per gradient oracle call (and on wall-clock) compared to the non-boosted baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种不依赖于Lipschitz常数的步长策略，将Boosted Frank-Wolfe算法扩展到随机设置，并首次证明了其在非凸和拟凸目标上的收敛率，实验表明该算法在每次梯度调用和实际时间上均优于非增强基线。
AI.motivation: 经典Boosted Frank-Wolfe算法仅适用于确定性凸问题，且需要线搜索或已知梯度Lipschitz常数来设定步长，这限制了其在实际应用中的灵活性。作者旨在开发一种无需Lipschitz常数的步长策略，使其能够扩展到随机优化场景。
AI.method: 提出一种不依赖梯度Lipschitz常数的新型步长策略，将该策略与多种现代梯度估计器（如SAGA、L-SVRG、SAG、Heavy Ball动量、零阶估计器等）结合，形成随机Boosted Frank-Wolfe算法。理论分析涵盖了凸、非凸和拟凸目标函数。
AI.result: 理论结果表明，所提步长策略可保持普通随机Frank-Wolfe的最坏情况收敛率；首次给出了Boosted Frank-Wolfe在非凸和拟凸目标上的收敛率（对确定性情况也是新结果）。实验在稀疏逻辑回归和量子过程层析成像上验证了随机Boosted Frank-Wolfe在每次梯度调用和实际运行时间上均优于非增强基线。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的无Lipschitz常数依赖的步长策略成功将Boosted Frank-Wolfe推广到随机设置，并兼容多种梯度估计器，同时在非凸和拟凸问题上取得了新的理论收敛结果，实验验证了其有效性。

title: Nonstationary Generalized Linear Bandits with Discounted Online Mirror Descent
summary: We study nonstationary generalized linear bandits (GLBs), where the expected reward is modeled through a nonlinear link function with an unknown time-varying parameter. This framework encompasses a broad class of reward models, including linear, Bernoulli, and binomial rewards. Existing approaches are predominantly based on maximum-likelihood estimation (MLE), using sliding-window, restart, or discounting mechanisms to handle nonstationarity. Although these methods achieve statistically efficient regret guarantees, they generally require revisiting past observations at every round, which leads to computation and memory costs that grow with time; moreover, several of them rely on a non-convex projection step. In this paper, we propose DOMD-GLB, a new algorithm for nonstationary GLBs that utilizes discounted online mirror descent (DOMD) for parameter estimation, thereby incurring only $O(1)$ computation and memory costs per round. We prove dynamic regret bounds of order $\tilde{O} \big(c_μ^{-1/2} d^{3/4} P_T^{1/4} T^{3/4}\big)$ in drifting environments and $\tilde{O}\big(c_μ^{-1/3} d^{2/3} Γ_T^{1/3} T^{2/3}\big) $in piecewise-stationary environments, where $d$ denotes the feature dimension, $T$ the time horizon, $P_T$ the path length, $Γ_T$ the number of change points, and $c_μ$ a curvature parameter associated with the link function, while substantially improving computational efficiency over prior work. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first algorithm for nonstationary GLBs with per-round computation and memory costs independent of time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DOMD-GLB算法，利用折扣在线镜像下降（DOMD）进行参数估计，在非平稳广义线性bandits（GLBs）中实现了每轮O(1)的计算和内存开销，并给出了动态遗憾界。
AI.motivation: 现有非平稳GLB方法主要基于最大似然估计（MLE），使用滑动窗口、重启或折扣机制，虽在统计效率上表现良好，但每轮需要重新访问历史数据，计算和内存成本随时间增长，且部分方法依赖非凸投影步骤。因此需要一种计算效率更高的算法。
AI.method: 提出DOMD-GLB算法，采用折扣在线镜像下降（DOMD）进行参数估计，避免了每轮重新访问历史数据的需求，使得每轮计算和内存开销为O(1)。
AI.result: 在漂移环境下获得$\tilde{O}(c_μ^{-1/2} d^{3/4} P_T^{1/4} T^{3/4})$的动态遗憾界；在分段平稳环境下获得$\tilde{O}(c_μ^{-1/3} d^{2/3} Γ_T^{1/3} T^{2/3})$的动态遗憾界，同时大幅提升计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个在非平稳GLB中实现每轮计算和内存开销与时间无关的算法。

title: Verified SHAP: Provable Bounds for Exact Shapley Values of Neural Networks
summary: Shapley additive explanations (SHAP) are widely recognised as computationally intractable for neural networks, since they induce an exponential search space over the input features. In this work, we take a first step towards scaling exact SHAP computation to larger search spaces by introducing an algorithm that leverages recent advances in neural network verification to compute arbitrarily tight exact lower and upper bounds on SHAP values for neural networks, ultimately recovering the exact SHAP values. We demonstrate that our approach scales to orders of magnitude larger search spaces than state-of-the-art exact methods. This provides an important first step towards exact SHAP computation and establishes a principled cornerstone for evaluating statistical approximation methods on larger search spaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用神经网络验证技术来精确计算SHAP值的方法，相比现有精确方法能处理数量级更大的搜索空间。
AI.motivation: SHAP值对于神经网络来说计算上是棘手的，因为其需要指数级搜索空间，现有精确方法无法处理较大规模的问题。
AI.method: 利用神经网络验证的最新进展，设计算法计算SHAP值的任意紧致的精确上下界，最终恢复精确SHAP值。
AI.result: 该方法能够扩展到比现有最先进精确方法大数量级的搜索空间。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作为大规模精确SHAP计算奠定了原理性基石，也为评估统计近似方法提供了基准。

title: Spacetime Formation under Requirements: Contextual Realization and Form-Dependent Probability
summary:
Quantum cognition often explains order effects, contextuality, and violations of the law of total probability by replacing classical probability with quantum probability on a fixed event structure. This paper proposes a different interpretation: quantum probability is the fixed-spacetime projection of contextual spacetime formation under finite-state requirements.
  The framework begins not with time, space, objects, or probabilities, but with requirements such as finite representational capacity, single-state semantic stability, context-sensitive intervention, avoidance of explicit context labels, coherent world-formation, and intersubjective transformability. When these requirements cannot be realized within a single global Boolean event structure, the mismatch appears, under fixed-spacetime projection, as noncommutativity, interference, and quantum-like probability.
  Building on prior single-state approaches to contextuality, we reinterpret classical contextual bookkeeping cost as the fixed-spacetime shadow of contextual spacetime formation. Auxiliary memory or context labels in a classical representation correspond, in this account, to holonomy-like mismatch among locally Boolean logic-worlds. The interference term is the cross term generated when locally classical realization contributions are nontrivially glued and projected back into a fixed classical spacetime form.
  The result is a transcendental-operational realist account: objecthood, eventhood, probability, and spacetime are treated as forms of realization under requirements, while objectivity is defined by invariants preserved across observer- and history-dependent spacetime formations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出量子概率并非基础性的概率框架，而是在有限状态要求下，情境化时空构型在固定时空投影中的表现。当全局布尔事件结构无法满足有限表征容量、单态语义稳定性等要求时，非对易性、干涉项和类量子概率作为固定时空投影的“影子”出现。
AI.motivation: 现有量子认知研究通常用固定事件结构上的量子概率替代经典概率来解释序效应、情境性和全概率律违反。本文旨在提供一种不同解释：将量子概率视为在有限状态要求下，情境化时空构型被投影回固定时空形式的产物，从而为量子认知现象提供超越-操作实在论的基础。
AI.method: 1. 从先决条件（有限表征容量、单态语义稳定性、情境敏感干预、避免显式情境标签、连贯世界构型、主体间可转换性）出发，而非从时间、空间、对象或概率出发。2. 当这些条件无法在单一全局布尔事件结构中实现时，固定时空投影下表现为非对易性和类量子概率。3. 将经典情境性记账成本重新解释为情境化时空构型在固定时空下的“影子”，将辅助记忆或情境标签解释为局部布尔逻辑世界间的类似和乐（holonomy）的失配。4. 干涉项被视为局部经典实现贡献经非平凡粘合后投影回固定经典时空形式的交叉项。
AI.result: 建立了超越-操作实在论框架：对象性、事件性、概率和时空被视为在要求下的实现形式，而客观性由跨观察者和历史依赖的时空构型中保持的不变量定义。
AI.conclusion: 量子概率不是基础概率模型，而是有限状态现实约束下情境化时空构型的投影效应。该框架为量子认知现象提供了不同于标准量子概率替代的解释路径，并重新定义了客观性的基础。

title: Uncertainty Quantification in Data-Driven Inverse Optimization via Bayesian Inference
summary: Inverse optimization (IO) is used to estimate unknown parameters of an optimization model from observed decisions. In the data-driven context, the estimated parameters are inherently uncertain, yet quantifying this uncertainty has received limited attention in the literature, where existing methods return a point estimate. In this paper, we propose a hierarchical Bayesian framework for parameter uncertainty quantification in data-driven inverse optimization. Considering two data-generating processes, we develop two Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithms to estimate the posterior distribution of the unknown parameter vector, which is used to construct credible regions. We establish posterior consistency under standard identifiability conditions. Numerical experiments demonstrate near-nominal empirical coverage of the credible regions and show that the regions shrink as the number of observed decisions increases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种分层贝叶斯框架，用于数据驱动逆优化中的参数不确定性量化，通过两种MCMC算法估计未知参数的后验分布并构建可信区域，实验表明该区域具有接近名义的覆盖度并随观测决策数增加而缩小。
AI.motivation: 逆优化中估计的参数本身存在不确定性，但现有方法仅返回点估计，缺乏对参数不确定性的量化研究。
AI.method: 提出分层贝叶斯框架，针对两种数据生成过程开发两种马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛算法，估计未知参数向量的后验分布并构建可信区域，并在标准可辨识条件下建立后验一致性。
AI.result: 数值实验表明可信区域具有接近名义的经验覆盖度，且区域随观测决策数增加而收缩。
AI.conclusion: 所提贝叶斯框架能有效量化逆优化中参数的不确定性，且具有理论上的后验一致性保证和良好的实证性能。

title: Optimal Design for Multinomial Logit Model with Applications to Best Assortment Identification
summary: We study optimal experimental design for multinomial logit (MNL) bandits, where an agent repeatedly selects a subset of $K$ items from a ground set of size $N$ and observes single-choice feedback. Unlike linear or generalized linear bandits, MNL bandits have a combinatorial action space, which makes classical optimal design approaches and naive optimization over all subsets computationally intractable. We propose a computationally efficient optimal design framework for MNL models that achieves both statistical efficiency and scalability through two complementary approaches: (i) an exact or certified-approximate reformulation of the design oracle as a $0$-$1$ mixed-integer linear program (MILP) with solver-certified early stopping, and (ii) a fully polynomial-time lifted design that replaces the nonlinear objective with a tractable surrogate. Using the Kiefer-Wolfowitz equivalence theorem, we establish near G-optimality guarantees and characterize the induced statistical-computational trade-offs. As an application, we develop a best assortment identification algorithm for MNL bandits with linear utilities and non-uniform revenues, and prove an instance-dependent sample complexity of $\tilde{O}\big(\frac{d \log N}{Δ^2}\big)$, where $d$ is the feature dimension, $N$ is the number of arms, and $Δ$ is the minimum revenue gap.

AI.tldr: 本文针对MNL bandits中的最优实验设计问题，提出两种计算高效的方法：一是将设计oracle精确或近似重构为0-1混合整数线性规划（MILP）并支持求解器认证的提前停止；二是提出完全多项式时间的提升设计方法，用易处理的替代目标替换非线性目标。基于Kiefer-Wolfowitz等价定理，建立了近G-最优性保证，并刻画了统计-计算权衡。作为应用，开发了针对线性效用和非均匀收益的最佳assortment识别算法，实现了$\tilde{O}(d \log N / \Delta^2)$的实例相关样本复杂度。
AI.motivation: MNL bandits的动作空间是组合的（从N个物品中选择K个子集），这使得经典最优设计方法和对所有子集进行朴素优化在计算上不可行。现有方法难以同时兼顾统计效率和计算可扩展性。
AI.method: 提出两种互补方法：(1) 将设计oracle精确或近似重构为0-1混合整数线性规划（MILP），支持求解器认证的提前停止；(2) 提出完全多项式时间（FPT）的提升设计，用可处理的替代函数替换非线性目标函数。利用Kiefer-Wolfowitz等价定理建立理论保证。
AI.result: 建立了近G-最优性保证，刻画了统计-计算权衡。在最佳assortment识别应用中，实现了$\tilde{O}(d \log N / \Delta^2)$的实例相关样本复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种计算高效的MNL模型最优实验设计框架，通过两种互补方法同时实现了统计效率和可扩展性，并展示了在最佳assortment识别中的实际应用价值。

title: Overcoming "Physics Shock" in Earth Observation A Heteroscedastic Uncertainty Framework for PINN-based Flood Inference
comment: This article is accepted in IEEE Journal of Selected Topics in Applied Earth Observations and Remote Sensing
summary: Rapid and accurate flood extent mapping from Remote Sensing data, such as Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR), is critical for operational disaster response, but standard Deep Learning models often produce physically impossible predictions due to a lack of hydrological constraints. While PhysicsInformed Neural Networks (PINNs) attempt to address this by embedding governing laws directly into the loss function, their application to real-world remote sensing data frequently fails. Enforcing rigid spatial derivatives (e.g., the 2D Shallow Water Equations) onto unconditioned latent spaces attempting to fit noisy SAR speckle causes catastrophic gradient divergence, a phenomenon we term Physics Shock. In this paper, we propose a novel Uncertainty-Aware PINN framework tailored specifically for applied Earth Observation that addresses this instability. By integrating a dynamic Warm-Start protocol and modeling heteroscedastic aleatoric uncertainty via a negative log-likelihood objective, the network learns to dynamically relax physical constraints in regions of high sensor noise while strictly enforcing them in high-confidence areas. Evaluated on the Sen1Floods11 dataset, our probabilistic Attention-Gated FNO-UNet successfully stabilizes multi-objective optimization, achieving a +25% relative improvement in Intersection over Union (IoU) compared to deterministic baselines. Furthermore, through Deep Ensembles, we successfully disentangle intrinsic sensor noise from out-of-distribution terrain ignorance, providing operational agencies with highly calibrated, physically consistent confidence bounds for robust disaster mitigation and real-time decision-making.

AI.tldr: 针对标准深度学习模型在遥感SAR影像洪水制图中产生物理不一致预测的问题，本文提出一种不确定性感知的物理-informed神经网络框架。通过集成动态热启动协议和异方差偶然不确定性建模，网络能够在高噪声区域动态放松物理约束、在高置信区域严格执行，有效解决物理冲击导致的梯度发散问题。在Sen1Floods11数据集上，所提概率注意力门控FNO-UNet相较于确定性基线实现了IoU提升25%，并通过深度集成解耦了传感器噪声与分布外地形不确定性，提供了校准良好、物理一致的置信边界。
AI.motivation: 标准深度学习模型在SAR洪水制图中缺乏水文约束，常产生物理上不可能的预测；而传统PINNs在真实遥感数据上因强行施加刚性空间导数（如浅水方程）到受噪声污染的SAR潜空间，导致灾难性梯度发散（即物理冲击），因此亟需一种能够处理遥感数据高噪声特性且稳定优化物理约束的框架。
AI.method: 1) 提出不确定性感知PINN框架，结合动态Warm-Start协议缓解初始训练不稳定；2) 通过负对数似然目标建模异方差偶然不确定性，使网络自适应地在高噪声区域放松物理约束、在高置信区域严格施加约束；3) 采用概率注意力门控FNO-UNet架构；4) 利用深度集成解耦传感器噪声与分布外地形不确定性。
AI.result: 在Sen1Floods11数据集上，所提方法相比确定性基线在IoU上提升25%，有效稳定了多目标优化过程，并生成校准良好、物理一致的置信边界。
AI.conclusion: 该不确定性感知PINN框架成功解决了物理约束在遥感噪声数据中的梯度发散问题，为灾害应急响应提供了兼具物理一致性和可靠性量化的实时决策支持工具。

title: Right-Sizing Communication and Recommendation Set Size in AI-Assisted Search
summary:
We model the interaction between a user and an AI driven recommendation system. The user initiates the process by conveying preference information through a costly and noisy message. The AI assistant, acting as a Bayesian agent, interprets the user's message to form a posterior belief about their true preferences and make product recommendations. In particular, it determines how many recommendations to present so as to maximize the user's expected utility from their final choice, while accounting for the search cost induced by the size of the recommendation set. We use mutual information based cost functions to model the two distinct costs incurred by the user during the interaction: (i) a communication cost, which increases with the precision of their preference message, and (ii) a search cost, which increases with the size of the recommendation set provided by the AI assistant.
  We study products and preferences which live in d dimensional space, and ask how the user's expected payoff can be maximized. For large d, we characterize how optimal message precision and recommendation set size depend on the cost parameters, under two distinct distributions from which recommendations can be sampled from the product universe: (i) Bayes' posterior belief, and (ii) an optimized tilted distribution. Under the posterior sampling scheme (i), we identify a hybrid regime, in which an efficient interaction policy requires jointly optimizing the amount of information (in bits) conveyed by the user and the number of recommendations provided by the AI assistant. In the tilted sampling scheme (ii), our results show that the optimal interaction policy uses only one of communication and search, favoring whichever of them is less costly.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个贝叶斯推荐系统模型，研究用户通过有成本、有噪声的消息传递偏好信息，AI助手根据后验信念推荐产品。在d维空间中，分析了两种采样策略下最优信息精度与推荐集大小的权衡，发现后验采样策略下需要联合优化通信与搜索成本，而倾斜采样策略下仅需使用成本较低的一种方式。
AI.motivation: 建模用户与AI推荐系统的交互过程，考虑用户传递偏好信息的通信成本以及浏览推荐列表的搜索成本，研究如何在两种成本之间进行最优权衡以最大化用户期望效用。
AI.method: 采用互信息成本函数分别建模通信成本（偏好消息精度）和搜索成本（推荐集大小），在高维（d大）场景下分析两种采样分布策略：后验信念采样和优化的倾斜分布采样。
AI.result: 后验采样策略下存在混合机制，需要联合优化用户信息传输量（比特数）和推荐数量；倾斜采样策略下，最优策略仅使用通信或搜索中成本较低的一种方式。
AI.conclusion: 推荐系统的交互效率取决于成本参数的相对大小与采样策略的选择，不同策略下最优机制存在本质差异。

title: A Sequential Quadratic Programming Perspective on Optimal Control
summary:
This paper investigates the performance of Newton's method, iterative Linear Quadratic Regulator (iLQR), and Differential Dynamic Programming (DDP) in solving discrete-time optimal control problems. We offer a unified perspective on these approaches, centered on the understanding that each method ultimately solves a sequence of quadratic programs. Building upon previous comparative works, this paper contributes additional mathematical explanations and results to the analysis.
  In particular, it is shown that iLQR is a principled Sequential Quadratic Programming (SQP) approach, rather than merely an approximation of DDP that neglects Hessian terms. This characteristic guarantees that iLQR will always produce a cost-descent direction and converge to an optimum, under some mild assumptions. In contrast, Newton's method and DDP lack these guarantees, especially when initialized far from an optimum. A series of numerical examples are presented to corroborate the mathematical reasoning and analysis developed in the paper.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了牛顿法、迭代线性二次调节器(iLQR)和微分动态规划(DDP)在求解离散时间最优控制问题中的性能，提供了一个统一视角，表明这些方法本质上都是求解一系列二次规划。论文证明iLQR是一种原则性的序列二次规划(SQP)方法，而非DDP的近似，这保证了iLQR总能产生代价下降方向并收敛到最优解，而牛顿法和DDP则缺乏这种保证。
AI.motivation: 现有文献对牛顿法、iLQR和DDP在离散时间最优控制问题中的关系缺乏统一的理论理解，特别是iLQR常被错误地视为忽略海森项的DDP近似，其理论性质未被充分阐明。
AI.method: 从统一视角出发，将三种方法均解释为求解一系列二次规划的过程。通过数学推导证明iLQR本质上是原则性的SQP方法，并在温和假设下分析其收敛性和代价下降方向保证，同时对比牛顿法和DDP的理论缺陷。
AI.result: iLQR总能产生代价下降方向并在温和假设下收敛到最优解；牛顿法和DDP在远离最优解初始化时缺乏这些保证。数值实验验证了理论分析。
AI.conclusion: iLQR是一种具有更强理论保证的SQP方法，优于牛顿法和DDP在初始化敏感性和收敛性方面的表现。

title: Learning Sparse Compositional Functions with Norm-Constrained Neural Networks
summary: The ability of deep neural networks to learn hierarchical features is widely regarded as a key mechanism underlying their success in high-dimensional learning. Existing theory partially supports this view by establishing approximation rates based on parameter counts and sample complexity guarantees for compositional models without incurring the curse of dimensionality (CoD). To study overparameterized regimes, where the number of parameters exceeds the sample size, we develop a framework that measures complexity via the parameter norm. Within this approach, we establish approximation rates and excess risk bounds for learning sparse compositional functions whose compositional structure is represented by directed acyclic graphs (DAGs), using Frobenius norm-constrained deep neural networks. Our results have broad applicability since every function that is efficiently Turing computable admits sparse compositional representations. In particular, we cover a range of representative models, including multi-index models, binary tree structures, and general compositional architectures. The rates we derive show that deep networks can exploit the compositional structure of the target functions, effectively avoiding the CoD through hierarchical representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于参数范数度量复杂度的框架，证明了深度神经网络在过参数化（参数数量超过样本量）情况下，能够通过学习稀疏组合函数（由有向无环图表示）避免维度灾难，并建立了近似率和过量风险界。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络学习层次化特征的能力是其在高维学习中成功的关键，但现有理论主要关注参数数量较少时的近似率和样本复杂度，缺乏对过参数化场景（参数数超过样本数）的严格理论分析。
AI.method: 开发了一个基于参数范数（Frobenius范数约束）度量复杂度的理论框架，针对由有向无环图（DAG）表示的稀疏组合函数，分析Frobenius范数约束深度神经网络的近似率和过量风险。
AI.result: 建立了稀疏组合函数的近似率和过量风险界；覆盖了多指标模型、二叉树结构、通用组合架构等代表性模型；证明深度网络能利用目标函数的组合结构，通过层次化表示有效避免维度灾难。
AI.conclusion: 深度神经网络可以通过层次化表示利用组合结构避免维度灾难，且该框架具有广泛适用性（任何可高效图灵计算的函数都存在稀疏组合表示）。

title: Riemannian Archetypal Analysis: Interpretable non-linear data analysis on deformed star distributions
summary: Classical archetypal analysis is appealing for its interpretability, but its linear geometry can limit performance on data with strongly non-linear structure; at the same time, existing neural extensions improve flexibility while often weakening the geometric meaning of archetypes and interpolations. In this work, we develop a Riemannian version of archetypal analysis based on data-driven pullback geometry for real-valued data, with the goal of combining the interpretability of classical archetypal analysis with the expressive power of modern non-linear models. We introduce a class of deformed star distributions together with associated pullback Riemannian geometry to provide a statistical interpretation of the resulting manifold mappings, define the Riemannian archetypal mapping (RAM) as a projection onto the manifold of geodesically convex combinations of archetypes, and propose a practical optimization scheme based on convex relaxation followed by non-convex refinement. We further propose a learning scheme that yields reasonable, albeit generally suboptimal, deformed star distributions from data. Experiments on synthetic examples and MNIST show that the resulting framework produces meaningful geodesics, useful denoising projections, and geometry-aware classifications, while also clarifying where current optimization limitations remain.
