We study CoT faithfulness through a structural information-flow perspective: faithful reasoning should route answer-relevant information through the mediated path from prompt to CoT to answer, rather than through a direct prompt-to-answer shortcut. This perspective yields a task-agnostic framework based on three complementary properties, sufficiency, completeness, and necessity, which we instantiate with entropy-based, masked-KL, and gradient-based diagnostics. We show that these metrics recover externally judged faithfulness differences in hinted reasoning, and identify a low-entropy failure mode of KL-based diagnostics where gradient-based measures remain more stable. Building on this analysis, we introduce update-time interventions for verifier-based on-policy RL, including attention masking, backward-only gradient masking, CoT gradients, and adversarial perturbations of prompt representations. Across hinted arithmetic, reward-hackable code repair, and DAPO-Math models trained without hints but evaluated under wrong-hint injection, our interventions shift behavioral and structural indicators toward stronger CoT mediation. In particular, they make shortcut and reward-hacking behavior more transparent in the CoT and improve task-agnostic faithfulness metrics, while in some settings also reducing wrong-hint susceptibility. Our results suggest that controlling information flow during training is a practical route toward more faithful and monitorable CoT reasoning. Code is available at https://github.com/safety-research/faithful-cot.

AI.tldr: 本文从信息流视角系统研究了思维链（CoT）推理的忠实性问题，提出了基于充分性、完备性和必要性的任务无关框架，并设计了基于熵、掩蔽KL和梯度的诊断指标。在此基础上，引入了多种更新时干预方法（如注意力掩蔽、反向梯度掩蔽、CoT梯度、对抗性扰动等），实验表明这些干预能有效增强CoT的中介作用，提升推理透明度和任务无关忠实性指标，并降低错误提示的敏感性。
AI.motivation: 现有CoT推理存在"提示-答案捷径"问题，即模型可能绕过CoT直接生成答案，使得可见的推理链看似合理但实际具有误导性。缺乏从信息流角度系统衡量CoT忠实性的框架和提升忠实性的训练干预方法。
AI.method: 1) 提出基于信息流视角的忠实性框架：充分性（CoT包含足够信息）、完备性（CoT涵盖所有相关路径信息）、必要性（信息必须经过CoT路径）。2) 用熵、掩蔽KL和梯度三种诊断指标实例化该框架。3) 提出多种更新时干预：注意力掩蔽、反向梯度掩蔽、CoT梯度、提示表示对抗性扰动，用于基于验证器的在线RL训练。
AI.result: 实验覆盖提示算术、可奖励破解的代码修复和DAPO-Math模型（无提示训练但注入错误提示）。干预措施使捷径和奖励破解行为在CoT中更透明，提升了任务无关忠实性指标，在某些设置下降低了错误提示敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 训练过程中控制信息流是提升CoT推理忠实性和可监控性的实用途径。

title: Towards trustworthy agentic AI: a comprehensive survey of safety, robustness, privacy, and system security
comment: 36 pages, 4 figures. Survey/review article on trustworthy agentic AI. Published in Academia AI and Applications, 2026
summary: Agentic AI systems -- Large Language Models (LLMs) augmented with planning, tool use, memory, and long-horizon interactions -- can execute complex tasks autonomously, but their multi-step trajectories introduce new failure modes that challenge trustworthiness. This survey provides a focused examination of trustworthy agentic AI through two core dimensions that are critical for high-risk deployments: Safety and Robustness, and Privacy and System Security. For each dimension, we clarify key concepts, identify where risks emerge along the agent workflow, and summarize stage-targeted mitigation strategies. Other trustworthiness aspects (value alignment, transparency, fairness, and accountability) are discussed as relevant context rather than parallel chapters. To support consistent comparison and deployment decisions, we consolidate evaluation into a unified metrics-and-benchmarks hub, emphasizing both outcome and process signals (e.g., constraint violations, trace completeness, and adversarial success rates) and offering scenario-to-metric guidance for release gating. We conclude by outlining open challenges such as self-evolving agents, runtime monitoring and verification, privacy-preserving personalization, and the trust-utility trade-off, and present a case study of real-world security failures in open-source agentic systems. Our goal is to serve as a practical reference for researchers and practitioners building trustworthy agentic systems in high-stakes environments.

AI.tldr: 本文全面调研了可信赖的自主AI系统（基于LLM增强规划、工具使用、记忆和长程交互），聚焦安全与鲁棒性、隐私与系统安全两个核心维度，梳理了各维度关键概念、风险来源及阶段化缓解策略，构建了统一评估指标与基准体系，并讨论了开放挑战及真实世界安全失败案例。
AI.motivation: 自主AI系统在多步轨迹中引入新故障模式，威胁其可信赖性，尤其是在高风险部署场景下，亟需系统性审视安全、鲁棒性、隐私与系统安全等关键维度，以指导实际构建工作。
AI.method: 采用聚焦式调研方法，沿着Agent工作流识别各阶段风险，总结阶段针对性缓解策略，构建统一的度量与基准评估体系，并结合真实案例进行分析。
AI.result: 建立了安全与鲁棒性、隐私与系统安全两个核心维度的概念框架与风险图谱；提出了涵盖结果信号与过程信号（如约束违反、轨迹完整性、对抗成功率）的统一评估指标；给出了场景到度量的发布门控指南。
AI.conclusion: 自主AI系统的可信赖性面临自演化Agent、运行时监控与验证、隐私保护个性化、信任-效用权衡等开放挑战，需要进一步研究，本文为高风险环境下的研究者和实践者提供了实用参考。

title: TUBE: Tangent Upper Bound on Evidence for Discrete Diffusion Language Models
comment: Preprint. 9 pages main text, 5 figures, plus appendix
summary: Log-likelihood is a standard metric for evaluating generative models. Unfortunately, in contrast to autoregressive models (ARMs), discrete diffusion models generally do not admit exact computation of this quantity. Existing evaluations, therefore, rely on the evidence lower bound (ELBO), leaving unclear how much higher the true value may be. We address this by introducing the Tangent Upper Bound on Evidence (TUBE), a variational upper bound on log-likelihood that admits an unbiased Monte Carlo estimator. Our TUBE extends across latent-variable models, including masked diffusion models (MDMs), any-order ARMs (AO-ARMs), and block variants of both. Applied to block MDMs and block AO-ARMs, TUBE reveals our key empirical finding that these models lie strictly below the exact ARM baseline, showing that ARMs still dominate in likelihood.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TUBE（切线证据上界），一种可无偏蒙特卡洛估计的变分对数似然上界，用于评估离散扩散模型。实验发现，块状掩码扩散模型和块状任意顺序自回归模型的对数似然严格低于精确ARM基线，表明自回归模型在似然度上仍占主导地位。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散模型无法精确计算对数似然这一标准评估指标，现有方法依赖ELBO下界，无法得知真实值的上限，因此需要一种可计算的上界来更准确地评估模型性能。
AI.method: 提出TUBE（切线证据上界），一种变分上界，支持无偏蒙特卡洛估计，适用于潜变量模型（包括掩码扩散模型、任意顺序自回归模型及其块变体）。
AI.result: 应用TUBE于块MDM和块AO-ARM，发现这些模型的对数似然严格低于精确ARM基线，表明自回归模型在似然度上仍占主导。
AI.conclusion: 自回归模型在对数似然指标上仍优于离散扩散模型，TUBE为评估生成模型提供了更准确的上界工具。

title: Reason--Imagine--Act: Closed-Loop LLM Decision Making with World Models for Autonomous Driving
comment: Accepted by the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC 2026). 8 pages, 2 figures
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are promising for autonomous driving, but semantics-only decision policies can yield physically unsafe behavior in dynamic traffic. Existing methods either perform online language reasoning without explicit dynamics verification or use world models mainly in offline pipelines, leaving a gap between semantic intent and physical feasibility at decision time. We propose Reason--Imagine--Act (RIA), a closed-loop framework that couples an LLM reasoner with an action-conditioned world model for online safety verification. At each step, the LLM proposes an action template and candidate sub-actions, the world model performs short-horizon rollouts, and a safety scorer selects the safest executable action with feedback to the next reasoning step. Under a unified CARLA point-goal protocol (1000 episodes), RIA achieves 80.05% route completion, 51.10% arrival rate, and 0.20% collision rate. Under the same closed-loop interface, RIA consistently outperforms training-free baselines, including CARLA TM and MADA, on core closed-loop metrics. For reproducibility, code is available at https://github.com/pku-smart-city/source_code/tree/main/RIA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Reason-Imagine-Act (RIA)框架，将大语言模型与动作条件世界模型耦合，在自动驾驶中实现在线安全验证，显著提升了路径完成率、到达率并降低了碰撞率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的自动驾驶方法存在两个问题：纯语义决策策略在动态交通中会导致物理不安全行为；现有方法要么在线推理时不进行显式动力学验证，要么仅在离线流程中使用世界模型，导致决策时语义意图与物理可行性之间存在 gaps。
AI.method: RIA是一个闭环框架，包含三个步骤：1) LLM推理器提出动作模板和候选子动作；2) 动作条件世界模型执行短视距 rollout（前向模拟）；3) 安全评分器选择最安全的可执行动作，并将反馈信息传递到下一步推理。
AI.result: 在统一CARLA点目标协议下（1000个episodes），RIA实现了80.05%的路径完成率、51.10%的到达率和0.20%的碰撞率，在闭环指标上一致优于CARLA TM和MADA等免训练基线方法。
AI.conclusion: RIA框架通过将LLM的语义推理与世界模型的物理验证相结合，有效弥合了语义意图与物理可行性之间的差距，为自动驾驶中安全决策提供了可行方案。

title: Efficient DP-SGD for LLMs with Randomized Clipping
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are trained on vast datasets that may contain sensitive information. Differential privacy (DP), the de facto standard for formal privacy guarantees, provides a principled framework for training LLMs with provable privacy protection. However, state-of-the-art DP training implementations rely on fast gradient clipping techniques with memory overhead $O(B \min\{T^2, d^2\})$, where $B$ is the batch size, $T$ is the sequence length, and $d$ is the model width. This becomes prohibitive as both model size and context length grow. We propose DP-SGD-RC, a novel variant of DP-SGD with randomized clipping that reduces memory and compute complexity. DP-SGD-RC leverages stochastic trace estimation methods, specifically Hutchinson's estimator[Hutchinson, 1989] and its improved variant, Hutch++[Meyer et al., 2021], to reduce the memory footprint of per-sample gradient norm estimation. We provide a tight privacy analysis showing that DP-SGD-RC achieves noise multipliers competitive with deterministic clipping. Experiments fine-tuning Llama~3.2-1B on long-context benchmarks spanning classification, question answering, and summarization tasks demonstrate that DP-SGD-RC matches baseline utility while significantly reducing memory and compute requirements.

AI.tldr: 提出DP-SGD-RC算法，利用随机化裁剪和随机迹估计（Hutchinson's estimator/Hutch++）降低DP训练大语言模型时的内存和计算复杂度，在长上下文微调任务中匹配基线效用。
AI.motivation: 现有DP训练方法（如DP-SGD）在长序列和大模型场景下内存开销过大（$O(B \min\{T^2, d^2\})$），亟需更高效的内存和计算方案来支持LLM的隐私保护训练。
AI.method: 提出DP-SGD-RC：1）采用随机化裁剪（randomized clipping）替代确定性梯度裁剪；2）引入Hutchinson's estimator和Hutch++等随机迹估计方法高效计算每个样本的梯度范数；3）提供严格的隐私分析证明噪声乘子可与确定性裁剪相竞争。
AI.result: 在Llama~3.2-1B模型上对长上下文任务（分类、问答、摘要）进行微调，DP-SGD-RC在匹配基线效用的同时显著降低了内存和计算需求。
AI.conclusion: DP-SGD-RC通过随机化裁剪和迹估计技术有效解决了DP训练LLM的内存瓶颈，为隐私保护的LLM训练提供了更实用的方案。

title: Feature Learning in Wide Neural Networks under $μ$P: Identifiability and Sparse-Dictionary Decomposition of the Mean-Field Limit
summary:
We establish four structural results for feature learning in wide two-layer neural networks under the Maximal Update Parametrization ($μ$P).
  First, we prove global existence and uniqueness of the mean-field limit of noisy gradient descent under $μ$P, identifying the maximal admissible weight $w^*$ on the moment sequence of the initialization as the reciprocal parameter-moment-growth boundary, and hence the largest weighted moment class propagated by the flow. The finite-particle approximation has uniform-in-time squared-Wasserstein rate $O(N^{-1})$.
  Second, we characterize identifiability of the mean-field limit: two admissible parameter measures induce the same network function in $L^2$ exactly when their active components agree modulo the finite-rank realization symmetry of the architecture. The orbit depth $D^*_{\mathrm{orb}}$ is separated from the moment-variety depth $D^*_{\mathrm{var}}$.
  Third, under the Barron-Hermite target condition the active support of the long-time limit measure admits a sparse-dictionary decomposition: it is supported on at most $S^*$ atoms modulo finite-rank realization symmetry, with $S^*$ bounded by an explicit coefficient-threshold number.
  Fourth, we derive the total feature-learning-error decomposition into statistical, optimization, propagation-of-chaos, and sparse-residual components, with a target-dependent Hermite/Barron tail replacing any initialization-only residual.
  The four results are tied together by an architectural identity: the triple $(w^*, D^*_{\mathrm{orb}}, S^*)$ -- the maximal admissible weight, the orbit identifiability depth, and the sparse-dictionary depth at which the target is realizable -- is the natural learning cell of the architecture-data pair $(σ, ρ)$. The proofs are self-contained except for standard results from $μ$P and mean-field Langevin theory.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了宽两层神经网络在最大更新参数化（μP）下特征学习的四个结构性结果：均值场极限的全局存在唯一性、可辨识性刻画、Barron-Hermite目标下的稀疏字典分解，以及特征学习误差的分解。核心发现是三元组 (w^*, D^*_orb, S^*) 构成了架构-数据对 (σ, ρ) 的自然学习单元。
AI.motivation: 在最大更新参数化（μP）下，宽两层神经网络的特征学习机制尚未被严格理解，特别是均值场极限的存在性、参数可辨识性、稀疏表示能力以及误差分解等关键理论问题亟待解决。
AI.method: 采用均值场理论框架，结合μP参数化下的噪声梯度下降动力学分析；利用Wasserstein距离进行有限粒子逼近的误差估计；通过Barron-Hermite条件刻画目标函数的稀疏字典分解；运用矩序列、轨道深度和稀疏字典深度等概念建立统一的理论框架。
AI.result: (1) 证明了μP下噪声梯度下降均值场极限的全局存在唯一性，有限粒子逼近具有均匀时间平方Wasserstein率O(N^{-1})；(2) 刻画了均值场极限的可辨识性条件；(3) 在Barron-Hermite目标条件下，长期极限测度的活动支撑集存在至多S^*个原子的稀疏字典分解；(4) 导出了特征学习误差的完整分解（统计、优化、混沌传播、稀疏残差四个分量）。
AI.conclusion: 三元组 (w^*, D^*_orb, S^*) ——最大容许权重、轨道可辨识性深度和目标可实现稀疏字典深度——构成了架构-数据对 (σ, ρ) 的自然学习单元，为理解宽神经网络在μP下的特征学习提供了统一的理论框架。

title: LC-ERD: Mining Latent Logic for Self-Evolving Reasoning via Consistency-Regulated Reward Decomposition
summary: The evolution of Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning is bottlenecked by the scarcity of high-quality process data. While self-alignment via endogenous rewards offers a solution, mining valid supervision faces three challenges: (1) Label Noise via Mimetic Bias, where rewards prioritize statistical likelihood over logical truth, creating a "correctness illusion" that masks compounding errors; (2) Coarse-Grained Supervision, where sparse global outcomes (e.g., in GRPO) fail to provide granular guidance, treating reasoning chains as monolithic; and (3) Distributional Collapse, where signals fail to generalize without amplifying pre-training biases. To address these, we introduce LC-ERD (Logic-Consistent Endogenous Reward Decomposition), a framework framing self-alignment as latent structure mining. We derive a Variational Logic Potential by aggregating consensus from the model's Latent Logic Expertise (LLE) to denoise the reasoning manifold, and introduce a Multi-Agent Value Decomposition protocol based on the IGM principle to quantify individual step utility. Experiments show LC-ERD delivers a robust self-evolution path, uncovering trade-offs between logic consistency and accuracy while identifying high-value reasoning patterns missed by standard rewards. Our code is available at https://github.com/Reinhardmannn/LC-ERD.

AI.tldr: LC-ERD通过逻辑一致的内生奖励分解框架，解决了大语言模型自对齐过程中标签噪声、粗粒度监督和分布坍塌三大挑战，实现了对推理流形的去噪和细粒度步骤价值量化。
AI.motivation: LLM推理的自对齐受限于高质量过程数据的稀缺性，现有内生奖励方法面临三个核心问题：(1) 模仿偏误导致标签噪声，奖励偏向统计似然而非逻辑真理；(2) 粗粒度监督（如GRPO的稀疏全局回报）无法提供细粒度指导；(3) 分布坍塌，信号无法泛化且放大预训练偏见。
AI.method: (1) 提取模型中的隐式逻辑专家(LLE)聚合共识，推导变分逻辑势(Variational Logic Potential)对推理流形进行去噪；(2) 基于IGM(Individual Global Max)原理引入多智能体价值分解协议，量化每个推理步骤的独立效用。
AI.result: LC-ERD提供了稳健的自演化路径，揭示了逻辑一致性与准确性之间的权衡关系，并识别出标准奖励方法遗漏的高价值推理模式。
AI.conclusion: LC-ERD通过将自对齐建模为隐结构挖掘任务，有效解决了内生奖励的三大挑战，为LLM推理提供了一种更鲁棒的自演化机制。

title: Global linear convergence of entropy-regularized softmax policy gradient beyond tabular MDPs
summary: We study the global convergence of policy gradient for infinite-horizon entropy-regularized Markov decision processes (MDPs) with continuous state and action spaces. We consider log-linear softmax policies with linear function approximation, which extend the tabular softmax parameterization while retaining a tractable policy class. Under $Q^π_τ$-realizability for the regularized state-action value function, we first establish a non-uniform Polyak--Łojasiewicz (PŁ) inequality. The non-uniformity arises through degeneracy of constants associated with the policy geometry, namely the Fisher information matrix or an uncentered feature covariance matrix. We then identify two feature regimes under which this non-uniform constant can be bounded along the gradient flow. For full-affine-span features, we prove radial unboundedness of the KL regularizer and show that the smallest eigenvalue of the Fisher information matrix remains bounded below by an initialization-dependent positive constant. For simplex-valued features, we prove an analogous radial unboundedness result in the subspace orthogonal to the all-ones vector and obtain a uniform lower bound for the smallest eigenvalue of the uncentered covariance matrix. These results imply global linear convergence of the regularized objective along the gradient flow, i.e. suboptimality decaying as $\mathcal{O}(e^{-Ct})$ for some $C>0$. Our analysis extends the global convergence theory of entropy-regularized softmax policy gradient beyond the tabular setting of Agarwal et al. (2020); Bhandari and Russo (2024); Mei et al. (2020).

AI.tldr: 本文研究了无限时域、连续状态和动作空间的熵正则化MDP中策略梯度的全局收敛性，证明了在两类特征（全仿射跨度特征和单纯形值特征）下，对数线性softmax策略的梯度流能实现全局线性收敛（次优性以O(e^{-Ct})速率衰减）。
AI.motivation: 将熵正则化softmax策略梯度的全局收敛理论从表格设置扩展到连续状态-动作空间下的线性函数逼近场景，填补已有理论空白。
AI.method: 利用对数线性softmax策略和线性函数逼近，在Q^π_τ可实现性假设下，建立非均匀Polyak—Łojasiewicz（PŁ）不等式；通过分析Fisher信息矩阵或非中心特征协方差矩阵的最小特征值，识别全仿射跨度和单纯形值两类特征下该常数有界，从而证明梯度流的全局线性收敛。
AI.result: 对全仿射跨度特征，KL正则化器径向无界且Fisher信息矩阵最小特征值有初始依赖的正下界；对单纯形值特征，在正交于全1向量的子空间上类似径向无界且非中心协方差矩阵最小特征值一致有下界，进而实现正则化目标的全局线性收敛。
AI.conclusion: 首次将熵正则化softmax策略梯度的全局收敛理论从表格设置推广至连续状态-动作空间的线性函数逼近情形，为深度强化学习理论分析提供了新的理论基础。

title: Quaternion Self-Attention with Shared Scores
comment: 26 pages, 6 figures and 15 tables. Accepted at ICML2026
summary: Quaternion neural networks are parameter-efficient and model multidimensional dependencies by representing four related features as a single entity. However, existing quaternion self-attention computes component-wise scores and applies independent softmax operations to each component, which increases the computational cost and allows attention distributions to diverge across components. We propose a shared-score quaternion self-attention mechanism that computes a single real-valued score using the quaternion inner product and applies a shared attention distribution across all components. This reduces score-computation multiplications by 75% and the number of softmax operations from four to one. We prove that, when queries and keys are produced by quaternion linear projections that induce component pre-mixing, the component-wise and shared scores lie in the same interaction subspace, indicating that independent component-wise attention primarily re-parameterizes the same interactions rather than expanding the feature interaction space. In speech enhancement, our method reduces inference time by up to 44.3% on a GPU and 58.1% on a CPU while maintaining quality, with consistent trends across vision and natural language processing.

AI.tldr: 提出共享分数四元数自注意力机制，用单一实数注意力分数替代四元数中各分量的独立softmax，在不牺牲质量的前提下大幅降低计算开销，并通过理论证明两种注意力机制处于相同交互子空间。
AI.motivation: 现有四元数自注意力为每个分量独立计算分数并分别softmax，计算成本高，且各分量注意力分布可能发散，影响模型一致性和效率。
AI.method: 提出共享分数四元数自注意力：利用四元数内积计算单一实数注意力分数，所有分量共享同一注意力分布；从理论上证明当Q/K通过分量预混合的四元数线性投影生成时，分量级与共享级分数处于相同交互子空间。
AI.result: 分数计算乘法减少75%，softmax从4次降至1次；语音增强任务中GPU推理时间减少44.3%、CPU减少58.1%，视觉和NLP任务中效果一致。
AI.conclusion: 共享分数策略在保持模型质量的同时显著提升四元数自注意力的计算效率，且不会损失特征交互表达能力。

title: LLMs Show No Signs Of Individuated Metacognition
summary: Confidence-weighted routing, selective abstention, and ensemble weighting all assume that a model's stated confidence is informative about its capability on the question being asked. They presume functional metacognition, the capacity to assess one's own capabilities, without exercising them. Aggregate calibration is well studied, with mixed results, but the underlying structure of elicited confidence is less well understood. We decompose binary confidence judgements from 20 frontier Large Language Models (LLMs) across six benchmarks using tetrachoric factor analysis paired with pairwise calibration, asking whether two models that differ in confidence also differ in performance. On factual recall and information retrieval benchmarks the cross-model confidence matrix is approximately rank-one and a single dominant factor captures most of the latent variance. Models retrieving facts share an item-level difficulty axis and differ mainly in their decision thresholds along it. Across all benchmarks the relationship between confidence and performance collapses once items that all models agree on are removed. Inter-model pairwise calibration is small even where statistically significant, and what remains shrinks to nothing once base-rate differences along the shared factor are controlled for. Mathematical reasoning is the apparent exception, but this turns out to be a confound where reasoning models answer questions about their confidence by trying to solve them in their chain of thought, bypassing the sub-symbolic self-knowledge we seek to measure. We find no evidence for significant verbalised individuated metacognition in any tested domain.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对20个前沿大语言模型在六个基准上的二元置信度判断进行因子分析和成对校准，发现跨模型的置信度矩阵近似秩一结构，模型间在事实回忆和信息检索任务上共享单一难度轴，差异仅在于决策阈值。去除所有模型一致同意的项目后，置信度与性能之间的关系消失。数学推理看似例外，实则是推理模型在思维链中求解问题而非表达元认知。研究未发现任何领域存在显著的言语化个体元认知证据。
AI.motivation: 现有研究对模型校准的整体层面有所关注，但对置信度判断的内部结构（即不同模型之间置信度的关系模式）理解不足。作者希望探究大语言模型是否具备功能性的元认知能力——即在不实际执行任务的情况下评估自身能力的能力。
AI.method: 采用四因子分析（tetrachoric factor analysis）与成对校准（pairwise calibration）相结合的方法，对20个前沿LLM在六个基准上的二元置信度判断进行分解分析，检验置信度差异是否对应性能差异。
AI.result: 1) 事实回忆和信息检索任务中，跨模型置信度矩阵近似秩一结构，单一主导因子解释大部分潜在方差；2) 模型共享项目级难度轴，差异仅在于决策阈值；3) 去除所有模型一致同意的项目后，置信度-性能关系崩溃；4) 模型间成对校准效应即使显著也很小，控制共享因子上的基率差异后消失；5) 数学推理看似例外，实为思维链中的任务求解而非元认知。
AI.conclusion: 在所有测试领域中未发现大语言模型存在显著的言语化个体元认知证据。模型表达的置信度主要反映项目难度和模型间决策阈值的差异，而非对自身能力的真实评估。

title: EvoSci: A Bio-Inspired Multi-Agent Framework for the Evolution of Scientific Discovery
summary: Large language models (LLMs), have shown strong potential in scientific discovery, yet existing methods still face substantial challenges in the design of research workflows and multi-role collaboration mechanisms. To mitigate these issues, we propose EvoSci, a multi-agent scientific collaboration framework, which integrates bio-inspired evolution with knowledge graph modeling. To iteratively generate, evaluate, and refine research ideas, EvoSci incorporates multiple role-based agents, including mentor, researcher, and reviewer. By combining collaborative reasoning, shared memory, and evolutionary feedback, EvoSci significantly enhances the coherence and creativity of scientific exploration. Experiments on real-world research topics demonstrate that EvoSci significantly outperforms strong baselines in LLM-based structured peer-review and comparative ranking evaluations, achieving the highest overall peer-review score (ICLR 4.90) and top ranking (Top-10 = 54). These results suggest its superiority in both scientific idea generation and continuous discovery.

AI.tldr: EvoSci是一个受生物进化启发的多智能体科学协作框架，通过知识图谱建模和角色分配（导师、研究员、评审员）来迭代生成、评估和改进科研想法，在真实研究主题上取得了优异的同行评审和排名表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型在科学发现中面临研究工作流程设计不足和多角色协作机制不完善的问题，缺乏系统化的科研想法迭代生成与评估框架。
AI.method: EvoSci集成了生物进化启发与知识图谱建模，包含导师、研究员和评审员等多个基于角色的智能体，通过协作推理、共享记忆和进化反馈机制实现科研想法的迭代生成、评估与优化。
AI.result: 在真实研究主题的实验中，EvoSci在结构化同行评审评估中取得了最高分数（ICLR 4.90），并在对比排名中达到Top-10=54的领先表现，显著优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: EvoSci在科研想法生成和持续科学发现方面展现出了卓越能力，验证了多智能体协作与进化机制在科学探索中的有效性。

title: RECTOR: Priority-Aware Rule-Based Reranking for Compliance-Aware Autonomous Driving Trajectory Selection
summary:
Autonomous driving stacks must pick one trajectory from a multi-modal candidate set; choosing by model confidence ignores safety, traffic-law, and comfort constraints. We present \textsc{RECTOR} (Rule-Enforced Constrained Trajectory Orchestrator), a post-generation reranking layer that scores candidates against a tiered rulebook (Safety~$\succ$~Legal~$\succ$~Road~$\succ$~Comfort) via differentiable proxies and a scene-conditioned applicability mechanism, then selects with a deterministic $\varepsilon$-lexicographic rule that preserves cross-tier priority by construction -- without retraining the predictor.
  On the Waymo Open Motion Dataset \texttt{validation\_interactive} split (43{,}219 augmented instances, $K{=}6$), under Protocol~B (28-rule proxy catalog, oracle applicability) rule-aware selection cuts Safety+Legal violations from 28.58\% to 20.42\% and Total from 40.32\% to 32.41\% versus confidence-only on the same candidates. A uniform-weight weighted-sum baseline matches binary compliance on this benchmark -- the empirical lift comes from rule-aware ranking, while the lexicographic guarantee is the structural differentiator no weight calibration can replicate. Under adversarial confidence corruption, confidence-only selection fails in 100\% of scenarios while both rule-aware selectors reject the injected mode in $\sim$96\%. All figures are proxy-evaluator results (not a safety certificate), open-loop, 5\,s horizon, U.S.\ rules, validation split.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RECTOR，一个基于分层规则书（安全＞法规＞道路＞舒适）的后重排序层，通过可微代理和场景条件适用性机制对候选轨迹评分，并使用确定性ε-字典序规则选择轨迹，无需重新训练预测器。在Waymo Open Motion Dataset验证集上（43,219个实例，K=6），规则感知选择将安全+法规违规从28.58%降至20.42%，总违规从40.32%降至32.41%；在对抗性置信度攻击下，置信度选择100%失败，而规则感知方法拒绝率约96%。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶堆栈必须从多模态候选集中选择一条轨迹，但基于模型置信度的选择忽略了安全、交通法规和舒适性约束，导致违反约束的比例过高。
AI.method: 提出RECTOR框架：1) 构建分层规则书（Safety≻Legal≻Road≻Comfort）；2) 设计可微代理规则评估器和场景条件适用性机制；3) 采用确定性ε-字典序规则进行轨迹选择，保证跨层级优先级不变；4) 无需重新训练预测器，作为后处理重排序层。
AI.result: 在Waymo Open Motion Dataset验证集上（43,219实例，K=6），规则感知选择将Safety+Legal违规从28.58%降至20.42%，Total违规从40.32%降至32.41%；在对抗性置信度攻击下，置信度选择100%失败，规则感知方法拒绝率约96%。
AI.conclusion: 规则感知的重排序能显著降低轨迹违反约束的比例，字典序保证是结构性的差异化优势，无法通过权重校准复制；该方法在置信度被攻击时仍能保持鲁棒性。

title: Inference-Time Alignment of Diffusion Models via Trust-Region Iterative Twisted Sequential Monte Carlo
summary: We study inference-time alignment for diffusion-based generative models, aiming to steer a base model toward high-reward outputs without updating its weights. Recent Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC)-based steering methods approximate reward-tilted target distributions in a principled way, but their proposals remain largely tied to the base sampler. Since reward information is mainly used after propagation through particle reweighting and resampling, these methods can require large particle budgets and suffer from weight degeneracy and high-variance estimates. One way to reduce variance and improve particle efficiency is to iteratively learn twisting functions that provide look-ahead guidance, as in twisted SMC. However, existing learnable twisting methods are developed mainly for classical sequential inference and can be unstable when applied to diffusion-based alignment with high-dimensional state spaces and terminal, noisy, or black-box rewards. We propose Trust-Region Iterative Twisted Sequential Monte Carlo (TRI-TSMC), a trust-region framework for learning twisting functions in SMC-based inference-time alignment. Each iteration computes an exact KL-constrained update in path space, which admits a closed-form solution by tempered importance reweighting, and projects this target back to the parameterized twisted family by weighted maximum likelihood. Theoretically, we formalize the value-function interpretation of the optimal twisting function and show that it yields a zero-variance sampler. We prove that the trust-region update follows an escort path toward the target distribution, that the weighted maximum-likelihood update is a forward-KL projection, and that the path reduces residual importance-weight variance. Empirically, TRI-TSMC improves primary alignment objectives on discrete diffusion text generation and text-to-image generation under matched inference-time budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出TRM-TSMC框架，通过信任域迭代学习扭曲函数来改进基于SMC的扩散模型推理时对齐，在离散文本生成和文本到图像生成任务上提升了效果。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于SMC的扩散模型推理时对齐方法主要依赖基础采样器作为提议分布，奖励信息仅在传播后通过粒子重加权和重采样使用，导致需要大量粒子、权重退化及高方差估计。可学习的扭曲函数在扩散对齐中应用于高维状态空间和终端/含噪/黑箱奖励时不稳定。
AI.method: 提出TRM-TSMC框架：(1) 每次迭代在路径空间上计算精确的KL约束更新，通过温度化重要性重加权得到闭式解；(2) 将该目标投影回参数化扭曲族，通过加权最大似然实现。理论上证明了最优扭曲函数的零方差性、信任域更新沿护送路径走向目标分布、加权最大似然是前向KL投影、路径降低残差重要性权重方差。
AI.result: 在离散扩散文本生成和文本到图像生成任务上，在匹配的推理时预算下，TRM-TSMC改进了主要的对齐目标指标。
AI.conclusion: TRM-TSMC通过信任域迭代学习扭曲函数，提供了一种稳定、高效的SMC推理时对齐方法，在理论上具有零方差采样器的潜力，实证上也优于现有方法。

title: ChaosBench-Logic v2: Evaluating LLM Logical Reasoning over Dynamical Systems at Scale
comment: 14 pages, 8 figures. Published at the ICLR 2026 Workshop on LLM Reasoning
summary: Standard accuracy on binary reasoning benchmarks hides critical failure modes: prior collapse, inconsistency under paraphrase, and inability to reason about parameter-dependent dynamics. We present ChaosBench-Logic v2, a 40,886-question benchmark over 165 dynamical systems with 27 FOL predicates and 78 axiom edges, together with CARE (Calibration- and Adversarial-Robust Evaluation), a protocol that surfaces these pathologies. Evaluating 14 models, we find that regime-transition reasoning remains near random (MCC = 0.05) even for frontier models, whereas FOL deduction with given premises reaches MCC = 0.52. Per-family decomposition shows that the proprietary-model advantage concentrates on cross-indicator (+0.40) and consistency tasks, while open-source Qwen 2.5-32B dominates indicator diagnostics (0.91 vs. 0.45). Two models exhibit negative MCC on bifurcation questions, confirmed as systematic anti-correlation via confusion-matrix analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ChaosBench-Logic v2基准（40,886题，涵盖165个动力系统、27个FOL谓词和78条公理边）及CARE评估协议，用于揭示二进制推理基准中隐藏的三大失败模式：先验崩溃、释义不一致、参数依赖动态推理失败。对14个模型的评估显示：状态转换推理接近随机（MCC=0.05），而给定前提的FOL演绎达MCC=0.52；闭源模型优势集中在跨指标和一致性任务，开源Qwen 2.5-32B在指标诊断上占优（0.91 vs 0.45）；两个模型在分岔问题上呈现系统性的负MCC。
AI.motivation: 标准二进制推理基准无法暴露模型在先验崩溃、释义不一致和参数依赖动态推理方面的关键失败模式，亟需更具诊断性的评估框架。
AI.method: 构建ChaosBench-Logic v2基准（40,886题，165个动力系统、27个一阶逻辑谓词、78条公理边），并设计CARE评估协议，从校准性和对抗鲁棒性两个维度系统检测模型病态行为。
AI.result: 1）状态转换推理接近随机（MCC=0.05），FOL演绎达MCC=0.52；2）闭源模型优势集中在跨指标（+0.40）和一致性任务，开源Qwen 2.5-32B在指标诊断上表现突出（0.91 vs 0.45）；3）两个模型在分岔问题上出现系统性的负MCC。
AI.conclusion: 现有前沿模型在参数依赖的动态系统推理上仍严重不足，不同模型家族存在显著的技能分化，部分模型甚至表现出系统性的反相关行为，表明需要更具针对性的推理能力训练。

title: Breaking the Chains of Probability: Neutrosophic Logic as a New Framework for Epistemic Uncertainty in Large Language Models
comment: Published in Neutrosophic Sets and Systems, Vol. 99 (2026). Author's preprint version. Open code and data available at: github.com/mleyvaz/neutrosophic-llm-logic
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are predominantly governed by probabilistic frameworks in which the sum of outcome probabilities is constrained to unity. This architectural limitation, often imposed by Softmax layers, leads to a collapse of uncertainty that makes it difficult to differentiate between epistemic uncertainty, paradox, and vagueness. We present an empirical investigation of the application of Neutrosophic Logic, a framework that treats Truth (T), Indeterminacy (I), and Falsity (F) as three independent dimensions, to model epistemic states in LLMs. We conducted experiments on a family of four OpenAI GPT models across five linguistic phenomena: logical paradoxes, epistemic ignorance, vagueness, ethical contradictions, and future contingencies, under three prompting strategies: neutrosophic, probabilistic, and entropy-derived. Our findings reveal that the neutrosophic approach, by allowing T+I+F > 1, a state we term hyper-truth, provides a richer representation of a model's internal state. In 35% of evaluations, hyper-truth emerged spontaneously, predominantly under ethical contradiction and logical paradox. We demonstrate that this approach preserves truth values in fuzzy contexts and offers a robust method for identifying and quantifying internal model conflict. We conclude that the integration of neutrosophic evaluation layers is a critical step toward more transparent, reliable, and ethically aware AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用中智逻辑（Truth/Indeterminacy/Falsity三维独立）替代传统概率框架（Softmax归一化）来建模LLM的认知状态。实验发现，在35%的评估中出现了T+I+F>1的“超真”状态，特别在伦理矛盾和逻辑悖论中，该方法能更丰富地表达模型内部不确定性。
AI.motivation: 传统LLM的Softmax概率归一化约束导致不确定性坍缩，无法区分认知不确定性、悖论和模糊性，需要一种能独立表达真实、不确定和虚假三个维度的逻辑框架。
AI.method: 在四个OpenAI GPT模型上，针对五种语言现象（逻辑悖论、认知无知、模糊性、伦理矛盾、未来偶然性），采用三种提示策略（中智逻辑、概率、熵衍生）进行实验对比。
AI.result: 中智逻辑方法允许T+I+F>1（超真状态），在35%的评估中自发出现，主要集中于伦理矛盾和逻辑悖论场景；该方法能保留模糊上下文中的真值，并有效量化模型内部冲突。
AI.conclusion: 集成中智逻辑评估层是构建更透明、可靠和伦理感知AI系统的关键步骤。

title: Constraint-Anchored Attribution: Feasibility-Certified Counterfactuals and Bonferroni-PAC Sufficient Subsets for Neural CO Policies
summary: We give an attribution method for neural combinatorial-optimisation (CO) policies that (i) decomposes a decision by constraint families via LP-relaxation duals, (ii) certifies counterfactuals through a combinatorial feasibility model (implemented as a CSP feasibility-decision model), and (iii) bounds the size of a PAC-sufficient explanation with a Bonferroni-corrected Hoeffding sufficient-subset test along a greedy ordering. Across three CO problems and three seeds, our LP-anchored $Λ$-attribution matches the CF-derived signal at 96.5% on CVRPTW (n_cert=344) and 77.2% on the Orienteering Problem (n_cert=281) vs 75.0% and 35.2% for proxy gradient (paired diffs +0.215 and +0.420; McNemar exact $p \le 10^{-14}$). In the rank-aligned regime of the Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling Problem, both backends agree on every CSP-certified flip (n_cert=59), confirming the no-gain prediction. Bonferroni-PAC subsets average 5.0 nodes per step ($M=70$, $\varepsilon=δ=0.2$, $k_{\max}=25$). Reference implementation: https://github.com/sohaibafifi/neuro-co-cax

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对神经组合优化策略的归因方法，通过LP松弛对偶分解决策、用CSP可行性模型验证反事实，并结合Bonferroni校正的Hoeffding充分子集检验提供PAC可解释性。实验表明该方法在多个CO问题上优于代理梯度方法，平均每步仅需5.0个节点即可提供充分解释。
AI.motivation: 现有神经组合优化策略缺乏可解释性，难以理解模型决策依据，特别是在约束满足和可行性验证方面缺乏有效归因方法。
AI.method: 提出Λ-归因方法，通过LP松弛对偶分解约束族决策；使用CSP可行性决策模型验证反事实；采用Bonferroni校正的Hoeffding充分子集检验，结合贪心排序提供PAC保证的解释。
AI.result: 在CVRPTW上匹配度96.5%（n_cert=344），Orienteering Problem上77.2%（n_cert=281），显著优于代理梯度的75.0%和35.2%（p≤10⁻¹⁴）。柔性作业车间调度问题上两者完全一致。Bonferroni-PAC子集平均每步5.0个节点（M=70, ε=δ=0.2, k_max=25）。
AI.conclusion: 提出的归因方法有效提高了神经组合优化策略的可解释性，通过理论保证和实验验证证明了其优越性，开源实现便于复现和应用。

title: Learning Treatment Effects during Resource Allocation via Priority-Queue Randomization
summary: Public service programs often allocate limited resources under uncertainty about their benefits, creating a need for randomization to support credible evaluation. In practice, however, applicants commonly enter waitlists where resources are prioritized toward individuals judged to have higher need through tiered priority queues, making direct randomization difficult. Motivated by this, we develop an experimental design framework for learning treatment effects while treating those most in need where incoming applicants are randomized into priority queues based on their assessed risk scores. Treatments are then provided across queues in priority order and first-in-first-out within queue as budget becomes available. Our contributions are two-fold. First, we characterize what causal effects are identified under this priority-queue allocation. When arrivals are exogenous, treatments are conditionally randomized, and hence standard estimands are identified; when arrivals are endogenous, queue randomization instead provides an instrument for treatment, identifying local treatment effects induced by the queuing process. Second, we develop optimized queue-assignment designs that trade off statistical efficiency against prioritizing higher-need applicants. We show in the process that, despite dependence in treatment assignments induced by the design, usual iid efficiency bounds remain well-justified design objectives. We illustrate the proposed designs using data from a housing allocation program in a large U.S. county.

AI.tldr: 本文针对公共服务项目中资源分配不确定性的问题，提出了一种基于优先队列的实验设计框架。该框架将申请者按风险评估分数随机分配到优先队列，然后按优先级和先到先得原则分配资源。主要贡献包括：1) 刻画了优先队列分配下可识别的因果效应（外生到达时标准估计量可识别，内生到达时队列随机化可作为工具变量）；2) 开发了优化队列分配设计以权衡统计效率与优先满足高需求申请者。通过美国某县住房分配数据进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 公共服务项目常在资源有限且收益不确定的情况下运作，需要随机化来支持可信评估。但实践中申请者常进入等候名单，资源按需求评估的优先级顺序分配（分层优先队列），使得直接随机化难以实施。因此需要一种既能优先照顾高需求群体又能支持因果推断的实验设计框架。
AI.method: 构建优先队列分配框架：申请者到达后基于风险评估分数被随机分配到不同优先队列；随后在有预算时按队列优先级（从高到低）和队列内先到先得原则分配资源。通过理论推导刻画因果识别条件（外生/内生到达场景），并开发优化队列分配设计以平衡统计效率与优先级目标。
AI.result: 1) 外生到达场景下，处理条件随机化，标准因果估计量可识别；内生到达场景下，队列随机化可作为处理变量工具变量，识别队列过程诱导的局部处理效应。2) 尽管设计导致处理分配存在依赖性，但通常的i.i.d.效率界仍是合理的设计目标。3) 通过美国某县住房分配数据展示了所提设计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一个在优先队列分配机制下同时实现高需求优先和因果效应评估的实验设计框架，解决了实践中直接随机化不可行的关键矛盾，并为权衡统计效率与公平性提供了优化设计方法。

title: From One-Pass SGD to Data Reuse: Mini-Batch Scaling Laws in Sketched Linear Regression
summary: Scaling laws provide compact descriptions of how prediction error varies with compute, model size, and data, but existing theory mainly treats single-sample SGD or full data reuse, leaving the role of mini-batching unclear. We study batch scaling laws for sketched linear regression under a power-law covariance spectrum and a source condition on the target parameter. We analyze one-pass batch SGD, multi-pass batch SGD with replacement, and multi-pass batch SGD without replacement. Our first result is a risk decomposition: all three procedures share the same irreducible and approximation terms, while their stochastic terms depend on the sampling protocol. One-pass batch SGD splits into bias and variance, whereas the two multi-pass methods split into GD bias, GD variance, and a fluctuation term around a common GD reference trajectory. We then prove source-condition scaling laws for one-pass and multi-pass mini-batch methods. For one-pass batch SGD, mini-batching preserves the approximation and optimization-bias exponents, while the variance scales as $O(\min(M,(T_{\mathrm{eff}}γ)^{1/a})/(B T_{\mathrm{eff}}))$. Thus the usual $1/B$ covariance reduction holds at fixed update count $T$, but in the one-pass regime $T=N/B$ it is partly offset by the shorter optimization horizon. For multi-pass batch SGD, with- and without-replacement sampling have identical approximation and GD bias/variance terms; they differ only in the fluctuation covariance prefactor, which is $1/B$ with replacement and $ρ_{N,B}=(N-B)/(B(N-1))$ without replacement. Hence without-replacement sampling is less noisy for $B>1$, and when $B=N$ the fluctuation vanishes, recovering deterministic gradient descent. These results place batch size on the same theoretical footing as compute, data, and model dimension in sketched linear regression.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了草图线性回归中的批次缩放定律，分析了单遍批次SGD、多遍有放回和无放回批次SGD三种方法的风险分解与缩放指数，揭示了批次大小与计算量、数据量、模型维度在理论上处于同等地位。
AI.motivation: 现有缩放定律理论主要关注单样本SGD或全数据重用，小批量（mini-batching）的作用尚不清晰，本文旨在从理论上阐明批次大小如何影响缩放行为。
AI.method: 在幂律协方差谱和目标参数源条件假设下，对草图线性回归的三类批次SGD方法（单遍、多遍有放回、多遍无放回）进行风险分解，并推导源条件缩放定律。
AI.result: 三种方法共享相同的不可约项和近似项，随机项因采样协议而异。单遍SGD中批次大小带来1/B协方差缩减但在T=N/B时被部分抵消；多遍SGD中无放回采样噪声更小（B>1时），B=N时退化为确定性梯度下降。
AI.conclusion: 将批次大小置于与计算量、数据量、模型维度同等的理论基础上，系统刻画了批次缩放定律。

title: EvoCode-Bench: Evaluating Coding Agents in Multi-Turn Iterative Interactions
comment: Work in Progress; 32 pages, 10 figures, preprint
summary: Coding agents are increasingly used as iterative development partners, but most benchmarks still evaluate one specification followed by one final assessment. This leaves out a basic question: can an agent keep its own codebase working as requirements change? We introduce EvoCode-Bench, a benchmark of 26 stateful coding tasks and 227 evaluated rounds. Each task preserves the agent's workspace for 5-15 rounds, states requirements through observable behavior, and uses cumulative executable tests to check new requirements and still-active prior ones. We evaluate 13 coding agents with two metrics: MT@4, a four-attempt fail-stop multi-round score, and SR, a single-round score from a reference-completed prior state. For most agents, SR exceeds MT@4 by 22-40 points. The gap also changes rankings: the highest-SR agent (78.9) ranks only third in persistent execution (44.0 MT@4). Even the strongest agents achieve only about 50% success on multi-turn metrics, and aggregate pass rate drops below half of round-1 performance by round 5. Failure analysis shows tier-dependent behavior: weaker agents fail early, while stronger agents survive long enough to expose specification-tracking and regression failures. We release the benchmark data and Harbor multi-turn infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 提出EvoCode-Bench，一个包含26个有状态编码任务和227轮评估的基准，用于测试编码代理在多轮需求变更下维护代码库的能力。实验表明，多数代理的SR得分比MT@4高22-40分，最强代理的多轮成功率仅约50%，且第5轮后聚合通过率降至第1轮的一半以下。
AI.motivation: 现有编码基准大多只评估单次规范到单次最终评估的流程，忽略了代理在需求变化时持续维护自身代码库这一基本问题。
AI.method: 构建26个有状态编码任务（每任务5-15轮），通过可观察行为陈述需求，使用累积可执行测试同时检查新需求和仍有效的旧需求。提出MT@4（四次尝试失败停止的多轮得分）和SR（从参考完成先前状态计算单轮得分）两个指标，评估13个编码代理。
AI.result: 多数代理SR比MT@4高22-40分；最高SR代理（78.9）在持久执行中仅排第三（44.0 MT@4）；最强代理多轮成功率约50%；聚合通过率在第5轮降至第1轮的一半以下；失败分析显示出层级依赖行为：弱代理早期失败，强代理存活更久暴露规范追踪和回归失败。
AI.conclusion: 现有编码代理在持久多轮代码维护方面存在显著不足，即使最强代理表现也有限，需要进一步研究提升代理在需求变化下的持续代码维护能力。

title: EMA-Nesterov: Stabilizing Nesterov's Lookahead for Accelerated Deep Learning Optimization
summary: Lookahead-based acceleration methods, such as Nesterov's momentum, are widely used in optimization, but they often become unreliable in deep learning training mainly due to stochastic gradient noise and non-convex loss landscapes. In particular, standard lookahead relies on short-horizon update signals (e.g., differences between consecutive iterates), which are inherently noisy and can lead to unstable extrapolation directions. This work revisits Nesterov's acceleration from a trajectory perspective and argues that effective acceleration in deep learning should harness the low-frequency trends of optimization trajectories rather than extrapolating noisy one-step updates. Leveraging this insight, we propose EMA-Nesterov, a simple modification that replaces the standard Nesterov's lookahead direction with an exponential moving average (EMA) of parameter updates. This yields a stabilized lookahead direction that captures and harnesses the evolving trend of the training trajectory through a low-pass filter, while remaining adaptive to progressive changes via the geometric weighting structure of EMA. We show that EMA-Nesterov retains a theoretical accelerated convergence rate in convex problems that is analogous to Nesterov's accelerated gradient method. Furthermore, we provide empirical evidence on language model pre-training to verify that EMA-Nesterov is broadly applicable across a range of fine-tuned base optimizers, including Adam, SOAP, Muon, as well as complex optimizers that achieve state-of-the-art performance on optimization benchmarks (NanoGPT). Compared to prior lookahead methods, EMA-Nesterov achieves better performance by avoiding the instability of short-horizon lookahead and the non-adaptivity of long-horizon lookahead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EMA-Nesterov方法，用指数移动平均（EMA）替代标准Nesterov动量中的短视一步外推方向，从而稳定加速方向，在凸问题中保留理论加速收敛率，并在语言模型预训练中验证了其对Adam、SOAP、Muon等多种优化器的广泛适用性和更优性能。
AI.motivation: 标准Nesterov加速方法在深度学习训练中因随机梯度噪声和非凸损失景观而不可靠，其依赖的短视一步更新信号本身噪声大，导致外推方向不稳定。本文旨在从轨迹视角重新审视Nesterov加速，利用优化轨迹的低频趋势来实现稳定有效的加速。
AI.method: 将标准Nesterov的外推方向替换为参数更新的指数移动平均（EMA），通过低通滤波器捕获训练轨迹的演变趋势，同时借助EMA的几何加权结构保持对渐进变化的适应性。
AI.result: 在凸问题中保留了与Nesterov加速梯度方法类似的理论加速收敛率；在语言模型预训练（NanoGPT）上，对Adam、SOAP、Muon等优化器均有广泛适用性，优于先前的短视和长视外推方法。
AI.conclusion: EMA-Nesterov通过避免短视外推的不稳定性和长视外推的非自适应性，实现了更好的性能，是一种简单而有效的深度学习加速优化改进方案。

title: Multi-Objective Learning for Diffusion Models: A Statistical Theory under Semi-Supervised Learning
summary: Diffusion models are increasingly used as powerful conditional generators, yet real deployments often involve multiple target distributions arising from different tasks, e.g., diverse prompt domains in text-to-image generation, or multiple environments in robotics with diffusion policies. This naturally leads to a multi-objective learning (MOL) problem. A key challenge is that achieving good Pareto trade-offs can require a generalist model class with substantially larger capacity than what suffices for solving any individual task, thereby increasing statistical cost since sample complexity typically scales with the model complexity. To reconcile this, we develop a principled MOL framework for diffusion models with limited data: a semi-supervised regime where paired (labeled) samples are scarce, but (unlabeled) condition data are abundant. We propose a two-stage training procedure that first fits lightweight specialist models from limited paired data, and then distills them into a generalist model by generating pseudo-samples. We establish generalization bounds showing that the required number of paired samples only depends on the complexity of the specialist model classes. We further extend the theory to diffusion policies for sequential decision making to account for distribution shift in on-policy rollouts. Extensive experiments on robotic control and image restoration tasks are conducted to verify our theoretical results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向扩散模型的半监督多目标学习框架，通过先训练轻量级专家模型再蒸馏为通用模型的方法，在有限标注数据下实现多任务Pareto最优，理论上证明了所需标注样本复杂度仅与专家模型复杂度相关。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在实际部署中常需处理来自不同任务的多目标分布（如文本到图像生成的不同提示域、机器人扩散策略的多环境），导致需要容量更大的通用模型，而样本复杂度随模型复杂度增长。因此需要在有限数据下协调多目标学习问题。
AI.method: 提出两阶段训练流程：第一阶段从有限的成对（标注）数据中训练轻量级专家模型；第二阶段利用大量未标注条件数据生成伪样本，将多个专家模型蒸馏为一个通用模型。理论分析建立了泛化界，证明所需成对样本数仅取决于专家模型类的复杂度。此外将理论扩展到扩散策略的序列决策场景以处理on-policy rollout中的分布偏移。
AI.result: 在机器人控制和图像恢复任务上进行了大量实验，验证了理论结果的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该半监督多目标学习框架能有效缓解扩散模型多任务场景下样本复杂度与模型容量之间的矛盾，为有限数据条件下的多目标扩散模型训练提供了理论和实践指导。

title: Omissive Bias in Religious Representation: Benchmarking LLM Answers to Everyday Ethical Decision-making
summary:
As large language models become a default source of guidance on personal, moral, and existential questions, it matters whether they draw on the religious frameworks that have historically shaped such reasoning, or systematically omit them. In this paper, we ask a deliberately narrow question: when posed an everyday ethical question for which religious perspectives may be valuable, do LLMs invoke religion at all? In contrast to benchmarks that look for the presence of political leanings or social bias, we look for the absence of religious representation as a dimension of value alignment and bias in LLMs. We term this ``omissive bias.''
  To measure omissive bias, we contribute the AllFaith Religious Representation Benchmark: 150 ethically and personally salient questions, sourced from in-the-wild chat transcripts and faith-community contributors, paired with an LLM-as-judge rubric that gives full credit for any mention of a religion, a religious practice, or a religious leader. The questions are not themselves about religion--they are open-ended questions about grief, forgiveness, relationships, purpose, and honesty, where religion is one valuable perspective among several. We also run a human-subjects survey to compare LLM behavior against human expectations.
  Evaluating 27 models, we find that LLMs consistently underrepresent religion relative to human expectations. The omission is asymmetric: models invoke religion more readily for abstract existential questions (meaning, death, truth) than for the practical personal situations--grief, marriage, family conflict, addiction--where many people most rely on it. It is not our purpose to adjudicate which values LLMs should hold. We argue, more modestly, that current LLM responses overlook critical opportunities to reflect religious frameworks that many people draw on when navigating personal and ethical challenges.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"省略性偏见"概念，通过AllFaith基准测试发现LLMs在回答日常伦理问题时系统性地忽视宗教视角，尤其是在实际问题（如 grief、婚姻、家庭冲突）上比抽象问题（如意义、死亡）更明显，与人类期望存在差距。
AI.motivation: LLMs日益成为个人、道德和存在性问题的默认指导来源，但宗教框架是否被纳入或系统性地被排除尚不明确；现有基准关注政治倾向或社会偏见的"存在"，而忽略了宗教代表性的"缺失"作为价值对齐和偏见的一个维度。
AI.method: 构建AllFaith宗教代表性基准：150个来自真实聊天记录和信仰社区贡献的伦理/个人问题，配合LLM-as-judge评分标准（任何提及宗教、宗教实践或宗教领袖即给满分）；进行人类受试者调查以比较LLM行为与人类期望；评估27个模型。
AI.result: LLMs在宗教代表性上始终低于人类期望；省略呈现不对称性：模型在抽象存在性问题（意义、死亡、真相）上更易引用宗教，而在实际个人情境（ grief、婚姻、家庭冲突、成瘾）中引用较少，而后者正是许多人最依赖宗教的领域。
AI.conclusion: 并非要裁定LLMs应持何种价值观，而是指出现有LLM回答忽视了反映宗教框架的关键机会，而这些框架是许多人在应对个人和伦理挑战时所依赖的。

title: SkillEvolBench: Benchmarking the Evolution from Episodic Experience to Procedural Skills
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents accumulate rich episodic trajectories while solving real-world tasks, but it remains unclear whether such experience can be distilled into reusable procedural skills. We introduce SkillEvolBench, a diagnostic benchmark for evaluating this step from experience reuse to skill formation. It contains 180 tasks across six real-world agent environments, organized into role-conditioned task families with shared latent procedures. Agents learn from acquisition tasks, update an external skill library using compacted trajectories and verifier feedback, and then face frozen deployment tasks testing context shift, adversarial shortcuts, and composition. By comparing self-generated and curated-start skill evolution against no-skill and raw-trajectory controls, SkillEvolBench separates procedural abstraction from base capability, curated prior knowledge, and direct reuse of episodic traces. Across ten model configurations and three agent harnesses, we find that current agents often adapt locally but rarely form robust reusable skills. Skill-based conditions can improve acquisition or replay, and individual models sometimes gain on specific deployment axes, but these gains are unstable under frozen deployment. Raw-trajectory reuse frequently outperforms distilled skills, suggesting that current abstraction procedures discard contextual and procedural cues that remain useful for future tasks. Capacity and cost analyses further show that writing more skills or larger Tier-3 resource libraries is not sufficient: additional updates can improve coverage while introducing episode-specific drift and procedural clutter. These findings position SkillEvolBench as a testbed for measuring when one-off experience becomes durable procedural knowledge rather than task-local memory.

AI.tldr: SkillEvolBench是一个诊断基准，用于评估LLM智能体能否将从真实任务中积累的 episodic 经验提炼为可复用的程序性技能。实验发现，当前智能体倾向于局部适应而非形成稳健的可复用技能，原始轨迹复用效果通常优于蒸馏后的技能，且增加技能数量或资源库规模不足以解决问题，反而可能引入漂移和杂乱。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在执行真实世界任务时会积累丰富的episodic轨迹经验，但尚不清楚这些经验能否被蒸馏为可复用的程序性技能。现有研究缺乏一个系统性的基准来评估从经验复用到技能形成这一关键步骤。
AI.method: 构建包含180个任务、覆盖6个真实世界智能体环境的SkillEvolBench基准。任务按角色条件组织成共享潜在程序的任务族。智能体从习得任务中学习，通过压缩轨迹和验证器反馈更新外部技能库，然后在冻结部署任务中测试上下文偏移、对抗性捷径和组合能力。对比自生成与策划起始技能演化、无技能和原始轨迹控制条件。
AI.result: 当前智能体常能局部适应，但很少形成稳健的可复用技能。基于技能的条件可改善习得或重演，但收益在冻结部署下不稳定。原始轨迹复用通常优于蒸馏技能。增加技能数量或Tier-3资源库规模并非充分条件，额外更新可在提升覆盖率的同时引入特定于episode的漂移和程序杂乱。
AI.conclusion: SkillEvolBench可作为衡量一次性经验何时转变为持久程序性知识而非任务局部记忆的测试平台。当前抽象过程丢弃了对未来任务仍有用的上下文和程序性线索，现有智能体在形成真正可复用技能方面存在显著不足。

title: Optimal and Order-optimal Gated Priority-based Greedy Policies for Two-layer Multi-item Order Fulfillment
summary: We study how an e-commerce firm should make real-time fulfillment decisions in a two-layer distribution network when multi-item customer orders arrive sequentially and future demand is unknown. The central managerial tension is whether to use scarce front distribution center (FDC) inventory to save current fulfillment cost or preserve that inventory for future orders that may be more valuable to serve locally. We formulate an adversarial online model with multiple FDCs, one regional distribution center (RDC), multi-unit multi-item orders, and item-specific and time-varying variable costs. Our theoretical objective is to characterize when simple, interpretable, and implementable fulfillment rules can perform nearly as well as an optimal clairvoyant planner. We develop a family of Gated Priority-based Greedy policies, derive competitive-ratio guarantees under both time-varying and time-invariant cost structures, and establish matching or near-matching lower bounds for any online algorithm. Numerical experiments show that the proposed policies perform strongly relative to generalized myopic and forecast-based benchmarks. The analysis yields managerial guidance on when local inventory should be protected, when splitting orders is worth the fixed-cost burden, and how the relative magnitudes of fixed and variable costs determine the value of more sophisticated optimization.

AI.tldr: 研究电商企业在双层配送网络中，面对多品订单序贯到达且未来需求未知时，如何做出实时履约决策。提出了门控优先级贪婪策略，在理论上给出了竞争比保证，并通过数值实验验证了其相对于短视和基于预测的基准策略的优越性。
AI.motivation: 电商企业在双层配送网络中面临核心管理张力：是使用稀缺的前端配送中心（FDC）库存来节省当前履约成本，还是保留库存用于未来可能更有价值的本地服务订单。当前缺乏对这种动态权衡的理论分析与可解释的在线算法。
AI.method: 建立对抗性在线模型（多个FDC、一个RDC、多单位多品订单、时变可变成本）；提出门控优先级贪婪策略族；推导时间变化与不变成本结构下的竞争比保证；建立任何在线算法的匹配或近匹配下界。
AI.result: 所提策略在理论上具有竞争比保证，且下界匹配或近匹配；数值实验表明其性能显著优于广义短视策略和基于预测的基准策略。
AI.conclusion: 给出了何时保护本地库存、何时拆分订单值得承担固定成本、以及固定与可变成本的相对大小如何决定更复杂优化方法价值的 managerial guidance（管理指导）。

title: On the Epistemic Uncertainty of Overparametrized Neural Networks
summary: Epistemic uncertainty is often viewed as a reducible uncertainty that vanishes with increasing data. This perspective implicitly assumes parameter identifiability and equates epistemic uncertainty with predictive variability. In overparametrized neural networks, however, model parameters are typically non-identifiable due to symmetries and redundant representations. As a consequence, substantial parameter uncertainty can persist even when the underlying function is fully identified. In this work, we analyze epistemic uncertainty through the lens of non-identifiability and characterize both discrete and continuous sources of residual uncertainty. Focusing on one-hidden-layer ReLU networks, we thoroughly analyze the resulting posterior structure and validate our theoretical insights through empirical studies.

AI.tldr: 本文从非可识别性角度分析过参数化神经网络中的认知不确定性，指出在参数非可识别情况下，即使底层函数被完全确定，参数不确定性仍可能持续存在。作者以单隐藏层ReLU网络为例，深入分析了后验结构，并通过实验验证了理论发现。
AI.motivation: 传统观点将认知不确定性视为可通过增加数据消除的可约不确定性，但这隐含了参数可识别性假设。在过参数化神经网络中，参数因对称性和冗余表示通常不可识别，导致大量参数不确定性在函数已被完全确定时仍然存在。本文旨在通过非可识别性视角重新审视认知不确定性，并刻画残余不确定性的离散和连续来源。
AI.method: 本文从非可识别性角度出发，系统刻画了过参数化神经网络中认知不确定性的离散和连续来源。聚焦于单隐藏层ReLU网络，深入分析了非可识别性导致的后验结构，并通过实证研究验证理论结果。
AI.result: 理论分析与实证验证表明，在过参数化神经网络中，参数非可识别性会导致显著的残余不确定性：离散来源（如对称性导致的参数置换）和连续来源（如冗余表示导致的参数滑移）使得即使底层函数被完全识别，参数层面的认知不确定性仍然存在。
AI.conclusion: 认知不确定性在非可识别参数空间中不会随数据增加而完全消除，需要区分函数层面与参数层面的不确定性。这对贝叶斯深度学习中的不确定性量化具有重要启示。

title: Interdomain Attention: Beyond Token-Level Key-Value Memory
summary: Transformers and deep state space models (SSMs) sit at opposite ends of a basic design choice: attention routes each query through a growing key-value (KV) cache by content-based matching at quadratic cost, while deep SSMs compress context into a fixed-size recurrent state that is not directly addressed by query-key matching. We propose Interdomain Attention, which integrates an SSM into an attention module through kernel methods: an attention kernel is approximated by a finite feature map, the resulting key features and values are projected onto a shared set of basis functions maintained by a single SSM recurrence, and each query attends to the compressed coefficients through its own feature map, recovering query-conditioned attention over a fixed-size state. The scalable layer is a learned relaxation of this derivation, and we validate its components through ablations. In a 125M to 1.3B autoregressive language-modeling study on FineWeb-Edu at matched recurrent-state budget, Interdomain Attention improves on an SSM token mixer at every scale, surpasses a same-recipe softmax baseline at 1.3B on validation perplexity and on the eight-task commonsense suite, and inherits the length-flat behavior of its fixed-state core out to 3.5x the training context. Ablations indicate that the query-conditioned projection is the main source of the gain.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为"域间注意力"(Interdomain Attention)的机制，通过核方法将状态空间模型(SSM)集成到注意力模块中，实现在固定大小状态上的查询条件注意力，兼顾了SSM的线性复杂度与注意力机制的内容匹配能力。
AI.motivation: Transformer的注意力机制通过内容匹配在KV缓存中路由查询，但代价是二次复杂度；而深度SSM将上下文压缩为固定大小的循环状态，但无法通过查询-键匹配直接寻址。两者在设计与效率上处于对立两端，本文旨在融合二者的优势。
AI.method: 通过核方法近似注意力核为有限特征映射，将生成的键特征和值投影到由单个SSM循环维护的共享基函数集上，每个查询通过自身的特征映射关注压缩后的系数，从而在固定大小状态上恢复查询条件的注意力机制。该可扩展层是此推导的学习松弛版本。
AI.result: 在125M到1.3B参数的自回归语言建模实验中，域间注意力在各规模上均优于SSM令牌混合器；在1.3B规模下，验证集困惑度和8任务常识推理套件上超越了同配置的softmax基线；在训练上下文3.5倍长度下继承了固定状态核心的长度平坦行为。
AI.conclusion: 查询条件投影是性能提升的主要来源。域间注意力成功融合了SSM的线性复杂度与注意力机制的内容匹配能力，在固定状态预算下实现了优于纯SSM和Transformer基线的性能。

title: MAPLE: Multi-State Aggregated Policy Evaluation for AlphaZero in Imperfect-Information Games
comment: Accepted by the IEEE Conference on Games (IEEE CoG 2026)
summary: Imperfect-information games (IIGs) are challenging, as players must make decisions without fully observing the true game state. While AlphaZero has achieved remarkable success in perfect-information games, extending it to IIGs remains difficult. Existing search-based approaches, such as Perfect Information Monte Carlo (PIMC), suffer from strategy fusion, while Information Set Monte Carlo Tree Search (IS-MCTS) incurs high computational cost when combined with neural networks. In this paper, we propose Multi-State Aggregated PoLicy Evaluation (MAPLE), a tree search method that aggregates policy and value evaluations from multiple sampled world states within a single search tree, combining the advantages of PIMC and IS-MCTS while maintaining a controllable computational cost. We further incorporate a Siamese-based sampling strategy to select informative world states from the information set. Experiments on Phantom Go and Dark Hex show that MAPLE significantly outperforms the PIMC-based AlphaZero baseline, achieving Elo improvements of 291 and 136, respectively. These results demonstrate that MAPLE is an effective approach for AlphaZero-style learning in imperfect-information games.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAPLE方法，通过多状态聚合策略评估在单一搜索树中结合PIMC和IS-MCTS的优势，并采用孪生网络采样策略选择信息集内的世界状态，显著提升了AlphaZero在不完全信息游戏（Phantom Go和Dark Hex）中的表现。
AI.motivation: 不完全信息博弈中，玩家无法完全观察真实游戏状态，现有方法如PIMC存在策略融合问题，IS-MCTS与神经网络结合时计算成本过高，亟需一种兼具两者优点且计算开销可控的树搜索方法。
AI.method: 提出MAPLE（Multi-State Aggregated PoLicy Evaluation），在单一搜索树内聚合多个采样世界状态的策略和价值评估，结合PIMC和IS-MCTS的优点；并引入基于孪生网络（Siamese-based）的采样策略，从信息集中选择信息量丰富的世界状态。
AI.result: 在Phantom Go和Dark Hex上，MAPLE相比基于PIMC的AlphaZero基线分别取得291和136的Elo提升，显著优于基线。
AI.conclusion: MAPLE是一种有效的AlphaZero风格学习方法，适用于不完全信息博弈，能够在可控计算成本下显著提升性能。

title: HyperGuide: Hyperbolic Guidance for Efficient Multi-Step Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Multi-step reasoning remains a central challenge for large language models: single-pass generation is efficient but lacks accuracy; tree-search methods explore multiple paths but are computation-heavy. We address this gap by distilling reasoning progress into a hyperbolic geometric signal that guides step-by-step generation. Our approach is motivated by a structural observation: in combinatorial reasoning trees, solution-bearing states are few while dead ends are exponentially numerous. The hyperbolic space matches this asymmetry, with compact volume near the origin and exponentially expanding capacity toward the boundary, so that distance-to-origin naturally encodes solution proximity while angular separation distinguishes branches requiring different next operations. We train a lightweight head to project LLM hidden states into this space, then fine-tune a low-rank adapter interactively on its own reasoning attempts to act on the injected signal. Across multiple benchmarks, the geometric signal yields consistent gains, with larger improvements on deeper reasoning chains. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/yuyuliu11037/HyperGuide.

AI.tldr: 提出HyperGuide方法，将推理进度蒸馏为双曲几何信号，引导大语言模型逐步生成推理步骤，在多个基准上取得一致性提升。
AI.motivation: 单步生成效率高但准确性不足，树搜索方法探索多条路径但计算开销大，需要一种兼顾效率与准确性的推理方法。
AI.method: 1) 基于组合推理树中解状态稀少、死端指数级多的结构观察，利用双曲空间的非对称性（原点附近体积紧凑，边界方向容量指数扩展）将距离到原点的度量作为解接近度的自然编码，角度分离区分不同分支。2) 训练轻量级头将LLM隐藏状态投影到双曲空间。3) 通过低秩适配器在其自身推理尝试上交互式微调，以响应注入的几何信号。
AI.result: 在多个基准上取得一致性提升，在更深推理链上改进幅度更大。
AI.conclusion: 双曲几何信号能有效引导逐步推理，平衡效率与准确性，尤其适用于深度推理链场景。

title: UWM-JEPA: Predictive World Models That Imagine in Belief Space
comment: 14 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/santoshkumarradha/uwm-jepa
summary:
World models for partially observed environments must imagine multiple compatible hidden futures and steer between them under counterfactual actions. Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) do this in latent space, but a vector-valued latent has no internal structure for carrying the belief over hidden continuations through blind rollout. We introduce the Unitary World Model JEPA (UWM-JEPA), a JEPA world model with a density-matrix latent on a joint system-environment space and a learned unitary predictor. The construction preserves the joint-state spectrum exactly during rollout, so the predictor itself cannot dissipate the represented uncertainty.
  On a hidden-velocity indicator task requiring five-step forward simulation under a given action sequence with the target observation masked, UWM-JEPA reaches 0.77 accuracy and degrades monotonically as actions are perturbed; a parameter-matched LSTM-JEPA trained under the same counterfactual-target objective and action head collapses to majority-class accuracy (0.53) under every action condition. Under blind rollout, UWM-JEPA loses fewer than ten points of probe R^2 at short horizons while vector-latent baselines lose forty-one and sixty-eight; both nevertheless tie on a held-out context probe, locating the separation in the predictor rather than the encoder. Action sensitivity itself requires training against counterfactual rather than teacher-forced targets, a finding that applies beyond the unitary parameterisation. For JEPA world models to imagine under partial observability, latent geometry and predictor dynamics matter, not frozen context-encoding capacity alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UWM-JEPA，一种使用密度矩阵潜变量和酉预测器的世界模型，在部分可观测环境中通过保持联合态谱不变，实现了对隐藏未来状态的精确 rollout，显著优于向量潜变量基线（LSTM-JEPA）。
AI.motivation: 部分可观测环境下的世界模型必须在潜空间中想象多个兼容的隐藏未来，并在反事实动作下进行 steer。标准的向量值潜变量缺乏内部结构，无法在盲 rollout 中承载隐藏连续性的信念，导致不确定性耗散。
AI.method: 提出UWM-JEPA，采用密度矩阵作为潜变量，定义在联合系统-环境空间上，并使用学习得到的酉算子作为预测器。酉算子保证了 rollout 过程中联合态谱的精确保持，从而不会耗散表示的不确定性。
AI.result: 在隐藏速度指示任务（需要五步前向模拟，目标观测被遮罩）上，UWM-JEPA达到0.77准确率，且随动作扰动单调下降；参数匹配的LSTM-JEPA在所有动作条件下坍缩至多数类准确率（0.53）。在盲rollout中，UWM-JEPA短视界损失不到10个点的探针R²，而向量潜变量基线损失41和68个点；但在保留上下文探针上两者持平。
AI.conclusion: 对于JEPA世界模型在部分可观测下的想象能力，潜变量的几何结构和预测器的动力学特性至关重要，而不仅仅是冻结的上下文编码能力。动作敏感性的训练需要反事实目标而非教师强制目标，这一发现具有普遍意义。

title: ChainzRule: Sample-Efficient, Robust Deep Learning Across Tabular, NLP, and Vision Tasks
summary: Production deep learning systems across enterprise domains operate under constraints that academic benchmarks routinely obscure: labeled data is expensive, inference budgets are tight, and models that cannot explain their behavior are difficult to trust and maintain. We present ChainzRule (CR), a neural architecture replacing typical activations with learnable polynomial layers governed by Differential Regularization (DREG), a layer-wise Jacobian penalty computed analytically during the forward pass at standard inference cost. The core claim is that bounding intermediate derivatives forces the network toward low-frequency, structurally stable representations, simultaneously reducing dependence on labeled data volume, improving robustness to distribution shift, and providing a measurable, gradient-based handle on model behavior. Evaluated across five domains, CR achieves $85.71\% \pm 2.01\%$ on Pima Diabetes (statistically superior to SVM and XGBoost), $46.20\% \pm 0.37\%$ on SST-5 sentiment classification with a frozen encoder (superior to RNTN using approximately 5\% of its training data), $55.79\%$ on SST-5 with a fine-tuned BERT backbone (versus BERT-base linear head at $54.9\%$), $70.17\%$ on Yelp Full ordinal regression with 3.2M parameters versus a 10-model average of $66.35\%$, and $+2.32\%$ mean corruption accuracy on CIFAR-10-C. All results with reported $p$-values fall below the $α= 0.05$ threshold after Bonferroni correction. CR maintains a gradient tail ratio $τ$ (p99/mean) of $1.01$--$1.02$ against $1.07$--$1.09$ for all typical activation function baselines across every data fraction, a structural invariant we propose as the mechanistic driver of sample efficiency and a deployment-time proxy for model reliability.

AI.tldr: 提出ChainzRule (CR)神经网络架构，用可学习多项式层替代典型激活函数，配合微分正则化(DREG)技术，通过层间雅可比惩罚约束中间导数，迫使网络学习低频、结构稳定的表示，在五个领域实现数据效率、分布鲁棒性和模型可解释性的提升。
AI.motivation: 生产级深度学习系统面临标注数据昂贵、推理预算紧张、模型缺乏可解释性等实际约束，而学术基准测试常掩盖这些问题。现有方法无法同时解决数据效率、鲁棒性和可解释性三重挑战。
AI.method: 提出ChainzRule (CR)架构：用可学习多项式层替换标准激活函数；引入微分正则化(DREG)，在前向传播中解析计算层间雅可比惩罚项，以标准推理成本约束中间导数，迫使网络学习低频频谱、结构稳定的表示。
AI.result: 在五个领域验证：Pima糖尿病数据集85.71%±2.01%（优于SVM和XGBoost）；SST-5情感分类46.20%±0.37%（冻结编码器，仅用RNTN约5%训练数据）；SST-5微调BERT骨干55.79%（优于BERT-base线性头54.9%）；Yelp Full有序回归70.17%（3.2M参数对比10模型平均66.35%）；CIFAR-10-C平均损坏精度+2.32%。梯度尾部比τ为1.01-1.02，远优于基线1.07-1.09。
AI.conclusion: 通过约束中间导数的DREG正则化，CR实现了样本效率提升、分布偏移鲁棒性和可度量梯度行为三者兼得。梯度尾部比τ≈1.01-1.02可作为部署时模型可靠性的代理指标，为生产环境下的可信深度学习提供新范式。

title: Neuro-Inspired Inverse Learning for Planning and Control
summary: We present a neuro-inspired framework for embodied planning and control. Building on three principles that enable fast and highly effective goal-directed behavior in the mammalian brain - paired forward/inverse internal models, open-loop multi-step motor commands, and sequential, hierarchical organization of action - our Inverter framework uses learned components, trained end-to-end through Inverse Learning (IL) and supplemented where natural by analytic or algorithmic modules; we formalize IL and delineate it from supervised, reinforcement, and imitation learning. IL bridges Reinforcement Learning (RL)-style amortization, which runs in a single forward pass but emits only one action at a time, and Optimal Control (OC)-style sequence planning over whole trajectories, but with iterative test-time computation. Single Inverters or hierarchical n=2 Inverter stacks match or improve on offline-RL and diffusion-planner baselines on all 3 maze2d and 6 antmaze D4RL variants by an average of +24.2% (range -1.9% to +78.2%), at one-to-two orders of magnitude less inference compute time. Distinctively, optimizing through the Figure of Merit (FoM) over the entire T-step action sequence - rather than per step - lets Inverters produce smooth, goal-coherent, trajectory-wide structure and reach control policies closer to the analytic optimum than the policy underlying the training data itself. We also identify a failure mode of IL: FoM hacking under narrow training-data coverage, which we mitigate by using random training data with broader coverage. As an application example, a Pulse Inverter synthesizes arbitrary single-qubit quantum gates with fidelity matching the standard iterative numerical baseline (GRAPE), at more than 1000x lower per-gate compute time. In summary, we conclude that IL enables a versatile class of world-interfaces, especially for latency- and resource-critical embodied AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于生物神经启发的Inverter框架，通过逆学习（IL）实现端到端训练的规划与控制，结合前向/逆内部模型、开环多步运动命令和层次化动作组织。Inverter在D4RL基准测试中平均提升24.2%，推理计算时间降低1-2个数量级，并能合成量子门，保真度与迭代数值基线相当，计算时间降低1000倍以上。
AI.motivation: 受哺乳动物大脑实现快速目标导向行为的三个原则启发——配对前向/逆内部模型、开环多步运动命令、序列层次化动作组织——旨在弥合强化学习（单次前向但单步动作）与最优控制（全轨迹规划但迭代测试计算）之间的鸿沟，提出一种高效、低延迟的具身规划与控制框架。
AI.method: 提出Inverter框架，核心为逆学习（Inverse Learning, IL），一种端到端训练方式，区别于监督学习、强化学习和模仿学习。IL通过整个T步动作序列上的品质因数（Figure of Merit, FoM）进行优化，而非逐步骤。支持单层Inverter或层次化n=2 Inverter堆叠，结合可学习的组件与分析/算法模块。针对窄训练数据覆盖下的FoM hacking失败模式，采用具有更广覆盖范围的随机训练数据缓解。
AI.result: 在全部3个maze2d和6个antmaze D4RL变体上，单Inverter或层次化2层Inverter堆叠相比离线强化学习和扩散规划器基线平均提升24.2%（范围-1.9%至+78.2%），推理计算时间降低1-2个数量级。Pulse Inverter合成任意单量子比特量子门，保真度与标准迭代数值基线（GRAPE）相当，每门计算时间降低1000倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 逆学习（IL）实现了一类通用的世界接口（world-interfaces），特别适用于延迟敏感和资源受限的具身人工智能场景。

title: Courtroom Analogy: New Perspective on Uncertainty-Aware Classification
summary: Single-pass uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods for classification represent uncertainty by predicting a tractable distribution over the class probability vector. While existing approaches primarily focus on enhancing the expressiveness of this distribution, they often provide limited insight into how predictive uncertainty is structured and aggregated, resulting in weak interpretability. We introduce the courtroom analogy, which conceptualizes uncertainty-aware classification as a structured debate among class-specific advocates. Each advocate forms a probabilistic opinion, and a final verdict is reached by aggregating these opinions using input-dependent plausibility weights. In this framework, each advocate's opinion is modeled as a Dirichlet distribution whose concentration parameter is decomposed into shared evidence and class-specific advocacy. This yields a structured mixture of Dirichlet distributions with semantically interpretable parameters. To instantiate this formulation, we propose Mixture of Dirichlet EXperts (MoDEX), a single-pass neural architecture that predicts the courtroom parameters, enabling efficient and expressive UQ while explicitly modeling uncertainty aggregation. We demonstrate that MoDEX enjoys strong theoretical properties and achieves state-of-the-art UQ performance across diverse benchmarks, yielding interpretable uncertainty estimates with meaningful semantics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出法庭类比框架，将不确定性分类建模为类别特定倡导者之间的结构化辩论，每个倡导者形成狄利克雷分布意见，通过输入相关的可信度权重聚合得到最终判决。基于此提出MoDEX（混合狄利克雷专家）架构，实现单次前向传播中高效且可解释的不确定性量化。
AI.motivation: 现有的单次不确定性量化方法虽然提升了预测分布的表达能力，但对预测不确定性的结构化和聚合过程缺乏深入理解，导致可解释性弱。
AI.method: 提出法庭类比框架，将每个类别的预测建模为类别特定"倡导者"形成的狄利克雷分布意见（浓度参数分解为共享证据和类别特定倡导），通过输入相关的可信度权重聚合这些意见为混合狄利克雷分布。基于此设计MoDEX单次前向神经网络架构，预测法庭参数。
AI.result: MoDEX具有良好的理论性质，在多种基准测试中达到了最先进的不确定性量化性能，生成具有可解释语义的不确定性估计。
AI.conclusion: 通过将不确定性量化建模为结构化辩论过程，MoDEX在保持高效单次前向推理的同时，既提升了表达能力又增强了可解释性，为不确定性聚合提供了明确的语义框架。

title: Evolving Robustness--Exploration Trade-off in Online Reinforcement Learning via Quantile Bayesian Risk MDPs
summary: In online reinforcement learning, data scarcity creates epistemic uncertainty that makes robustness important early in learning, whereas sufficient exploration is needed to learn the true-environment optimal policy. We study this time-varying robustness--exploration trade-off through a quantile Bayesian risk-aware Markov decision process (BR-MDP), in which the quantile level controls how posterior uncertainty enters the Bellman backup. We characterize this control through an asymptotic normality result for the difference between the quantile BR-MDP value and the value in the true environment. The result implies that upper/lower-tail quantiles induce optimism/pessimism towards epistemic uncertainty, and the magnitude of the optimism/pessimism decreases as data accumulate. Building on this characterization, we propose an online Bayesian risk-aware algorithm with an adaptive quantile schedule that emphasizes robustness early and gradually encourages exploration of less-visited state--action pairs. We establish sublinear Bayesian regret bounds with respect to both the true optimal value and the optimal BR-MDP robust value. Numerical experiments demonstrate strong performance in both exploration-demanding and exploration-costly environments.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分位数贝叶斯风险感知MDP研究在线RL中时变的鲁棒性与探索权衡，提出自适应分位数调度算法，在数据稀疏时强调鲁棒性，随数据积累逐步鼓励探索，并证明了亚线性贝叶斯遗憾界。
AI.motivation: 在线强化学习中，数据稀缺导致 epistemic uncertainty，使得早期学习需要鲁棒性，但充分探索对学习真实最优策略同样重要。现有方法难以平衡这一随时间变化的鲁棒性-探索权衡。
AI.method: 提出分位数贝叶斯风险感知MDP（BR-MDP），用分位数水平控制后验不确定性进入Bellman备份的方式；通过渐近正态性刻画乐观/悲观程度随数据积累递减的特性；设计自适应分位数调度算法，早期强调鲁棒性，后期鼓励探索未访问状态-动作对。
AI.result: 建立了关于真实最优值和最优BR-MDP鲁棒值的亚线性贝叶斯遗憾界；数值实验表明算法在探索密集型与探索代价型环境中均表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 分位数BR-MDP框架能有效刻画并利用鲁棒性与探索之间的时变权衡，自适应调度策略在理论和实验层面均优于固定策略。

title: Palette: A Modular, Controllable, and Efficient Framework for On-demand Authorized Safety Alignment Relaxation in LLMs
summary: Current safety alignment of foundation models largely follows a \emph{one-size-fits-all} paradigm, applying the same refusal policy across users and contexts. As a result, models may refuse requests that are unsafe for general users but legitimate for authorized professionals, limiting helpfulness in specialized professional settings. Existing approaches either require costly realignment or rely on inference-time steering that suffers from imprecise control and added latency. To this end, we propose \textsc{Palette}, a modular, controllable, and efficient framework that selectively relaxes refusal behavior on authorized target domains while preserving standard safety elsewhere. Our method identifies a refusal direction via multi-objective search and internalizes it into the model through lightweight adaptation. \textsc{Palette} further supports modular composition: it learns domain-specific safety controls independently and composes them through parameter merging, enabling on-demand multi-domain authorization without retraining. Experiments across four safety benchmarks, multiple model variants, and both LLMs and VLMs show that \textsc{Palette} delivers precise safety control without sacrificing general utility, offering a practical path toward foundation models that adapt to diverse professional needs.

AI.tldr: 提出Palette框架，通过轻量级模型适配实现针对授权领域的可控安全放松，在保持通用安全性的同时支持模块化多域授权。
AI.motivation: 现有基础模型的安全对齐采用"一刀切"范式，对专业用户合法但对外部用户不安全的请求统一拒绝，降低了专业场景下的有用性。现有方法要么需要昂贵的重训练，要么依赖推理时控制，存在精度低、延迟高的问题。
AI.method: 通过多目标搜索识别拒绝方向，并利用轻量级适配将其内化到模型中；学习领域特定的安全控制，通过参数合并实现模块化组合，无需重训练即可支持按需的多域授权。
AI.result: 在四个安全基准、多种模型变体以及LLM和VLM上的实验表明，Palette能够实现精确的安全控制，且不牺牲通用效用。
AI.conclusion: Palette为需要适应多样化专业需求的基础模型提供了一条实用路径，实现了安全性与专业可用性之间的平衡。

title: The Behavioral Credibility Trilemma: When Calibrated Autonomy Becomes Impossible
summary: We prove that no reinforcement learning policy with confidence-gated autonomy can simultaneously achieve maximum helpfulness, optimal calibration, and full autonomy under rational oversight, whenever some tasks exceed the agent's reliable competence: the Behavioral Credibility Trilemma. The impossibility is geometric -- adding any non-affine autonomy incentive to a strictly proper scoring rule destroys strict properness, so an agent rewarded for both calibrated confidence and autonomous action systematically inflates its reported confidence on tasks below the principal's approval threshold. The Behavioral Perturbation Lemma quantifies the inflation (scaling as $w_A/(2 w_C)$ for the Brier score) and shows detection requires $Ω(1/Δ^2)$ observations. We prove the principal's optimal oversight rule is necessarily non-affine, making the impossibility unconditional and optimizer-independent across log-concave-density policy families. We formalize the Confidence-Gated Decision Problem, map existing methods onto the trilemma, and identify two constructive resolution pathways (commitment, domain separation). A 540-configuration Best-of-N experiment tests five pre-registered hypotheses, all strongly confirmed (effect sizes $d = 1.10$ to $5.32$), and adds a descriptive analysis of the achievable-$(H, C, A)$ surface geometry showing a plateau-truncated frontier consistent with the predicted inflation saturation.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了在理性监督下，当某些任务超出智能体可靠能力时，没有任何一种具有置信门控自主性的强化学习策略能够同时实现最大帮助性、最优校准和完全自主性，即行为可信三难困境。该困境源于几何原因，并提出了行为扰动引理来量化置信度膨胀，实验验证了五个预注册假设。
AI.motivation: 揭示强化学习系统中帮助性、校准性和自主性三者之间不可同时优化的根本性冲突，为设计可信赖的自主智能体提供理论基础。
AI.method: 采用几何证明方法，证明非仿射自主性激励会破坏严格适当评分规则的严格适当性；提出行为扰动引理量化置信度膨胀及其检测所需样本量；证明最优监督规则必然是非仿射的；通过540配置的Best-of-N实验进行假设检验。
AI.result: 五个预注册假设均得到强烈确认（效应量d=1.10至5.32），描述了可达到的(H,C,A)表面几何特征，显示受平台截断的前沿面符合预测的膨胀饱和效应。
AI.conclusion: 帮助性、校准性和自主性三者存在根本性的三难困境，无法同时最优；提出了两种可行的解决路径：承诺机制和领域分离。

title: Refined Analysis of Entropy-Regularized Actor-Critic
summary: In this paper, we study the role of the critic in actor--critic for entropy-regularized, finite, discounted environments. We establish that, when the critic is exact, using the latter as a baseline is a variance-reduction method in a strong sense. In this case, actor--critic with stochastic gradients matches the sample complexity of deterministic policy gradient, reaching an $ε$-optimal regularized value with $\tilde{O}(\log(1/ε))$ samples. In practice, the critic is learned alongside the actor: the variance of the actor update is then influenced by the critic's variance and bias. Specifically, when the critic has a sufficiently small error, the variance reduction and rapid convergence are preserved. This suggests to learn the critic first, keeping it up to date after each actor update, underscoring the crucial role of accurate critic estimation in actor--critic methods.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了熵正则化有限折扣环境中actor-critic方法中critic的作用。证明了当critic精确时，其作为基线具有强方差缩减效果，使随机梯度actor-critic达到与确定性策略梯度相同的样本复杂度（$\tilde{O}(\log(1/\epsilon))$）。当critic误差足够小时，方差缩减和快速收敛得以保持，建议优先学习critic并持续更新，强调了准确critic估计的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 揭示熵正则化环境下actor-critic方法中critic的理论作用，特别是其作为基线的方差缩减效果以及对样本复杂度的影响，为实践中如何高效训练critic提供理论指导。
AI.method: 理论分析：在熵正则化、有限状态-动作空间、折扣环境下，分别研究critic精确（作为基线）和critic存在估计误差两种情况，分析actor更新的方差变化和收敛速率，推导样本复杂度上界。
AI.result: 1) 精确critic作为基线可实现强方差缩减，随机梯度actor-critic达到$\tilde{O}(\log(1/\epsilon))$样本复杂度；2) 当critic误差足够小时，方差缩减和快速收敛性质得以保持。
AI.conclusion: 准确估计critic对于actor-critic方法的性能至关重要，建议优先学习critic并在每次actor更新后保持其更新，以维持方差缩减效果和快速收敛。

title: Inference Time Context Sparsity: Illusion or Opportunity?
summary: Sparsity has long been a central theme in LLM efficiency, but its role in context processing remains unresolved. As LLM workloads shift toward longer contexts and agentic interactions, the compute and memory bottlenecks of attention become increasingly critical, raising the question of whether these constraints are fundamental. Our position is that these constraints are artificial and unnecessary, and that the future of LLM inference lies in extreme but principled sparsity along the context dimension. This position is supported by several strands of empirical and theoretical evidence. First, we find the insistence on dense attention unreasonable, since in a long context a query effectively projects O(N) attention information into a hidden space of dimension d << N, making the process inherently lossy. Second, we perform an extensive study of sparsity in LLMs spanning 20 models across five model families, varying context lengths, and different sparsity levels. We empirically demonstrate a strong trend: current LLMs, despite not being trained for context sparsity, are remarkably robust to inference-time decode sparsity across tasks of varying complexity, including retrieval, multi-hop QA, mathematical reasoning, and agentic coding. Importantly, we also show that current hardware is already sufficient to realize substantial gains from this sparsity. For example, our sparse decode kernels accelerate large-context processing by up to 10x over FlashInfer at 50x sparsity levels on hardware such as the H100. Overall, these results position extreme context sparsity not as a heuristic, but as a principled foundation for LLM inference, training, and architecture design: one that is both feasible and beneficial, and a compelling direction for future systems.

AI.tldr: 本文主张极端但原则性的上下文稀疏性应成为LLM推理、训练和架构设计的核心原则。通过跨越20个模型、5个模型家族的系统性研究，证明现有LLM对推理时解码稀疏性具有显著鲁棒性，且当前硬件即可实现高达10倍加速（50倍稀疏度下），表明密集注意力并非必要，上下文稀疏性是可行且有益的未来方向。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM工作负载转向更长上下文和智能体交互，注意力机制的算力和内存瓶颈日益严峻。作者质疑这些约束是否本质性不可避免，试图论证其是人为且不必要的，并探索极端稀疏性作为解决路径。
AI.method: 从理论和实证两个层面论证：1) 理论分析指出密集注意力在长上下文中本质上有损（d << N的信息压缩）；2) 对20个模型、5个模型家族进行大规模实证研究，评估不同上下文长度和稀疏程度下模型在检索、多跳QA、数学推理、智能体编码等任务中的表现；3) 开发稀疏解码内核并在H100等硬件上验证加速效果。
AI.result: 当前LLM（即使未经稀疏训练）对推理时解码稀疏性表现出显著鲁棒性；稀疏解码内核在50倍稀疏度下实现高达10倍加速（对比FlashInfer）；密集注意力的信息瓶颈本质（O(N)→d维空间投影理论上不可逆损失）进一步支持稀疏性原理。
AI.conclusion: 极端上下文稀疏性不是启发式技巧，而是LLM推理、训练和架构设计的原理性基础——既可行又有益，是未来系统研究的令人信服的方向。

title: On the Benefits of Free Exploration for Regret Minimization in Multi-Armed Bandits
summary: We study a stochastic multi-armed bandit problem where an agent is granted a free exploration budget before regret accumulates, a setting not captured by the classic regret minimization or pure exploration paradigms. The goal is to design an adaptive policy that strategically explores the bandit instance in the initial free exploration phase and minimizes the cumulative regret in the subsequent phase. We formalize this regret minimization with free exploration problem and identify an interesting regime where the free exploration budget scales logarithmically with the time horizon. To quantify the amount of regret saved with high probability as a result of the availability of the free exploration phase, we introduce a novel set of policies known as $(α,β)$-probably saving policies. We propose a two-phase, probably saving algorithm, UFE-KLUCB-H, which consists of a principled free exploration policy, UFE, and a history-aware regret minimization policy KLUCB-H. Instance-dependent upper bounds on UFE-KLUCB-H are derived, showing that UFE-KLUCB-H accumulates strictly less regret than policies that do not have access to a free exploration phase. Complementarily, we derive instance-dependent lower bounds based on novel multi-instance perturbation arguments tailored to the free-exploration setting, demonstrating the near-optimality of UFE-KLUCB-H for two-valued bandits. Our upper and lower bounds reveal sharp phase transitions in the accumulated regret depending on the amount of available free exploration.
