Building on these safety-enhanced foundation models, we propose Safe-MoMA (Safe Mixture of Models and Agents), a framework that enables traceable and efficient inference through the orchestrated deployment of multiple models and agents. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that JT-Safe-V2 achieves state-of-the-art performance across both general intelligence and safety benchmarks. Moreover, Safe-MoMA reduces inference costs by more than 30\% compared to using the largest standalone model baseline while maintaining comparable performance. To facilitate future research on safety-by-design foundation models, we publicly release the post-trained JT-Safe-V2-35B model checkpoint.

AI.tldr: JT-Safe-V2 是一个通过联合优化通用智能与安全性设计的大型语言模型，结合 Safe-MoMA 框架实现多模型/智能体的可追溯、高效推理，在性能和安全性上达到 SOTA，且推理成本降低 30% 以上。
AI.motivation: 为了推进基础模型的安全性和可信赖性，将前代 JT-Safe 模型扩展为更全面的安全性设计范式，实现通用智能与安全性的联合优化。
AI.method: 通过三项关键创新：(1) 用上下文世界知识丰富预训练数据；(2) 高确定性预训练流程；(3) 面向企业级智能体能力的安全强化后训练机制。在此基础上提出 Safe-MoMA 框架，实现多模型与多智能体的编排部署以实现可追溯、高效推理。
AI.result: JT-Safe-V2 在通用智能和安全性基准测试上均达到 SOTA；Safe-MoMA 相比最大单模型基线降低 30%+ 推理成本且性能相当；公开发布了后训练的 JT-Safe-V2-35B 模型 checkpoint。
AI.conclusion: 通过安全性设计范式与多模型编排框架，可以有效兼顾大语言模型的智能水平、安全性与推理效率，为未来安全基础模型研究提供了可行方向与开源资源。

title: ECHO: Terminal Agents Learn World Models for Free
summary: CLI agents are the closest thing language models have to an embodied setting: the model emits commands, the terminal executes them, and the returned stream -- stdout, errors, files, logs, and traces -- records the consequences. We argue that this stream is a supervision signal, but standard agent RL discards it: GRPO-style training updates action tokens with sparse outcome-level rewards while ignoring environment responses already in the rollout. Failed rollouts provide little policy-gradient signal despite containing rich evidence about how the environment responds. We introduce ECHO (Environment Cross-entropy Hybrid Objective), a hybrid objective that combines the standard policy-gradient loss on action tokens with an auxiliary loss that trains the policy to predict environment observation tokens resulting from its own actions. ECHO reuses the same forward pass as GRPO, requires no additional rollouts, and turns terminal feedback into dense supervision for all rollouts. ECHO doubles GRPO pass@1 on TerminalBench-2.0: Qwen3-8B improves from 2.70% to 5.17%, and Qwen3-14B from 5.17% to 10.79%. ECHO also produces policies that better predict terminal dynamics, even on trajectories they did not generate: across held-out rollouts, it sharply reduces environment-token cross-entropy while GRPO alone barely changes it. From base Qwen3-8B, ECHO matches expert-SFT-then-GRPO performance on held-out terminal tasks without expert demonstrations, and recovers roughly half of the expert-SFT initialization benefit on TerminalBench-2.0. In some settings, the environment prediction loss alone enables verifier-free self-improvement, allowing policies to improve on unseen OOD tasks by learning only from environment interactions. Together, these results suggest that environment observations are not merely context for future actions, but a dense, on-policy supervision signal already present in every rollout.

AI.tldr: ECHO通过混合目标函数，将环境观测的预测损失与标准策略梯度损失结合，利用终端反馈作为密集监督信号，显著提升了CLI智能体的性能。
AI.motivation: 标准智能体强化学习（如GRPO）只对动作token使用稀疏的结果级奖励更新，忽略了rollout中已经存在的环境响应（stdout、错误、文件、日志等）。失败rollout含有丰富环境反馈但几乎没有策略梯度信号。
AI.method: 提出ECHO混合目标：标准策略梯度损失（动作token）+ 辅助损失（预测动作产生的环境观测token）。复用GRPO的同一前向传播，无需额外rollout，将终端反馈转化为所有rollout的密集监督。
AI.result: 在TerminalBench-2.0上，ECHO使GRPO的pass@1翻倍：Qwen3-8B从2.70%提升至5.17%，Qwen3-14B从5.17%提升至10.79%。环境token交叉熵显著降低。从基础模型出发，ECHO无需专家演示即可匹配SFT+GRPO的性能。
AI.conclusion: 环境观测不仅是未来动作的上下文，更是rollout中已存在的、密集的、在策略上的监督信号。在部分设置下，仅靠环境预测损失即可实现无需验证器的自我改进。

title: Benchmarking the Limits of In-Context Reinforcement Learning for Ad-Hoc Teamwork
summary: In-Context Reinforcement Learning (ICRL) has enabled foundation agents to adapt instantaneously to novel tasks, yet its efficacy in Ad-Hoc Teamwork (AHT)-where coordination with unknown partners is required-remains unexplored. To rigorously evaluate this, we introduce a large-scale benchmark ICRL4AHT, built upon a high-throughput JAX implementation of Overcooked-V2. Our benchmark includes a large, diverse teammate suite spanning both RL and heuristic policies, enabling controlled train-test shifts, and provides a reproducible end-to-end pipeline for teammate generation, learning-history collection, dataset construction, and online multi-episode evaluation. We evaluate representative history-conditioned ICRL algorithms, including Algorithm Distillation (AD) and Decision-Pretrained Transformer (DPT), across millions of transitions. Results reveal notable limitations: contrary to their success in single-agent domains, these baselines fail to exhibit robust test-time adaptation in multi-agent settings. Specifically, these methods frequently underperform random baselines across both unseen teammate and unseen layout tracks, with no clear in-context improvement over long horizons. These findings highlight the challenges of strategic inference under partial observability within the OvercookedV2 AHT protocol, establishing our benchmark as a critical testbed for next-generation coordination algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ICRL4AHT基准，基于Overcooked-V2构建，用于评估上下文强化学习在临时团队合作中的表现。实验发现AD和DPT等代表性算法在未见过的队友和布局上经常低于随机基线，未能展现出鲁棒的测试时自适应能力。
AI.motivation: 虽然ICRL已使基础智能体能够快速适应新任务，但其在需要与未知伙伴协调的临时团队合作（AHT）中的有效性尚未被探索。
AI.method: 基于JAX实现的高吞吐量Overcooked-V2构建大规模基准，包含多样化的队友策略库（RL和启发式策略），支持可控的训练-测试分布偏移，并提供可复现的端到端流程：队友生成、学习历史收集、数据集构建和在线多回合评估。
AI.result: AD和DPT在未见过的队友和未见过的布局上经常低于随机基线，没有表现出清晰的上下文内改进，且随着时间跨度增加表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: 当前ICRL算法在多智能体AHT场景中未能实现鲁棒的测试时自适应，揭示了在部分可观测性下进行策略推理的挑战，该基准可作为下一代协调算法的关键测试床。

title: MindAlign: Bridging EEG, Vision, and Language for Zero-Shot Visual Decoding
summary: Visual decoding from brain signals is a key challenge at the intersection of computer vision and neuroscience, requiring methods that bridge neural representations and computational models of vision. We introduce a tri-modal contrastive framework for EEG-based visual decoding that aligns EEG, visual, and textual representations within a unified latent space. Our approach follows a two-stage design. First, we pre-train an EEG encoder via masked reconstruction on unlabeled trials, learning spatio-temporal regularities that transfer robustly to downstream tasks. Second, we jointly align EEG, image, and LLM-generated textual descriptions through contrastive learning, where text supervision acts as a semantic regularizer that injects linguistic structure into the shared space without overwhelming the primary EEG-image signal. The encoder integrates subject-specific adaptation, graph-attention over channels, and temporal-spatial convolutional embeddings. On the Things-EEG2 200-way zero-shot benchmark, our framework achieves 54.1% Top-1 and 83.4% Top-5 accuracy, substantially exceeding the strongest prior baseline (32.4% / 64.0%), with paired Wilcoxon tests confirming significance (p < 0.01) over all in-subject baselines. We validate generalization on Things-MEG. Analysis reveals that compact embedding geometries (CN-CLIP) outperform much larger backbones, and that decoding aligns with established neurophysiology of visual processing. This work is a critical step towards robust, semantically-grounded visual decoding from non-invasive temporal neural signals. The source code is publicly available in https://github.com/anon-eeg/eeg_image_decoding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种三模态对比学习框架，用于基于EEG的视觉解码，通过掩码重建预训练和对比学习对齐EEG、图像和文本表征，在Things-EEG2零样本基准上达到54.1% Top-1和83.4% Top-5准确率，远超此前最优基线（32.4%/64.0%）。
AI.motivation: 从脑信号中解码视觉信息是计算机视觉与神经科学交叉领域的关键挑战，需要连接神经表征与计算视觉模型的方法。现有方法在解码精度和跨模态对齐上存在不足，尤其是在零样本场景下性能有限。
AI.method: 提出三模态对比学习框架。两阶段设计：1) 通过掩码重建在无标签EEG数据上预训练编码器，学习时空正则性；2) 通过对比学习联合对齐EEG、图像和LLM生成的文本描述。编码器集成被试自适应、图注意力机制和时空卷积嵌入。
AI.result: 在Things-EEG2 200路零样本基准上，Top-1准确率54.1%、Top-5准确率83.4%，显著超过此前最优基线（32.4%/64.0%），配对Wilcoxon检验p<0.01。在Things-MEG上验证了泛化性。分析发现紧凑的嵌入几何（CN-CLIP）优于更大骨干网络。
AI.conclusion: 本工作是迈向从非侵入式时间神经信号进行鲁棒、语义驱动视觉解码的关键一步，揭示了解码结果与视觉处理神经生理学的一致性。代码已开源。

title: SAM: State-Adaptive Memory for Long-Horizon Reasoning Agent
summary: Long-horizon agentic reasoning requires large language models to act over long interaction histories containing thoughts, tool calls, observations, and partial conclusions. The challenge is not merely that these histories grow long, but that information needed for the current decision may be scattered across distant steps and only become relevant later. Existing approaches address this difficulty by truncating the interaction history, compressing it into shorter surrogates, or retrieving selected parts of it for reuse, but they do not explicitly model how access to past interaction should adapt to the agent's evolving state. We instead cast long-horizon reasoning as a problem of state-adaptive memory. To this end, we propose State-Adaptive Memory~(SAM), a standalone framework that consolidates ongoing interaction into compact memory cues while preserving raw trajectory pages for intent-driven recall. These cues are not treated as replacements for history; rather, they serve as lightweight handles that allow the agent to reconstruct temporally distant information according to its current needs, without retraining the underlying backbone. We further optimize the memory module through expert-guided supervision and reinforcement learning, aligning it with trajectory-level utility. Across BrowseComp, BrowseComp-ZH, WideSearch, and HLE, SAM consistently outperforms strong baselines over diverse agent backbones. Our results suggest that explicit memory modeling provides a simple and effective foundation for long-horizon agentic reasoning.

AI.tldr: SAM框架通过状态自适应记忆机制，将长程智能体推理建模为可重构的轻量级记忆线索与原始轨迹页面的联合系统，无需重新训练骨干模型即可实现高效的长历史交互推理，在多个基准测试上超越强基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法（截断、压缩、检索）未显式建模智能体状态变化对历史访问需求的影响，无法适应性地从长交互历史中获取当前决策所需信息。
AI.method: 提出State-Adaptive Memory (SAM)框架，将交互历史压缩为紧凑记忆线索（轻量级句柄），同时保留原始轨迹页面供意图驱动检索；通过专家引导监督和强化学习优化记忆模块，使其与轨迹级效用对齐。
AI.result: 在BrowseComp、BrowseComp-ZH、WideSearch和HLE四个基准上，SAM在多种智能体骨干模型上一致优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式记忆建模为长程智能体推理提供了简单有效的 foundation，状态自适应的记忆访问机制优于固定策略的截断/压缩/检索方法。

title: What Are We Actually Decoding? Source Attribution for Non-Invasive Brain-to-Language Retrieval
summary: In non-invasive neural language decoding, results can be inflated by sources that are not stimulus-evoked neural evidence: decoder priors, embedding-based metrics, and non-neural structural nuisances such as signal duration. The methodological challenge is therefore attribution: a reported gain is more informative when it can be traced to a specific source. We recast stimulus-locked MEG-to-audio retrieval as an auditing framework that separates apparent performance into three sources - structural shortcuts, window-level stimulus-locked evidence, and cross-window contextual aggregation - and provides a diagnostic for each. Signal-blind Gaussian noise reaches 66.3% Rank@1 (R@1) under variable-length decoding but collapses to near chance once fixed-duration windows and stimulus-identity splits are enforced, isolating structural leakage. Under these controls, fixed-window retrieval recovers measurable MEG-audio discriminability, while an oracle sentence-bucket diagnostic shows that 95.7% of Top-1 errors select the wrong sentence, localising the residual bottleneck to sentence-level competition. We audit this contextual source with Group Context Bias (GCB), an inference-time additive logit bias that pools sentence-consistent evidence across windows while leaving the base retrieval scores and candidate pool fixed. Used as a score-space intervention, GCB makes the contextual source measurable: R@1 shifts from 44% to 52% on Gwilliams and from 22% to 29% on MOUS under the same fixed setting. GCB is auditable under this design: its effect collapses under random-grouping perturbations and vanishes when local evidence is attenuated in MEG or is near chance in EEG, supporting its use as a controlled source-attribution intervention. These results suggest that brain-to-language performance should be source-attributed, not merely reported.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种源归因审计框架，将MEG到音频的检索性能分解为结构捷径、窗口级刺激锁定证据和跨窗口上下文聚合三个来源，并通过固定时长窗口、刺激身份分割和组上下文偏差（GCB）等方法进行诊断，证明脑到语言的表现应归因于具体来源而非简单报告。
AI.motivation: 非侵入式神经语言解码中，结果可能被非刺激诱发的神经证据（如解码器先验、基于嵌入的度量、信号时长等结构干扰）所夸大，因此需要将报告的性能提升追溯到具体来源，解决归因难题。
AI.method: 将刺激锁定的MEG到音频检索重构为一个审计框架，分离三种来源（结构捷径、窗口级证据、跨窗口上下文聚合）；采用固定时长窗口和刺激身份分割控制结构泄漏；设计组上下文偏差（GCB）作为推理时加性对数几率偏差，跨窗口聚合句一致证据以测量上下文源。
AI.result: 信号盲高斯噪声在变长解码下达到66.3% R@1，但在固定窗口和刺激身份分割下崩溃为近乎随机；固定窗口检索恢复可测量的MEG-音频可区分性；95.7%的Top-1错误选择了错误句子；GCB使R@1从44%提升至52%（Gwilliams）和从22%提升至29%（MOUS），其效果在随机分组扰动下崩溃，在MEG局部证据衰减或EEG接近随机时消失。
AI.conclusion: 脑到语言的表现应进行源归因而非仅仅报告，GCB可作为受控的源归因干预工具。

title: SPACE: Unifying Symmetric and Asymmetric Routing Problems for Generalist Neural Solver
summary: Generalist neural routing solvers have shown great potential in solving diverse vehicle routing problems (VRPs) with a unified model. However, existing solvers are typically limited to symmetric settings or degrade in performance when switching to asymmetric settings due to input inconsistencies or inherent structural differences, substantially limiting their practicality in real-world scenarios that encompass both scenarios. To address this limitation, we define the spatial position of each node based on the relative distances to a specific set of pivots and further propose a Spatial Pivot-Aligned Coordinate-free Embedding (SPACE) framework that unifies node representation and solution generation across symmetric and asymmetric VRPs. Specifically, we construct a bidirectional Frechet representation using a novel furthest pivot sampling strategy to enable invariant node representations across distinct problem settings. Furthermore, we introduce a weight-decomposed adaptive decoding mechanism that decouples geometric perception from problem representations, mitigating the overfitting of constraint decisions to a specific geometry setting. Extensive experiments on 110 VRP variants, comprising 55 symmetric problems and their asymmetric counterparts, demonstrate that SPACE achieves promising zero-shot generalization in both symmetric and asymmetric VRPs.

AI.tldr: 针对现有神经路由求解器在对称和非对称VRP间切换时性能退化的问题，提出SPACE框架，通过基于枢轴的空间对齐无坐标嵌入和权重分解自适应解码机制，在110个VRP变体上实现了零样本泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有通用神经路由求解器通常局限于对称设置，或在切换到非对称设置时因输入不一致或结构差异导致性能下降，限制了其在现实场景中的实用性。
AI.method: 1) 基于相对距离定义节点空间位置，提出空间枢轴对齐无坐标嵌入(SPACE)；2) 使用最远枢轴采样策略构建双向Fréchet表示，实现跨问题设置的节点表示不变性；3) 引入权重分解自适应解码机制，将几何感知从问题表示中解耦。
AI.result: 在110个VRP变体（55个对称问题及其非对称对应问题）上的实验表明，SPACE在对称和非对称VRP中均实现了有前景的零样本泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: SPACE框架有效统一了对称和非对称VRP的节点表示与解生成，为通用神经路由求解器在现实场景中的应用提供了可行方案。

title: SemanticZip: A Pilot Framework for Lossy Text Compression with LLMs as Semantic Decompressors
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Pilot framework paper; code and supplementary artifacts available in ancillary files
summary:
Text compression for large language model (LLM) systems is usually framed as token deletion, retrieval, summarization, or exact reconstruction. We study a more aggressive but explicitly lossy setting: compress text into compact codes that an LLM can expand into task-relevant meaning. We call this setting SemanticZip. Unlike lossless compression, SemanticZip does not require byte-identical reconstruction; unlike ordinary summarization, it treats model-based decompression as part of the codec and evaluates whether task-relevant semantic commitments are recovered.
  This paper is a pilot framework, not a benchmark claim. We formalize LLM-mediated decompression, define a protected/lossy packet architecture, and evaluate six representation regimes over five author-constructed diagnostic cases: structured prose, JSON, CCL-Core, CCL-Min, SemanticZip ASCII, and SemanticZip emoji. An independent decoder LLM reconstructs typed semantic atoms from each compressed representation, and we score Critical Atom Recall, Weighted Atom Recall, precision, and tokenizer gain. In this pilot, structured prose has the highest recoverability, with WAR = 0.956 and 19.1% o200k_base token gain. CCL-Min is the strongest balanced point, with 39.4% token gain and WAR = 0.874. SemanticZip ASCII provides the largest useful compression, with 46.5% token gain and WAR = 0.802, while emoji-heavy SemanticZip performs worse on both compression and recovery.
  The main contribution is not the claim that these numbers establish a universal frontier. Rather, we introduce a reproducible experimental interface for studying lossy, LLM-decompressible text codes and a design principle: safety-critical and exact commitments should remain protected, while predictable low-risk context may be semantically zipped.

AI.tldr: 提出SemanticZip框架，一种有损文本压缩方法，通过LLM解压恢复任务相关的语义信息，而非字节级精确重建。实验评估了六种表示方案，发现结构化散文恢复率最高，CCL-Min取得最佳平衡，语义ASCII压缩比最大。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM文本压缩多聚焦于token删除、检索、摘要或精确重建，缺乏对"有损压缩+LLM解压恢复语义"这一更激进但实用的场景的系统研究。
AI.method: 形式化定义LLM介导的解压过程，设计保护/有损分组架构，在五个诊断案例上评估六种表示方案（结构化散文、JSON、CCL-Core、CCL-Min、语义ASCII、语义emoji），使用独立解码器LLM重建语义原子，计算关键原子召回率、加权原子召回率、精确率和分词增益。
AI.result: 结构化散文恢复率最高（WAR=0.956, 19.1% token增益）；CCL-Min最佳平衡（39.4% token增益, WAR=0.874）；语义ASCII最大压缩（46.5% token增益, WAR=0.802）；emoji方案在压缩和恢复上均表现最差。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献在于建立可复现的实验框架，而非宣称性能最优。提出设计原则：安全关键和精确承诺应受保护，可预测的低风险上下文可进行语义压缩。

title: AgentFugue: Agent Scaling for Long-Horizon Tasks through Collective Reasoning
summary: Recent progress on long-horizon agentic tasks has been driven largely by scaling up individual agents through stronger models, better tools, and more effective scaffolding. In contrast, much less is understood about scaling out: whether multiple peer agents, all targeting the same task, can become an additional source of capability without relying on explicit role specialization or workflow orchestration. We study this question and propose AgentFugue, a collective reasoning framework built around a shared reasoning hub. As peer agents explore the same task in parallel, the hub records concise notes on what each agent has established, attempted, or ruled out, and enables each agent to selectively access what other agents have discovered in a form useful for its current search. This design turns otherwise isolated trajectories into a connected ecology of reusable intermediate reasoning without requiring centralized planning. We instantiate the hub as a plug-in communication layer, trained with supervised fine-tuning and end-to-end reinforcement learning. Across the challenging long-horizon settings we study, AgentFugue improves over strong baselines. Our results suggest that collective reasoning can turn scaling out peer agent systems into a distinct source of capability gains, rather than merely a way of spending more compute.

AI.tldr: AgentFugue提出了一种基于共享推理中心的集体推理框架，使多个对等代理在并行执行长周期任务时能够通过共享笔记进行选择性信息访问，从而将孤立轨迹转化为可复用的中间推理生态，显著提升了任务完成能力。
AI.motivation: 当前长周期智能体任务的进展主要集中在通过更强的模型、更好的工具和更有效的脚手架来扩展单个智能体（scaling up），而关于多个对等智能体共同处理同一任务（scaling out）是否能够成为额外能力来源的研究非常有限，特别是缺乏无需明确角色分工或工作流编排的集体推理机制。
AI.method: 提出AgentFugue框架，核心是一个共享推理中心（reasoning hub）。多个对等代理并行探索同一任务时，中心记录每个代理已建立、尝试或排除的简明笔记；每个代理可选择性地访问其他代理的发现信息以辅助当前搜索。该中心作为插件式通信层，通过监督微调和端到端强化学习训练。
AI.result: 在多个具有挑战性的长周期任务场景中，AgentFugue相比强基线方法取得了显著改进。结果表明集体推理能够将并行代理系统的扩展（scaling out）转变为一种独立的能力增益来源，而不仅仅是增加计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 集体推理框架能够有效利用多代理并行探索的中间结果，在不依赖集中规划的情况下实现可复用的推理生态，为长周期智能体任务的扩展提供了新的方向。

title: Rethinking Federated Unlearning via the Lens of Memorization
comment: This paper has been accepted by SIGKDD 2026
summary: Federated learning (FL) increasingly needs machine unlearning to comply with privacy regulations. However, existing federated unlearning approaches may overlook the overlapping information between the unlearning and remaining data, leading to ineffective unlearning and unfairness between clients. In this work, we revisit federated unlearning through the lens of memorization. We argue that unlearning should mainly remove the unique memorized information attributable to the data to be forgotten, while preserving overlapping patterns that are also supported by the remaining data. Specifically, we propose Grouped Memorization Evaluation, an example-level metric that separates memorized knowledge from overlapping knowledge. Building on this metric, we introduce Federated Memorization Pruning (FedMemPrune), a pruning-based unlearning approach that resets redundant parameters responsible for memorization. Extensive experiments show that FedMemPrune closely matches retraining-based unlearning baselines while more effectively eliminating memorization than existing federated unlearning algorithms, yielding strong unlearning performance without sacrificing the utility of retained knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于记忆分组的联邦遗忘方法FedMemPrune，通过区分唯一记忆知识与重叠知识，利用分组记忆评估指标和记忆剪枝技术，在保护保留数据效用的同时更有效地消除需遗忘数据的记忆痕迹。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦遗忘方法忽视了遗忘数据与保留数据之间的重叠信息，导致遗忘不彻底且造成客户端间不公平。本文从记忆化视角重新审视联邦遗忘问题，旨在仅移除需遗忘数据的独特记忆化信息，同时保留重叠模式。
AI.method: 提出分组记忆评估（Grouped Memorization Evaluation）作为示例级别度量，区分记忆化知识与重叠知识；在此基础上提出联邦记忆剪枝（FedMemPrune），一种基于剪枝的遗忘方法，重置负责记忆化的冗余参数。
AI.result: 广泛实验表明，FedMemPrune与基于重训练的遗忘基线高度匹配，同时比现有联邦遗忘算法更有效地消除记忆化，在保持保留知识效用的前提下实现强遗忘性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过区分唯一记忆与重叠知识，基于剪枝的联邦遗忘方法能够在保证保留数据效用的同时实现更彻底的遗忘，为联邦学习中的隐私合规提供了有效解决方案。

title: TIGER: Text-Informed Generalized Enzyme-Reaction Retrieval
summary: Enzyme-reaction retrieval is a fundamental problem in computational biology, underpinning enzyme characterization, reaction mechanism elucidation, and the rational design of metabolic pathways and biocatalysts. As a bidirectional task, it entails both enzyme-to-reaction and reaction-to-enzyme mapping. However, existing approaches suffer from poor generalization across tasks and distributions, with performance highly sensitive to dataset splits and substantial asymmetry between retrieval directions. To address these challenges, we present TIGER, a Text-Informed Generalized Enzyme-Reaction Retrieval framework that leverages protein-to-text generation models to distill textual semantic knowledge from enzyme sequences, providing a generalized representation that bridges enzymes and biochemical reactions. To ensure the quality and reliability of textual semantics, we design a Dynamic Gating Network that adaptively fuses text-derived knowledge with sequence features, enabling more consistent and informative enzyme representations, while a Structure-Shared Feature Projector aligns enzyme and reaction representations within a unified latent space. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, under bidirectional retrieval supervision, TIGER significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across diverse distributions and exhibits strong robustness and transferability across tasks.

AI.tldr: TIGER是一个基于文本信息的通用酶-反应检索框架，通过蛋白质到文本的生成模型、动态门控网络和结构共享特征投影器，在双向检索任务中显著优于现有方法，并展现出强大的鲁棒性和迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 现有酶-反应检索方法存在泛化能力差、对数据集划分高度敏感、双向检索方向严重不对称等问题，亟需一种更通用、鲁棒的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出TIGER框架，包含三个核心组件：1) 利用蛋白质到文本生成模型从酶序列中提取文本语义知识；2) 动态门控网络自适应融合文本知识与序列特征；3) 结构共享特征投影器将酶和反应表示对齐到统一潜在空间。
AI.result: 在双向检索监督下，TIGER在各种分布上显著优于最先进的基线方法，展现出强大的鲁棒性和跨任务迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: TIGER通过融合文本语义知识有效解决了酶-反应双向检索中的泛化性和不对称性问题，为计算生物学中的酶表征和反应检索提供了新的有效范式。

title: RL with Learnable Textual Feedback: A Bilevel Approach
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards can improve LLM reasoning, but learning remains sample-inefficient when terminal rewards are sparse. This has motivated a growing line of work on RL with textual feedback, where a critic model generates natural language feedback to guide a reasoning model (the actor), augmenting scalar rewards with richer learning signals. However, existing methods typically treat feedback as fixed or auxiliary, which misses a key property: feedback should not merely be correct, but should improve the policy (actor model) when provided in context. This motivates a paradigm of learnable textual feedback for RL. Yet the learnability and usefulness of feedback depend on the policy's ability to learn from it, making RL with learnable feedback an inherently bilevel problem. We formalize this coupling as a Stackelberg bilevel program and derive Bilevel Natural Language Actor-Critic (Bi-NAC), which jointly trains a critic to generate reward-improving feedback and an actor to exploit it. Across MATH-500, MBPP, and GPQA, Bi-NAC improves sample and parameter efficiency over RL and fixed-critic baselines: our 2B model outperforms the 3B GRPO baseline, achieving 46.6% versus 41.4% on MATH-500, while our 6B model surpasses the 7B GRPO baseline, achieving 49.3% versus 43.6% on GPQA.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于Stackelberg双层规划的文本反馈强化学习方法Bi-NAC，联合训练评论模型生成可提升策略的反馈和演员模型利用该反馈，在MATH-500、MBPP和GPQA上相比GRPO基线实现了更优的样本效率和参数效率（如2B模型在MATH-500上46.6% vs 41.4%）。
AI.motivation: 现有基于可验证奖励的强化学习在终端奖励稀疏时样本效率低下；虽已有工作引入文本反馈作为增强信号，但现有方法将反馈视为固定或辅助信息，忽视了反馈应不仅能正确指出问题，更应能提升策略性能这一关键属性。
AI.method: 将可学习的文本反馈强化学习形式化为Stackelberg双层优化问题，提出Bi-NAC（Bilevel Natural Language Actor-Critic），联合训练评论模型生成能改进奖励的反馈，同时训练演员模型利用该反馈进行学习。
AI.result: 在MATH-500、MBPP和GPQA上，Bi-NAC优于RL和固定评论基线。2B模型在MATH-500上达到46.6%（3B GRPO为41.4%），6B模型在GPQA上达到49.3%（7B GRPO为43.6%）。
AI.conclusion: 可学习的文本反馈能显著提升强化学习的样本和参数效率，Bi-NAC通过双层优化联合训练评论和演员模型是实现这一目标的有效框架。

title: Market Regime Council for Dynamic Credit Assignment in Multi-Agent LLM Decision Systems
summary: Multi-agent LLM decision systems for portfolio management still lack a principled way to assign credit across specialist agents, remain vulnerable to cold-start dominance under regime shifts, and offer limited transparency into how final allocations are formed. We propose Market Regime Council (MRC), a cooperative multi-agent decision system that computes exact Shapley credits across all single, pairwise, and Grand-coalition outputs for online agent weighting. Instantiated with N=3 specialist agents, at each trading period, MRC recomputes coalition-based Shapley weights from exponentially weighted performance histories, uses a Bayesian adaptive mixture to stabilize early periods, applies regime-dependent multipliers to adjust agent authority, and records each rebalance through a five-layer causal trace. Over 1,037 trading days across 13 crypto assets and five seeds, MRC achieves a Sharpe ratio of 1.51 and a cumulative return of 440.1%, ranking first on CR, SR, and IR among active baselines and attaining the lowest MDD among active methods. Ablation results show that the gains come from Shapley-weighted integration across coalition outputs rather than from any single stage in isolation. Code and demo data are included in the supplementary material.

AI.tldr: 提出市场机制委员会(MRC)，一个通过精确计算Shapley信用值来分配多智能体权重的合作式投资组合管理系统，在13个加密资产上实现1.51夏普比率和440.1%累计收益。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM决策系统在投资组合管理中缺乏原则性的信用分配机制，容易在制度转变时出现冷启动主导问题，且最终资产分配的形成过程透明度有限。
AI.method: 采用N=3个专业智能体，在每个交易周期基于指数加权历史计算联盟Shapley权重，使用贝叶斯自适应混合稳定早期阶段，应用制度依赖乘数调整智能体权威，并通过五层因果追踪记录每次再平衡。
AI.result: 在1037个交易日的13种加密资产上，MRC实现夏普比率1.51、累计收益440.1%，在CR、SR、IR指标上排名第一，MDD为主动方法中最低。消融实验表明收益来自Shapley加权的联盟输出集成。
AI.conclusion: Shapley值信用分配机制能有效解决多智能体投资系统中的冷启动和透明度问题，且集成效应优于单一模块贡献。

title: Deep ZakaiJ: Structured Filtering for Jump-Diffusion Time Series Forecasting
summary: Time series driven by unobserved latent states frequently exhibit abrupt jump discontinuities whose timing and magnitude cannot be predicted from observed history alone. Classical jump-diffusion models offer a principled mathematical framework but assume rigid parametric forms, while recent neural jump models operate on fully observed trajectories without inferring the hidden states that govern the dynamics. We propose \textit{Deep ZakaiJ}, a latent-state model for partially observed jump-diffusion systems that embeds the Zakai nonlinear filtering equation into a neural encoder--decoder architecture. The encoder recursively updates a belief over the latent state via Strang splitting into three interpretable substeps: prior propagation, diffusion innovation, and jump innovation, yielding a differentiable, first-order-accurate approximation of the exact filtering evolution. The decoder is a structured jump-diffusion model explicitly conditioned on the filtered belief, preserving the separation between continuous dynamics and discontinuous shocks. On synthetic, financial, and oceanographic datasets, \textit{Deep ZakaiJ} improves distributional forecasts while remaining competitive in point accuracy, achieving calibrated predictive intervals and recovering interpretable latent structure in synthetic and qualitative case studies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Deep ZakaiJ，一种将Zakai非线性滤波方程嵌入神经编码器-解码器的隐状态模型，用于部分观测的跳跃扩散系统，通过Strang分裂实现可微分的近似滤波更新，在合成、金融和海洋数据上提升了分布预测质量并保持点预测竞争力。
AI.motivation: 经典跳跃扩散模型假设刚性参数形式，而近期神经跳跃模型在完全观测轨迹上操作，无法推断控制动力学的隐状态。现有方法难以处理部分观测下具有突变跳跃的非线性动力系统。
AI.method: 将Zakai非线性滤波方程嵌入神经编码器-解码器架构。编码器通过Strang分裂递归更新隐状态信念，包含三个可解释子步骤：先验传播、扩散创新和跳跃创新，实现一阶精度的可微近似滤波。解码器为结构化跳跃扩散模型，显式以滤波信念为条件，保持连续动力学与不连续冲击的分离。
AI.result: 在合成、金融和海洋数据集上，Deep ZakaiJ在分布预测上优于基线，点预测精度保持竞争力，预测区间校准良好，并在合成及定性案例研究中恢复了可解释的隐结构。
AI.conclusion: 将经典非线性滤波理论与神经架构相结合，能够有效处理部分观测下的跳跃扩散系统，在保持点预测精度的同时显著提升分布预测质量和可解释性。

title: Reasoning as an Attack Surface: Adaptive Evolutionary CoT Jailbreaks for LLMs
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in reasoning and generation tasks and are increasingly deployed in real-world applications. However, their explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) mechanism introduces new security risks, making them particularly vulnerable to jailbreak attacks. Existing approaches often rely on static CoT templates to elicit harmful outputs, but such fixed designs suffer from limited diversity, adaptability, and effectiveness. To overcome these limitations, we propose an adaptive evolutionary CoT jailbreak framework, called AE-CoT. Specifically, the method first rewrites harmful goals into mild prompts with teacher role-play and decomposes them into semantically coherent reasoning fragments to construct a pool of CoT jailbreak candidates. Then, within a structured representation space, we perform multi-generation evolutionary search, where candidate diversity is expanded through fragment-level crossover and a mutation strategy with an adaptive mutation-rate control mechanism. An independent scoring model provides graded harmfulness evaluations, and high-scoring candidates are further enhanced with a harmful CoT template to induce more destructive generations. Extensive experiments across multiple models and datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed AE-CoT, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art jailbreak methods.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种自适应进化思维链越狱框架AE-CoT，通过教师角色扮演将有害目标改写为温和提示，分解为语义连贯的推理片段，利用多代进化搜索进行片段级交叉和自适应变异，结合有害CoT模板增强，在多个模型和数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型（LRMs）的显式思维链（CoT）机制引入了新的安全风险，使其容易受到越狱攻击。现有方法依赖静态CoT模板，存在多样性不足、适应性差和有效性有限的问题。
AI.method: 提出AE-CoT框架：(1) 通过教师角色扮演将有害目标改写为温和提示，并分解为语义连贯的推理片段构建CoT越狱候选池；(2) 在结构化表示空间中进行多代进化搜索，通过片段级交叉和自适应变异率控制机制扩展候选多样性；(3) 使用独立评分模型进行分级有害性评估，高分候选者进一步通过有害CoT模板增强以诱导更具破坏性的生成。
AI.result: 在多个模型和数据集上的大量实验表明，AE-CoT consistently优于最先进的越狱方法。
AI.conclusion: AE-CoT通过自适应进化搜索有效提升了CoT越狱攻击的多样性、适应性和有效性，揭示了LRMs在安全防护方面面临的新挑战。

title: Position: AI for Science Should Treat Measurement-to-Dataset Pipelines as Inference Components
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures, Proceedings of the 43 rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea. PMLR 306, 2026
summary:
AI for Science (AI4Science) workflows often treat the released dataset as a fixed interface to the underlying system.
  However, in domains relying on \emph{indirect observation}, the learner observes a derivative representation produced by multi-stage measurement, reconstruction, and preprocessing pipelines.
  \textbf{We argue that these measurement-to-dataset pipelines are inference components: treating their outputs as ``given data'' freezes an observation model and obscures uncertainty over feasible pipeline choices.}
  We identify three failure modes arising from this ``frozen lens'': \textbf{(C1) hidden hypothesis space}, where the released dataset does not specify the pipeline configuration or its validity conditions; \textbf{(C2) uncertified transportability}, where a pipeline may be documented but its regime of validity is untested, so failures under distribution shift cannot be adjudicated; \textbf{(C3) ungoverned multiplicity}, where many defensible pipelines exist and dispersion is real but not propagated into uncertainty-aware evidence.
  We stress-test these claims with a large-scale neuroscience empirical audit, finding a survival rate of $\approx 0.0004\%$ under a cross-dataset stability criterion.
  We call on the AI4Science community to make pipelines \emph{computable} inference objects via domain-specific Computable Observation Frameworks.
  This shift enables quantifying pipeline adequacy and stability, converting implicit implementation choices into auditable, reproducible, and cumulative scientific evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文指出AI4Science领域将测量到数据集的处理流程视为固定接口，但实际上这些流程是推理组件。通过大规模神经科学实证审计（存活率约0.0004%），揭示了三种失败模式：隐藏假设空间、未认证的可迁移性、未治理的多重性，并呼吁将管道变为可计算的推理对象。
AI.motivation: 在依赖间接观测的AI4Science领域，现有工作将发布的数据集视为系统的固定接口，忽略了从测量到数据集的多阶段处理流程（测量、重建、预处理）本身就是推理组件，导致不确定性被遮蔽。
AI.method: 提出"冻结透镜"概念，识别三种失败模式（C1隐藏假设空间、C2未认证的可迁移性、C3未治理的多重性），并通过大规模神经科学实证审计进行压力测试。
AI.result: 在跨数据集稳定性准则下，存活率约为0.0004%，验证了所提出的三种失败模式的实际存在和严重性。
AI.conclusion: 呼吁AI4Science社区将管道变为可计算的推理对象（Computable Observation Frameworks），从而量化管道的充分性和稳定性，将隐含的实现选择转化为可审计、可复现、可累积的科学证据。

title: Hypothesis Generation and Inductive Inference in Children and Language Models
summary: Real world decision-making requires constructing mental models under uncertainty over evidence, over the underlying causal rules, and over the state of the world itself. Which computational principles underpin human inference under such conditions, and do LLM-based agents exhibit similar behavior given matching constraints? We address these questions using an inductive inference Box Task in which participants, human children and LLM-based agents, infer a latent cause through sequential interaction with an uncertain environment. We formalize this task as program induction with Bayesian particle-based inference, admitting two complementary interpretations: (1) as a constraint satisfaction process over hypotheses, and (2) as a program synthesis problem in which hypotheses are executable programs evaluated against evidence. Using the constraint-based formulation, we show that children's behavior is best explained by a combination of subjective evidence reliability and online hypothesis generation, accounting for both their evidence-seeking patterns and their dissociation between task completion and rule generalization. Using the program synthesis formulation, we treat LLM-based agents as model organisms: controllable systems that allow systematic manipulation of task conditions. Across backends, LLM-based agents replicate children's responses to changes in evidence reliability and observability, including discounting unreliable evidence, seeking to resolve partial information, and dissociating between task completion and causal generalization. At the same time, LLM-based agents tend to over-observe and over-comply with instructions relative to children. These results suggest that while children and LLM-based agents adapt similarly to environmental structure, their information-seeking behavior exhibits distinct underlying costs and inductive biases.

AI.tldr: 本文通过归纳推理盒子任务，研究儿童和LLM智能体在不确定性下进行因果推断的计算原理，发现两者对环境结构的适应相似，但在信息寻求行为上存在不同成本与归纳偏差。
AI.motivation: 探索人类（儿童）和LLM智能体在不确定性环境下进行因果推断的计算原理，比较两者是否表现出相似的推理行为。
AI.method: 采用归纳推理盒子任务，将问题形式化为贝叶斯粒子滤波的程序归纳框架，提供约束满足和程序合成两种互补解释；以儿童为人类被试，以LLM智能体为可控模型有机体进行系统对比。
AI.result: 儿童的推理行为可用主观证据可靠性与在线假设生成最优解释；LLM智能体在证据可靠性和可观测性变化上复现了儿童行为，但倾向于过度观测和过度遵从指令。
AI.conclusion: 儿童和LLM智能体在适应环境结构方面具有相似性，但两者在信息寻求行为背后存在不同的成本结构和归纳偏差。

title: PILOT: Policy-Informed Learned Optimization for Adaptive Deep Network Training
summary:
Despite the central role of optimization in deep learning, most optimizers rely on update structures whose functional form is fixed before training begins. This static design can limit their ability to respond to changing gradient behavior across the loss landscape, where training may shift between stable, noisy, and inconsistent regimes.
  This study proposes PILOT (Policy-Informed Learned OpTimizer), an online optimizer that adapts its update behavior during training. Rather than using a fixed balance between momentum, normalization, and sign-based updates, PILOT uses gradient-direction agreement as a signal of local training stability. Conditioning the update rule on this agreement signal allows the optimizer to adjust its behavior when gradients become stable, noisy, or inconsistent.
  Experiments on FashionMNIST and CIFAR-10 show that PILOT consistently achieves the highest accuracy among the evaluated optimizers across convolutional settings. On the CNN architecture, PILOT reaches 94.13% on FashionMNIST and 81.94% on CIFAR-10. On ResNet-18, it further improves performance, reaching 95.71% on FashionMNIST and 93.42% on CIFAR-10. These results suggest that learning how to adapt the update structure during training can improve performance across both compact and deeper convolutional models while preserving a simple first-order optimization framework.
  The implementation of PILOT is publicly available at https://github.com/SattamAltwaim/PILOT.git

AI.tldr: 本文提出PILOT，一种通过梯度方向一致性信号在线调整更新策略的自适应优化器，在FashionMNIST和CIFAR-10上优于传统固定结构优化器。
AI.motivation: 传统深度学习优化器的更新结构在训练前固定不变，无法适应损失景观中梯度行为的变化（如稳定、噪声、不一致等不同训练阶段），限制了优化性能。
AI.method: PILOT利用梯度方向一致性（gradient-direction agreement）作为局部训练稳定性的信号，动态调整动量、归一化和符号更新之间的平衡，实现更新规则的在线自适应。
AI.result: 在CNN架构上，PILOT在FashionMNIST达94.13%，CIFAR-10达81.94%；在ResNet-18上分别提升至95.71%和93.42%，均优于对比优化器。
AI.conclusion: 在训练过程中学习自适应更新结构可以提升紧凑型和深层卷积模型的性能，同时保持简单的一阶优化框架。

title: DemoEvolve: Overcoming Sparse Feedback in Agentic Harness Evolution with Demonstrations
summary: Agent harness evolution improves frozen language-model agents by modifying the executable structures around them. We study this paradigm as a form of sample-efficient fast adaptation: instead of updating model weights, an agent can acquire task-specific competence by changing its external harness, while leaving the base model's general capabilities intact. Prior work shows that self-generated rollouts can support harness search, suggesting that agents may acquire new task competence through practice. Yet in long-horizon stochastic environments, self-practice becomes fragile: rewards are sparse, outcomes are high-variance, and failures are hard to attribute to concrete harness mechanisms. We introduce DemoEvolve, a demonstration-bootstrapped approach to harness evolution. When reward-only search is too broad and noisy, competent human trajectories serve as expert reference experience for the coding proposer, guiding harness-level diagnosis and editing. Experiments on Liar's Dice show that self-rollout evolution can work when episodes are short and failures are attributable. In contrast, Balatro exposes a harder long-horizon stochastic regime, where self-rollout evolution is misled by sparse feedback and candidate-selection noise, while tutorial-like textual knowledge alone does not yield stable improvement. Under the same limited budget, DemoEvolve produces more effective and auditable harness edits and achieves better performance. Overall, demonstrations make sparse-feedback harness evolution more diagnosable, localizable, and stable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DemoEvolve，一种利用人类演示数据引导智能体外部框架（harness）进化的方法，以解决长时域随机环境中基于自我回滚的框架搜索面临奖励稀疏、方差高、归因困难等问题。实验表明，在Liar's Dice短场景下自我进化有效，但在Balatro这类长时域随机场景中失败，而DemoEvolve能在有限预算下生成更有效、可审计的框架编辑，取得更好性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于自我回滚的框架进化（self-rollout evolution）在长时域随机环境中表现脆弱：奖励稀疏、结果高方差、失败难以归因到具体的框架机制。因此需要更高效的引导方式来提升框架进化的样本效率和稳定性。
AI.method: DemoEvolve采用演示引导（demonstration-bootstrapped）的框架进化方法。利用人类专家轨迹作为参考经验，辅助编码提议者（coding proposer）进行框架层面的诊断和编辑，从而在奖励信号过于稀疏和嘈杂时提供更有效的引导信号。
AI.result: 在Liar's Dice环境中，短场景下自我回滚进化有效；在Balatro（长时域随机环境）中，自我回滚进化被稀疏反馈和候选选择噪声误导，而仅靠教程类文本知识也无法稳定改进。在相同有限预算下，DemoEvolve生成了更有效和可审计的框架编辑，并取得了更好的性能。
AI.conclusion: 演示数据能够使稀疏反馈的框架进化变得更加可诊断（diagnosable）、可定位（localizable）和稳定（stable），是解决长时域随机环境下框架进化困境的有效途径。

title: Polymorphism Is Rotation: Operational Mechanistic Interpretability from a Two-Layer Transformer to Pythia-70m
comment: 26 pages, 4 figures, 40 references. Pre-registered four-bar framework; all numerical claims reproducible
summary:
Independently trained transformers compute the same function in residual-stream bases that differ by a uniform random rotation on $\mathrm{SO}(d_{\mathrm{model}})$. We call this phenomenon polymorphism: same function, mutually unintelligible interior coordinates. One matrix multiplication per model pair removes it: an orthogonal Procrustes fit on a single batch of activations transfers sparse-autoencoder feature dictionaries and steering vectors between independently trained models, with no retraining.
  The phenomenon is invisible to the standard SAE universality metric. Decoder-column cosine similarity matches across seeds at 98%, the SAE-universality headline number, while an SAE trained on one seed reconstructs another seed's activations at negative explained variance, worse than predicting the constant mean. The decoder columns align; the encoder reads from a rotated frame. A single Procrustes rotation $R$ restores reconstruction to within 0.025 EV of the within-seed ceiling at every internal site.
  $R$ is Haar-distributed: $\|R - I\|_F$ matches the random-orthogonal prediction $\sqrt{2 d_{\mathrm{model}}}$ to 0.1% at $d_{\mathrm{model}} = 512$, and a Kolmogorov-Smirnov test of $R$'s eigenvalue spectrum against Haar $\mathrm{SO}(d_{\mathrm{model}})$ returns $p \approx 1.000$ pooled and per-pair. Diff-of-means steering vectors transfer in three regimes by alignment with $R$'s invariant subspace: clean when pinned by shared output weights, partial when overlapping the rotated subspace, inverted otherwise. With no shared I/O (Pythia), all three collapse to universally inverted. The same rotation account holds across training checkpoints within a single run.
  Validated on a 104k-parameter Dyck-3 transformer and nine independently-trained Pythia-70m seeds on The Pile, via a pre-registered four-bar operational framework. Frontier-scale (10B+) replication remains open.

AI.tldr: 独立训练的Transformer在残差流基中存在随机旋转差异（多态性），通过一次正交Procrustes拟合可消除，使SAE特征字典和转向向量在模型间迁移，无需重新训练。
AI.motivation: 发现独立训练的Transformer虽然功能相同，但其内部表示坐标存在随机正交旋转差异（称为多态性），导致模型间的表示不可互译，阻碍了机制可解释性研究的迁移和复用。
AI.method: 通过正交Procrustes拟合（单批激活数据上求解最优旋转矩阵R），对齐独立训练模型间的残差流基；验证R的Haar分布性质；在Dyck-3 Transformer和9个独立训练的Pythia-70m种子模型上，通过预注册的四条操作框架进行验证。
AI.result: Procrustes旋转将跨种子重构的负解释方差恢复至接近种内天花板（0.025 EV内）；R的Frobenius范数与随机正交预测$\sqrt{2d_{model}}$偏差仅0.1%；K-S检验p≈1.000；转向向量根据与R不变子空间的对齐程度呈现三种迁移模式。
AI.conclusion: 独立训练的Transformer存在可预测的坐标旋转差异（多态性），该差异可通过简单线性变换消除，使得SAE特征和转向向量无需重新训练即可跨模型迁移。标准SAE通用性指标（解码器列余弦相似度98%）掩盖了此现象。

title: Emission-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Sustainable Electric Vehicle Charging and Carbon Dioxide Reduction Under Varying Renewable Penetration
comment: Submitted the Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence Journal (Elsevier)
summary: The rapid growth of Electric Vehicle (EV) adoption challenges power distribution networks through peak load spikes, voltage instability, and transformer overloads from uncoordinated charging. While Model Predictive Control (MPC) and standard Reinforcement Learning (RL) methods have addressed these issues, existing approaches rarely treat real-time carbon intensity or fluctuating renewable energy (RE) availability as primary scheduling objectives, leaving substantial decarbonisation potential unrealised. This paper proposes an emission-aware RL strategy based on the Soft Actor Critic (SAC) algorithm, with a multi-objective reward that penalises carbon emissions, curtailed on-site renewables, and unmet user demand. The agent is trained within a unified benchmarking framework on the EV2Gym platform, incorporating behind-the-meter solar and wind profiles, time-varying EirGrid carbon intensity data, and realistic workplace EV behaviour across 25 Electric Vehicle Supply Equipment (EVSE) units. Nine control strategies, including heuristics, emission-aware MPC variants, and the proposed RL agent, are compared under five renewable penetration scenarios (0%-50%) over ten independent runs each. The RL agent achieves a carbon intensity as low as 23.96 grams of carbon dioxide per kilowatt-hour under 50% wind penetration, representing up to 87% emission reduction versus the uncontrolled baseline, and outperforms the external graph-based Power Distribution Network (PDN) benchmark. Transformer overload remains below 7 kWh across scenarios, against up to 1093 kWh for the As Fast As Possible (AFAP) heuristic, and renewable self-consumption reaches 52% under combined wind and solar supply. Embedding carbon intensity forecasts into the RL state and reward aligns charging with low-emission periods while preserving grid compliance and user satisfaction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于SAC算法的排放感知强化学习策略，通过多目标奖励函数（碳排放、可再生能源消纳、用户需求）在EV2Gym平台上进行训练。在五种可再生能源渗透场景下与九种控制策略对比，该RL agent在50%风电渗透率下实现23.96 gCO₂/kWh的碳强度，相比无控制基线减排87%，变压器过载低于7 kWh，可再生能源自消纳率52%。
AI.motivation: 现有电动汽车充电控制方法（MPC、标准RL）很少将实时碳强度和可再生能源波动性作为主要调度目标，未能充分发挥脱碳潜力。
AI.method: 采用SAC算法构建排放感知RL策略，设计包含碳排放、可再生能源消纳和用户需求的多目标奖励函数；在EV2Gym平台上整合光伏/风电曲线、EirGrid碳强度数据和实际工作场景充电行为进行训练。
AI.result: RL agent在50%风电渗透下碳强度低至23.96 gCO₂/kWh，减排87%；变压器过载低于7 kWh（对比AFAP的1093 kWh）；可再生能源自消纳率达52%。
AI.conclusion: 将碳强度预测嵌入RL状态空间和奖励函数，能够将充电行为引导至低碳时段，同时保持电网合规性和用户满意度。

title: Beyond Control-Flow: Integrating the Resource Perspective into Multi-Collaborative Process Modeling from Text
summary: Process modeling is a sub-domain of Business Process Management (BPM) focused on the translation of process artifacts into formal models. This task traditionally requires extensive human input and domain expertise in both BPM notations and the specific business context. While Large Language Models (LLMs) can now automate much of this manual work, current text-to-model approaches focus predominantly on the control-flow perspective-ordering activities without considering the collaborative aspect of the processes. In this paper, we introduce a resource-aware generation pipeline that produces formal BPMN 2.0 collaboration diagrams from natural-language descriptions. Rather than solely prompting an LLM for raw XML, we describe a compact, executable intermediate language with mandatory resource details defining both the organization (pool) and the role (lane). Cross-organization dependencies are materialized using the standard formal notation for such interactions-message events-while an orthogonal layout routine automatically handles the spatial arrangement of elements within pools and lanes. Experiments on ten business processes with nine LLMs show strong resource discovery while preserving control-flow quality and adding only marginal runtime overhead. This approach moves generative modeling toward a more comprehensive, multi-collaborative representation of business operations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种资源感知的生成流程，能够从自然语言描述自动生成包含协作信息的BPMN 2.0正式模型，在保持控制流质量的同时实现了良好的资源发现能力，且运行时开销极小。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到流程模型方法仅关注控制流视角（活动排序），忽略了流程中的协作方面（如组织与角色等资源信息），无法生成完整的跨组织协作图。
AI.method: 提出资源感知生成流程：设计了一种紧凑的可执行中间语言，强制包含资源细节（泳池对应组织，泳道对应角色）；跨组织依赖通过标准消息事件表示；通过正交布局例程自动处理池和道内元素的空间排列；仅用LLM输出中间语言而非直接生成原始XML。
AI.result: 在10个业务流程和9个LLM上的实验表明，该方法在保持控制流质量的同时实现了强大的资源发现能力，且仅增加少量运行时开销。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将生成式建模推向更全面的、多协作的业务运营表示，弥补了现有方法忽略协作维度的不足。

title: LAPLEX: The FFT of Learnable Laplace Kernels
summary:
Fast linear algebra in deep learning usually comes with a choice: fixed geometry and exact computation, as in the Fourier transform, or adaptive geometry paid for by dense parameters, random features, or low-rank surrogates. To move beyond this trade-off, we introduce LAPLEX, a class of exact, trainable (phased) Laplace-kernel operators.
  A LAPLEX layer is a typically full-rank dense matrix, implicitly defined by learnable coordinate anchors, with FFT-like scaling. Consequently, it supports trainable matrix--vector operations at vector dimensions up to $10^9$ on modern GPUs. As a neural layer, it yields compact projections and classification heads interpretable as soft, trainable routing models. The same primitive also serves as an efficient Gram operator, enabling high-dimensional covariance models on flattened images of dimension $3 \cdot 10^6$ that preserve visible spatial structure without imposing convolutional bias. These applications reflect a single principle: dense geometry can be learned without storing a dense matrix, which enables data-adaptive global interactions in regimes where ordinary dense layers are out of reach. In this sense, LAPLEX separates expressivity from storage cost: it behaves like a dense trainable matrix, but is represented and applied through a small structured set of parameters.

AI.tldr: LAPLEX 是一类基于可学习坐标锚点的精确可训练拉普拉斯核算子，支持类似 FFT 的高效矩阵-向量运算，可在现代 GPU 上处理高达 10^9 维的向量，实现稠密矩阵的表达能力而无需显式存储稠密矩阵，打破了固定几何与自适应几何之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 深度学习中快速线性代数面临两难选择：要么采用固定几何和精确计算（如傅里叶变换），要么采用自适应几何但需要稠密参数、随机特征或低秩代理。LAPLEX 旨在超越这一权衡。
AI.method: LAPLEX 通过可学习的坐标锚点隐式定义通常为满秩稠密矩阵的层，利用拉普拉斯核实现类似 FFT 的高效缩放，支持可训练的矩阵-向量操作。
AI.result: 支持维度高达 10^9 的向量运算；可作为紧凑投影和分类头，解释为软可训练路由模型；可作为高效 Gram 算子，在 3·10^6 维展平图像上实现保留空间结构的高维协方差模型，无需卷积偏置。
AI.conclusion: 稠密几何可以在不存储稠密矩阵的情况下学习，实现了数据自适应的全局交互；LAPLEX 将表达性与存储成本分离，通过小规模结构化参数集表示和应用稠密可训练矩阵。

title: PALoRA: Projection-Adaptive LoRA for Preserving Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Efficiently updating Large Language Models (LLMs) with new or evolving factual knowledge remains a central challenge, as even parameter-efficient adaptation can erode previously acquired reasoning abilities. This tension reflects a plasticity-stability dilemma: models must incorporate new knowledge while preserving skill-critical representations. In this work, we study this trade-off through the spectral structure of multilayer perceptron weight matrices. We show, both theoretically and empirically, that information essential for reasoning is not localized only in dominant singular directions, but is instead distributed across the singular spectrum. Motivated by this observation, we introduce PALoRA, a two-stage framework for knowledge injection with reduced interference. PALoRA first trains a Singular Value Fine-Tuning (SVF) expert on a reasoning dataset and uses its learned singular scaling vector as a frozen geometric probe to identify components that are critical for the target skill. It then performs factual knowledge injection with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) under a structural orthogonality constraint, ensuring that updates avoid the identified skill-relevant subspace. Across Llama 3.1 8B and Mistral 7B, and across mathematical, coding, and scientific reasoning benchmarks, PALoRA preserves on average 95% of the SVF expert's reasoning performance while maintaining competitive factual recall. It consistently improves skill retention over prior spectral Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods while adding less than 0.006% parameter overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出PALoRA框架，通过奇异值分解识别推理关键子空间，并在知识注入时施加正交约束来保护该子空间，从而在Llama 3.1 8B和Mistral 7B上平均保留95%的推理性能，同时保持竞争性的事实召回。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在更新事实知识时面临可塑性-稳定性困境：参数高效微调（如LoRA）在注入新知识时会侵蚀先前习得的推理能力。现有方法未能充分理解推理信息在权重矩阵奇异谱中的分布规律。
AI.method: 两阶段框架PALoRA：1) 在推理数据集上训练奇异值微调（SVF）专家，将其学习的奇异缩放向量作为几何探针，识别对目标技能关键的成分；2) 在事实知识注入阶段使用LoRA，施加结构正交约束确保更新避开已识别的技能相关子空间。
AI.result: 在数学、编程和科学推理基准上，PALoRA平均保留SVF专家95%的推理性能，同时维持竞争性的事实召回。相比先前的谱PEFT方法，技能保留持续提升，且参数开销低于0.006%。
AI.conclusion: 推理关键信息并非仅集中在主导奇异方向，而是分布在奇异谱中。通过正交约束将知识注入限制在非关键子空间，可以有效缓解可塑性-稳定性困境。

title: Beyond Fixed Points: Superpolynomial Capacity of Asymmetric Hopfield Networks
summary: Classical Hopfield networks are limited to static patterns due to symmetric weights, whereas asymmetric networks can encode temporal sequences via limit-cycle attractors. Achieving high-capacity storage of long sequences in classical synchronous asymmetric networks, however, has remained a challenge. We present a simple and robust construction within the classical asymmetric Hopfield model with binary neurons and synchronous updates, that allows $n$ neurons to support $\exp\!\big(Ω(n/(\log n)^2)\big)$ distinct limit-cycle attractors, each with period $\exp\!\big(Ω(\sqrt n/\log n)\big)$ and robust to random noise with flip probability up to $\frac12-o(1)$, yielding superpolynomial capacity in both the number and length of stored sequences. This is the first demonstration of such capacity for asymmetric Hopfield networks, which we obtain by combining results from combinatorics, number theory and the analysis of opinion dynamics. Our findings show that synchronous asymmetric Hopfield networks possess a sequence-memory capacity which is larger and more robust than previously recognized, demonstrating that, in both biological and artificial neural systems, robust sequence representation can be achieved through coarse architectural motifs rather than complex nonlinearities.

AI.tldr: 本文在经典二元异步Hopfield网络中，通过组合数学、数论与意见动力学分析，实现了指数级容量的极限环吸引子存储（序列数量与长度均超多项式），且对随机噪声具有高度鲁棒性，首次证明了异步Hopfield网络具备超出以往认知的强大序列记忆能力。
AI.motivation: 经典Hopfield网络因对称权重只能存储静态模式，而非对称网络虽能通过极限环编码时序序列，但如何在经典同步异步模型中实现高容量长序列存储一直是未解决的挑战。
AI.method: 在经典异步Hopfield模型（二元神经元、同步更新）中提出一种简单且鲁棒的构造方法，融合组合数学、数论和意见动力学分析，证明n个神经元可支持exp(Ω(n/(log n)²))个不同的极限环吸引子，每个周期长度达exp(Ω(√n/log n))，且对翻转概率高达1/2-o(1)的随机噪声鲁棒。
AI.result: 实现了序列数量与长度均达到超多项式（指数级）的存储容量，这是首次在异步Hopfield网络中展示如此高的序列记忆容量。
AI.conclusion: 同步异步Hopfield网络具备比先前认知更大且更鲁棒的序列记忆能力，表明在生物与人工神经系统中，粗粒度架构模式而非复杂非线性即可实现鲁棒的序列表征。

title: Jailbreak to Protect: Buffering and Reinforcing via Temporary Jailbreaking for Safe Fine-Tuning in Large Language Models
summary: Fine-tuning-as-a-Service (FaaS) enables personalization of large language models (LLMs), but it can weaken safety-alignment under harmful fine-tuning attacks. Recent work has shown that activating harmful-behavior modules during fine-tuning can prevent models from learning undesired behaviors, but its mechanism remains unclear. In this paper, we revisit temporary jailbreaking as a defense against harmful fine-tuning and provide a gradient-level analysis showing that it saturates safety-degrading gradients while preserving benign task-relevant gradients. Based on this insight, we propose a Buffer-and-Reinforce fine-tuning framework that buffers harmful updates during user fine-tuning and reinforces safety after adaptation. Specifically, BufferLoRA induces temporary jailbreaking as a removable adapter to reduce harmful updates during user fine-tuning. After adaptation, ReinforceLoRA, trained to recover refusal behavior under the temporarily jailbroken state, is integrated with UserLoRA via QR decomposition-based merging to reinforce safety while preserving user-task performance. Extensive experiments show that our framework achieves superior safety and utility with no additional safety data during user fine-tuning and minimal computational cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Buffer-and-Reinforce微调框架，通过临时越狱（BufferLoRA）在用户微调期间缓冲有害更新，并在适应后通过ReinforceLoRA（基于QR分解合并）强化安全性，在不需额外安全数据且计算成本极低的情况下，实现了优越的安全性与实用性平衡。
AI.motivation: 微调即服务（FaaS）在实现大语言模型个性化时，会因有害微调攻击而削弱安全对齐。现有方法虽能通过激活有害行为模块来防止模型学习不良行为，但其机制尚不明确，亟需更深入的分析和高效的防御方案。
AI.method: 首先从梯度层面分析临时越狱的防御机制，揭示其能饱和安全退化梯度同时保留良性任务相关梯度。据此提出Buffer-and-Reinforce框架：BufferLoRA作为可移除适配器在用户微调时诱导临时越狱以减少有害更新；微调后，ReinforceLoRA在临时越狱状态下训练以恢复拒绝行为，并通过QR分解合并与UserLoRA集成，在强化安全性的同时保持用户任务性能。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该框架在用户微调期间无需额外安全数据、计算成本极低的情况下，实现了优越的安全性与实用性。
AI.conclusion: 临时越狱作为一种有效的有害微调防御机制，其梯度层面的解释为安全对齐提供了新视角；Buffer-and-Reinforce框架为FaaS场景下平衡安全与实用提供了高效可行的方案。

title: Beyond Generative Priors: Minority Sampling with JEPA-Guided Diffusion
summary: Minority sampling aims to generate low-density instances on a data manifold and is of central importance in applications such as medical diagnosis, anomaly detection, and creative AI. Existing approaches, however, define minority samples relative to generative priors learned from training data, confining rarity to model-specific notions that may poorly reflect real-world semantics. In this work, we propose a world-centric perspective on minority sampling, which defines rarity with respect to real-world priors rather than generator-induced densities. To this end, we introduce JEPA guidance, a diffusion sampling framework guided by a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) -- a class of world models that encode broad, semantically rich representations. JEPA guidance steers diffusion trajectories toward low-density regions under the implicit density induced by the JEPA, thereby aligning generated minorities with real-world semantic rarity. To make JEPA guidance computationally practical, we develop principled approximation strategies accompanied by theoretical error bounds, significantly reducing the overhead of guidance computation. Extensive experiments across unconditional, class-conditional, and text-to-image generation demonstrate that JEPA guidance consistently improves the fidelity and semantic validity of minority samples, outperforming generator-centric baselines in capturing real-world notions of rarity. Code is available at https://github.com/soobin-um/jepa-guidance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于世界模型的JEPA引导扩散采样框架，通过联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）定义真实世界语义上的稀有性，而非传统生成模型内部的密度概念，从而生成更符合现实语义的少数样本。
AI.motivation: 现有少数样本采样方法依赖于生成先验定义稀有性，导致稀有性概念局限于模型内部密度，无法反映真实世界的语义稀缺性。
AI.method: 提出JEPA引导的扩散采样框架，利用JEPA世界模型编码的丰富语义表征，引导扩散轨迹朝向JEPA隐式密度下的低密度区域；并开发了具有理论误差界的近似策略以降低计算开销。
AI.result: 在无条件、类别条件及文本到图像生成任务中，JEPA引导方法在少数样本的保真度和语义有效性上持续优于基于生成器中心的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 以世界模型为中心定义稀有性能够更好地捕捉现实世界的语义稀缺性，JEPA引导为少数样本采样提供了一种高效且语义一致的范式。

title: Summoning the Oracle to Slay It: Mitigating Look-Ahead Bias in Financial Backtesting with Large Language Models
summary: Backtesting large language models (LLMs) on historical financial data is unreliable because pre-training cuts off after the events happened. An LLM trained in 2024 already "knows" which way 2018-2020 stocks moved. We name this failure parametric look-ahead bias and propose FinCAD, an inference-time adaptation of Context-Aware Decoding that suppresses an LLM's memory of historical outcomes without retraining. FinCAD pairs an adversarial bias-discovery pipeline that learns a model-specific memory-activating prior prompt with an entity- and date-adaptive rule that scales the CAD strength to per-(entity, date) memorisation, so the penalty fires on memorised in-sample dates and decays to zero out-of-sample. Across five 7-14B LLMs and five mega-cap equities, FinCAD cuts in-sample backtest returns by up to -67.1% on memorised dates while leaving 2025 out-of-sample returns within $8K and Sharpe within 0.10 of baseline, and preserves general-purpose reasoning within 1.7 pts. On an eleven-model leaderboard, it raises the in-sample / out-of-sample Spearman correlation from +0.779 to +0.846, recovering rankings that genuinely predict out-of-sample performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出参数化前瞻偏差（LLM因预训练数据包含未来信息导致的回测不可靠问题），并设计FinCAD方法——通过推理阶段的上下文感知解码抑制模型对历史结果的记忆，无需重新训练。该方法在多个LLM和股票数据上有效降低回测偏差，同时保持泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在历史金融数据上的回测不可靠，因为预训练数据截止日期晚于事件发生时间，导致模型已"知道"历史股价走势，产生参数化前瞻偏差，使得回测结果虚假高估。
AI.method: 提出FinCAD，包含两部分：1) 对抗性偏差发现流水线，学习模型特定的记忆激活先验提示；2) 实体与日期自适应规则，根据每个(实体, 日期)的记忆程度动态缩放CAD强度，对记忆过的样本内日期施加强惩罚，对样本外日期衰减至零。
AI.result: 在5个7-14B参数LLM和5只大型股票上，FinCAD在记忆日期上将样本内回测收益降低高达-67.1%，同时2025年样本外收益偏差仅$8K，Sharpe比率偏差在0.10以内，通用推理能力保持1.7分以内。在11个模型的排行榜上，样本内/样本外Spearman相关性从+0.779提升至+0.846。
AI.conclusion: FinCAD有效消除了LLM在金融回测中的参数化前瞻偏差，使得样本内表现能真实预测样本外表现，无需重新训练模型即可获得可靠的金融回测结果。

title: On the Stability and Realizability of Recurrent Polynomial Surrogate Ternary Logic Gate Networks
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) can learn to predict Signal Temporal Logic (STL) verdicts online from partial trajectories, but deploying them as runtime monitors in safety-critical systems demands more than predictive accuracy. Standard RNN architectures offer no structural guarantee that outputs degrade gracefully under sensor degradation; a dropped input can silently flip a verdict from safe to unsafe. We introduce the Recurrent Differentiable Ternary Logic Gate Network (R-DTLGN), a recurrent architecture that operates over Kleene's three-valued logic $\{-1, 0, +1\}$, where $0$ explicitly represents unknown. The R-DTLGN trains through continuous polynomial surrogates and hardens to a discrete ternary logic circuit at inference. We analyze the hardened circuit through two gate vocabularies derived from two orderings on the ternary domain: numerically monotone gates ensure stable recurrent dynamics, while information-monotone gates, when present, guarantee principled abstention (unknown inputs never produce wrong outputs) and monotonicity in input certainty (more information can only improve the verdict). We show that the recurrent connections required by bounded STL operators use exclusively AND and OR, which belong to both vocabularies, linking the monitoring task to the architecture's guarantees. A realizability bound derived from the STL formula's temporal operators directly sizes the network's hidden state, replacing hyperparameter search with a formula-driven specification. We evaluate on STL specifications over D4RL PointMaze navigation data, testing prediction accuracy, degradation under predicate dropout, and the accuracy-versus-safety tradeoff between two label construction pipelines. The R-DTLGN is, to our knowledge, the first recurrent architecture that couples learned temporal prediction with formal degradation guarantees rooted in three-valued logic.

AI.tldr: 提出R-DTLGN，一种基于Kleene三值逻辑的循环架构，能在保持形式化退化保证的同时学习预测STL在线判定。
AI.motivation: 标准RNN在安全关键系统中作为运行时监控器时，缺乏对传感器退化（如输入丢失）的结构性保证，退化可能导致判定从安全静默翻转为不安全。
AI.method: 在Kleene三值逻辑{-1,0,+1}上构建循环架构，通过连续多项式代理训练，推理时硬化为离散三值逻辑电路。利用数值单调和信息单调两种门词汇表分析硬化电路，前者保证稳定循环动力学，后者保证原则性弃权（未知输入不产生错误输出）和输入确定性单调性。
AI.result: 在D4RL PointMaze导航数据的STL规范上评估了预测精度、谓词丢弃下的退化表现，以及两种标签构建管道的精度-安全权衡。证明有界STL算子所需的循环连接仅包含AND和OR门，两者同时属于两种单调词汇表。
AI.conclusion: R-DTLGN是首个将学习到的时序预测与基于三值逻辑的形式化退化保证相结合的循环架构，通过STL公式的时序算子直接确定网络隐藏状态大小，消除了超参数搜索。

title: Associations between echocardiographic traits and AI-ECG predictions of heart failure
summary:
Artificial intelligence-enabled electrocardiography (AI-ECG) can detect heart failure (HF), including disease not captured by left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF), but the cardiac phenotypes underlying model predictions remain unclear. We therefore investigated whether AI-ECG-predicted HF risk aligns with established echocardiographic measures of myocardial dysfunction, remodelling, and filling pressures.
  We retrospectively analysed ECG and echocardiography data from 8147 patients who underwent both examinations within three days at Akershus University Hospital between 1 January 2023 and 1 June 2025. A previously validated AI-ECG model for HF detection was applied to all ECGs. Spearman's rank correlation $ρ$ quantified associations between echocardiographic parameters and AI-ECG risk. Subgroup analyses were performed by sex and left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF). External validation included 36,286 ECG-echocardiography pairs from Columbia University Irving Medical Center.
  Global longitudinal strain (GLS) showed the strongest correlation ($ρ$=0.57), followed by mitral annular plane systolic excursion (MAPSE) ($ρ$=-0.49) and LVEF ($ρ$=-0.45). In patients with LVEF>50%, correlations remained substantial for GLS, MAPSE, and diastolic-related parameters. Volumetric left ventricular indices correlated less strongly in women, whereas diastolic indices showed stronger correlations in women than in men.
  Physiological validation showed that AI-ECG HF risk predictions align primarily with measures of systolic function, particularly global longitudinal strain, while also capturing diastolic-related abnormalities in patients with preserved LVEF. This approach may improve clinical interpretability and identify opportunities for model refinement.

AI.tldr: 本研究验证了AI-ECG预测的心力衰竭风险与超声心动图指标（尤其是整体纵向应变GLS）高度相关，即使在LVEF保留的患者中也能捕捉舒张功能异常，增强了模型的临床可解释性。
AI.motivation: AI-ECG能检测心力衰竭（包括LVEF未捕获的疾病），但模型预测背后的心脏表型尚不清楚，因此需要探究AI-ECG预测的HF风险是否与已确立的超声心动图心肌功能障碍、重构和充盈压测量指标一致。
AI.method: 回顾性分析8147例患者的ECG与超声心动图数据（3天内完成）。使用已验证的AI-ECG模型检测HF，通过Spearman秩相关评估超声参数与AI-ECG风险之间的关联，并按性别和LVEF进行亚组分析，外部队列验证包含36,286对数据。
AI.result: GLS与AI-ECG风险的相关性最强（ρ=0.57），其次为MAPSE（ρ=-0.49）和LVEF（ρ=-0.45）。LVEF>50%患者中，GLS、MAPSE及舒张相关参数仍保持显著相关。女性中容积性左心室指标相关性较弱，而舒张指标相关性更强。
AI.conclusion: AI-ECG预测的HF风险主要与收缩功能指标（特别是GLS）一致，同时在LVEF保留的患者中也能捕获舒张功能异常，有助于提高临床可解释性并识别模型优化方向。

title: WLNO: Wavelet-Laplace Neural Operator for Solving Partial Differential Equations
summary: This work introduces the Wavelet-Laplace Neural Operator (WLNO), a novel neural operator that fuses Haar wavelet multi-scale spatial decomposition with the Laplace-domain pole-residue formulation of the Laplace Neural Operator (LNO). While LNO captures transient and steady-state dynamics through learnable system poles and residues, it lacks an explicit mechanism for extracting spatially localized multi-scale features inherent in complex PDE solutions. WLNO addresses this by augmenting the LNO core with a parallel single-level Haar discrete wavelet transform (DWT) branch that decomposes the lifted feature map into four frequency subbands: approximation (LL), horizontal detail (LH), vertical detail (HL), and diagonal detail (HH) and applies independent learned $1\times1$ convolutions to each subband before reconstruction via the inverse DWT. The two branches are fused through a learnable sigmoid-gated weight $α_\mathrm{wav}$, initialized to give a small initial contribution to the wavelet branch, allowing the model to adaptively balance Laplace-domain dynamics against spatial multi-scale features throughout training. WLNO is evaluated against LNO on five benchmark PDE problems using identical hyperparameters, training data, and evaluation protocols: the diffusion equation, the Burgers equation, the reaction-diffusion system, Darcy flow, and the two-dimensional Navier-Stokes equation. WLNO consistently outperforms LNO on all five problems, with the most pronounced improvement on problems with strong spatial multi-scale structure, such as the Burgers equation with sharp shock fronts and the Navier-Stokes equation with coherent vortical structures, while remaining consistent across smoother and elliptic problems. These results demonstrate that wavelet-based multi-scale spatial decomposition is a principled and effective complement to Laplace-domain operator learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出小波-拉普拉斯神经算子（WLNO），通过将Haar小波多尺度空间分解与拉普拉斯神经算子（LNO）的极点-留数公式融合，在五个PDE基准问题上一致超越LNO，尤其对具有强空间多尺度结构的问题提升显著。
AI.motivation: LNO虽然能够通过可学习的系统极点和留数捕捉瞬态与稳态动力学，但缺乏显式机制来提取复杂PDE解中固有的空间局部化多尺度特征。
AI.method: WLNO在LNO核心基础上增加一个并行的单层Haar离散小波变换（DWT）分支，将提升后的特征图分解为四个频率子带（LL、LH、HL、HH），对每个子带应用独立学习的1×1卷积，再通过逆DWT重构；两个分支通过可学习的sigmoid门控权重α_wav融合，初始赋予小波分支较小贡献。
AI.result: 在扩散方程、Burgers方程、反应扩散系统、达西流和二维Navier-Stokes方程五个PDE基准问题上，WLNO一致优于LNO，在具有尖锐激波前端的Burgers方程和具有相干涡结构的Navier-Stokes方程上改进最为显著，在光滑和椭圆问题上表现一致。
AI.conclusion: 基于小波的多尺度空间分解是拉普拉斯域算子学习的一种有原则且有效的补充方法。

title: HeartBeatAI: An Interpretable and Robust Deep Learning Framework for Multi-Label ECG Arrhythmia Detection
summary: While Deep Learning (DL) enhances automated electrocardiogram (ECG) analysis, clinical deployment is hindered by class imbalance and the generalization gap. This paper presents HeartBeatAI, a deep learning framework combining domain generalization, multi-scale feature aggregation, and clinical explainability for robust 12-lead ECG classification. Moving beyond image-based paradigms, HeartBeatAI integrates a Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE) ResNet to isolate diagnostic leads alongside a Multi-Layer Concentration Pipeline to capture macro-rhythm and micro-morphological anomalies. To mitigate domain shift, the framework employs MixStyle regularization and Label Smoothing. Rigorous benchmarking across four large-scale datasets using intra-source and Leave-One-Domain-Out (LODO) protocols demonstrates high performance (98% Macro F1-score) under intra-source conditions. However, LODO evaluations reveal significant degradation in detecting rare anomalies, highlighting a persistent challenge in cross-institutional deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HeartBeatAI框架，结合领域泛化、多尺度特征聚合和临床可解释性进行12导联ECG分类。该方法采用SE-ResNet和多层浓度管道，通过MixStyle正则化和标签平滑缓解域偏移。在四个大规模数据集上，内部源评估达到98% Macro F1-score，但留一域外评估显示罕见异常检测性能显著下降，揭示了跨机构部署的持续挑战。
AI.motivation: 深度学习的ECG分析在临床部署中面临类别不平衡和泛化差距两大障碍，现有方法难以同时兼顾鲁棒性、可解释性和跨域泛化能力。
AI.method: HeartBeatAI框架包含：(1) Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE) ResNet用于隔离诊断导联；(2) Multi-Layer Concentration Pipeline捕获宏观节律和微观形态异常；(3) MixStyle正则化与标签平滑缓解域偏移。采用内部源和留一域外两种评估协议。
AI.result: 内部源协议下达到98% Macro F1-score；LODO协议下罕见异常检测性能显著下降，表明跨机构部署仍面临挑战。
AI.conclusion: HeartBeatAI在域内场景表现优异，但跨域场景下罕见异常检测的退化问题表明，领域泛化仍是临床部署的核心瓶颈，需要进一步研究以增强模型对罕见病理的泛化能力。

title: IterInject: Indirect Prompt Injection Against LLM Agents via Feedback-Guided Iterative Optimization
summary: LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed for complex tasks requiring planning, tool use, and interaction with external services. Their reliance on untrusted external content exposes them to indirect prompt injection (IPI), in which adversarial instructions embedded in retrieved data hijack agent behavior. Existing attacks rely on static payloads that cannot adapt to agent-specific defenses; even recent adaptive methods lack structured feedback to guide optimization. We introduce \oursys, a feedback-guided iterative framework that closes the loop between injection, diagnosis, and refinement: a rule-based diagnoser produces structured outcome labels with behavioral descriptions, and an LLM-based optimizer refines payloads conditioned on the full optimization history. A synthesis step generates new disguise seeds from failure patterns, enabling the strategy space to self-evolve. On AgentDojo and InjectAgent, \oursys substantially outperforms static baselines and existing adaptive methods across four victim models. Extension experiments on Claude Code, a production-grade coding agent with layered defenses, show that optimized payloads achieve full success on 5 of 9 targets; even those that resist full exploitation exhibit measurable improvement from iterative refinement. We further present a mechanistic analysis of IPI, identifying an attention-mediated threshold mechanism in mid-to-late layers; three causal interventions validate this finding and point to concrete defense directions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Oursys，一个基于反馈引导的迭代框架，通过诊断器-优化器-生成器的闭环机制生成自适应对抗payload，在AgentDojo和InjectAgent上显著优于静态和现有自适应方法，并揭示了IPI的注意力介导阈值机制。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体依赖不可信外部内容，容易遭受间接提示注入攻击。现有攻击使用无法适应智能体特定防御的静态payload，即使最新的自适应方法也缺乏结构化反馈来引导优化过程。
AI.method: 提出Oursys框架，包含三个核心组件：规则诊断器生成带有行为描述的结构化结果标签；LLM优化器基于完整优化历史精炼payload；合成步骤从失败模式生成新的伪装种子，实现策略空间自我进化。
AI.result: 在AgentDojo和InjectAgent上跨四个受害模型显著优于静态基线和现有自适应方法。在Claude Code上，优化payload在9个目标中的5个达到完全成功。机制分析发现注意力介导的阈值机制，三个因果干预验证了该发现。
AI.conclusion: 反馈引导的迭代优化能有效突破智能体防御，注意力介导阈值机制为设计更鲁棒的防御策略提供了具体方向。

title: Learning to Reason Efficiently with A* Post-Training
summary: Many applications of large language models (LLMs) require deductive reasoning, yet models frequently produce incorrect or redundant inference steps. We frame natural language inference as a search problem where the final answer is the valid proof itself, requiring a reasoning procedure in which intermediate inferences are correct. Specifically, we investigate whether LLMs can learn to generate correct and efficient proofs with guidance from A* search -- an algorithm that guarantees an optimally efficient path to a goal. We explore two training techniques: supervised fine-tuning on execution traces from A* and reinforcement learning with A*-informed process reward models. Empirically, we find that Llama-3.2 models in the 1B--3B range benefit substantially from A* post training, going from near-zero accuracy to outperforming DeepSeek-V3.2 -- a much larger model. Our analysis uncovers a trade-off: while simple correctness rewards maximize accuracy, A*-informed signals strike a balance between accuracy and efficiency. Furthermore, we find that on larger search spaces, models trained with imperfect heuristics exhibit superior accuracy. Our results demonstrate a promising direction towards reasoning guided by principles derived from classical search algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将自然语言推理建模为搜索问题，利用A*搜索算法引导LLM生成正确且高效的推理证明。通过监督微调（A*执行轨迹）和强化学习（A*过程奖励模型）两种方法训练Llama-3.2（1B-3B）模型，在推理准确性和效率上显著提升，甚至超越DeepSeek-V3.2等大模型。
AI.motivation: LLM在演绎推理任务中常产生错误或冗余的推理步骤，现有方法缺乏对推理过程正确性和效率的保证。作者希望将经典搜索算法（A*）的原理融入LLM训练，使其生成最优推理路径。
AI.method: 1）监督微调：在A*搜索生成的执行轨迹上训练模型。2）强化学习：使用A*算法提供的过程奖励信号（过程奖励模型）指导模型学习。对比简单正确性奖励与A*信息奖励的效果，并研究非完美启发式函数对较大搜索空间的影响。
AI.result: Llama-3.2（1B-3B）在A*后训练后从近零准确率提升至超越DeepSeek-V3.2。简单正确性奖励最大化准确率，而A*信号在准确率和效率之间取得平衡。更大的搜索空间下，非完美启发式训练出的模型准确率更高。
AI.conclusion: 将经典搜索算法的原理（如A*最优路径搜索）融入LLM训练是一种有效的推理增强方向，能够在保证推理正确性的同时提升效率。

title: Trajectory-Based Difficulty Scoring for Reliable Learning on Tabular Data
summary: Gradient-boosted trees achieve strong performance on tabular data, yet often leave a long tail of poorly predicted instances. We introduce a Trajectory-based Difficulty Score (TDS), an instance-level difficulty estimator for boosted ensembles derived from per-tree cumulative prediction trajectories. For each instance, we compute interpretable trajectory descriptors (e.g., variance, oscillation peaks, sign switches, and tail stability) and train a lightweight regression model to predict held-out loss. An empirical CDF calibrates the resulting signal into a score in $[0,1]$ that supports ranking hard cases. Across diverse tabular benchmarks and ensemble sizes, TDS exhibits strong rank correlation with error and outperforms established instance-hardness and uncertainty baselines on classification, while remaining competitive on regression. We then show how a single difficulty signal improves multiple data mining workflows: difficulty-driven active learning for label-efficient training, difficulty-thresholded selective prediction for improved risk-coverage trade-offs, and TDS-stratified (Mondrian) conformal prediction for more uniform conditional coverage. Finally, clustering high-TDS instances using SHAP attributions reveals coherent failure modes characterized by compact feature-value ranges, supporting error analysis and targeted data acquisition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于轨迹的难度评分（TDS），通过梯度提升树的累积预测轨迹为每个实例计算可解释的难度指标，并展示了该评分在主动学习、选择性预测、共形预测以及错误分析等多个数据挖掘任务中的有效性。
AI.motivation: 梯度提升树在表格数据上表现优异，但常存在大量难以预测的实例（长尾分布），缺乏有效的实例级难度估计方法。
AI.method: 从每棵树的累积预测轨迹中提取可解释的描述符（如方差、振荡峰值、符号翻转、尾部稳定性），训练轻量级回归模型预测留出损失，并通过经验CDF将信号校准到[0,1]分数区间。
AI.result: 在多个表格数据基准和不同集成规模下，TDS与误差具有强秩相关性，在分类任务上优于已有的实例难度和不确定性基线，在回归任务上具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: TDS单一难度信号能同时改进多种数据挖掘流程：主动学习、选择性预测、Mondrian共形预测的条件覆盖均匀性，且对高TDS实例进行SHAP聚类可揭示一致的失败模式，支持错误分析与针对性数据采集。

title: Hera: Learning Long-Horizon Coordination for Device-Cloud Collaborative LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents excel at solving complex long-horizon tasks through autonomous interaction with environments. However, their real-world deployment faces a fundamental device--cloud dilemma: on-device models are efficient but often brittle, while cloud models are stronger but costly in computation. State-of-the-art LLM device--cloud routers usually make coarse task-level decisions, which cannot adapt to the changing difficulty of multi-step agent interactions. To address this issue, we present Hera, a step-level device--cloud LLM agent coordinator for long-horizon tasks achieving a strong performance--cost Pareto frontier. Hera adopts a novel two-stage training paradigm: (1) imitation learning for cold-start, followed by (2) reinforcement learning that jointly optimizes task success and cloud usage efficiency. The first stage casts step-level routing as a supervised classification problem: the device agent is replayed on cloud trajectories, with each state labeled by the agreement between device and cloud actions. In the second stage, we perform cost-aware reinforcement learning by grouping identical states across trajectories and updating Hera with labels favoring higher expected return and fewer future cloud calls. We evaluate Hera on ALFWorld, WebShop, and AppWorld, where it consistently outperforms prior methods, achieving 92.5% of the cloud-only success rate with cloud use in only 46.3% of steps.

AI.tldr: Hera是一种面向长时间跨度任务的步骤级设备-云LLM协调器，采用两阶段训练（模仿学习+强化学习），在仅使用46.3%云步骤的情况下达到92.5%的纯云成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM设备-云路由器通常做粗粒度的任务级决策，无法适应多步智能体交互中不断变化的难度，导致设备-云部署面临设备模型脆弱的性能和云模型高昂的计算成本之间的权衡困境。
AI.method: 两阶段训练范式：第一阶段将步骤级路由建模为监督分类问题，通过回放云轨迹上设备与云动作的一致性进行状态标注；第二阶段进行成本感知的强化学习，将跨轨迹的相同状态分组，用偏好更高期望回报和更少未来云调用的标签更新Hera。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop和AppWorld上，Hera一致优于先前方法，以46.3%的云步骤使用率实现了92.5%的纯云成功率。
AI.conclusion: 步骤级路由决策比任务级更灵活有效，两阶段训练范式能有效地在性能与成本之间取得帕累托最优权衡。

title: Beyond the Aggregation Dilemma: Prior-Retaining Decoupled Learning for Multimodal Graphs
summary: Multimodal Attributed Graph Learning (MAGL) integrates intrinsic node attributes with structural topology via graph aggregation. However, as pretrained encoders evolve into Large Foundation Models (LFMs), the landscape of MAGL fundamentally shifts: under high-confidence LFM priors, mandatory aggregation introduces topological noise that overwhelms discriminative signals, triggering a counter-intuitive performance inversion where sophisticated MAGL architectures underperform simple topology-agnostic MLPs. Through systematic empirical and theoretical analysis, we identify that this inversion stems from a fundamental aggregation dilemma characterized by two concurrent pathologies: (1) Representational Pathology (SNR Degradation) - mandatory aggregation dilutes robust intrinsic features with topological noise, causing the noise penalty to outweigh its collaborative benefit; and (2) Optimization Pathology (Gradient Starvation) - topological aggregation attenuates gradient flow, while a shared task loss causes dominant modalities to prematurely suppress weaker ones. To resolve this dilemma, we propose SUPRA (Shared-Unique Prior-Retaining Architecture), a decoupled dual-pathway paradigm. SUPRA processes modality-specific features through topology-agnostic MLPs while capturing structural synergy via a lightweight shared GNN, with auxiliary deep supervision counteracting gradient starvation. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that SUPRA achieves state-of-the-art performance while requiring 3.5x lower peak GPU memory and up to 4.4x faster training time than Multimodal Graph Transformers.

AI.tldr: 本文发现多模态属性图学习（MAGL）在大规模基础模型（LFM）时代存在性能反转现象：强制图聚合会引入拓扑噪声，导致复杂GNN模型性能反而不如简单MLP。作者通过理论和实证分析揭示了聚合困境的两大病理——表示病理（SNR退化）和优化病理（梯度饥饿），并提出解耦双通路架构SUPRA（共享-独特先验保持架构），将模态特定特征通过拓扑无关的MLP处理，结构协同通过轻量共享GNN捕捉，并辅以深度监督。SUPRA在保持SOTA性能的同时，相比多模态图Transformer降低3.5倍峰值GPU内存、提升4.4倍训练速度。
AI.motivation: 传统MAGL方法假设图聚合总是有益的，但在LFM时代，预训练编码器已能提供高置信度节点先验，强制聚合反而引入拓扑噪声，导致性能反转。现有研究缺乏对这一现象的系统分析及解决方案。
AI.method: 提出SUPRA架构：解耦双通路范式——(1) 拓扑无关MLP处理模态特定特征（保留强判别性先验）；(2) 轻量共享GNN捕捉结构协同信息；(3) 辅助深度监督机制对抗梯度饥饿问题。
AI.result: SUPRA在多个数据集上达到SOTA性能；相比多模态图Transformer，峰值GPU内存降低3.5倍，训练速度提升4.4倍。
AI.conclusion: LFM时代下MAGL存在聚合困境，解耦双通路设计能有效规避拓扑噪声污染，同时保持结构协同能力，实现性能与效率的双重提升。

title: Agent-as-Peer-Debriefer: A Multi-Agent Framework with Perspective-Based Refinement for Qualitative Analysis
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for qualitative data analysis (QDA), yet their outputs often miss the depth and nuance of human analysis. We argue this gap reflects a missing credibility practice from human QDA: peer debriefing, in which an analyst seeks feedback from a disinterested peer and uses it to refine their coding. To bring this practice into LLM-assisted QDA, we propose Agent-as-Peer-Debriefer, a multi-agent QDA framework that builds peer debriefing into key coding steps. In our framework, a Hierarchical Coding Agent follows the standard QDA process to generate codes, sub-themes, and themes, along with self-explanations and reflection memos. It then shares these outputs with three Peer-Debriefing Agents, each applying a distinct analytical perspective (Theory-Driven, Data-Driven, or Applied) and refining the codes by keeping, renaming, reassigning, merging, or splitting them.
