These perspectives are drawn from established human QDA practices that generalize across domains and datasets. To evaluate the framework, we test it on three datasets across two domains with three LLMs, measuring semantic similarity to human-annotated codes. Across all settings, perspective-based, peer-debriefing refinement aligns more closely with human codes than a single-LLM baseline, and an ablation further shows the gain is not merely from additional refinement. The three perspectives also produce distinct trade-offs, showing that the choice of perspective is a meaningful and controllable design decision. More broadly, these findings suggest that simulating peer debriefing with explicit perspectives is a promising route to more credible LLM-assisted QDA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Agent-as-Peer-Debriefer框架，通过在LLM辅助的质性数据分析中引入人类同行汇报（peer debriefing）实践，利用三个不同分析视角的智能体对分层编码结果进行同行评议式优化，实验表明该方法在多个数据集和模型上显著提升了编码结果与人工标注的一致性。
AI.motivation: LLM用于质性数据分析时，输出结果常缺乏人类分析的深度和细微差异。作者认为这一差距源于缺少人类QDA中的关键可信度实践——同行汇报（peer debriefing），即分析师向中立的同行寻求反馈并据此完善编码。
AI.method: 提出Agent-as-Peer-Debriefer多智能体QDA框架：分层编码代理按标准QDA流程生成编码、子主题和主题，并附带自我解释和反思备忘录；随后将输出共享给三个同行汇报代理（理论驱动、数据驱动、应用导向），每个代理从不同分析视角通过保留、重命名、重分配、合并或拆分等方式细化编码。
AI.result: 在三个数据集、两个领域、三种LLM上的实验表明，基于视角的同行汇报细化方法在所有设置下均比单LLM基线更接近人工编码；消融实验证明性能提升不仅仅是额外细化步骤带来的；三种视角产生不同的权衡效果，表明视角选择是有意义且可控的设计决策。
AI.conclusion: 模拟具有明确视角的同行汇报是提高LLM辅助QDA可信度的有效途径。

title: Streaming Reinforcement Learning under Partial Observability with Real-Time Recurrent Learning
summary: Streaming reinforcement learning has emerged as an online learning paradigm that conforms to the restrictions of natural learning agents that process data incrementally, i.e. with a batch size of 1 and no replay buffer. While streaming RL has recently been shown to scale with deep function approximation with full observability, partially observable settings have remained out of reach. Truncated backpropagation through time collapses to a one-step gradient horizon under the streaming setting, and exact real-time recurrent learning is prohibitively expensive. We close this gap using recurrent trace units, a diagonal recurrent architecture that enables exact RTRL with linear time and memory complexity in the parameter count, and show that they integrate cleanly into existing streaming algorithms across both discrete and continuous control. On a MemoryChain diagnostic with chain lengths from 2 to 128, our method sustains performance where streaming TBPTT(1) baselines using feedforward, GRU, and RTU networks collapse. On five POPGym tasks and on partially observable MuJoCo continuous control, the streaming approach is competitive with batched PPO on POPGym and recovers a substantial fraction of batched performance on masked MuJoCo, despite using no replay buffer or batched updates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用循环迹单元（RTU）实现部分可观测环境下的流式强化学习，解决了流式TBPTT梯度退化问题，在MemoryChain诊断任务、POPGym和部分可观测MuJoCo上表现出与批处理方法竞争的性能。
AI.motivation: 流式强化学习（批量大小为1、无回放缓冲区）符合自然学习代理的增量处理约束，但此前仅在完全可观测场景下通过深度函数近似实现扩展，部分可观测设置仍无法解决。流式设置下截断反向传播通过时间（TBPTT）退化为单步梯度，而精确实时递归学习（RTRL）计算成本过高。
AI.method: 使用循环迹单元（Recurrent Trace Units, RTU），一种对角递归架构，能够以参数数量的线性时间和内存复杂度实现精确RTRL。RTU可无缝集成到现有流式算法中，适用于离散和连续控制任务。
AI.result: 在MemoryChain诊断任务（链长2到128）上，该方法保持性能，而使用前馈、GRU和RTU网络的流式TBPTT(1)基线崩溃。在五个POPGym任务和部分可观测MuJoCo连续控制上，流式方法在POPGym上与批处理PPO竞争，在掩码MuJoCo上恢复了批处理方法的大部分性能，尽管没有使用回放缓冲区或批处理更新。
AI.conclusion: RTU能够高效实现精确RTRL，有效弥合了流式RL在部分可观测设置下的差距，为自然学习代理的在线学习范式提供了可行方案。

title: Lattice theory and algebraic models for deep convolutional learning based on mathematical morphology
summary:
We develop a rigorous algebraic framework for deep convolutional architectures, CNNs, ResNets, and encoder--decoder networks such as UNet, grounded in lattice theory and mathematical morphology. The central tool is the Matheron--Maragos--Banon--Barrera (MMBB) universal representation theory for translation-invariant operators, which we apply systematically to every layer of a standard deep network.
  The principal finding is that the standard CNN pipeline (linear convolution~$+$ ReLU~$+$ flat max-pooling) is a cross-lattice operator: the convolution is an erosion in the Fourier inf-semilattice while ReLU is a lattice-join closing and max-pooling is a dilation in the pointwise max-plus lattice, and their composition is a morphological opening in neither. A second finding is that the upper adjoint of ReLU in the pointwise lattice is a global (non-local) operator, the identity on globally non-negative functions and $-\infty$ otherwise, so no local morphological erosion can form an adjunction pair with ReLU. These two results together provide the precise algebraic reason why depth in standard CNNs introduces genuine representational power: the composed layer is not idempotent.
  Three layer designs that are genuine idempotent openings are identified and fully characterised: the pure max-plus morphological layer (pointwise lattice), the spectral Wiener layer (Fourier lattice), and the self-dual morphological layer. We establish a complete fixed-point and convergence theory.
  The framework also unifies max-pooling, strided convolution, and the Laplacian pyramid under the Goutsias--Heijmans adjoint pyramid theory, and gives the Activation--Pooling Dilation (APD) factorisation with its correct adjoint.

AI.tldr: 本文基于格论和数学形态学，为深度卷积架构（CNN、ResNet、UNet等）建立了严格的代数框架。核心工具是MMBB通用表示理论，主要发现是标准CNN管道（卷积+ReLU+最大池化）是一个交叉格算子，其复合层非幂等，这解释了深度为何带来真正的表示能力。同时识别并刻画了三种真正的幂等开算子层设计，并建立了完整的固定点与收敛理论。
AI.motivation: 为深度卷积网络建立严格的代数理论基础，从格论和形态学角度理解标准CNN操作的本质，解释深度网络为何需要深度（即非幂等性带来的表示能力），并寻找可替代的幂等层设计。
AI.method: 运用MMBB（Matheron-Maragos-Banon-Barrera）平移不变算子通用表示理论，将格论与数学形态学中的侵蚀、膨胀、开运算、闭运算等概念系统应用于CNN、ResNet、UNet的每一层。分析卷积（傅里叶下半格中的侵蚀）、ReLU（逐点格上的闭连接）、最大池化（逐点最大-加格上的膨胀）的格论属性及其复合效应。利用Goutsias-Heijmans伴随金字塔理论统一池化、步进卷积和拉普拉斯金字塔。
AI.result: (1) 标准CNN管道是交叉格算子，其复合不是形态学开运算，因此非幂等——深度带来真正的表示能力；(2) ReLU在逐点格上的上伴随是一个全局算子（全局非负函数上为恒等，否则为负无穷），因此没有局部形态学侵蚀能与ReLU形成伴随对；(3) 识别三种真正的幂等开算子层：纯最大-加形态学层、谱维纳层、自对偶形态学层，建立完整的固定点与收敛理论；(4) 统一了最大池化、步进卷积和拉普拉斯金字塔，给出Activation-Pooling Dilation（APD）分解及其正确伴随。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为理解深度卷积架构提供了严格的代数语言，揭示了标准CNN非幂等性的根本原因，并给出了可替代的幂等层设计。这为设计更可解释、具有更好收敛保证的深度网络提供了理论指导。

title: GlobalDentBench: A Multinational Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Clinical Reasoning in Dentistry with Expert Calibration
summary: While large language models (LLMs) hold transformative potential for medicine, their reasoning robustness and safety in real-world clinical scenarios remain critically underexplored, particularly in dentistry. Here we introduce GlobalDentBench, the first multinational dental benchmark, featuring a taxonomy that encompasses 14 dental specialties across 88 countries and regions spanning six continents. The benchmark comprises 8,978 expert-validated questions across three formats (multiple-choice, short-answer, and case-based questions) and assesses three progressive reasoning levels: knowledge recall (L1), routine reasoning (L2), and individualized reasoning (L3). To ensure data quality, the automated construction framework was calibrated by six senior dentists, achieving expert agreement rates of 99.98% for multiple-choice and short-answer questions and 96.78% for the more complex case-based questions. Evaluation of 12 frontier LLMs on GlobalDentBench revealed a sharp, stepwise performance degradation with increasing reasoning complexity. Specifically, accuracy plummeted from 81.34% on multiple-choice to 64.53% on short-answer and 22.34% on case-based questions, while declining markedly from 74.01% at L1 to 55.64% at L2 and 35.71% at L3. More critically, risk analysis of real-world dental cases demonstrated an alarming overall unsafe rate of 31.01% in LLM-generated clinical recommendations, with 4.51% posing risks of irreversible patient harm and risks particularly pronounced in specialties such as orthodontics. These findings expose fundamental limitations in the medical reasoning and safety of current LLMs. Consequently, GlobalDentBench provides a scalable foundation for trustworthy clinical AI evaluation, underscoring the urgent need for rigorous validation before the safe deployment of these models in healthcare.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个跨国牙科基准数据集GlobalDentBench，涵盖14个牙科专科、88个国家/地区，包含8,978道专家验证题目及三级推理难度评估。对12个前沿LLM的评测显示，从多选题到病例题准确率从81.34%骤降至22.34%，从L1到L3推理从74.01%降至35.71%；更关键的是，LLM生成的临床建议中31.01%存在安全隐患，4.51%可能导致不可逆的患者伤害。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对LLM在牙科这一医学细分领域中推理鲁棒性和安全性的系统性评估，尤其是在跨国、多专科的真实临床场景下。
AI.method: 构建了包含14个牙科专科、88个国家/地区、8,978道题目的跨国牙科基准，题目分为多选题、简答题和病例题三种格式，对应知识回忆（L1）、常规推理（L2）和个体化推理（L3）三级推理水平。由6名资深牙医验证自动化构建框架，MCQ和简答题专家一致率达99.98%，病例题为96.78%。
AI.result: 12个前沿LLM评估显示：精度从多选题81.34%降至简答题64.53%再到病例题22.34%；L1为74.01%，L2为55.64%，L3为35.71%。临床建议风险分析显示31.01%存在安全隐患，其中4.51%可能导致不可逆患者伤害，正畸等专科风险尤为突出。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在医学推理和安全性方面存在根本性局限，GlobalDentBench为可信临床AI评估提供了可扩展基础，强调在安全部署前需进行严格验证。

title: Hardware-Aware Federated Learning for Speech Emotion Recognition
summary: Federated learning (FL) enables privacy-preserving collaborative training across distributed edge devices, but real deployments involve heterogeneous clients with different processing power, memory capacity, and communication latency, which often increase round duration and system cost. This paper proposes a hardware-aware federated learning framework for emotion recognition on session-partitioned IEMOCAP that integrates hardware profiling, top-K client selection, and adaptive local epochs within a unified training loop. We compare the method against FedAvg, FedProx, and random top-K selection under a non-IID setup and show that, across 50 federated rounds and 5 independent trials, the proposed approach achieves competitive validation accuracy (0.352), reduces total training time by about 36.5% compared to FedAvg, and lowers cumulative communication cost by 40%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种硬件感知的联邦学习框架，用于IEMOCAP情感识别任务，通过硬件性能分析、Top-K客户端选择和自适应本地轮次，在非IID环境下相比FedAvg、FedProx和随机Top-K选择，在50轮联邦训练中实现了竞争性验证准确率(0.352)，同时减少约36.5%的训练时间和40%的累积通信成本。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习在真实部署中面临客户端异构性问题（不同处理能力、内存容量和通信延迟），导致轮次持续时间增加和系统成本上升，现有方法未充分考虑硬件异构性对训练效率的影响。
AI.method: 提出硬件感知联邦学习框架，集成硬件性能分析、Top-K客户端选择和自适应本地轮次，在会话划分的IEMOCAP数据集上进行情感识别任务。
AI.result: 在50轮联邦训练和5次独立试验中，验证准确率达0.352，训练时间较FedAvg减少约36.5%，累积通信成本降低40%。
AI.conclusion: 硬件感知的客户端选择与自适应本地轮次策略能有效缓解联邦学习中的异构性问题，在保持模型性能的同时显著提升训练效率并降低通信开销。

title: AVBench: Human-Aligned and Automated Evaluation Benchmark for Audio-Video Generative Models
summary: Rapid advances in audio-video (AV) generation have enabled high-fidelity synthesis with synchronized sound, particularly for human-related scenarios involving speech and interactions. Yet evaluation for AV generation remains at an early stage, with only a few coarse-grained benchmarks for human-related scenarios and relying on limited preset evaluations with generic multimodal LLMs, leading to inaccurate assessments of model capabilities. To address these issues, we introduce AVBench, a fully automated benchmark tailored for human-centric AV generation. AVBench is built on two key designs for comprehensive and accurate evaluation: (i) Human-centric and fine-grained metrics. AVBench integrates ten evaluation dimensions designed for human-centered real-world scenarios, covering visual quality, audio quality, and multi-level consistency across modalities. These practical metrics capture human-related details that existing benchmarks often overlook. (ii) Specialized evaluators via preference learning. To address the lack of specialized training data, we construct large-scale supervision by transforming real-world videos into diverse training pairs with controlled perturbations. After fine-tuning on this high-quality dataset, the evaluators learn to reliably detect subtle cross-modal inconsistencies. Crucially, instead of producing discrete textual judgment, AVBench derives continuous evaluation scores from the model's prediction confidence on binary decisions. This probabilistic scoring mechanism enables a more reliable assessment than traditional VQA-style evaluation and aligns closely with human judgment. Taken together, AVBench offers automated evaluation for AV generation, demonstrates strong potential for data filtering, and serves as a differentiable reward signal for Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF).

AI.tldr: 本文提出AVBench，一个面向以人为中心的音视频生成的自动化基准测试框架，通过细粒度的人本评估指标和基于偏好学习的专门化评估器，实现对音视频生成质量的全面准确评估。
AI.motivation: 现有音视频生成评估仍处早期阶段，缺乏细粒度的人本场景基准，依赖通用多模态大模型的预设评估，导致对模型能力的评估不准确。
AI.method: AVBench包含两个核心设计：（1）人本细粒度指标：整合十个评估维度覆盖视觉质量、音频质量及多模态一致性；（2）基于偏好学习的专门化评估器：通过真实视频构建带可控扰动的多样化训练对进行微调，从二元决策的预测置信度中推导连续评估分数。
AI.result: 实现了完全自动化的音视频生成评估，能可靠检测细微的跨模态不一致性，评估结果与人工判断高度一致，优于传统VQA式评估。
AI.conclusion: AVBench不仅提供自动化评估，还展现出数据过滤潜力，并可作为RLHF中可微分的奖励信号使用。

title: Reinforcement Learning for Reachability: Guaranteeing Asymptotic Optimality
comment: Main text and appendix of work accepted in ICML 2026
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for reachability specifications is fundamental in sequential decision-making, yet theoretical guarantees remain less explored. A recent work achieves asymptotic convergence to optimal policies. However, this approach provides limited insight into convergence dynamics. In this work, we present an alternative approach that provides deeper theoretical insights into convergence. Our approach builds on PAC learning with assumptions. PAC learning guarantees near-optimal policies with high confidence in finite time but requires knowing internal MDP parameters like minimum transition probability. We argue that while these parameters are unknown in RL, they can be iteratively refined and estimated with increasing accuracy. By iteratively satisfying PAC conditions, we show that exact optimality can be achieved in the limit. Empirical evaluations on standard benchmarks validate our theoretical insights into convergence dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于PAC学习的强化学习方法，通过迭代估计MDP内部参数，在有限时间内以高概率保证接近最优策略，并在极限情况下达到精确最优，为标准基准测试提供了收敛动力学的理论洞见。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习在可达性规范下的收敛性研究多依赖渐近收敛理论，缺乏对收敛动力学的深入理解。本文旨在提供一种替代方法，揭示收敛过程中的理论机制。
AI.method: 基于PAC学习框架，假设MDP内部参数未知但可迭代估计；通过逐步满足PAC条件，在有限时间内保证高置信度的近似最优策略，并在迭代过程中逼近精确最优。
AI.result: 在标准基准测试上的实证评估验证了所提出的收敛动力学理论洞见。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过迭代参数估计与PAC条件满足，实现了从有限时间近似最优到极限精确最优的收敛，为可达性规范下的RL提供了更深层的理论理解。

title: Beyond Inference-Only Deployment: Comparing Weight-Based Consolidation Against Cascading Compaction
summary: Major LLM platforms deploy models in an inference-only configuration: the model serves requests but never updates per-user weights. Users must repeatedly re-teach preferences, corrections, and project context, and context-based workarounds consume context-window space and degrade under cascading compaction. We evaluate an alternative: nightly consolidation of interaction knowledge into model weights via reflection, synthesis, and Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) fine-tuning on a single consumer GPU. Across ten realistic software development conversations (n = 10, 1,146 test questions across three memory types), three cycles of cascading compaction retain 36.8 +/- 3.0% of knowledge (between an 11.8% no-context floor and a 90.1% full-context ceiling), while consolidation retains 80.4 +/- 1.3% -- a 43.6 pp gain (paired t(9) = 14.8, p < 0.001) that more than doubles what compaction preserves, with the largest gains on procedural corrections (36.3% -> 74.6%) and episodic project facts (31.5% -> 78.2%). As a methodological aside, mean per-token validation cross-entropy is negatively correlated with LLM-judged accuracy (r = -0.51) while median per-token validation cross-entropy tracks accuracy almost exactly (r = +0.99): under evaluators that tolerate surface-form variation, the mean is misleading and a heavy-tail-robust statistic is the faithful signal. Persistent personalization requires moving beyond inference-only deployment toward architectures that consolidate knowledge into weights.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过夜间反射、合成和LoRA微调将交互知识整合到模型权重中，替代传统纯推理部署。实验表明，该方法在知识保留上（80.4%）显著优于级联压缩（36.8%），并在程序性修正和情景项目事实方面提升最大。同时发现平均每token交叉熵与准确率呈负相关（r=-0.51），而中位数呈强正相关（r=0.99），说明平均值在容忍表面形式变化的评估器下具有误导性。
AI.motivation: 主流LLM平台采用纯推理部署，每次对话都需重新教授偏好、修正和项目上下文，基于上下文的变通方案会占用上下文窗口空间且性能逐级退化。
AI.method: 夜间通过反射、合成和LoRA微调，在单块消费级GPU上将交互知识整合到模型权重中。
AI.result: 三次级联压缩保留36.8%知识，而整合方法保留80.4%（提升43.6个百分点，p<0.001）。程序性修正从36.3%提升至74.6%，情景项目事实从31.5%提升至78.2%。平均每token验证交叉熵与LLM判断的准确率负相关（r=-0.51），中位数则呈强正相关（r=0.99）。
AI.conclusion: 持久个性化需要超越纯推理部署，转向能将知识整合到权重的架构。

title: Aligning Molecular Graph Explanations with Chemical Identity via InChIfied Invariants
summary: Obtaining consistent explanations for machine learning on molecular graphs requires predictions and attributions to be aligned with chemical identity. However, chemically equivalent drawings of the same molecule can induce different molecular representations, leading to inconsistent predictions and explanations. Here, we introduce InChIfied Invariants, a class of node, edge, and graph features based on the International Chemical Identifier (InChI) and designed to be invariant under transformations that preserve chemical identity. Using one million molecular graphs from PubChem Substances, we show that InChIfied Invariants produce identical representations for chemically equivalent graphs in 99.62% of cases, whereas standard Daylight invariants do so in only 0.35% of cases. Across MoleculeNet tasks, InChIfied Invariants preserve predictive performance while significantly improving prediction consistency across alternative graph depictions of the same molecules. We further perform a quantitative attribution analysis and show that explanations produced with standard molecular featurization methods vary substantially across chemically equivalent graphs, while InChIfied Invariants enforce consistent attributions by construction. We release open-source software implementing InChIfied Invariants, which can be used as a drop-in replacement for standard molecular graph features.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于InChI的图不变特征（InChIfied Invariants），使得化学等价分子在不同图表示下获得一致的预测和归因解释，在99.62%的化学等价图上产生相同表示（标准Daylight不变性仅0.35%），且不降低预测性能。
AI.motivation: 化学等价的分子图可能因不同的绘制方式（如SMILES排列顺序）产生不同的分子表示，导致机器学习模型的预测和归因解释不一致，这一问题亟需解决以增强模型在化学领域的可靠性和可解释性。
AI.method: 基于国际化学标识符（InChI）设计节点、边和图级别的特征，利用InChI规范化的分层编码结构（如原子层、连接层、氢原子层等）构建对化学身份保持不变的图特征表示。
AI.result: 在PubChem Substances的100万分子图上，InChIfied Invariants在99.62%的化学等价图上产生一致表示（Daylight仅0.35%）；在MoleculeNet任务中保持预测性能的同时显著提升预测一致性；归因分析表明该方法能强制产生一致的归因解释。
AI.conclusion: InChIfied Invariants可作为一种即插即用的替代方案，有效解决分子图机器学习中因表示不一致导致的预测和解释不稳定问题。

title: Measuring Reasoning Quality in LLMs: A Multi-Dimensional Behavioral Framework
summary: LLMs have achieved remarkable success in complex reasoning tasks, yet current evaluation approaches predominantly rely on final-answer correctness, offering limited insight into the underlying reasoning processes that produce those answers. To address this gap, this study proposes a unified multi-dimensional framework for measuring reasoning quality in LLMs from a behavioral perspective, operationalizing six theoretically grounded dimensions: Correctness (CQ), Consistency (CS), Robustness (RS), Logical Coherence (LS), Efficiency (ES), and Stability (SS). Extensive experiments on seven LLMs across 975 items from four benchmarks demonstrate that the framework reveals behaviors invisible to accuracy-only metrics. Notably, logical coherence is orthogonal to correctness (r = -0.172, ns), confirming that correct answers can arise from incoherent reasoning, while Claude-Haiku-4.5 achieves the highest multi-dimensional score (Q_bal = 0.778). Furthermore, the framework exposes critical ranking inversions: DeepSeek-V3 ranks second under accuracy-priority but fifth under legal/compliance weighting, a reversal that single-metric evaluation cannot detect. Discriminant validity confirms 11/15 dimension pairs are independent (|r| < 0.50), providing psychometric support for treating each dimension as a distinct signal. The dimensional profiles produced by the framework directly support three classes of deployment decision: identifying models whose reasoning traces would fail accountability audits despite correct final answers (LS--CQ orthogonality); preventing ranking errors caused by accuracy-only benchmarking; and ensuring that no single metric silently substitutes for the six independent signals the framework captures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的多维推理质量评估框架，从行为视角衡量LLM的推理质量，包含正确性、一致性、鲁棒性、逻辑连贯性、效率、稳定性六个维度。实验发现逻辑连贯性与正确性正交（r=-0.172），正确答案可能源于不连贯推理；该框架能暴露仅有准确率指标无法发现的排名反转等关键行为差异。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM评估方法过度依赖最终答案正确性，无法揭示产生这些答案的底层推理过程质量，缺乏对推理行为的多维量化视角。
AI.method: 提出一个六维度推理质量评估框架：正确性、一致性、鲁棒性、逻辑连贯性、效率、稳定性；在4个基准的975个条目上对7个LLM进行实验验证。
AI.result: 逻辑连贯性与正确性正交（r=-0.172，不显著）；Claude-Haiku-4.5获得最高多维得分（Q_bal=0.778）；DeepSeek-V3在准确率优先排序中排名第二，但在法律/合规加权下排名第五，出现排名反转；11/15维度对具有判别效度（|r|<0.50）。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能支持三类部署决策：识别那些答案正确但推理痕迹无法通过审计的模型、防止仅基于准确率的排名错误、确保单一指标不会替代六个独立信号。

title: Bilevel Optimization of Synthetic Trajectories for Multi-Turn LLM Fine-Tuning
summary: While LLMs excel at single-turn generation, they struggle with long-horizon, multi-turn interactions. Offline reinforcement learning (RL) offers a scalable approach, yet its performance hinges on the availability and quality of multi-turn trajectory data. A common remedy is to augment training with synthetic trajectories generated by LLMs or simulators, but synthetic data is highly heterogeneous in quality, and naively treating all trajectories as equally informative can degrade performance. We propose BOOST, a bilevel optimization framework where the inner level trains the LLM on reweighted data and the outer level trains a lightweight reweighting head on held-out real validation tasks, assigning continuous trajectory-level weights without requiring an external judge. To ground this approach, we derive a PAC-Bayesian bound revealing a three-way trade-off: synthetic data increases diversity but risks task-shift, while concentrating weight on high-quality trajectories improves empirical performance at the cost of effective sample size. Empirically, our method consistently outperforms multiple baselines. Analysis reveals it upweights synthetic trajectories that align with the real data distribution and exhibit higher qualitative merit.

AI.tldr: 提出BOOST框架，通过双层优化对合成轨迹数据进行自适应加权，解决离线强化学习中多轮交互数据质量异构的问题，并给出PAC-Bayesian理论边界。
AI.motivation: LLM在长程多轮交互中表现不佳，离线RL依赖高质量多轮轨迹数据，但合成数据质量参差不齐，统一对待所有轨迹会降低性能。
AI.method: 双层优化框架：内层在加权数据上训练LLM，外层在真实验证任务上训练轻量级重加权头，自动为每条轨迹分配连续权重，无需外部评判器。
AI.result: 在多个基准上持续优于基线方法；分析表明该方法倾向于提升与真实数据分布对齐且质量更高的合成轨迹的权重。
AI.conclusion: BOOST通过自适应重加权有效缓解合成数据异构性问题，PAC-Bayesian界揭示了多样性、任务偏移与有效样本量之间的三方权衡。

title: When Mean CE Fails: Median CE Can Better Track Language Model Quality
summary:
Mean cross-entropy is the standard validation metric for language models, but it can fail to track model quality during training. We examine this in two common scenarios. First, in Qwen2.5-1.5B SFT on synthetic fact-learning, we find that mean CE rises substantially after the initial learning phase while held-out fact-recall accuracy remains near its peak. Second, we find that in top-K distillation on TinyStories, decreasing K improves median CE while worsening mean CE; the Top-5 student attains the highest LLM-judge score and crosses below its teacher on median CE, despite having the worst mean CE. In both cases, median CE correlates much more closely with task performance than does mean CE.
  Analyzing how bulk and tail percentile CE move during training reveals that training reshapes the empirical per-token CE distribution. In top-K distillation, smaller K yields a distribution with more mass at both extremes, decreasing the median and increasing the mean. In Qwen SFT, the bulk saturates quickly while the tail extends in the latter half of training. In both, the task-evaluation metric appears more sensitive to the bulk than to the tail.
  Practically, we recommend reporting a small set of percentile CE summaries alongside the mean, and using concordance among them as a tool to keep track of distribution reshaping, as well as a low-cost diagnostic for when mean and median CE disagree on model selection.

AI.tldr: 平均交叉熵（Mean CE）作为语言模型的标准验证指标，在训练过程中可能无法准确反映模型质量。本文通过两个实验（Qwen2.5-1.5B SFT合成事实学习和TinyStories上的Top-K蒸馏）发现，中位数CE比均值CE与任务性能的相关性更紧密。训练会重塑每个token的CE分布，导致均值和中间值产生分歧。建议在报告均值的同时，补充一组百分位CE摘要，并将其作为监测分布重塑和模型选择的低成本诊断工具。
AI.motivation: 现标准验证指标平均交叉熵（Mean CE）在训练过程中可能无法准确反映模型质量，需要探究其失效原因并寻找更可靠的评估指标。
AI.method: 通过两个实验场景进行分析：(1) Qwen2.5-1.5B在合成事实学习上的SFT训练；(2) TinyStories上的Top-K蒸馏实验。分析平均CE、中位数CE与任务性能指标之间的相关性，并研究CE分布的百分位数变化。
AI.result: (1) Qwen SFT中，初始学习阶段后平均CE显著上升，但事实召回准确率保持高位；(2) TinyStories蒸馏中，减小K改善中位数CE但恶化平均CE，Top-5学生获得最高LLM评判分数且中位数CE低于教师，但平均CE最差。两种情况下，中位数CE与任务性能的相关性均远优于平均CE。
AI.conclusion: 建议在报告模型性能时，除了平均CE外还应补充一组百分位CE摘要；利用这些指标之间的一致性作为监测CE分布重塑的工具，以及在平均CE和中位数CE对模型选择产生分歧时的低成本诊断手段。

title: A computational phase transition for learning-to-sample from Ising models
summary: We study \emph{learning-to-sample} -- a basic algorithmic task underlying generative modeling -- for Ising models, a standard testbed for algorithmic ideas in both theoretical computer science and machine learning. Given i.i.d. samples of an unknown target distribution, the goal of learning-to-sample is to learn a computationally efficient generation procedure that produces new samples following approximately the same distribution. We construct a family of Ising models of constantly bounded-width which lie just beyond the spectral threshold $λ_{\max}(J)-λ_{\min}(J)=1$, and show that learning-to-sample for this family is computationally hard under standard cryptographic assumptions, even when the learner is given both polynomially many i.i.d. samples from the model and explicit access to its parameters. Combined with results of [AJKPV24,KLV25] showing tractability of learning-to-sample below the spectral threshold, this establishes a sharp computational phase transition at the spectral threshold. Moreover, combined with prior results on parameter learning for bounded-width Ising models [KM17,WSD19,VML20], this shows that learning-to-sample can be more difficult than parameter learning. Finally, we show that any efficient learner for these hard instances exhibits a natural memorization-hallucination dichotomy: the learner must either output configurations that, after a simple transformation, match the (transformed) training data or place substantial mass on configurations of negligible probability under the target distribution.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Ising模型中的"学习采样"问题，构建了一族位于谱阈值之上的有界宽度Ising模型，证明在标准密码学假设下学习采样是计算困难的，并揭示了学习采样与参数学习之间的难度差异，以及记忆-幻觉二分法现象。
AI.motivation: 研究生成建模中的基本算法任务"学习采样"的计算复杂性，特别是在Ising模型这一理论计算机科学和机器学习的标准测试平台上，探索计算相变边界。
AI.method: 构造一族常数有界宽度的Ising模型，其谱阈值λ_max(J)-λ_min(J)=1恰被突破；基于标准密码学假设证明学习采样的计算困难性；分析学习采样与参数学习的难度对比；揭示记忆-幻觉二分法。
AI.result: 在谱阈值之上学习采样是计算困难的（基于密码学假设）；在谱阈值之下是可处理的，形成尖锐的计算相变；学习采样可以比参数学习更困难；存在记忆-幻觉二分法。
AI.conclusion: 确立了Ising模型学习采样问题在谱阈值处的计算相变，揭示了该任务与参数学习之间的本质难度差异，以及学习器必然面临的记忆-幻觉权衡。

title: Exploration of Perceptual Speech Features for Clinical Decision-Support in Mental Health Care
comment: Accepted to CLPsych 2026, part of ACL 2026
summary: Speech and language technologies offer valuable opportunities for supporting mental health assessment through objective and interpretable cues. We present a systematic feature-based analysis framework leveraging perceptually grounded acoustic and linguistic characteristics, including prosody, vocal quality, semantic coherence, syntactic structure, and sarcasm. Using statistical analysis and interpretable machine learning (XGBoost with SHAP and LIME), we examine associations between speech features and validated symptom measures of depression, anxiety, and ADHD. Evaluated on both controlled benchmark datasets (StressID, DAIC-WOZ, Androids, EATD) and a real-world clinical dataset, the framework reveals stable and consistent relationships between symptom severity and vocal irregularities (e.g., shimmer, jitter), lexical-syntactic patterns, and affective tone. An ablation study conducted across all datasets further identifies the most informative feature groups. This work explores a transparent and clinically interpretable approach to speech-based mental health analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于感知声学和语言学特征的系统分析框架，通过统计分析和可解释机器学习（XGBoost结合SHAP和LIME），在多个数据集上验证了语音特征与抑郁、焦虑、ADHD症状之间的稳定关联，并进行了消融研究以识别最具信息量的特征组。
AI.motivation: 语音和语言技术为心理健康评估提供了客观、可解释的线索，但目前缺乏基于感知特征的系统性分析框架，且需要验证这些特征在不同数据集上的稳定性和临床可解释性。
AI.method: 构建了基于感知的声学和语言学特征分析框架（包括韵律、嗓音质量、语义连贯性、句法结构和讽刺等特征），使用统计分析和可解释机器学习（XGBoost结合SHAP和LIME）分析特征与症状指标的关系，并在控制数据集（StressID, DAIC-WOZ, Androids, EATD）和真实临床数据集上进行评估，同时进行消融研究。
AI.result: 框架揭示了症状严重程度与嗓音不规则性（如shimmer、jitter）、词汇-句法模式和情感语调之间的稳定且一致的关系，消融研究进一步识别了最具信息量的特征组。
AI.conclusion: 该工作探索了一种透明且临床可解释的基于语音的心理健康分析方法，为未来的临床应用提供了基础。

title: A Contractive Feedback Semantics for Reinforcement Learning
summary: Discounted reinforcement learning is usually presented through Bellman equations on closed Markov decision processes. This paper develops a compositional view: a one-step decision process is treated as an open stochastic component, and infinite-horizon policy evaluation is obtained by closing a contractive feedback loop. The resulting semantics assigns typed Bellman transformers to open components, interprets series and parallel wiring as composition and tensoring of transformers, and interprets feedback as an admissible guarded Banach trace realized by a unique fixed point. This perspective yields three theoretical consequences. First, approximate component equivalence is a contextual congruence for admitted well-typed guarded one-hole contexts: local operator error remains controlled after plugging the component into a surrounding circuit that uses the hole once and whose feedback nodes have certified uniform guardedness. Second, exact and approximate state abstractions become commuting or near-commuting coalgebraic diagrams, giving value-preservation and explicit sup-norm distortion bounds. Third, under monotone $ω$-continuous contract-transformer semantics, safety, risk, and resource specifications can be represented as quantale-valued contracts, where local inductive bounds lift through wiring and feedback by least-fixed-point reasoning. Its central claim is not that all RL morphisms form a global traced monoidal category, but that discounted Bellman evaluation admits a contractive feedback semantics on the admissible class of guarded circuits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种组合视角下的折扣强化学习策略评估方法，将马尔可夫决策过程视为开放随机组件，通过收缩反馈环路实现无限时域策略评估，并建立了类型化的贝尔曼变换子语义，证明了近似等价在受保护上下文中的同余性、状态抽象的值保持与误差界，以及基于单调ω-连续合约变换子的安全/风险/资源规格的量化表示。
AI.motivation: 传统折扣强化学习通过封闭马尔可夫决策过程的贝尔曼方程呈现，缺乏组合性视角。本文旨在发展一种组合化方法，将一步决策过程视为开放随机组件，通过反馈闭环实现策略评估，从而为组件等价、状态抽象和合约推理提供更结构化的理论基础。
AI.method: 将一步决策过程建模为开放随机组件，赋予类型化的贝尔曼变换子语义；串行和并行连接分别解释为变换子的复合与张量积；反馈通过可容许的受保护巴拿赫迹（唯一不动点）实现。在此基础上，分析了近似组件等价在受保护上下文中的同余性，将状态抽象建模为交换或近似交换的余代数图，并引入单调ω-连续合约变换子语义处理安全、风险和资源规格。
AI.result: 1) 近似组件等价在合格受保护单孔上下文中是语境同余的，局部算子误差在接入电路后仍受控；2) 精确和近似状态抽象可表示为交换或近似交换的余代数图，给出值保持和显式上确界范数失真界；3) 安全、风险、资源规格可表示为量值值合约，局部归纳界通过最小不动点推理在布线和反馈中提升。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心主张并非所有强化学习态射构成全局的迹幺半范畴，而是折扣贝尔曼评估在受保护电路的可容许类上承认收缩反馈语义。

title: Emotional intelligence in large language models is fragmented across perception, cognition, and interaction
summary: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into emotionally sensitive domains, the structural integrity of their emotional intelligence (EI) becomes a critical frontier for safety and alignment. Current benchmarks often conflate superficial politeness with deep affective reasoning, failing to distinguish between perceptual accuracy and interactive efficacy. Here, we introduce FACET (Functional Affective Competence and Empathy Test), a psychometrically grounded framework comprising 480 expert-crafted items. Unlike previous metrics, FACET is theoretically anchored in the Mayer-Salovey-Caruso four-branch ability model, operationalizing EI through perception, facilitation, understanding, and management of emotions. Through an evaluation of nine frontier models (including GPT-5, Claude-Sonnet-4), we demonstrate that emotional intelligence is not a monolithic capability but is fragmented across cognitive and interactive dimensions. While frontier models demonstrate robust proficiency in objective emotion recognition and social reasoning, this does not consistently translate to interactive success. We categorize these discrepancies into three distinct performance profiles: cognitive-dominant, interactive-dominant, and context-dependent. These typologies indicate that emotional skills do not scale uniformly with general intelligence or model size; rather, they are shaped by specific alignment paradigms. Notably, we identify hidden emotion recognition as a universal performance bottleneck across all architectures. Our results suggest that current RLHF processes may optimize for "stochastic empathy", a statistical mimicry of emotional syntax, at the expense of integrated affective reasoning. These findings challenge the assumption of linear emotional scaling and provide a rigorous roadmap for developing socially aware agents capable of genuine clinical resonance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FACET框架，基于Mayer-Salovey-Caruso四分支能力模型评估大语言模型的情感智能，发现情感智能并非单一能力，而是碎片化分布在认知和交互维度中，且当前RLHF过程可能优化了"随机共情"而非真正的整合情感推理。
AI.motivation: 现有情感智能基准常将表面礼貌与深层情感推理混为一谈，未能区分感知准确性与交互效能，缺乏理论上锚定的系统性评估框架。
AI.method: 构建包含480个专家精心设计项目的FACET框架，以Mayer-Salovey-Caruso四分支能力模型（感知、促进、理解、管理情绪）为理论基础，评估9个前沿大语言模型。
AI.result: 前沿模型在客观情绪识别和社会推理方面表现稳健，但这并不一致地转化为交互成功；识别出三种性能画像：认知主导型、交互主导型和上下文依赖型；隐藏情绪识别是普遍性能瓶颈；情感技能并不随通用智能或模型规模线性扩展。
AI.conclusion: 当前RLHF可能优化了"随机共情"（情感句法的统计模仿）而非整合情感推理，挑战了情感能力线性扩展的假设，为开发具有真正临床共鸣的社会感知型智能体提供了路线图。

title: High-fidelity Modeling of Full-scale Pressurized Water Reactor Flow Fields for Machine Learning Applications
summary: This work presents a high-fidelity computational fluid dynamics (CFD) and data-driven modeling framework for assembly-level flow characterization in a four-loop pressurized water reactor (PWR). A full lower-plenum and core-inlet domain was constructed using publicly available geometry and operating conditions, enabling transient simulations with pump-induced swirl boundary conditions. The results show that cold-leg swirl and lower-plenum transport generate strongly heterogeneous assembly-wise inlet flow distributions, particularly near the lower core region, while axial resistance and mixing progressively homogenize the flow at higher elevations. These physics-informed datasets were subsequently used to evaluate machine learning (ML) applications for partial field reconstruction and short-term autoregressive prediction. A 3D convolutional-based inpainting model successfully recon-structed missing assembly-level mass flow rates from partial observations, with errors concentrated in the highly turbulent base (bottom) layer and diminishing significantly in upper layers. Comparative analysis across multiple ML models demon-strates that spatially aware architectures, particularly ConvLSTM, significantly outperform sequence-based (LSTM) and operator-learning (DeepONet) approaches by effectively capturing coupled spatio-temporal dynamics. The study also high-lights key challenges, including the sensitivity of inlet flow predictions to turbulence and mesh resolution, as well as the absence of full-scale experimental validation data. Despite these limitations, the results remain consistent with expected physical behavior. Overall, this work establishes high-fidelity CFD as a critical foundation for developing data-driven surrogates, sparse sensing strategies, and future multiphysics coupling frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了四环路压水堆下腔室与堆芯入口区域的高保真CFD模型，结合数据驱动方法，系统研究了组件级流量分布特性，并评估了多种机器学习模型（特别是ConvLSTM）在流场重建与短期预测中的表现。
AI.motivation: 为压水堆堆芯入口流动分布提供高保真数值模拟基准，并探索数据驱动代理模型在流场重建与预测中的可行性，以支持稀疏传感与多物理场耦合框架的建立。
AI.method: 基于公开几何与运行条件构建全下腔室-堆芯入口域CFD模型，施加泵致旋流边界条件进行瞬态模拟；利用CFD结果训练3D卷积修复模型（流场重建）及ConvLSTM、LSTM、DeepONet等模型（短期自回归预测），并比较其性能。
AI.result: 冷腿旋流与下腔室输运导致组件入口流量分布强烈不均匀，尤其在堆芯底部区域；轴向阻力与混合在高程上逐渐均匀化流动。3D卷积修复模型在底部高度湍流层误差较大，上层误差显著减小。ConvLSTM在捕捉时空耦合动力学方面显著优于LSTM和DeepONet。预测对湍流模型与网格分辨率敏感，且缺乏全尺度实验验证数据。
AI.conclusion: 高保真CFD是发展数据驱动代理模型、稀疏传感策略及未来多物理场耦合框架的关键基础。尽管存在湍流敏感性等挑战，但结果与预期物理行为一致，验证了方法的有效性。

title: MDIA: A Multi-Agent Diagnostic Intelligence Pipeline on HealthBench Professional
summary: Most reported gains on agentic-LLM clinical benchmarks are often attributed to prompt engineering, yet our results suggest that larger improvements can come from architectural and engine-level design. We present MDIA, a Multi-agent Diagnostic Intelligence Agent implemented as a 7-node specialty-routed clinical reasoning graph, on the full HealthBench Professional benchmark (n = 525), on a non-fine-tuned LLM. MDIA achieves 0.6272 under OpenAI's GPT-5.4-2026-03-05, which is +3.72 pp above the performance of OpenAI's ChatGPT for Clinicians. The experimental work shows that performance lift is attributable to system architecture: specialty routing, multi-turn context preservation, drug-state safety gating, site-filtered search, length-aware synthesis, and engine-level reliability. These findings support the view that agentic clinical benchmark performance is shaped both by the underlying foundation model and the orchestration architecture. Nevertheless, we also noticed notable differences when using other models as a grader; in particular, when using Gemini 2.5 Pro, MDIA scored 0.6585, which suggests that the choice of grader is a source of variability. Robust evaluation of LLMs would therefore require assessment across several independent grader models.

AI.tldr: MDIA是一个7节点专业路由临床推理图的多智能体诊断系统，在未微调LLM上于HealthBench基准达到0.6272（GPT-5.4），比ChatGPT for Clinicians高3.72个百分点，性能提升归因于系统架构设计而非提示工程。
AI.motivation: 现有文献常将LLM临床基准的提升归因于提示工程，但作者认为架构与引擎层面的设计可能带来更大改进，旨在验证系统架构设计对智能体临床基准性能的贡献。
AI.method: 提出MDIA，一个7节点专业路由临床推理图的多智能体诊断架构，包含专业路由、多轮上下文保持、药物状态安全门控、站点过滤搜索、长度感知合成及引擎级可靠性等组件，在未微调LLM上进行评估。
AI.result: 在HealthBench Professional基准（n=525）上，MDIA在GPT-5.4-2026-03-05下达到0.6272，比OpenAI的ChatGPT for Clinicians高3.72个百分点；使用Gemini 2.5 Pro作为评分模型时得分0.6585，表明评分模型选择是性能变异来源。
AI.conclusion: 智能体临床基准性能既受基础模型影响，也受编排架构影响；评估LLM时需使用多个独立评分模型以避免单一评分模型带来的变异性。

title: Muon in Vision Transformers: Optimizer-Recipe Interactions and Gradient Spectra
summary: Muon is a recently developed matrix-aware optimizer that has shown strong results in transformer training, but its behavior in vision transformers (ViTs) is not yet well understood. We study Muon for ViT training, largely on ImageNet-100 and Pl@ntNet-300K, comparing against AdamW under standard vision recipes involving mixup, cutmix, smoothing, and random augmentation and erasing. Muon consistently outperforms AdamW, with especially large gains on long-tailed Pl@ntNet macro top-1. These gains are also recipe-dependent, where Muon benefits much more than AdamW from advanced and significant data augmentation techniques. To understand this interaction, we analyze the singular-value structure of matrix gradients throughout the ViT. Within Muon training runs, removing heavy data augmentation induces a late-training spectral concentration and mode collapse in gradient matrices, primarily in deep MLP-down blocks. Under a fixed "full" augmentation recipe, the clearest Muon-AdamW contrast appears instead in QKV gradients, where AdamW gradient energy remains concentrated in a much narrower basis while Muon spreads energy across substantially more singular modes. Muon in ViTs is therefore best understood as an optimizer-recipe interaction. Under a fixed recipe, Muon differs from AdamW most clearly in attention projections, where its gradients consist of a broader spectral basis. Within Muon, a full training recipe is important for preventing late spectral concentration and mode collapse in deep feedforward blocks. We further demonstrate efficacy in training ViTs on image segmentation and masked autoencoder models, where Muon outperforms AdamW in all settings considered.

AI.tldr: Muon优化器在视觉Transformer（ViT）训练中优于AdamW，尤其在长尾分布数据集上提升显著；其优势依赖于数据增强策略，全增强配方可防止深层MLP块梯度谱的后期集中与模式坍缩，而QKV梯度的谱宽化是Muon与AdamW的核心差异。
AI.motivation: Muon在Transformer训练中表现优异，但在ViT中的行为尚未被充分理解，亟需系统性研究其与AdamW的对比及与数据增强的交互机制。
AI.method: 在ImageNet-100和Pl@ntNet-300K上，采用mixup、cutmix、平滑、随机增强与擦除等标准视觉策略，对比Muon与AdamW；通过分析ViT各模块的梯度奇异值结构，揭示Muon与数据增强的依赖关系及谱特性差异。
AI.result: Muon一致优于AdamW，在长尾Pl@ntNet的macro top-1上增益最大；Muon从高级数据增强中获益更多；去除强增强导致Muon训练后期深层MLP-down块出现梯度谱集中与模式坍缩；固定全增强下，Muon的QKV梯度谱更宽，而AdamW能量集中在更窄基上。
AI.conclusion: Muon在ViT中的表现是优化器与数据增强配方的联合效应；固定配方下，Muon在注意力投影中通过更宽的梯度谱基区别于AdamW；全增强配方对防止深层前馈块谱集中至关重要；在图像分割与MAE中Muon同样优于AdamW。

title: Fundamental Limitation in Explaining AI
summary: While large-scale models such as LLMs and diffusion models have achieved practical success, public institutions have emphasized the importance of explainability in AI. Existing methods for explaining AI, however, are not designed to provide completely faithful explanations of the behavior of large-scale AI systems. Although a completely faithful and interpretable explanation of the behavior of an AI system might be useful for AI governance, it has not been known whether providing such an explanation is theoretically possible. In this paper, we mathematically prove a fundamental quadrilemma in explaining AI, stating that AI and its explanation cannot satisfy the following four conditions simultaneously: 1) the complexity of the operation environment, 2) the goodness of the AI's performance, 3) the interpretability of the AI's explanation, and 4) the complete faithfulness of the AI's explanation. This quadrilemma suggests that, in most applications where we cannot change the environment or sacrifice good AI performance and an interpretable explanation, we should give up complete faithfulness of explanations and should instead aim to explain only the parts that are important for applications. As a consequence, the quadrilemma implies that AI governance should be designed on the premise that the faithfulness of AI explanations is always incomplete.

AI.tldr: 本文数学证明了AI解释存在一个基本四难困境：AI系统及其解释无法同时满足环境复杂性、AI性能优越性、解释可理解性和解释完全忠实性四个条件，意味着在大多数应用中应放弃完全忠实性，AI治理应基于解释忠实性总是不完整的这一前提。
AI.motivation: 现有AI解释方法无法提供对大规模AI系统行为完全忠实的解释，且理论上是否可能提供这种解释尚不清楚，这对AI治理具有重要意义。
AI.method: 通过数学证明的方式，推导出AI解释存在一个四难困境（quadrilemma），论证了四个条件无法同时满足。
AI.result: 证明了AI及其解释无法同时满足以下四个条件：1）运行环境的复杂性，2）AI性能的优越性，3）AI解释的可理解性，4）AI解释的完全忠实性。
AI.conclusion: 在大多数应用中应放弃解释的完全忠实性，转而解释对应用重要的部分；AI治理应基于解释忠实性总是不完整的这一前提来设计。

title: Hermite-NGP: Gradient-Augmented Hash Encoding for Learning PDEs
summary: We propose Hermite-NGP, a gradient-augmented multi-resolution hash encoding designed to enable fast and accurate computation of spatial derivatives for neural PDE solvers. Unlike existing NGP-based approaches that rely on automatic differentiation or finite differences and suffer from instability or high cost, Hermite-NGP explicitly stores function values and mixed partial derivatives at hash grid vertices, allowing fully analytic evaluation of gradients, Jacobians, and Hessians via Hermite interpolation. This design preserves the efficiency and spatial adaptivity of NGP while supporting analytic differential operators up to second order. We further introduce a multi-resolution curriculum training strategy analogous to multigrid V-cycles to enable coarse-to-fine optimization. Across a range of 2D and 3D PDE benchmarks, Hermite-NGP achieves up to approximately 20 times lower error than prior neural PDE methods, and reduces wall-clock convergence time by 2 to 10 times compared to other solvers, with per-epoch training times as low as 3.5 ms for models with up to 17M parameters.

AI.tldr: Hermite-NGP是一种梯度增强的多分辨率哈希编码方法，通过在哈希网格顶点显式存储函数值和混合偏导数，利用Hermite插值实现梯度、雅可比矩阵和海森矩阵的完全解析计算，从而为神经PDE求解器提供快速准确的二阶空间导数计算，在2D/3D基准测试中误差降低约20倍，收敛速度提升2-10倍。
AI.motivation: 现有基于NGP的方法依赖自动微分或有限差分计算空间导数，存在不稳定或计算成本高的问题，亟需一种既能保持NGP的效率和空间自适应性，又能稳定高效计算高阶空间导数的神经PDE求解方法。
AI.method: 提出Hermite-NGP，在哈希网格顶点显式存储函数值和混合偏导数，通过Hermite插值实现梯度、雅可比矩阵和海森矩阵的完全解析计算；引入类似多重网格V-cycle的多分辨率课程训练策略，实现从粗到细的优化。
AI.result: 在2D和3D PDE基准测试中，相比现有神经PDE方法误差降低约20倍；相比其他求解器，壁钟收敛时间减少2-10倍；参数量高达1700万的模型每轮训练时间低至3.5毫秒。
AI.conclusion: Hermite-NGP在保持多分辨率哈希编码效率和空间自适应性的同时，支持最高二阶的解析微分算子，为神经PDE求解提供了兼顾精度、速度和稳定性的有效方案。

title: Hylos: Operability Contracts for Model-Native Spatial Intelligence
comment: 27 pages, 7 figures. Systems/position preprint with focused artifact study
summary:
Foundation models can increasingly describe, reconstruct, and generate 3D objects, assemblies, scenes, and environments, but visually plausible spatial output is not yet operable 3D. A generated object or environment becomes useful to an agent only when the system can identify its entities, frames, surfaces, constraints, provenance, admissible actions, expected effects, and validation failures.
  This paper introduces Hylos, a systems architecture for contract-bounded spatial intelligence. Hylos maintains scene-scale operability state over objects, assemblies, assets, surface anchors, assertions, action candidates, solver jobs, shared actuator invocations, capability gaps, and effect diffs. Durable spatial changes are routed through a SpatialTransaction: a commit boundary that resolves references, checks admissibility, protects invariants, projects effects, and returns commit, review, rollback, deferral, or capability-gap outcomes.
  The paper is framed as a systems/position preprint with a focused artifact study rather than a broad benchmark. The study examines causal repair: a visible misalignment appears on a dependent component, while the supported repair lies upstream in the placement structure that controls it. The successful interaction traces the symptom through scene dependencies, selects a supported upstream interaction, and applies a validated change instead of directly editing visible geometry.
  The broader claim is that spatial AI should be evaluated not only by visual quality, but by whether generated or edited 3D can become reliable substrate for CAD, robotics, simulation, inspection, manufacturing, and interactive world authoring.

AI.tldr: Hylos 是一个面向合约约束空间智能的系统架构，通过 SpatialTransaction 机制维护场景级可操作状态，支持3D内容的因果修复与可验证编辑，旨在使生成的三维内容成为CAD、机器人、仿真等领域可靠的基础设施。
AI.motivation: 当前基础模型能够生成视觉上合理的3D对象、装配体、场景和环境，但这些输出缺乏可操作性，无法被智能体识别实体、框架、表面、约束、来源、允许的操作、预期效果及验证失败原因，因此需要一种系统架构来建立空间智能的可信合约机制。
AI.method: 提出 Hylos 系统架构，核心包括：1) 场景级可操作状态管理（对象、装配体、锚点、断言、动作候选、求解器任务、执行器调用、能力缺口、效果差异）；2) SpatialTransaction 提交边界机制，负责解析引用、检查可接受性、保护不变量、投影效果并返回提交/审查/回滚/延迟/能力缺口等结果；3) 通过因果修复流程（追踪症状场景依赖→选择上游支持交互→应用已验证变更）替代直接编辑可见几何。
AI.result: 通过聚焦因果修复的工件研究验证了系统有效性：当依赖组件出现可见错位时，系统成功追踪症状通过场景依赖关系，选择上游支持的交互，并应用已验证的变更而非直接编辑可见几何，实现了有效的因果修复。
AI.conclusion: 空间AI的评估不应仅基于视觉质量，而应衡量生成或编辑的3D内容能否成为CAD、机器人、仿真、检测、制造和交互式世界创作的可靠基板，Hylos 为此提供了可行的系统架构路径。

title: Complement Submodular Information Measures for Balanced and Robust Data Selection
summary:
Submodular optimization has become a fundamental paradigm for data selection, retrieval, summarization, and representation learning due to its ability to model coverage, diversity, and representativeness. However, classical submodular objectives optimize only the selected subset and do not explicitly preserve structural information between the selected subset and the remaining data. In many modern machine learning applications, including train/validation/test splitting, benchmark construction, and robust subset selection, the quality of a selection depends critically on preserving balanced structure across both the selected subset and its complement.
  In this work, we introduce Complement Submodular Information (CSI), a new class of complement-aware submodular objectives that quantify shared structural information between a subset and its complement. Our framework induces complement-aware variants of several classical submodular functions including Facility Location, Graph Cut, LogDet, Saturated Coverage, Set Cover, Probabilistic Set Cover, and Feature Based Functions. We analyze the theoretical properties of CSI objectives and show that they exhibit approximate monotonicity under bounded curvature conditions, leading to near-$(1-1/e)$ greedy approximation guarantees.
  Empirically, CSI objectives consistently outperform standard submodular objectives on robust hidden-slice-aware subset selection. In particular, CSI objectives significantly improve preservation of coherent rare/tail semantic structure while simultaneously suppressing noisy and isolated outliers, leading to substantially improved downstream predictive performance. Synthetic experiments further illustrate how different CSI instantiations capture complementary notions of representativeness, diversity, connectivity, and balanced neighborhood preservation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一类新的互补感知子模目标函数（CSI），用于量化子集与其补集之间的共享结构信息，在保留稀有语义结构和抑制噪声方面优于经典子模目标，并具有近似(1-1/e)的贪心逼近保证。
AI.motivation: 经典子模优化只优化所选子集，未能显式保留所选子集与剩余数据之间的结构信息，而在许多现代机器学习应用（如训练/验证/测试拆分、基准构建、鲁棒子集选择）中，选择的质量关键取决于在所选子集及其补集之间保持平衡的结构。
AI.method: 引入互补感知子模信息（CSI）这一新类别的目标函数，通过对经典子模函数（Facility Location、Graph Cut、LogDet、Saturated Coverage、Set Cover、Probabilistic Set Cover、Feature Based Functions）进行互补感知变体扩展来实现。理论分析证明了在有界曲率条件下的近似单调性及近(1-1/e)贪心逼近保证。
AI.result: CSI目标在鲁棒的隐藏切片感知子集选择中持续优于标准子模目标，显著改善了对稀有/尾部语义结构的保留，同时抑制噪声和孤立离群点，提升了下游预测性能。合成实验展示了不同CSI实例在代表性、多样性、连通性和平衡邻域保持方面的互补能力。
AI.conclusion: CSI框架有效弥补了经典子模优化忽视补集结构信息的缺陷，在保持平衡结构方面具有理论和实践优势。

title: Automated Detection and Classification of Delusion-related Content in Naturalistic Audio Diaries Using Multi-Agent Language Models
summary: Speech monologues recorded in naturalistic settings provide opportunities to characterize mental illness phenomenology and detect symptom exacerbation. Large language models (LLMs) offer new possibilities for automating this process, as they require annotated data primarily for evaluation rather than training. In this paper, we present a novel automated, multi-agent LLM pipeline for the fine-grained, multi-label extraction of language suggestive of delusional beliefs, associated affective responses, and behavioral responses from transcripts of naturalistic audio diaries collected from people with moderate persecutory ideation. Evaluating an ensemble of three foundation models, we demonstrate that detailed diagnostic prompt instructions successfully reduce false positives for delusional theme classification, but also constrain the interpretation of affective or behavioral responses. Furthermore, comparing multi-agent adjudication frameworks shows that complex conversational debate between agents diminishes accuracy on clinically ambiguous text by inducing premature consensus. Instead, majority voting establishes robust performance (Micro F1 of 0.872 and 0.779 for delusion detection and classification respectively). This work provides a validated and scalable pipeline for the automated detection and characterization of content suggesting delusional beliefs in naturalistic speech.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多智能体大语言模型（LLM）的自动化流水线，用于从自然录音日记中提取暗示妄想信念、相关情感和行为反应的细粒度多标签信息。研究发现详细的诊断提示可减少妄想主题分类的假阳性，但会限制情感/行为解释；多数投票法优于复杂辩论机制，在妄想检测和分类上分别达到0.872和0.779的Micro F1分数。
AI.motivation: 自然场景下的语音独白为表征精神疾病现象学和检测症状恶化提供了机会，但传统方法需要大量标注数据进行训练。LLM主要依赖标注数据进行评估而非训练，为自动化这一过程提供了新可能。
AI.method: 提出多智能体LLM流水线，集成三种基础模型，采用详细的诊断提示指令进行细粒度多标签提取，并比较了多智能体裁决框架（复杂对话辩论与多数投票）的性能。
AI.result: 详细诊断提示有效减少了妄想主题分类的假阳性，但约束了情感/行为反应的解读；智能体间的复杂辩论在临床模糊文本上因过早共识而降低准确性；多数投票法表现稳健，妄想检测Micro F1为0.872，分类Micro F1为0.779。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个经过验证且可扩展的自动化流水线，用于从自然语音中检测和表征暗示妄想信念的内容。

title: The Perception-Physics Paradox: Probing Scientific Alignment with TC-Bench
summary: While Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) excel at predictive tasks on satellite imagery, their performance can arise from visual correlations rather than underlying structural invariants, making even perception-based out-of-distribution accuracy a poor proxy for scientific utility. As a result, models may look correct without reasoning correctly, a discrepancy we term the Perception-Physics Paradox. To address this gap, we introduce scientific alignment as an implicit objective for representation learning in scientific domains. We study a principled, testable aspect of scientific alignment through structural isomorphism, which requires latent representations to uniquely identify physical systems up to a linear reparameterization. This perspective induces a hierarchy of necessary conditions and yields a systematic probing protocol for physical and causal interpretability. To operationalize this framework, we release TC-Bench, a global, reproducible benchmark dataset with an automated construction pipeline for tropical cyclone research, and show that current VFMs rely on visual shortcuts that collapse in intense regimes, indicating that scientific alignment does not arise as a natural byproduct of scaling alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"感知-物理悖论"概念，指出视觉基础模型(VFMs)在卫星图像上的表现可能依赖视觉相关性而非物理不变性，并引入科学对齐作为表征学习的隐式目标。通过结构同构性建立可检验的必要条件层次，发布TC-Bench数据集，证明当前VFMs依赖视觉捷径，在强极端情况下失效。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉基础模型在卫星图像预测任务中表现优异，但这种性能可能源于视觉相关性而非底层结构不变性，导致模型"看似正确但推理错误"。作者希望弥合感知准确性与科学效用之间的差距。
AI.method: 提出科学对齐作为科学领域表征学习的隐式目标，通过结构同构性要求潜在表示能够唯一识别物理系统（至多相差线性重参数化），由此导出一系列必要条件的层级体系，并构建系统性的物理与因果可解释性探测协议。同时发布TC-Bench热带气旋基准数据集及自动化构建流程。
AI.result: 当前视觉基础模型依赖视觉捷径，在强极端（如高烈度热带气旋）场景下性能崩溃，表明科学对齐不会仅通过规模扩展自然产生。
AI.conclusion: 视觉基础模型的规模扩展不足以实现科学对齐，需要将物理结构不变性显式纳入表征学习目标，TC-Bench可为此类研究提供标准化评估基准。

title: Proper Scoring Rules for Agentic Uncertainty Quantification
summary: Language-model agents increasingly emit uncertainty signals throughout a trajectory, but existing agentic UQ evaluations often conflate ranking usefulness with probabilistic truthfulness. AUROC, AUPRC, risk-coverage, Trajectory ECE, and scalarized trajectory scores evaluate discrimination, binwise calibration, or collapsed summaries, but do not strictly elicit the full prefix-conditioned success-probability trace $q_t = P^π(Y=1 | H_t)$. Building on prequential proper scoring, we introduce the Trajectory Proper Score (TPS), a predictor-agnostic family of strictly proper trajectory-level scoring rules for any per-step uncertainty signal calibrated into a probability of eventual success. We prove that TPS strictly elicits the success-probability process under complete observation, within the chosen score family and weight schedule. We extend the construction to administratively censored trajectories by projecting the complete-data score onto the observable stopped prefix, yielding an exact $q_Z$-weighted reduced score and a tractable approximation when $q_Z$ is unestimated. We further show that common trajectory evaluators target weaker objects than the full prefix-conditioned probability process: Trajectory ECE is resolution-blind, while scalarized Trajectory Brier elicits only the collapsed scalar, not the full trace. Experiments on StrategyQA, Tau2-Bench, HotpotQA, and WebShop show that these theoretical distinctions are operationally visible: probability recalibration can substantially change TPS while leaving rank metrics nearly unchanged, and the tractable censored approximation can change the verdict relative to complete-only evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出轨迹恰当分数（TPS），一种严格恰当的轨迹级评分框架，用于评估语言模型代理在轨迹中每步不确定性信号校准为最终成功概率的完整条件概率过程，并证明现有评估指标（如Trajectory ECE、标量化Brier分数）仅捕捉更弱的目标，实验验证了理论差异在实际中的可观测性。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型代理的不确定性量化（UQ）评估常将排序有用性与概率真实性混为一谈，常用指标（AUROC、AUPRC、风险覆盖曲线、Trajectory ECE、标量化轨迹分数）评估的是判别能力、分箱校准或压缩汇总，但未能严格地引出完整的前缀条件成功概率轨迹 $q_t = P^π(Y=1 | H_t)$。
AI.method: 基于前序恰当评分（prequential proper scoring），提出轨迹恰当分数（TPS），一种预测器无关的家族式严格恰当轨迹级评分规则；将构造扩展到管理性删失轨迹，通过将完整数据投影到可观测的停止前缀上，得到精确的$q_Z$加权简化分数及其可计算近似；并从理论上证明Trajectory ECE缺乏分辨率、标量化Trajectory Brier仅引出压缩标量而非完整轨迹。
AI.result: 在StrategyQA、Tau2-Bench、HotpotQA、WebShop上的实验表明：概率再校准可显著改变TPS而排名指标几乎不变；可计算的删失近似相对于仅完整轨迹评估可改变结论。
AI.conclusion: TPS弥补了现有代理UQ评估中缺乏严格概率轨迹级评分的空白，证明了理论差异在实际中是可操作的且影响评估结论。

title: CONF-KV: Confidence-Aware KV Cache Eviction with Mixed-Precision Storage for Long-Horizon LLM
summary: Long-horizon LLM inference turns the key--value (KV) cache into the dominant GPU memory consumer and makes per-token attention increasingly expensive. Many common eviction policies use static recency windows or historical attention, leaving unused a signal computed on every decoding step: the model's current uncertainty. We introduce CONF-KV, a KV-cache manager that converts the next-token distribution into a scalar confidence score and uses it to choose the per-step cache budget, retaining more context when the model is uncertain and pruning aggressively when it is confident. Within each budget, tokens are ranked by a composite of accumulated attention mass and recency, while a protected recent window preserves local coherence. We combine the policy with blockwise online-softmax attention, mixed FP16/INT8 storage, and a pyramidal per-layer budget variant. Across four model families and generated lengths up to 4K, CONF-KV stays near the footprint of a fixed 512-token sliding window while remaining within 1.5--2.1 perplexity points of full KV. On Needle-in-a-Haystack up to 32K tokens, CONF-KV reaches 91.4% retrieval accuracy versus 53.8% for sliding windows and 80.6% for H2O; on 75 VisualWebArena tasks it retains 95.3% of full-KV success at 2.8 times lower peak memory.

AI.tldr: CONF-KV是一种利用模型逐token置信度动态调整KV缓存预算的缓存管理策略，在保持低内存占用的同时，显著优于固定滑动窗口和H2O等基线方法，在长序列推理和视觉任务中表现出色。
AI.motivation: 长序列LLM推理中，KV缓存成为GPU内存的主要消耗者，且逐token注意力计算成本高昂。现有驱逐策略（如固定滑动窗口、基于历史注意力的方法）忽略了解码过程中可获取的模型当前不确定性信号，导致缓存管理不够高效。
AI.method: 将next-token分布转换为标量置信度分数，据此动态调整每步的缓存预算：模型不确定时保留更多上下文，自信时激进剪枝。在预算内，按累积注意力质量和时效性综合排序选择token，并保留受保护的最新窗口以保证局部连贯性。结合分块在线softmax注意力、混合FP16/INT8存储和逐层金字塔预算变体。
AI.result: 在四种模型家族和长达4K的生成序列中，CONF-KV的内存占用接近固定512滑动窗口，困惑度仅比全KV高1.5-2.1点。在32K的Needle-in-a-Haystack任务中检索准确率91.4%（滑动窗口53.8%，H2O 80.6%）；在75个VisualWebArena任务中保持95.3%的全KV成功率，峰值内存降低2.8倍。
AI.conclusion: CONF-KV通过利用模型置信度信号动态管理KV缓存，有效平衡了内存效率与推理质量，在长序列检索和视觉-语言任务上均优于现有方法。

title: Uncertainty Decomposition via Cyclical SG-MCMC and Soft-label Learning for Subjective NLP
summary: Annotator disagreement in emotion classification reflects ambiguity intrinsic to emotion concepts and is essential for predictor-quality assessment in subjective NLP. Yet no prior work integrates soft-label learning with Bayesian deep learning to evaluate uncertainty along axes including annotator-distribution fidelity. We train a linear head on a frozen RoBERTa via cyclical stochastic gradient Markov chain Monte Carlo (cSG-MCMC), targeting the empirical annotator distribution with a soft-label objective under a five-axis evaluation. On the 28-emotion GoEmotions benchmark, the proposed method outperforms Monte Carlo Dropout and Deep Ensemble simultaneously on three axes -- Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD) to the annotator distribution, Spearman correlation between per-emotion aleatoric uncertainty and disagreement, and selective-prediction Area Under the Risk-Coverage Curve (AURC) and Area Under the ROC Curve (AUROC) -- showing independent axes are jointly attainable from one posterior. Post-hoc temperature scaling exhibits a bidirectional effect, establishing hard-label calibration and annotator-JSD as independent dimensions and motivating joint reporting as an honest protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将软标签学习与贝叶斯深度学习结合，使用cSG-MCMC训练线性头在冻结RoBERTa上，在GoEmotions基准上沿五轴评估，在JSD、Spearman相关性和选择性预测三个轴上同时优于MC Dropout和Deep Ensemble，并发现后验温度缩放对硬标签校准和标注者JSD有双向影响。
AI.motivation: 情感分类中的标注者分歧反映了情感概念的固有模糊性，对于主观NLP中的预测质量评估至关重要，但尚无工作将软标签学习与贝叶斯深度学习结合来沿多个轴（包括标注者分布保真度）评估不确定性。
AI.method: 在冻结的RoBERTa上训练线性头，使用循环随机梯度马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（cSG-MCMC）方法，以软标签目标优化经验标注者分布，并在五轴评估框架下进行评价。
AI.result: 在28情感GoEmotions基准上，该方法在三个轴上同时优于MC Dropout和Deep Ensemble：Jensen-Shannon散度（JSD）、每个情感偶然不确定性（aleatoric uncertainty）与不一致性的Spearman相关性、选择性预测的AURC和AUROC。
AI.conclusion: 独立评估轴可以从单一后验中联合获得；后验温度缩放对硬标签校准和标注者JSD具有双向影响，表明二者是独立维度，应联合报告作为诚实协议。

title: Active Learning for Stochastic Contextual Linear Bandits
summary: A key goal in stochastic contextual linear bandits is to efficiently learn a near-optimal policy. Prior algorithms for this problem learn a policy by strategically sampling actions but naively (passively) sampling contexts from the underlying context distribution. However, in many practical scenarios -- including online content recommendation, survey research, and clinical trials -- practitioners can actively sample or recruit contexts based on prior knowledge of the context distribution. Despite this potential for active learning, the role of strategic context sampling in stochastic contextual linear bandits is underexplored. We propose an algorithm that learns a near-optimal policy by strategically sampling rewards of context-action pairs. We prove instance-dependent theoretical guarantees demonstrating that our active context sampling strategy can improve over the minimax rate by up to a factor of $\sqrt{d}$, where $d$ is the linear dimension. We show empirically that our algorithm reduces the number of samples needed to learn a near-optimal policy, in tasks such as warfarin dose prediction and joke recommendation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对随机上下文线性 bandit 问题，提出了一种主动上下文采样算法，通过策略性地采样上下文-动作对的奖励来学习近优策略。理论上证明了主动采样策略可将 minimax 率提升最多 √d 倍（d 为线性维度），并在华法林剂量预测和笑话推荐等任务上验证了样本效率的提升。
AI.motivation: 现有随机上下文线性 bandit 算法在采样动作时具有策略性，但对上下文的采样却是被动（naive）的。然而在诸多实际场景（如在线内容推荐、调查研究、临床试验）中，从业者可以基于上下文分布的先验知识主动采样或招募上下文。这种主动学习潜力尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出一种主动上下文采样算法，策略性地采样上下文-动作对的奖励。利用上下文分布的先验知识，设计实例相关的采样策略，以更高效地学习近优策略。
AI.result: 理论上证明了主动上下文采样策略可将 minimax 率提升最多 √d 倍（d 为线性维度）。在华法林剂量预测和笑话推荐任务上，实验结果显示该算法显著减少了学习近优策略所需的样本数量。
AI.conclusion: 主动上下文采样在随机上下文线性 bandit 中能带来实质性的样本效率提升，为实际应用中的主动学习提供了理论依据和有效算法。

title: PRIMA: Operational Patterns for Resilient Multi-Agent Research with Verifiable Identity and Convergent Feedback
comment: 11 pages. Single-author preprint. Supplementary case-study report (Graph Isomorphism algorithm proposal with three theorems, five conjectures, complete complexity analysis, and hard-instance evaluation) available at https://spockstein.github.io/prima/case-study-graph-isomorphism.html
summary: Operating LLMs as coordinated multi-agent research systems over multi-hour runs surfaces failure modes that single-shot evaluation cannot: upstream providers throttle without warning, sub-agents drift the task to fit accessible tools, narrate machinery instead of using it, open revision iterations with self-apology, or treat upstream context as executable directives. We present PRIMA, whose primary contributions are three operational patterns for surviving these failure modes: (1) a resilience-and-recovery layer that detects upstream rate-limit signals, persists a typed pause record to disk, and resumes long-running runs without re-executing converged work even across process restarts; (2) a sub-agent operating discipline encoding task-fidelity, tool-use, revision, and inter-step context-boundary norms as a structural prompt layer; (3) a multi-phase application pattern for structured engineering deliverables pairing orthogonal draft steps with an explicit cross-document harmonization pass before final synthesis. These sit atop a foundational protocol: a research-program specification language with explicit convergence criteria, a dual-metric scoring engine (LLM-judged rubric plus sandboxed code), an outer meta-optimization loop, event-driven persistence, hook-based middleware, context compaction, and a multi-provider LLM abstraction. Agent identities derive from prime powers, giving collision-free identifiers and trivially-verifiable cluster membership without a central registry. Theoretical guarantees include $O(k)$ verification, $O(V+E)$ DAG validation, and identity collision freedom by the Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic. A Graph Isomorphism case study grounds the architectural claims in a generated artifact: a six-step protocol that produced a research paper proposing a new canonical-form algorithm with three theorems and five conjectures.

AI.tldr: PRIMA 提出了一种应对长时间多智能体研究系统故障模式的运行框架，包含弹性恢复层、子代理操作规范和多阶段应用模式，并通过图同构案例验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有单次评估无法捕捉多智能体系统在长时间运行中出现的故障模式，如上流提供商的限流、子代理任务漂移、工具误用、自道歉式修订等。
AI.method: 提出 PRIMA 框架，核心贡献包括：(1) 弹性恢复层，检测上流限流信号并持久化恢复点；(2) 子代理操作规范，通过结构提示层编码任务保真度、工具使用等规范；(3) 多阶段应用模式，隔离正交草稿步骤与跨文档协调过程。底层协议包括研究程序规范语言、双指标评分引擎、元优化循环、事件驱动持久化等。
AI.result: 通过图同构案例研究生成了一个六步协议，产出一篇提出新规范形式算法的研究论文，包含三个定理和五个猜想。理论保证方面实现了 O(k) 验证、O(V+E) DAG 验证以及基于算术基本定理的标识无冲突。
AI.conclusion: PRIMA 通过三层操作模式和底层协议有效解决了多智能体长时间运行中的关键故障模式，为构建可靠的多智能体研究系统提供了架构性方案。

title: Disentangled Double Machine Learning for Accurate Causal Effect Estimation
summary: Confounding bias is a key challenge in causal effect estimation from observational data. Double Machine Learning (DML) addresses this issue by estimating treatment and outcome nuisance functions, constructing treatment and outcome residuals, and estimating causal effects from the residuals. However, DML often produces biased and unstable estimates in highdimensional or finite-sample scenarios. One reason is that DML estimates nuisance functions using all covariates without disentangling distinct latent factors, resulting in unreliable nuisance function estimation. Another is that imprecise nuisance estimation further introduces residual dependence between the treatment residual and the remaining outcome error, undermining the accuracy of causal effect estimates. To address these issues, in this paper, we propose Disentangled Double Machine Learning (DDML), a novel algorithm that integrates two key strategies. First, a causal role disentanglement strategy decomposes covariates into confounders, treatment-specific factors, and outcomespecific factors for enabling reliable nuisance function estimation. And second, a residual dependence orthogonalization strategy mitigates residual dependence caused by nuisance estimation errors for enhancing the precision of causal effect estimates. Experimental results on synthetic, semi-synthetic, and real-world datasets demonstrate that DDML significantly outperforms 13 state-of-the-art baseline algorithms in both MAE and RMSE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DDML算法，通过因果角色解缠和残差依赖正交化两大策略，解决了Double Machine Learning在高维或有限样本场景下因混淆因子未解缠和残差依赖导致的估计偏差问题，在合成、半合成及真实数据集上优于13个基线模型。
AI.motivation: DML在高维或有限样本场景下存在两个关键问题：(1) 使用所有协变量估计 nuisance 函数，未区分不同潜在因子，导致估计不可靠；(2) 不精确的 nuisance 估计会引入治疗残差与剩余结果误差之间的残差依赖，影响因果效应估计精度。
AI.method: DDML整合两大策略：(1) 因果角色解缠策略——将协变量分解为混淆因子、治疗特有因子和结果特有因子，以提升nuisance函数估计的可靠性；(2) 残差依赖正交化策略——缓解因nuisance估计误差导致的残差依赖，提高因果效应估计精度。
AI.result: 在合成、半合成及真实数据集上，DDML在MAE和RMSE两个指标上均显著优于13个最先进的基线算法。
AI.conclusion: DDML通过解缠和正交化策略有效提升了DML在高维和有限样本场景下的因果效应估计性能。

title: GRAIL: AI translation for scientists application workflow on satellite data
summary: Domain scientists increasingly develop Python scripts to analyze satellite imagery but they lack scalability to large-scale data. This paper demonstrates GRAIL, an agentic translation system that converts Python geospatial workflows into executable Spark-based programs without requiring scientists to learn a new framework. Rather than fine-tuning a specialized LLM model, GRAIL adapts RDPro, a Scala library for satellite data analysis, to make it LLM-ready using structured documentation, API alias functions, and repair-oriented error logs. Translation is structured as a LangGraph pipeline that decomposes code generation into explicit sections with guided inputs and outputs, enabling targeted repair without regenerating the full program. We demonstrate GRAIL on real-world geospatial workflows and showcase the correctness and scalability of the translated code.

AI.tldr: GRAIL是一个智能翻译系统，可将Python地理空间工作流自动转换为可扩展的Spark程序，无需科学家学习新框架，通过结构化文档、API别名函数和修复导向错误日志使RDPro库LLM就绪，并采用LangGraph流水线实现精准代码修复。
AI.motivation: 领域科学家常用Python脚本分析卫星图像，但这些脚本缺乏大规模数据的可扩展性，而学习新框架（如Spark）对非计算机科学家而言成本过高。
AI.method: 1) 将RDPro（Scala地理空间分析库）改造为LLM就绪格式，包括结构化文档、API别名函数和修复导向错误日志；2) 采用LangGraph流水线将代码生成分解为多个显式节段，支持定向修复而非整体重新生成。
AI.result: 在真实地理空间工作流上验证了翻译后代码的正确性和可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: GRAIL通过智能翻译而非微调专用LLM的方式，有效解决了Python地理空间脚本向Spark程序的可扩展迁移问题，兼顾了代码正确性与性能。

title: Cross-Domain Energy-Guided Diffusion Generation for Off-Dynamics Reinforcement Learning
summary: Off-dynamics offline reinforcement learning seeks to learn a target-domain policy from a large source dataset and a limited target dataset under mismatched transition dynamics. Existing approaches such as reward augmentation and data filtering are constrained to the source dataset and cannot synthesize new target behavior to improve coverage beyond the collected source trajectories. While recent model-based methods attempt to address this by learning target-aware dynamics, the generated experience is constructed only at the transition level, which leads to accumulated errors over long horizons. These limitations necessitate a shift toward trajectory-level generation for off-dynamics offline RL. We propose CEDGE, a Cross-domain Energy-guided Diffusion GEneration framework. CEDGE trains a trajectory diffusion model on source-domain trajectories and adapts the generated samples to the target domain through energy guidance. This guidance is derived by minimizing the distribution mismatch between the source and desired target-domain trajectories and is decomposed into return, domain, and behavior energy components. The resulting energy-guided trajectories are useful both for direct planning and as synthetic data for policy learning. Since target adaptation is achieved via energy guidance rather than retraining the diffusion model, CEDGE can be efficiently adapted to new target dynamics compared to previous methods. Experiments on the ODRL benchmark demonstrate that trajectory-level energy-guided generation improves diffusion planning under dynamics shifts and produces synthetic data that improves downstream target policy learning.

AI.tldr: CEDGE提出了一种跨域能量引导的轨迹扩散生成框架，通过在源域训练扩散模型并利用能量引导（分解为回报、域和行为能量）适配目标域，实现轨迹级生成，解决了离线强化学习中动力学不匹配下的长程误差累积问题，在ODRL基准上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有离动力学离线强化学习方法（如奖励增强、数据过滤）受限于源数据集，无法合成新的目标行为以改善覆盖范围；基于模型的方法仅在转移层面生成经验，导致长程累积误差。因此需要向轨迹级生成范式转变。
AI.method: CEDGE包含两个阶段：1) 在源域轨迹上训练轨迹扩散模型；2) 通过能量引导将生成样本适配到目标域，能量引导通过最小化源轨迹与期望目标轨迹之间的分布不匹配来推导，并分解为回报、域和行为三个能量组件。
AI.result: 在ODRL基准上，轨迹级能量引导生成改善了动力学偏移下的扩散规划性能，生成的合成数据提高了下游目标策略学习效果。
AI.conclusion: CEDGE通过能量引导而非重新训练扩散模型来实现目标适配，相比先前方法能高效适应新的目标动力学，验证了轨迹级生成在离动力学离线强化学习中的有效性。

title: PANDO: Efficient Multimodal AI Agents via Online Skill Distillation
summary: Recent advances in multimodal web agents often rely on increased inference-time computation, including rollout search, verifier passes, offline skill discovery, and specialist model stacks. This raises a central question: can a web agent become more efficient as it accumulates experience, rather than more expensive? We first analyze trajectories from VisualWebArena and identify three recurring sources of inefficiency: repeat-action loops, hidden discovery costs, and low prompt-cache reuse. We then introduce PANDO, a single-rollout online skill-distillation framework that maintains a structured Skill Library and combines progress reflection, confidence-based skill demotion, hierarchical routing, visual compression, and cache-aware prompting. On the full set of 910 VisualWebArena tasks, PANDO achieves a 58.3% success rate, outperforming SGV (54.0%) and our WALT reproduction (45.2%), while using 58% fewer tokens than SGV and 61% fewer tokens than WALT, without any pre-evaluation discovery budget. A 300-task ablation further shows that rules and routines provide most of the success gains, while routing, compression, and cache-aware prompting convert the larger skill library into lower marginal token cost. Finally, we introduce three trajectory-level efficiency metrics -- Action Repetition Rate, Step Overhead Ratio, and Prompt Cache Utilization -- to make efficiency visible beyond terminal success.

AI.tldr: PANDO是一个单轮在线技能蒸馏框架，通过结构化技能库、进度反思、置信度降级、层级路由、视觉压缩和缓存感知提示等技术，在VisualWebArena的910个任务上达到58.3%的成功率，同时比SGV少用58%的token，比WALT少用61%的token，并引入了三个轨迹级效率指标。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态网页Agent依赖增加推理时计算（如 rollout搜索、验证器、离线技能发现、专用模型堆叠）来提升性能，导致效率随经验积累而下降。作者提出核心问题：网页Agent能否随着经验积累变得更高效，而非更昂贵？
AI.method: PANDO框架包含：(1) 结构化技能库维护；(2) 进度反思机制；(3) 基于置信度的技能降级；(4) 层级路由；(5) 视觉压缩；(6) 缓存感知提示。通过单轮在线技能蒸馏实现。
AI.result: 在VisualWebArena 910个任务上，PANDO成功率达58.3%，优于SGV（54.0%）和WALT（45.2%），同时token消耗比SGV少58%、比WALT少61%，且无需预评估发现预算。300任务消融实验表明规则和例程贡献主要成功增益，路由、压缩和缓存感知提示将更大的技能库转化为更低的边际token成本。
AI.conclusion: PANDO证明了网页Agent可以通过在线技能蒸馏实现效率和性能的双重提升，并提出了Action Repetition Rate、Step Overhead Ratio、Prompt Cache Utilization三个轨迹级效率指标，使效率评估超越终端成功率。

title: DriftingMol: Decoder-Coupled Drift for One-Pass Property-Conditional Molecular Generation
summary: Property-conditional molecular generation should produce valid, diverse molecules while responding to continuous target values at low sampling cost. We introduce DriftingMol, a two-stage framework that adapts drifting models to a SELFIES latent molecular space. A frozen SELFIES beta-VAE provides the latent space, and the hidden representation of its decoder serves as the drift feature map. In decoder-coupled drift, decoder weights remain fixed, but drift gradients are backpropagated through the decoder feature map to a DiT generator, inducing a pullback metric aligned with molecular decoding. On ZINC250K, the default setting achieves QED Spearman correlation 0.493 with 94.7% uniqueness, while the strongest decoder-coupled condition reaches 0.510. Under protocol-matched four-property conditioning, decoder-coupled drift reaches mean Spearman correlation up to 0.598. Across 15 controlled variants, models that preserve the gradient path through decoder features achieve higher correlations than the tested latent-space, random-feature, and external-feature drift variants, while detached or stop-gradient decoder controls yield near-zero QED correlation and very low uniqueness. These results indicate that decoder-coupled drift is a useful low-cost mechanism for property-biased molecular generation, requiring one generator evaluation and one frozen decoder pass.

AI.tldr: DriftingMol是一种两阶段分子生成框架，在SELFIES隐空间中使用解码器耦合的漂移模型，通过反向传播漂移梯度通过冻结的β-VAE解码器特征图来引导DiT生成器，实现低采样成本下的属性条件分子生成，在ZINC250K上达到QED Spearman相关性0.493-0.510，唯一性94.7%。
AI.motivation: 现有的属性条件分子生成方法在平衡分子有效性、多样性和对连续目标值的响应能力方面存在挑战，且采样成本较高。作者希望开发一种低计算成本、高有效性的框架，能够根据连续属性值生成有效且多样的分子。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架DriftingMol：(1) 使用冻结的SELFIES β-VAE提供隐空间，解码器的隐藏表示作为漂移特征图；(2) 在解码器耦合漂移中，保持解码器权重固定，通过解码器特征图反向传播漂移梯度到DiT生成器，引入与分子解码对齐的拉回度量。
AI.result: 在ZINC250K上，默认设置QED Spearman相关性0.493，唯一性94.7%；最强解码器耦合条件达0.510。四属性条件下平均Spearman相关性达0.598。保持梯度路径通过解码器特征的模型相关性更高，而分离或停止梯度的控制变体QED相关性接近零且唯一性极低。
AI.conclusion: 解码器耦合漂移是一种有用的低代价属性偏置分子生成机制，仅需一次生成器评估和一次冻结解码器前向传播即可实现属性条件分子生成。

title: CoRe-Code: Collaborative Reinforcement Learning for Code Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance in code generation, but most methods rely on autoregressive decoding without global planning, often leading to locally coherent yet globally suboptimal solutions (e.g., failing test cases or inefficient complexity). While recent approaches such as Chain-of-Thought (CoT) and multi-agent systems (MAS) introduce planning, their limited role specialization and coordination hinder performance on complex tasks. To address the challenges of coordination and specialization in multi-agent code generation, we propose Collaborative Reinforcement Code (CoRe-Code), a framework for role specialized LLM agents that enhances inter-agent coordination to generate more accurate and efficient code. CoRe-Code adopts a simple Planner-Coder paradigm, where the Planner produces high-level plans and the Coder executes them to generate code. We further introduce a collaboration-aware reinforcement learning stage based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to enhance role specialization and alignment. Experiments show that CoRe-Code outperforms a wide range of existing RL-based and multi-agent methods. In addition, we demonstrate that CoRe-Code can generalize to other multi-agent frameworks (e.g., Retrieval and Debugging agents), highlighting its flexibility and scalability. We evaluate CoRe-Code on multiple benchmarks of varying difficulty using three base models. Compared to existing baselines, the results show consistent improvements in accuracy, while also achieving higher efficiency in terms of execution time and memory usage, demonstrating the effectiveness and practicality of CoRe-Code.

AI.tldr: CoRe-Code 提出了一个 Planner-Coder 双智能体协作框架，并引入基于 GRPO 的协作感知强化学习，以提升代码生成中角色分工与智能体协调能力，在多个基准上显著提升了代码的准确性和效率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代码生成方法依赖自回归解码缺乏全局规划，CoT和多智能体系统虽引入规划但角色分工和协调不足，导致复杂任务上表现不佳。
AI.method: 采用 Planner-Coder 双角色范式（Planner 生成高层计划，Coder 执行代码生成），并引入基于 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 的协作感知强化学习阶段来增强角色分工与对齐。
AI.result: 在多个不同难度的基准测试上，使用三种基座模型均取得了准确率的一致提升，同时执行时间和内存使用效率更高，优于现有RL和多智能体方法。
AI.conclusion: CoRe-Code 通过明确的角色分工和协作强化学习有效提升了多智能体代码生成的准确性和效率，且具有良好的泛化性和可扩展性。

title: Tiny Brains, Giant Impact: Uncovering the Keystone Neurons of LLM with Just a Few Prompts
summary: Large language models (LLMs) display strong comprehensive abilities, yet the internal mechanisms that support these behaviors remain insufficiently understood. In this work, we show that across a wide range of open-weight Transformers, a subset of neurons remains consistently highly activated during inference across tasks of multiple capability dimensions. By probing along the cross-task activation strength, an extremely sparse subset is isolated, whose removal causes a collapse in model behavior, which we term keystone neurons. Our analysis reveals that keystone neurons are a stable and intrinsic neuron subset of the model that is largely established during pretraining. The parameters associated with these neurons are tightly calibrated during the training process, and their precise values are critical for the capabilities of the model. Building on these insights, we propose a supervised fine-tuning approach that updates only keystone neurons, achieving task gains comparable to or even better than full-parameter fine-tuning while better preserving performance in other capability dimensions, despite modifying a much smaller number of parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文发现大型语言模型中存在一类"关键神经元"（keystone neurons），即跨任务持续高度激活的稀疏神经元子集。移除这些神经元会导致模型行为崩溃。这些神经元在预训练阶段形成，参数校准精确。基于此，提出仅更新关键神经元的微调方法，在修改极少参数的情况下，性能可与全参数微调相当甚至更优，同时更好保留其他能力。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型展现出强大的综合能力，但其内部工作机制尚不清晰，缺乏对支撑模型行为的关键神经元的深入理解。
AI.method: 1) 跨多个能力维度任务识别持续高度激活的神经元子集；2) 通过探针分析激活强度，分离出极稀疏的关键神经元；3) 分析关键神经元的稳定性、形成时机及参数校准特性；4) 提出仅更新关键神经元的监督微调方法。
AI.result: 关键神经元是模型稳定且固有的子集，主要在预训练阶段形成，其参数在训练过程中被精确校准；仅更新关键神经元的微调方法在多个任务上达到与全参数微调相当甚至更优的效果，同时更好保留其他能力维度的性能。
AI.conclusion: LLM中存在关键神经元这一固有结构，对其定向微调可在参数高效的前提下保持甚至提升模型性能，为理解模型内部机制和开发高效微调策略提供了新视角。

title: Agent Manufacturing: Foundation-Model Agents as First-Class Industrial Entities
summary: Manufacturing has passed through four widely recognized paradigms - mechanization, electrification, programmable automation, and Smart Manufacturing - each defined by the kind of work it shifted from humans to machines. In every case, one layer of industrial work remained fundamentally human: the coordinative cognition of production, comprising the interpretive, allocative, diagnostic, negotiative, and governance work exercised by engineers, planners, and operational managers. We argue that a fifth transition is now underway in which this layer, rather than the physical or routine-cognitive layers below it, is what foundation-model-based autonomous agents primarily redistribute. We name this paradigm Agent Manufacturing and define it operationally: a manufacturing system is an instance of Agent Manufacturing when its principal coordination mechanism is reasoning performed by foundation-model agents that can interpret open-ended goals, plan over long horizons, invoke tools and machines, and negotiate with other agents and humans. This is a narrower and more falsifiable definition than the existing literature on cognitive manufacturing or Industry 5.0 provides, and it distinguishes the paradigm sharply from classical multi-agent manufacturing systems, which were autonomous only within closed protocol spaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出第五次制造范式——智能体制造（Agent Manufacturing），其核心特征是由基础模型驱动的自主智能体取代人类工程师和经理，承担生产中的协调认知工作（解释、分配、诊断、协商、治理），而不仅仅是替代体力或常规认知劳动。该定义比现有认知制造或工业5.0文献更窄、更可证伪，并与仅在封闭协议空间内自主的经典多智能体制造系统形成鲜明对比。
AI.motivation: 前四次制造范式（机械化、电气化、可编程自动化、智能制造）每次都将特定类型的工作从人类转移给机器，但始终有一层工业工作——生产的协调性认知（包括解释、分配、诊断、协商和治理工作）——仍由工程师、规划师和运营经理执行。当前第五次转型正在发生，这层工作正成为基础模型自主智能体主要重新分配的对象。
AI.method: 本文采用概念性定义与边界划定的方法：操作性地定义"智能体制造"——当制造系统的主要协调机制是由基础模型智能体执行的推理（能够解释开放式目标、长周期规划、调用工具和机器、与其他智能体和人类协商）时，该系统即为智能体制造实例。该定义比现有认知制造或工业5.0文献更窄、更可证伪，并与仅在封闭协议空间内自治的经典多智能体制造系统划清界限。
AI.result: 识别出第五次制造范式转换，其中基础模型自主智能体主要重新分配的是协调性认知工作层，而非其下方的物理或常规认知层；给出了可操作、可证伪的"智能体制造"定义，并与现有文献和经典多智能体系统区分开来。
