Experimental results demonstrate that SpecAlign effectively detects semantic inconsistencies and improves assertion alignment without relying on golden RTL, providing a scalable complement to traditional formal verification evaluation metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SpecAlign框架，通过两轮迭代对齐循环和自一致性投票机制，实现LLM生成SystemVerilog断言的语义评估与改进，无需黄金RTL即可提升断言与自然语言规范的对齐度。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM生成SVA的方法主要关注语法有效性和形式验证结果，但生成的断言与自然语言规范之间的语义对齐难以量化，导致幻觉或错位断言在缺乏黄金RTL时降低可信度并增加调试负担。
AI.method: SpecAlign引入两个迭代对齐循环，使用蕴含分类评估自然语言属性和SVA与设计规范的语义一致性；通过思维链提示生成多条推理路径，并采用自一致性投票机制聚合决策；对错位断言进行分析以生成可操作的反馈；定义定量对齐分数衡量跨迭代的语义一致性。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，SpecAlign能有效检测语义不一致性，并在无需黄金RTL的条件下提升断言对齐度，可作为传统形式验证评估指标的可扩展补充。
AI.conclusion: SpecAlign通过语义对齐评估与迭代精炼，解决了LLM生成SVA中语义不一致难以量化的问题，为缺乏黄金RTL的场景提供了实用的断言质量保障方案。

title: A perspective on fluid mechanical environments for challenges in reinforcement learning
summary:
We consider the challenge of developing agents that efficiently interact with high-dimensional, evolving environments, towards a view of practical reinforcement learning (RL) agents interacting with open worlds, of which they witness and affect only a small part. We argue that canonical fluid mechanics problems, and their simulations, present a compelling testbed for the development of such methods. These problems arise in nonlinear instabilities, where small disturbances can grow to transform the dynamics of a system. Nonlinear instabilities represent several open scientific challenges with industrial applications -- the droplet breakup of a liquid jet, mixing at an interface between two fluids, and the appearance of unusually tall rogue waves in the ocean. In these settings, agents may leverage preserved representations across the changing dynamics to learn efficiently.
  We present two problem descriptions of agents interacting with a fluid mechanical environment, and describe the state and action spaces, and reward functions, for these agents. For these examples, we specify the aspects of the environment which are nonstationary and the preserved invariances. We note Dedalus and JAX-CFD as open-source simulators that can be used for the development of reinforcement learning methods (Burns et al., 2016; Kochkov et al., 2021)) We demonstrate the use of Dedalus for environment generation by creating RL agents that learn to navigate in a stationary environment that is simulated using Dedalus. This sets the stage for future development of RL agents that learn to meaningfully interact with simulated environments that represent scientific challenges in natural and industrial flows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将经典流体力学问题及其模拟作为强化学习（RL）智能体与高维、动态变化环境交互的测试平台，重点关注非线性不稳定性现象（如液滴破碎、界面混合、怪浪）。作者描述了两种智能体与流体环境交互的问题设定，包括状态空间、动作空间和奖励函数，并指出Dedalus和JAX-CFD可作为开源模拟器。通过在Dedalus生成的静止环境中训练导航RL智能体，验证了该平台的可行性，为未来开发能有效交互科学模拟环境的RL智能体奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 开发能够高效与高维、演化环境交互的RL智能体是实际应用中的关键挑战。非线性流体不稳定性问题（如液滴破碎、界面混合、怪浪）具有科学重要性和工业应用价值，且其动力学中蕴含可跨变化场景迁移的守恒表示，为高效学习提供了可能。作者希望借此推动RL方法在开放式科学问题中的应用。
AI.method: 1) 提出两种流体力学RL问题描述，明确智能体的状态空间、动作空间和奖励函数。2) 识别环境中的非平稳性来源和保持的不变性。3) 推荐Dedalus和JAX-CFD作为开源模拟器。4) 在Dedalus生成的静止环境中训练导航RL智能体，验证环境生成与交互的可行性。
AI.result: 成功在Dedalus模拟的静止流体环境中训练了具备导航能力的RL智能体，证明了将流体模拟器作为RL环境生成工具的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 流体力学模拟可作为RL方法在开放式、非平稳科学问题上发展的有效测试平台，为未来开发能交互并影响自然与工业流动中科学挑战的RL智能体奠定基础。

title: DarkForest: Less Talk, Higher Accuracy for Multi-Agent LLMs
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems improve reasoning by combining outputs from multiple agents, but interaction-heavy methods can introduce error propagation and high communication overhead. When agents exchange raw responses or reasoning traces, incorrect intermediate reasoning may be adopted and amplified, leading to confident but wrong consensus; multi-round communication also increases token consumption, latency, and inference cost. In this paper, we propose a controlled-communication coordination framework named DarkForest. DarkForest first keeps agents independent, so each agent produces an answer without seeing the others' outputs. It then parses the raw responses into structured candidate records, groups semantically equivalent candidates into clusters, and estimates a calibrated belief distribution over these clusters using agent reliability, confidence, parse quality, support-pattern reliability, and independence corrections. A coordinator receives only policy-permitted evidence from this belief state with controlled communication. Experiments on six reasoning benchmarks show that DarkForest achieves leading overall quality, improves the strongest baseline by up to 30.7\% on benchmark metrics, and reduces token consumption by up to $6.5\times$ compared with communication-heavy baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出DarkForest框架，通过结构化解析、语义聚类和校准置信度估计来实现多智能体LLM系统的受控通信协调，在提升推理质量的同时大幅降低通信开销。
AI.motivation: 现有交互繁重的多智能体LLM系统存在错误传播和通信开销高的问题，智能体交换原始响应或推理轨迹时，错误的中间推理可能被采纳和放大，导致自信但错误的共识，同时多轮通信增加token消耗、延迟和推理成本。
AI.method: DarkForest首先保持智能体独立生成答案；然后将原始响应解析为结构化候选记录；将语义等价的候选分组聚类；利用智能体可靠性、置信度、解析质量、支持模式可靠性和独立性校正来估计校准的置信度分布；协调器仅接收策略允许的证据。
AI.result: 在六个推理基准上，DarkForest取得了领先的整体质量，将最强基线提升最高30.7%，相比通信密集型基线将token消耗降低最多6.5倍。
AI.conclusion: 受控通信框架能在保持甚至提升推理质量的同时，显著降低多智能体系统的通信开销，有效解决了错误传播和计算成本问题。

title: MimirRAG: A Multi-Agent RAG Framework for Financial Data Retrieval with Metadata Integration
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems offer a promising approach to reduce hallucinations and improve answer accuracy in large language models (LLMs), a requirement for reliable, financial analysis where answers must be grounded in verifiable evidence from filings rather than generated from model priors. However, designing RAG systems that extract meaningful insights from mixed financial documents and integrate into analyst workflows remains challenging. This paper introduces MimirRAG (Metadata-Integrated Multi-Agent Information Retrieval), a multi-agent RAG system developed iteratively to address these challenges. MimirRAG features a modular pipeline encompassing structure-preserving parsing of PDF filings, table-aware chunking, metadata extraction, agent-based retrieval with query planning and hybrid search, validation, and context-aware generation with numerical reasoning support. Our ablation study identifies three key technical enablers for effective financial RAG: metadata integration, table-aware chunking, and an agentic workflow. MimirRAG was evaluated quantitatively using FinanceBench and qualitatively through expert validation with four financial analysts. The system achieved 89.3% accuracy on FinanceBench, outperforming the original benchmark baselines. Expert feedback highlighted that successful deployment also requires calibrated trust, comprehensive data integration, and user personalization. We conclude that combining multi-agent RAG architecture with human-centric design principles can improve the extraction of meaningful insights in financial analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MimirRAG，一个面向金融分析的多智能体检索增强生成系统，通过元数据集成、表格感知分块和智能体工作流三大关键技术，在FinanceBench上达到89.3%的准确率，并通过金融分析师验证了其在减少幻觉、提升可验证性方面的有效性。
AI.motivation: 金融分析需要基于可验证证据（如财报文件）的可靠回答，但现有RAG系统在处理混合金融文档和融入分析师工作流程方面存在挑战，设计能够从复杂金融文档中提取有意义洞察的RAG系统仍具困难。
AI.method: MimirRAG采用模块化多智能体流水线，包括：结构保持的PDF解析、表格感知分块、元数据提取、基于智能体的检索（含查询规划和混合搜索）、验证机制以及支持数值推理的上下文感知生成。
AI.result: 在FinanceBench上达到89.3%准确率，超越原始基准。消融实验识别出三大关键技术：元数据集成、表格感知分块和智能体工作流。专家验证指出成功部署还需校准信任、全面数据集成和用户个性化。
AI.conclusion: 结合多智能体RAG架构与人本设计原则可以改善金融分析中有意义洞察的提取。RAG在金融领域的有效部署不仅依赖技术性能，还需考虑用户信任校准、数据集成和个性化等人类因素。

title: Boosting Inference with Guided Reasoning: Stochastic Exploration for Recursive Models
comment: Presented at the proceedings of the ICML 2026 Workshop on Structured Probabilistic Inference & Generative Modeling (SPIGM)}, Seoul, South Korea. 2026
summary: Recent work on recursive architectures has shown that tiny neural networks can be surprisingly powerful on structured reasoning tasks. The trick is to model reasoning trajectories with a latent dynamical system. We argue that the inference-time behaviour of these architectures is best understood as approximate inference over latent reasoning trajectories, with deterministic recursion as the one-particle, zero-noise limit. We make this view operational through guided stochastic exploration: stochastic perturbations of the reasoning dynamics propose neighbouring trajectories, and the model's existing early-stopping head reweights them online. The framework yields three label-free diagnostics: local stability, guide alignment, and cloud-token entropy. These predict, from inference traces alone, whether the procedure will help and which of its outputs to trust. On Sudoku-Extreme it lifts exact-solve accuracy from $85.9\%$ to $98.0\%$ without retraining; on Maze-Hard the diagnostics flag a misaligned guide, as validation performance later confirms. The same machinery thus characterises both when recursive reasoning has room to improve at the trajectory level and when the model's internal guide can recover it.

AI.tldr: 本文通过随机扰动递归推理轨迹并利用模型自带的早停头在线重加权，提出了一种无标签的诊断框架（局部稳定性、引导对齐度、云令牌熵），能在不重新训练的情况下提升推理性能（数独精确率从85.9%提升至98.0%），并预测何时递归推理需要改进以及模型内部引导能否恢复。
AI.motivation: 理解递归架构的推理行为，将其视为隐式推理轨迹上的近似推断，从而开发无需标签的诊断工具来预测和改进递归推理性能。
AI.method: 将确定性递归视为单粒子、零噪声极限下的近似推断；通过随机扰动推理动力学以生成邻近轨迹，并利用模型已有的早停头在线重加权这些轨迹；提出三种无标签诊断指标：局部稳定性、引导对齐度、云令牌熵。
AI.result: 在Sudoku-Extreme上，无需重新训练即可将精确求解准确率从85.9%提升至98.0%；在Maze-Hard上，诊断指标成功标记了引导不对齐问题，后续验证实验证实了这一发现。
AI.conclusion: 该框架既能表征递归推理在轨迹层面是否有改进空间，也能判断模型内部引导能否恢复推理；证明了将递归推理视为隐式轨迹上的近似推断这一视角既有理论解释力也有实际工程价值。

title: Scale When Needed: Adaptive Neuron-level Mixed Precision Quantization Aware Training
summary: Deploying deep neural networks on resource-constrained 6G edge devices demands aggressive compression with minimal accuracy loss. Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) has emerged as a leading compression approach; however, existing mixed-precision methods typically operate at coarse layer- or channel-level granularity. These methods often rely on heuristic or search-based bit-allocation strategies, which may overlook fine-grained variability at the neuron level. We propose Neuron-Level Mixed-Precision QAT (NMP-QAT), where each neuron independently learns its own discrete precision during training. Starting from low-bit precision, NMP-QAT expands bit-width only when training signals demand it, via differentiable surrogates and straight-through estimators, while preserving a fully discrete inference graph. This adaptability extends to both weights and activations, reducing memory movement. Evaluated on telecom and non-telecom datasets across MLP and tabular foundation model architectures, NMP-QAT achieves superior compression-accuracy trade-offs over mixed-precision QAT baselines, making it well-suited for Green AI deployments at the network edge.

AI.tldr: 提出神经元级混合精度QAT方法(NMP-QAT)，让每个神经元自主学习离散精度，在资源受限的6G边缘设备上实现更优的压缩-精度权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有混合精度量化方法通常在粗粒度（层或通道级别）上操作，依赖启发式或搜索策略，忽略了神经元级别的细粒度差异，难以在6G边缘设备上实现最佳压缩-精度平衡。
AI.method: NMP-QAT：每个神经元独立学习离散精度；从低位宽开始，仅当训练信号需要时通过可微代理和直通估计器扩展位宽；权重和激活均适用，保持完全离散推理图。
AI.result: 在电信和非电信数据集上，基于MLP和表格数据基础模型架构，NMP-QAT相比混合精度QAT基线实现了更优的压缩-精度权衡。
AI.conclusion: NMP-QAT适用于网络边缘的绿色AI部署，在资源受限的6G边缘设备上有效。

title: Meta-Agent: From Task Descriptions to Verified Multi-Agent Systems
summary: AI agents are increasingly used to solve complex, multi-step tasks, but existing multi-agent frameworks remain brittle as workflows grow in scale and depth. Small errors at intermediate stages can propagate through agent interactions, while insufficient grounding and weak verification mechanisms further limit reliability. We present Meta-Agent, a two-phase framework that automatically constructs and executes specialized multi-agent systems from natural-language task descriptions. In the construction phase, a task planner decomposes a problem into a directed acyclic graph of agent specifications with explicit input/output contracts and verification criteria. A web search module grounds each specification with external evidence, and a code generation module produces system prompts and tool configurations. A construction-time verification stage then validates generated artifacts and triggers targeted regeneration when failures are detected. In the execution phase, a coordinator dispatches subtasks across the agent graph while execution-time verification gates intermediate outputs. We further introduce a three-level error attribution mechanism that distinguishes local, upstream, and structural failures, enabling targeted recovery strategies ranging from localized retries to partial re-execution and re-decomposition. We evaluate Meta-Agent across coding, contextual learning, and open-ended reasoning tasks. Experiments against strong multi-agent baselines and ablation studies demonstrate consistent improvements in task success rate, error recovery, and workflow stability. The results highlight the importance of tightly integrating planning, grounding, and verification for building reliable multi-agent systems.

AI.tldr: Meta-Agent是一个两阶段框架，通过任务分解、网络搜索验证、代码生成和三级错误归因机制，自动构建并执行可靠的专用多智能体系统，在编码、上下文学习和开放式推理任务上显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型多智能体框架在任务规模增大时表现脆弱，中间阶段的小错误会传播扩散，且缺乏充分的证据支持和验证机制，导致可靠性受限。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：(1) 构建阶段：任务规划器将问题分解为有向无环图形式的智能体规范（含输入输出契约和验证标准），网络搜索模块提供外部证据，代码生成模块生成系统提示和工具配置，构建时验证阶段检测失败并触发针对性重生成；(2) 执行阶段：协调器调度子任务，执行时验证门控中间输出，三级错误归因机制（本地/上游/结构性失败）实现差异化恢复策略。
AI.result: 在编码、上下文学习和开放式推理任务上，相比强多智能体基线和消融实验，Meta-Agent在任务成功率、错误恢复和工作流稳定性方面均取得一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: 紧密集成规划、证据支持和验证对于构建可靠的多智能体系统至关重要。

title: GL-LFGNN:A Global-Local Dual-branch Causal Graph Neural Network Based on Liang-Kleeman Information Flow for EEG Emotion Recognition
summary: EEG-based emotion recognition holds significant promise for objective diagnosis of mood disorders. Graph neural networks (GNNs) have emerged as the dominant paradigm for modeling inter-channel dependencies in EEG, yet existing approaches rely on symmetric adjacency matrices derived from spatial proximity or functional correlations that fundamentally capture statistical associations rather than directed causal influences, which conflicts with the inherently asymmetric, causally-driven nature of neural information flow. To bridge this gap, we propose GL-LFGNN, a Global-Local Dual-branch Causal Graph Neural Network grounded in Liang-Kleeman information flow theory. Unlike Granger causality that merely assesses temporal precedence, our approach rigorously quantifies causal strength from a dynamical systems perspective, yielding neurophysiologically interpretable directed graphs. A dual-branch architecture further integrates whole-brain connectivity with region-specific processing aligned to established functional neuroanatomy. On the MEEG dataset, GL-LFGNN achieves 86.17% (Arousal) and 86.71% (Valence) accuracy with only 37K parameters -- approximately 10% of the current state-of-the-art -- demonstrating that principled causal modeling can simultaneously enhance interpretability, generalization, and computational efficiency. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出GL-LFGNN模型，利用梁-克列曼信息流理论构建有向因果图神经网络用于EEG情绪识别，在MEEG数据集上以37K参数达到86.17%（唤醒度）和86.71%（效价）准确率，参数仅为SOTA的10%。
AI.motivation: 现有GNN方法使用对称邻接矩阵（基于空间距离或功能相关）捕捉统计关联而非有向因果影响，与神经信息流固有的非对称、因果驱动特性相矛盾。
AI.method: 基于梁-克列曼信息流理论构建有向因果图，采用全局-局部双分支架构，全局分支处理全脑连接，局部分支处理与功能神经解剖学对应的特定脑区。
AI.result: 在MEEG数据集上，唤醒度准确率86.17%，效价准确率86.71%，参数量仅37K，约为当前最优方法的10%。
AI.conclusion: 有向因果建模能同时提升可解释性、泛化能力和计算效率。

title: FrontierOR: Benchmarking LLMs' Capacity for Efficient Algorithm Design in Large-Scale Optimization
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for optimization modeling and solver-code generation, yet practical operations research and optimization problems often require a harder capability: designing scalable algorithms that exploit problem structure and outperform direct formulation-and-solve baselines. Existing benchmarks are limited to small or simplified examples far below real-world scale and complexity. We introduce FrontierOR, among the first benchmarks to systematically evaluate LLM-based efficient algorithm design for realistic large-scale optimization problems. FrontierOR includes 180 tasks derived from methodologically diverse papers published in top-tier operations research venues, each with standardized instances and a hidden, expert-verified evaluation suite. We evaluate seven LLMs spanning frontier, cost-effective, and open-source models both in one-shot and test-time evolution settings. The results reveal that frontier models still struggle to move from executable formulations to efficient optimization algorithms: the strongest one-shot model outperforms Gurobi in only 31% of cases in both solution quality and computational efficiency, and even strong coding agents with test-time evolution achieve only 50% on selected hard tasks. FrontierOR establishes a practical evaluation platform for LLM-based optimization algorithm design, which enables future LLMs and agents to be systematically tested on whether they can move beyond correct formulation toward a feasible, high-quality, and efficient algorithm. Our FrontierOR Benchmark is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/efficient-opt-bench-F03D.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FrontierOR基准，系统评估LLM在真实大规模运筹优化问题中设计高效算法（而非仅生成求解代码）的能力。180个任务来自顶刊论文，测试表明最强模型仅31%情况同时优于Gurobi的求解质量和效率，即使在测试时进化场景下也仅达50%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM优化基准局限于小型简化示例，无法衡量LLM在真实大规模运筹问题中设计可扩展、高效算法的能力，而实际场景中算法设计比直接建模求解更具挑战性。
AI.method: 从运筹顶刊论文中提取180个大规模优化任务，构建标准化实例和隐藏的专家验证评估集，在一次性推理和测试时进化两种设置下评估7种LLM。
AI.result: 最强一次性模型仅31%案例在求解质量和计算效率上同时优于Gurobi；具备测试时进化的强编码智能体在精选困难任务上也仅达到50%。
AI.conclusion: LLM在从正确求解转向高效算法设计方面仍存在显著差距，FrontierOR为系统评估LLM的优化算法设计能力提供了实用平台。

title: Reinforcement Learning for Laser Additive Manufacturing Scan-Order Optimisation: A Bilevel Proxy--FEA Diagnostic Framework for Reward and World-Model Diagnosis
summary: Reinforcement learning offers a promising approach for scan-order optimisation in laser additive manufacturing, where sequential scan decisions critically influence thermal accumulation, residual stress, distortion, and final part quality. A central challenge in applying RL to this domain lies in reward and world-model fidelity: full finite-element analysis is computationally prohibitive for dense in-the-loop evaluation, while cheap thermo-inspired proxy metrics, though efficient, may capture only partial aspects of the true thermo-mechanical objectives. This paper investigates a bilevel Proxy--FEA diagnostic framework for reward and world-model diagnosis in reinforcement-learning-guided scan-order optimisation. The lower level employs lightweight scan-path and thermo-inspired proxies for rapid candidate generation and preliminary policy-side screening, while the upper level utilises sparse Abaqus FEA simulations to provide simulation-based reference labels. The framework is examined on a simplified whole-track heating LDED32 stripe benchmark comprising ten representative scan strategies. Final-cooling residual Mises stress, U3 vertical distortion, and PEEQ plasticity metrics reveal an observed stress--distortion trade-off rather than a single monotonic quality objective. Within the evaluated set, the center_out strategy emerges as a robust compromise candidate, while raster_left_to_right and edge_in form opposing endpoints of the trade-off. Proxy--FEA alignment analysis shows that current cheap path-based metrics predominantly capture distortion-related (U3) behaviour and exhibit only weak correlation with the sparse FEA reference labels. These findings highlight that proxy-only reward designs risk misalignment in future RL training and underscore the value of sparse FEA reference signals for diagnostic-guided reward and world-model refinement prior to large-scale policy optimisation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种双层代理-有限元分析诊断框架，用于增材制造扫描顺序优化中强化学习奖励函数与世界模型的评估。通过轻量级代理指标快速筛选候选策略，结合稀疏Abaqus有限元模拟提供参考标签。在LDED32条带基准测试中发现应力-变形权衡关系，且现有路径代理指标主要捕获变形行为，与有限元参考标签相关性弱，表明纯代理奖励设计在强化学习训练中可能存在偏差。
AI.motivation: 强化学习在激光增材制造扫描顺序优化中面临奖励函数与世界模型保真度的核心挑战：完整有限元分析计算成本过高，而廉价热模拟代理指标虽高效但可能仅捕捉真实热力学目标的局部特性，亟需一种诊断框架来评估代理指标与真实物理仿真的对齐程度。
AI.method: 构建双层Proxy-FEA诊断框架：下层使用轻量级扫描路径和热模拟代理指标进行快速候选生成与策略筛选；上层使用稀疏的Abaqus有限元仿真提供基于仿真的参考标签。在简化的全轨迹加热LDED32条带基准上对十种代表性扫描策略进行评估。
AI.result: 最终冷却残余Mises应力、U3垂直变形和PEEQ塑性指标揭示了应力-变形权衡关系，而非单一单调质量目标。center_out策略为稳健折中方案，raster_left_to_right和edge_in构成权衡的两端。代理指标与有限元参考标签的对齐分析表明，当前廉价路径指标主要捕获与变形相关的行为，与稀疏有限元参考标签相关性弱。
AI.conclusion: 纯代理奖励设计在强化学习训练中可能存在错配风险，稀疏有限元参考信号对于大规模策略优化前的诊断引导奖励和世界模型细化具有重要价值。

title: LipoAgent: Coordinating Fine-Tuned LLM Agents for Safer Lipid Design
summary: Lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) are among the most clinically mature platforms for nucleic acid delivery, yet designing lipids that are both effective and biologically safe remains a major bottleneck. In practical screening, toxicity is a decision-level constraint: if a lipid is toxic, its efficiency prediction is clinically irrelevant. We propose LipoAgent, a safety-aware multi-agent LLM framework for lipid discovery. LipoAgent combines domain-specific finetuning with a conditional prediction objective that enforces toxicity as a prerequisite for efficiency prediction, and further improves reliability via multi-agent verification with lightweight human oversight when disagreement persists. Across multiple foundation models, LipoAgent achieves an average 32% relative improvement in mRNA transfection efficiency prediction compared with other reported models for lipid design. Wet-lab validation confirms that virtual screening rankings reliably translate to biological transfection outcomes. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/SAI-Lab-NYU/LipoAgent.git.

AI.tldr: LipoAgent是一个安全感知的多智能体LLM框架，通过将毒性作为效率预测的前提条件，并采用多智能体验证机制，在脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）发现中实现了比现有模型平均32%的mRNA转染效率预测提升，且湿实验验证了虚拟筛选排名与生物转染结果的一致性。
AI.motivation: 脂质纳米颗粒是核酸递送中最成熟的临床平台之一，但设计既有效又生物安全的脂质仍是主要瓶颈。在实际筛选中，毒性是决策级约束：如果脂质有毒，其效率预测在临床上是无关的。
AI.method: LipoAgent结合领域特定微调与条件预测目标（将毒性作为效率预测的先决条件），并通过多智能体验证机制提高可靠性，在存在分歧时辅以轻量级人工监督。
AI.result: 在多个基础模型上，LipoAgent在mRNA转染效率预测上相比其他脂质设计模型平均提升32%。湿实验验证确认虚拟筛选排名可靠地转化为生物转染结果。
AI.conclusion: LipoAgent通过将安全性约束嵌入预测流程，有效解决了脂质发现中效率与毒性权衡的关键问题，且虚拟筛选结果具备生物学可翻译性。

title: Leveraging Gauge Freedom for Learning Non-Gradient Population Dynamics of Stochastic Systems
summary: Existing work on population dynamics inference often focuses on flows arising from vector fields that are the gradients of scalar potentials. Among all admissible flows that are compatible with the population dynamics, gradient flows are optimal in a specific sense: they minimize kinetic energy. The selection of fields based on different criteria corresponds to a gauge freedom when determining population dynamics, which we leverage in this work. We propose Non-Gradient Inference Flows (NGIF), an algorithm to infer non-gradient population dynamics using a weak formulation of the continuity equation. This allows us to parameterize general vector fields and choose other selection criteria beyond minimal kinetic energy. We demonstrate on a variety of low- and high-dimensional physics problems that this more general approach improves distributional accuracy over gradient-restricted baselines and better captures non-potential transport.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NGIF算法，通过连续性方程的弱形式推断非梯度人口动力学，克服了传统梯度流方法仅能处理势能梯度的限制，在低维和高维物理问题上均提升了分布精度。
AI.motivation: 现有推断方法限制在梯度流（标量势的梯度）框架下，无法处理非梯度传输动力学。本文利用规范自由度，提出更通用的非梯度流推断方法。
AI.method: 基于连续性方程的弱形式，参数化一般向量场，并允许选择最小动能之外的其他筛选准则，实现非梯度人口动力学推断。
AI.result: 在多种低维和高维物理问题上，NGIF相比梯度受限的基线方法在分布精度上更优，且能更好地捕捉非势传输行为。
AI.conclusion: 非梯度流推断能有效处理更广泛的动力学场景，突破了梯度流方法的固有局限。

title: Whose Alignment? Comparing LLM Process Alignment Across Diverse Organizational Decision Contexts
comment: Accepted to ICML 2026 Pluralistic Alignment Workshop
summary: Aligning AI systems with organizational decision-making is typically framed as a single-target problem: make the model behave like the organization. We argue this framing obscures a deeper pluralistic challenge. We rely on a decision-policy capturing method to measure process alignment: whether an LLM weights information as the organization does, not merely whether it reaches the same conclusions. Applying this method to ECHR Article 6 decisions, process alignment strongly predicts output accuracy (r = 0.85, p < .001) and externalization substantially improves alignment for poorly-aligned models. Applying it to German consumer credit decisions, this relationship collapses (r = 0.15, p = .60): interventions produce inconsistent effects and the benchmark encodes potentially discriminatory historical patterns. This contrast is itself a pluralistic alignment finding: in contested domains, high process alignment is neither achievable via externalization nor unconditionally desirable. Output agreement alone cannot distinguish a model that has internalized an organizational policy from one that merely approximates its outcomes; process-level measurement is a necessary component of any pluralistic alignment evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出，将AI系统与组织决策对齐通常被视为单一目标问题（使模型行为像组织一样），但这掩盖了更深层的多元主义挑战。作者使用决策策略捕获方法来衡量过程对齐（LLM是否像组织一样加权信息，而不仅仅是得出相同结论）。将该方法应用于ECHR第6条决策时，过程对齐强烈预测输出准确性（r=0.85, p<.001），且外部化显著改善了对齐较差的模型。但应用于德国消费信贷决策时，这种关系消失（r=0.15, p=.60）：干预产生不一致效果，基准编码了潜在的歧视性历史模式。这种对比本身就是一个多元主义对齐发现：在有争议的领域，高过程对齐既无法通过外部化实现，也并非无条件可取。仅凭输出一致性无法区分真正内化组织策略的模型与仅近似其结果的模型；过程层面测量是任何多元主义对齐评估的必要组成部分。
AI.motivation: 现有AI对齐研究通常将组织决策对齐简化为单一目标问题（使模型输出与组织结论一致），忽视了组织内部可能存在多元价值冲突以及过程对齐的重要性。作者旨在揭示这种单一目标框架的局限性，并论证过程对齐测量作为多元主义对齐评估核心组成部分的必要性。
AI.method: 采用决策策略捕获方法（decision-policy capturing method）来测量过程对齐，具体衡量LLM在信息加权方式上是否与组织一致，而非仅关注输出结论的一致性。在ECHR第6条决策（欧洲人权公约）和德国消费信贷决策两个领域进行实证对比研究。
AI.result: 在ECHR领域，过程对齐强烈预测输出准确性（r=0.85, p<.001），外部化显著改善对齐；但在德国消费信贷领域，过程对齐与准确性关系消失（r=0.15, p=.60），干预效果不一致，且基准编码了潜在歧视性历史模式。两个领域的对比本身构成了一个多元主义对齐发现。
AI.conclusion: 在有争议的决策领域，高过程对齐既不可通过外部化实现，也非无条件可取。仅依赖输出一致性无法区分真正内化组织策略的模型与仅近似其结果的模型，过程层面测量是多元主义对齐评估中不可或缺的组成部分。

title: Revisiting Pre-Propagation GNNs: Robust Diffusion Operators and Hidden-State Re-Propagation
summary: Pre-propagation graph neural networks (PPGNNs) decouple node feature propagation from transformation: graph diffusion is performed once as preprocessing, and training reduces to dense per-node transformations. This design enables mini-batch training without inter-node dependencies, avoids repeated sparse matrix--matrix multiplications, and better matches modern accelerators optimized for dense compute. However, their expressivity remains unclear, and empirical results show a gap between PPGNNs and their message-passing counterparts on commonly used graph benchmarks, especially heterophilic ones. In this paper, we propose a suite of robust graph diffusion operators for preprocessing and a few-shot hidden-state re-propagation scheme during training. Our methods improve the validation and test accuracy of PPGNNs, enabling them to match the accuracy of message-passing GNNs while maintaining training efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出鲁棒图扩散算子与少样本隐状态重传播机制，解决了预传播图神经网络（PPGNNs）在异配图上的表达能力不足问题，使其在保持训练效率的同时匹配消息传递GNN的精度。
AI.motivation: PPGNNs虽在训练效率上有优势（解耦特征传播与变换，支持小批量训练），但其表达能力不明确，且在常用图基准（尤其是异配图）上与消息传递GNN存在精度差距。
AI.method: 1) 提出一套鲁棒的图扩散算子用于预处理阶段；2) 在训练过程中引入少样本隐状态重传播机制。
AI.result: 所提方法提升了PPGNNs的验证和测试精度，使其能够匹配消息传递GNN的准确率，同时保持训练效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过鲁棒扩散算子与隐状态重传播，PPGNNs可在不牺牲效率的前提下弥合与消息传递GNN在异配图上的性能差距。

title: AI Cartography: Mapping the Latent Landscape of AI Benchmark Ecosystems
summary: While aggregate leaderboard scores drive AI development, they contain substantial measurement noise whose sources and magnitudes remain unquantified, making it unclear when rankings reflect genuine capability differences versus evaluation artifacts. We introduce a framework for measuring the latent landscape in AI benchmark ecosystems. Applying Confirmatory Factor Analysis (CFA) and Generalizability Theory to 4,000+ models from the Open LLM Leaderboard, we decompose sources of ranking variance and establish: (1) structures assumed in current reporting practice underestimate the strength of relationships between benchmarks; (2) evidence of local dependence among leaderboard items, undermining uses of benchmarks as measurement instruments under current scoring systems; (3) contributor metadata explains more rank-relevant variance ($\approx9\%$) than architecture or deployment categories in this context; (4) a manifest-score "scaling law" slope has low reliability ($R_β=0.53$); by contrast, the latent general-factor size slope is highly stable across ecosystem controls ($R_g=0.97$). We are able to provide unique insights into benchmark dynamics, such as which benchmarks are a function of LLM size and which can be oppositely impacted by post-training practices. We provide actionable diagnostics to determine how benchmark rankings can be trusted and how benchmark design can be improved.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个框架，利用验证性因子分析（CFA）和概化理论，对Open LLM Leaderboard上4000+个模型的排名变异来源进行分解。发现：当前报告惯例低估了基准间关系强度；存在局部依赖问题；贡献者元数据解释的排名方差（≈9%）超过架构或部署类别；显式得分的"规模定律"斜率信度低（Rβ=0.53），而潜在通用因子规模斜率高度稳定（Rg=0.97）。研究为基准排名可信度和设计改进提供了可操作的诊断方法。
AI.motivation: 聚合的排行榜分数驱动着AI发展，但其包含大量未量化的测量噪声，导致难以区分排名反映的是真实能力差异还是评估伪影。当前缺乏系统框架来量化这些噪声源及其影响，因此需要建立方法以理解基准生态系统中的潜在结构。
AI.method: 采用验证性因子分析（CFA）和概化理论（Generalizability Theory），对Open LLM Leaderboard中4000+个模型进行多源方差分解，分析排名变异的结构性来源，包括基准间关系、局部依赖、元数据贡献以及规模定律的信度评估。
AI.result: (1)当前报告惯例低估了基准间关系强度；(2)发现排行榜项目间存在局部依赖，削弱了基准作为测量工具的效用；(3)贡献者元数据解释约9%的排名相关方差，高于架构或部署类别；(4)显式得分规模定律斜率信度低（Rβ=0.53），而潜在通用因子规模斜率高度稳定（Rg=0.97）。此外，区分了哪些基准受LLM规模影响、哪些受后训练实践影响。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能提供对基准动态的独特见解，并为判断基准排名可信度及改进基准设计提供可操作的诊断方法，从而帮助社区更准确地理解AI模型间的真实能力差异。

title: Courant: a State-Adaptive Perceiver-Based Neural Surrogate with Local Support and Interpretable Field Decomposition
summary: We introduce "Courant", a Perceiver-based encoder-processor-decoder surrogate model that has latent features exhibiting adaptive specialization and local support in the physical space, enabling functionality akin to an adaptive hp-refinement scheme, an attribute that is highly desirable in traditional numerical solvers and scientific machine learning broadly. The proposed architecture combines a shared random Fourier feature coordinate embedding, state-adapted latent queries, and a light-weight decoder. Courant is trained end-to-end with steady or transient simulation data and only a standard L_2 prediction loss in the physical space, achieving competitive accuracy on benchmarks. We demonstrate that Courant's inductive biases yield latents that are interpretable by design: they develop multiscale geometric specialization in the simulation domain and track coherent structures in the time-dependent case, acting analogously to time-evolving spatial basis functions and allowing for decoding a compact, geometry-anchored, partition-of-unity-like decomposition of the simulated field.

AI.tldr: Courant是一种基于Perceiver的编码器-处理器-解码器代理模型，其潜变量具有自适应特异性和物理空间中的局部支持，功能类似于自适应hp细化方案。模型结合了共享随机傅里叶特征坐标嵌入、状态自适应潜查询和轻量级解码器，仅使用标准L2损失训练，即可在基准测试中达到竞争性精度。其潜变量具有多尺度几何特异性和时间演化结构追踪能力，可解释为类似分区统一的模拟场分解。
AI.motivation: 开发一种代理模型，使其潜变量能够像传统数值求解器中的自适应hp细化方案一样，在物理空间中具有自适应特异性和局部支持，从而提升科学机器学习中代理模型的精度和可解释性。
AI.method: 采用Perceiver架构，结合共享随机傅里叶特征坐标嵌入、状态自适应潜查询和轻量级解码器，构建编码器-处理器-解码器框架。潜变量通过端到端训练，仅使用物理空间的标准L2预测损失进行优化。
AI.result: 在稳态和瞬态仿真数据基准测试中达到竞争性精度；潜变量发展出多尺度几何特异性，在时变情况下追踪相干结构，形成类似时间演化空间基函数的紧凑、几何锚定的分区统一分解。
AI.conclusion: Courant模型的设计使潜变量具有可解释性，其自适应特异性和局部支持特性使其在功能上等同于传统数值方法中的自适应hp细化，为科学机器学习提供了一种兼具精度和可解释性的代理建模方案。

title: Context-CoT: Enhancing Context Learning via High-Quality Reasoning Synthesis
summary: While LLMs excel at reasoning over prompts using static pretrained knowledge, they struggle significantly with context learning-the ability to dynamically extract, internalize, and apply new knowledge from complex, task-specific contexts. Recent evaluations on the CL-Bench reveal a critical capability gap: frontier models solve only 17.2% of context-dependent tasks on average.

AI.tldr: 论文指出LLMs在静态预训练知识推理上表现出色，但在动态上下文学习（从复杂任务特定语境中提取、内化并应用新知识）上存在显著能力差距，CL-Bench评估显示前沿模型平均仅能解决17.2%的上下文依赖任务。
AI.motivation: 揭示LLMs在上下文学习能力上的严重不足，指出仅依赖静态预训练知识无法应对需要动态知识提取和应用的复杂任务场景。
AI.method: 通过CL-Bench基准评估，定量分析前沿模型在上下文依赖任务上的表现。
AI.result: 前沿模型在CL-Bench上平均仅能解决17.2%的上下文依赖任务。
AI.conclusion: LLMs在上下文学习能力上存在关键能力缺口，需要在动态知识提取和应用方面进行改进。

title: Second Guess: Detecting Uncertainty Through Abstention and Answer Stability in Small Language Models
summary: Large language models often generate confident but incorrect answers rather than abstaining when uncertain. This problem is particularly acute for small language models (SLMs), where computational constraints and autonomous operation amplify the need for reliable uncertainty detection. We propose _Second Guess_, a lightweight, parameter-free prompting technique for abstention in multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) that is well-suited for SLMs. Our key empirical insight is that models which truly know an answer will select it consistently, while uncertain models exhibit unstable behavior when an ``I don't know'' option is added. Evaluated on four open models (2B-8B parameters) and four benchmarks, Second Guess achieves the highest composite risk improvement of 10.81\%. Notably, it maintains an 8\% composite risk improvement on fine-tuned models where entropy-based methods degrade, and improves most for lower-performing models. All code and results required to reproduce this work is available in https://github.com/Mystic-Slice/second-guess

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为"Second Guess"的轻量级、无参数提示技术，用于多选问答中的弃权判断，特别适合小语言模型。核心洞见是：真正知道答案的模型会一致选择，而不确定的模型在加入"我不知道"选项时会表现出不稳定行为。在4个开源模型(2B-8B参数)和4个基准上，该方法实现了10.81%的最高复合风险改善，在微调模型上仍保持8%的改善。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型常生成自信但错误的答案而非在不确定时弃权，这一问题在小语言模型中尤为严重，因其计算约束和自主运行需要更可靠的不确定性检测。
AI.method: 提出Second Guess方法，通过在多项选择问答中添加"我不知道"选项，观察模型回答的一致性来判断其是否真正知晓答案。该方法轻量级、无参数，特别适合小语言模型。
AI.result: 在4个开源模型(2B-8B参数)和4个基准上实现10.81%的最高复合风险改善；在微调模型上仍保持8%的复合风险改善；对性能较低的模型改善最为显著。
AI.conclusion: Second Guess是一种有效的轻量级不确定性检测方法，特别适合资源受限的小语言模型，在模型不确定时引导其弃权而非给出错误答案。

title: Optimizing Multidimensional Scaling in Gini Metric Spaces
summary: The Gini Multidimensional Scaling (Gini MDS) framework extends the Euclidean multidimensional scaling. We introduce a Gini pseudo-distance based on values and their ranks that depends on a fine-tunable hyperparameter. This pseudo-distance allows flexible exploration of latent configurations, enabling embeddings that best match observed dissimilarities. The Gini MDS is shown to be robust to noise and outliers, making it well-suited for real-world applications. We provide experiments on 16 UCI datasets with outliers and on MNIST images with noise to show that the Gini MDS outperforms the Euclidean MDS on noisy data. Finally, a tensor-based implementation in \texttt{PyTorch} provides GPU acceleration and efficient computation compared to the standard MDS of the \texttt{sklearn} library.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Gini多维缩放（Gini MDS）框架，通过引入基于值和秩的Gini伪距离（含可调超参数），实现对噪声和异常值的鲁棒嵌入。在16个UCI含异常值数据集和含噪声MNIST图像上的实验表明，Gini MDS优于欧氏MDS；基于PyTorch的张量实现相比sklearn标准MDS支持GPU加速且计算更高效。
AI.motivation: 传统欧氏MDS对噪声和异常值敏感，现实数据中常含噪声与异常值，亟需一种鲁棒的MDS变体来获得稳定的潜在配置嵌入。
AI.method: 提出Gini伪距离，该距离同时利用数值及其秩信息，通过可调超参数灵活控制；将其嵌入MDS框架替代传统欧氏距离，并以PyTorch张量运算实现GPU加速。
AI.result: 在16个UCI含异常值数据集和含噪声MNIST图像上，Gini MDS的嵌入质量优于欧氏MDS；PyTorch实现相比sklearn标准MDS计算效率更高。
AI.conclusion: Gini MDS是一种对噪声和异常值鲁棒的多维缩放方法，通过可调伪距离灵活探索潜在空间，且GPU加速实现具有实用优势。

title: Towards end-to-end LLM-based censoring-aware survival analysis
summary:
Objective: Survival analysis is central to medical prediction, yet large language models (LLMs) are rarely used as end-to-end survival models because censoring prevents straightforward supervised fine-tuning. Here we present LLMSurvival, a framework that enables censoring-aware survival analysis with unmodified LLMs operating directly on tabular clinical data.
  Materials and Methods: LLMSurvival reformulates time-to-event prediction as pairwise ranking among comparable subjects, and derives test-time risk by aggregating comparisons against anchor individuals from the training cohort.
  Results: Across two clinical tasks (ICU mortality prediction in MIMIC-IV and fragility fracture prediction in a NewYork-Presbyterian/Weill Cornell Medicine cohort), LLMSurvival improves overall concordance over Cox proportional hazards modeling by 3.1% for ICU mortality and 0.5% for fracture risk, 2.1% on average for ICU mortality and 2.8% for fracture risk over three established deep learning survival models.
  Discussion: The results show that survival modeling with censoring can be made compatible with LLM fine-tuning through comparison-based reformulation. The framework demonstrates high portability and superior performance over expert curated scores like SAPS-II and FRAX scores across diverse clinical context. Furthermore, the framework supports local deployment, as compact, publicly available base models provide sufficient performance.
  Conclusion: The LLMSurvival framework serves as a proof of concept for an integrated, censoring-conscious approach to survival analysis via LLMs.

AI.tldr: LLMSurvival是一个将大语言模型应用于生存分析的框架，通过将时间-事件预测重构为成对排序问题来处理删失数据，在ICU死亡率和骨折风险预测任务中优于传统Cox比例风险模型和深度学习生存模型。
AI.motivation: 生存分析在医学预测中至关重要，但由于删失数据的存在，大语言模型难以通过标准的监督微调直接作为端到端生存模型使用。
AI.method: 将时间-事件预测重构为可比受试者之间的成对排序问题，通过在训练队列中选取锚定个体进行比较来聚合风险评分，从而在测试时得出风险预测。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-IV ICU死亡率预测和骨折风险预测两个临床任务中，相比Cox比例风险模型，一致性指数分别提升3.1%和0.5%；相比三个成熟的深度学习生存模型，平均分别提升2.1%和2.8%。
AI.conclusion: LLMSurvival框架证明了通过基于比较的重构，可以实现在大语言模型中进行删失感知的生存分析，具有高可移植性、优于专家评分（如SAPS-II和FRAX）的性能，且支持在小型公开基础模型上本地部署。

title: Blocked Gibbs meets Diffusion Transformers: Unsupervised Learning for Constraint Optimization
summary: Diffusion models have shown promise in learning to solve constraint optimization problems. However, they are mostly restricted to problems with binary variables and rely on graph neural networks, hindering their application to a broader range of problems such as those with general discrete variables or constraint structures that necessitate global rather than local reasoning. We investigate the use of Diffusion Transformers to address the aforementioned limitations. A naive implementation performs poorly due to a fundamental mismatch between the standard diffusion process and constraint solving: while the former applies small, incremental denoising across all variables, the latter requires substantially altering specific subsets of variables to attain feasibility or optimality. Our method, Blocked Gibbs Diffusion Transformer (BloGDiT), is the first to address this limitation by replacing standard joint Gaussian denoising with blocked Gaussian denoising. BloGDiT uses iterative block resampling and anneals the block size over time to facilitate large, targeted edits within a block of variables. Across Sudoku, Graph Coloring, Maximum Independent Set, and MaxCut, BloGDiT matches or outperforms existing methods, demonstrating that blocked Gibbs-style diffusion provides a highly effective inductive bias for Transformer-based constraint satisfaction and optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BloGDiT，通过分块Gibbs去噪替代标准联合高斯去噪，解决了扩散模型在约束优化问题中无法处理非二元变量和全局推理的缺陷，在多个组合优化任务上达到或超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型在约束优化中局限于二元变量和GNN架构，难以处理一般离散变量或需要全局推理的约束结构。标准扩散过程渐进式微调所有变量，而约束求解需要大幅修改特定变量子集，存在根本性不匹配。
AI.method: 提出Blocked Gibbs Diffusion Transformer (BloGDiT)，用分块高斯去噪替代标准联合高斯去噪。通过迭代块重采样并随时间退火块大小，实现对变量块内的大幅定向编辑。
AI.result: 在Sudoku、Graph Coloring、Maximum Independent Set和MaxCut四个基准上，BloGDiT匹配或超越现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 分块Gibbs风格的扩散为基于Transformer的约束满足与优化提供了高效的归纳偏置。

title: CODESKILL: Learning Self-Evolving Skills for Coding Agents
summary: Coding agents produce rich trajectories while solving software-engineering tasks. To enable agent self-evolution, these trajectories can be distilled into reusable procedural skills that compactly encode experience to guide future behavior. However, existing skill construction and maintenance methods often rely on fixed prompts and heuristic update rules, leaving it unclear how knowledge should be selected, abstracted, and maintained to best serve downstream agents. We propose CODESKILL, an LLM-based framework that reformulates skill extraction and skill-bank maintenance as a learnable management policy. CODESKILL extracts multi-granularity procedural skills from coding-agent trajectories, evolves skills with new experience, and maintains a compact skill bank for future task solving. We train CODESKILL with reinforcement learning, using a hybrid reward that combines dense rubric-based skill-quality feedback with sparse verifiable execution feedback from the frozen downstream agent. Experiments on EnvBench, SWE-Bench Verified, and Terminal-Bench 2 show that CODESKILL improves average pass rate by 9.69 over the no-skill baseline and by 4.01 over the strongest prompt-based or memory baseline, while maintaining the skill bank at a stable size during iterative construction.

AI.tldr: 提出CODESKILL框架，通过强化学习训练技能提取和维护策略，从编码智能体轨迹中提取多粒度程序性技能，在三个基准测试上平均提升9.69%的通过率，并保持技能库规模稳定。
AI.motivation: 现有技能构建和维护方法依赖固定提示和启发式更新规则，不清楚如何选择、抽象和维护知识以最好地服务下游智能体，缺乏可学习的技能管理策略。
AI.method: 提出基于LLM的CODESKILL框架，将技能提取和技能库维护重构为可学习的管理策略。从编码智能体轨迹中提取多粒度程序性技能，进化新经验，维护紧凑技能库。使用强化学习训练，混合奖励结合密集的基于评分标准的技能质量反馈和稀疏的可验证执行反馈。
AI.result: 在EnvBench、SWE-Bench Verified和Terminal-Bench 2上，CODESKILL相比无技能基线平均提升9.69%通过率，相比最强基于提示或记忆基线提升4.01%，且技能库在迭代构建中保持稳定规模。
AI.conclusion: 可学习的技能管理策略优于固定启发式规则，能有效提升下游智能体任务解决能力并控制知识库规模。

title: Theoretical Analysis of Sparse Optimization with Reparameterization, Weight Decay, and Adaptive Learning Rate
summary: Sparse optimization is a fundamental challenge in various practical applications. A popular approach to sparse optimization is $\ell_p$ regularization. However, it may encounter optimization instability due to the unbounded gradients when $0<p<1$. In this paper, we introduce a novel approach to sparse optimization termed ReWA, based on Reparameterization, Weight decay, and Adaptive learning rate. ReWA is closely connected to $\ell_p$-regularization, yet it unveils a distinct optimization landscape that helps mitigate instability issues. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet with ResNets demonstrate that ReWA leads to significant sparsity improvements over the $\ell_1$-regularization approach while preserving test accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReWA方法，通过重参数化、权重衰减和自适应学习率解决ℓ_p正则化（0<p<1）在稀疏优化中的梯度不稳定问题，在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上相比ℓ_1正则化显著提升稀疏性且不损失测试精度。
AI.motivation: ℓ_p正则化（0<p<1）在稀疏优化中因梯度无界导致优化不稳定，亟需一种既能保持稀疏性又能避免该问题的新方法。
AI.method: 提出ReWA框架，结合重参数化（Reparameterization）、权重衰减（Weight decay）和自适应学习率（Adaptive learning rate），构建与ℓ_p正则化紧密相关但具有更稳定优化景观的目标函数。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上使用ResNet进行实验，ReWA相比ℓ_1正则化显著提升稀疏性，同时保持测试精度不变。
AI.conclusion: ReWA通过改变优化景观有效缓解了低阶ℓ_p正则化的不稳定性问题，是一种既稀疏又稳定的优化方法。

title: Security of OpenClaw Agents: Fundamentals, Attacks, and Countermeasures
summary: The rapid evolution of large language model (LLM)-driven autonomous agents has given rise to OpenClaw, a new class of open-source agent frameworks that operate as continuously running, skill-augmented systems with persistent memory, multi-channel interaction, and high degrees of autonomy. Such capabilities enable OpenClaw agents to autonomously execute complex, multi-step tasks and interact seamlessly with external applications, but simultaneously introduce a substantially enlarged attack surface. In particular, the combination of high-privilege operations and persistent memory exposes OpenClaw agents to various emerging threats, including skill poisoning, cognitive manipulation, multi-agent cascading failures, and supply-chain vulnerabilities. In this survey, we present a comprehensive study of the security landscape of OpenClaw agents. We first examine the general architecture and key characteristics that distinguish OpenClaw agents from traditional AI agent systems. We categorize existing security and privacy threats into a layered framework and analyze how vulnerabilities arise during agent reasoning, action execution, and external interaction. Representative defense mechanisms are also reviewed to draw the current defense landscape. Finally, several unresolved issues related to the reliability and trustworthiness of OpenClaw ecosystems are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了由大语言模型驱动的开源自主智能体（OpenClaw）的安全与隐私问题，包括其架构特性、威胁分类、防御机制及未解决的信任挑战。
AI.motivation: LLM驱动的自主智能体（OpenClaw）具有持续运行、技能增强、持久记忆、多通道交互和高自主性等能力，但同时也带来了显著扩大的攻击面，亟需对其安全威胁进行系统梳理和防御研究。
AI.method: 通过分析OpenClaw智能体与传统AI智能体的架构差异，将安全与隐私威胁分类为分层框架，从推理、动作执行和外部交互三个层面分析漏洞成因，并梳理现有防御机制。
AI.result: 识别出技能投毒、认知操纵、多智能体级联故障和供应链漏洞等新兴威胁，总结了当前针对这些威胁的防御手段，并指出OpenClaw生态系统在可靠性和可信度方面仍存在若干未解决问题。
AI.conclusion: OpenClaw智能体在带来强大自主能力的同时，其安全挑战严峻且多样化，现有防御尚不完善，需在可靠性、可信度和供应链安全等方面进一步研究和治理。

title: ASTRO: Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Reinforcement Optimization for GNN Powered Anomly Detection in Cyber Physical Systems
summary: Anomaly detection in Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) environments is essential to protect the Industrial Control Systems (ICS) and Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) from occuring run time false data injection and other malicious attacks. The increasing complexity of sensor networks and interconnected control loops makes it difficult to identify anomalous behavior hidden within high-dimensional and time-dependent signals. To address these challenges, this article introduces Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Reinforcement Optimization ASTRO (ASTRO), a novel anomaly detection framework that pioneers the use of reinforcement learning for dynamic threshold optimization. By integrating a Deep Q-Network (DQN) with Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), temporal modelling and a Multi-Head Attention mechanism, ASTRO continuously adapts its decision boundaries to improve detection accuracy. The GNN component models the spatial relations among sensors, Temporal model captures time series dependencies and the attention layer highlights most informative time steps. The model generates continuous anomaly scores, which are transformed into binary decisions using an adaptive threshold, optimized via a Deep Q-Network (DQN). The ASTRO approach is evaluated on two real world industrial benchmarks: the Secure Water Treatment (SWaT) and Water Distribution (WADI) datasets. The proposed model achieves an exceptional performance on the SWaT with F1 score of 0.990. Moreover, on highly complex 127 end devices WADI dataset, it secures F1 score of 0.788, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines by nearly 14%. Results across multiple runs confirm consistent generalization and stability. These experiments demonstrate that the ASTRO framework is highly practical and scalable method for strengthening the large scale cyber physical infrastructures

AI.tldr: 本文提出ASTRO框架，利用深度Q网络（DQN）结合图神经网络（GNN）、时间建模和多头注意力机制，实现工业物联网环境中异常检测的动态阈值优化。在SWaT和WADI数据集上分别取得0.990和0.788的F1分数，在WADI上超越基线方法约14%。
AI.motivation: 工业物联网环境中的异常检测对保护工业控制系统和网络物理系统至关重要。随着传感器网络和控制回路的日益复杂，隐藏在高维、时间依赖信号中的异常行为难以识别，现有方法在动态阈值优化方面存在不足。
AI.method: ASTRO框架将深度Q网络（DQN）与图神经网络（GNN）、时序建模模块和多头注意力机制集成。GNN建模传感器空间关系，时序模型捕获时间序列依赖，注意力层突出信息量最大的时间步。模型生成连续异常分数后，通过DQN优化自适应阈值，将连续分数转化为二元检测结果。
AI.result: 在SWaT数据集上取得0.990的F1分数；在包含127个终端设备的复杂WADI数据集上取得0.788的F1分数，超越最先进基线方法约14%。多次运行结果验证了模型的一致泛化能力和稳定性。
AI.conclusion: ASTRO框架是一种高度实用且可扩展的方法，适用于大规模网络物理基础设施的异常检测，在复杂工业环境中表现出优异的检测性能和稳定性。

title: A Signal-Language Foundation Model for Broad-Spectrum Cardiovascular Assessment from Routine Electrocardiography
summary: Electrocardiography (ECG) is central to cardiovascular care, but conventional AI models are often restricted to common arrhythmias and may generalize poorly across populations or clinically subtle diseases. We developed ECG Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (ECGCLIP), a signal-language contrastive learning framework that aligns ECG waveforms with expert diagnostic reports. ECGCLIP was pre-trained on 2,837,962 ECG studies from 1,324,856 patients and evaluated on a held-out internal test set plus nine independent external cohorts comprising about 1.5 million ECGs. Evaluation covered 89 downstream tasks, including 45 ECG diagnoses, 39 echocardiographic targets, and 5 rare cardiac diseases, using PRAUC as the primary metric. ECGCLIP consistently improved performance over random initialization and Merl-R18 baselines. On the internal test set, ECGCLIP-R34 achieved strong performance for atrial fibrillation (PRAUC 0.900) and ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (PRAUC 0.383), with robust generalization across all external cohorts. It also improved low-prevalence and diagnostically elusive diseases, including Ebstein anomaly, constrictive pericarditis, dextrocardia, and cardiac amyloidosis, with internal PRAUC values of 0.253, 0.175, 0.121, and 0.201, respectively. ECGCLIP was data efficient, matching or exceeding full-dataset baseline performance with only 10% of training data. Feature visualization and saliency analysis suggested clinically meaningful representations aligned with established electrocardiographic criteria. These findings indicate that large-scale ECG-report contrastive pre-training can expand routine ECG interpretation beyond common arrhythmias toward broad cardiovascular assessment and opportunistic screening of echocardiographic and rare conditions.

AI.tldr: ECGCLIP是一个基于对比学习的信号-语言预训练框架，通过将ECG波形与专家诊断报告对齐，在约283万份ECG研究上预训练，在89个下游任务（含45种ECG诊断、39种超声心动图目标、5种罕见心脏病）中超越基线，对房颤（PRAUC 0.900）和STEMI（PRAUC 0.383）表现优异，并显著提升了低患病率疾病（如Ebstein畸形、缩窄性心包炎等）的诊断性能，仅需10%训练数据即可达到全量数据基线水平。
AI.motivation: 传统AI心电模型局限于常见心律失常，泛化能力差，难以处理临床细微差异和罕见疾病，亟需一种能够广泛覆盖心血管评估并能泛化到多种临床场景的AI框架。
AI.method: 提出ECGCLIP（心电图对比语言-图像预训练）框架，采用信号-语言对比学习，将ECG波形与专家诊断报告进行对齐；在2,837,962份ECG研究、1,324,856名患者上预训练，并在1个内部测试集和9个独立外部队列（约150万份ECG）上评估，覆盖89个下游任务。
AI.result: ECGCLIP-R34在内部测试集上对房颤PRAUC达0.900，STEMI达0.383；对低患病率疾病如Ebstein畸形(0.253)、缩窄性心包炎(0.175)、右位心(0.121)、心脏淀粉样变性(0.201)均有提升；仅用10%训练数据即可匹配或超越全量数据基线性能；特征可视化和显著性分析显示模型学习到了符合心电学标准的临床有意义的表征。
AI.conclusion: 大规模ECG-报告对比预训练能够将常规ECG解读从常见心律失常扩展到广泛的心血管评估，包括超声心动图目标和罕见病的机会性筛查，展现出数据高效性和强大的泛化能力。

title: Abduction-Deduction Entanglement: Domain Generalization via Representation Transplants
summary: Prediction models trained under the source distribution do not generalize well to a different target distribution. A valid inference about an unseen data distribution must be anchored by the invariance of certain causal mechanisms that generate the source and target data, however, these structural invariances are non-identifiable from the source data alone. Under mild causal assumptions about the data, we show that the optimal prediction in the target is in fact partially identifiable by the source distribution. The result rests on a simple observation: In any domain, the optimal prediction can be factorized into what we call a pair of abduction and deduction maps, where the abduction map makes inference about some unobserved variables (possibly confounders) from the observed variables and the deduction map predicts the label using both the observed and inferred quantities. Access to large source data pins down the optimal prediction, thus constrains the valid abduction-deduction ensembles that produce it -- a non-identifiability that we call the abduction-deduction entanglement. To leverage this, we parameterize the constrained family using what we call a representation transplant, that is a specific linear transformation in the representation space that manipulates the abduction content of the representation while retaining the deduction component. Invariance of the causal mechanism generating the label implies existence of an invariant deduction map between source and target. Thus, we can search the space of plausible target distributions via a parametric transplant. We use this scheme in a learner-adversary game that, under an idealistic optimization, provably terminates with the learner having the minimax-optimal target prediction. Evaluations verify the theory, showing that the method is competitive in DG benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于因果不变性的方法，通过“表示移植”（representation transplant）技术，在源分布上学习到的预测模型能够泛化到目标分布，解决分布偏移下的域泛化问题。
AI.motivation: 在源分布上训练的预测模型通常无法泛化到不同的目标分布。虽然因果机制的不变性是跨域泛化的理论基础，但仅从源数据中无法识别这些结构不变性，因此需要一种能够利用源数据部分识别目标最优预测的方法。
AI.method: 将最优预测分解为溯因映射（abduction map）和演绎映射（deduction map），利用源数据约束有效的溯因-演绎组合（非可识别性称为溯因-演绎纠缠）。通过表示移植（线性变换）参数化约束族，操纵表示中的溯因内容而保留演绎成分。利用标签生成机制的跨域不变性，在源和目标之间搜索不变演绎映射，通过学习者-对手博弈实现极小极大最优目标预测。
AI.result: 理论证明在理想优化下该方法能收敛到极小极大最优目标预测。实验验证了理论，在域泛化基准测试中表现具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 在温和因果假设下，目标域的最优预测可由源分布部分识别。提出的表示移植方法能有效利用这一部分可识别性，实现跨域泛化。

title: ATWL: A Formal Language for Representing, Comparing, and Reusing Visual Analytics Workflows
summary: Visual analytics (VA) workflows are inherently complex, involving data transformation, feature engineering, visual representation, and human interpretation. They are typically described in unstructured prose, hindering systematic comparison, reuse of proven strategies, and training of novices. We present Artifact-Transform Workflow Language (ATWL), a domain-agnostic, declarative language that formally represents VA workflows by capturing their structure and underlying analytical intent. ATWL is built upon a modular ontology of eight artifact types (entities, features, arrangements, visualisations, patterns, models, knowledge, specifications) and transforms characterised by standardised intents (e.g., define-unit, characterise, contextualise, abstract). To show that formalisation effort need not impede adoption, we extract workflows from research papers through supervised interaction with LLM agents, reducing the human role to review and refinement. Using this process, we constructed a library of seventeen ATWL workflows from published VA papers. Cross-workflow analysis reveals structural regularities -- a recurrent meta-structure, recurring motifs, reusable building blocks, diverse iterative strategies, and cross-domain equivalences -- that remain invisible in prose. We further evaluate practical utility through a controlled experiment in which the same LLM addressed two analytical problems with the library supplied either as original papers or as ATWL representations. Both forms enabled useful recommendations, but the formal representation systematically added explicit iteration structure, typed data flow, fragment-level adaptation provenance, and compactness supporting scaling beyond what prose libraries can fit in an LLM's context. ATWL enables a transition from narrative descriptions to formally represented, comparable, and reusable analytical knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ATWL（Artifact-Transform Workflow Language），一种领域无关的声明式语言，用于形式化表示可视化分析工作流的结构和分析意图。通过LLM辅助从论文中提取工作流，构建了17个ATWL工作流库。跨工作流分析揭示了结构规律性（元结构、重复模式、可复用构建块、迭代策略和跨领域等价性）。对照实验表明，ATWL相比纯文本在提供迭代结构、类型化数据流、片段级改编溯源和上下文紧凑性方面更具优势，促进了从叙事描述向形式化、可比较、可复用的分析知识转变。
AI.motivation: 可视化分析工作流通常以非结构化散文描述，阻碍了系统比较、策略复用和新手培训。需要一种形式化表示方法来捕获工作流结构和分析意图，以支持知识的可比较性和可复用性。
AI.method: 设计ATWL语言，基于八种工件类型（实体、特征、排列、可视化、模式、模型、知识、规范）和标准化意图的变换，通过LLM代理从研究论文中提取工作流，人工仅负责审查和完善，构建工作流库，并通过对照实验评估实用价值。
AI.result: 构建了17个ATWL工作流，揭示了散文中不可见的元结构、重复模式、可复用构建块、迭代策略和跨领域等价性。对照实验显示ATWL形式化表示在迭代结构明确性、类型化数据流、片段级改编溯源和上下文紧凑性方面优于纯文本。
AI.conclusion: ATWL实现了从叙事描述到形式化、可比较、可复用的分析知识的转变，其形式化努力可通过LLM辅助降低门槛，为VA工作流的系统比较、复用和教学提供了可行方案。

title: AME-TS: Anchored Mixture-of-Experts for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Time series forecasting models are increasingly scaled through large Transformer backbones, yet most existing approaches process all series through a shared dense computation path despite substantial heterogeneity in temporal structure. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) offers a natural alternative by enabling conditional computation, but standard MoE routing leaves expert specialization weakly identified and often unstable during downstream adaptation. We propose AME-TS, a structure-guided sparse time series foundation model that aligns expert routing with interpretable temporal structure. AME-TS first uses a lightweight regime predictor to estimate series-level descriptors, including forecastability, seasonality, trend, and sparsity, and maps them to a soft structural prior over experts. This series-level prior guides token-level routing during training, encouraging structure-aligned specialization. On the GIFT-Eval benchmark, AME-TS delivers a strong accuracy-efficiency tradeoff across model scales: it substantially outperforms existing time series foundation models at small model scales and remains competitive with the strongest models at larger scales, while activating substantially fewer parameters through sparse routing. We further show that AME-TS learns more interpretable routing geometry and substantially more stable expert specialization than standard MoE during fine-tuning on the M5 dataset. These results suggest that structure-aware routing is an effective and reliable way to realize the benefits of sparse expert models for time series forecasting.

AI.tldr: 提出AME-TS，一种结构引导的稀疏时间序列基础模型，通过将专家路由与可解释的时间结构（可预测性、季节性、趋势、稀疏性）对齐，在GIFT-Eval基准上实现了优异的精度-效率权衡，并展现出比标准MoE更稳定、更可解释的专家专业化。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列预测模型通过大型Transformer扩展，但所有序列共享同一密集计算路径，忽略了时间结构的异质性；标准MoE路由虽然能实现条件计算，但专家专业化弱且下游微调时不稳定。
AI.method: AME-TS首先使用轻量级状态预测器估计序列级描述符（可预测性、季节性、趋势、稀疏性），将其映射为专家软结构先验，进而引导token级路由训练，实现结构对齐的专家专业化。
AI.result: 在GIFT-Eval基准上，AME-TS在不同模型规模下均展现出优异的精度-效率权衡：小规模时显著优于现有时间序列基础模型，大规模时与最强模型竞争力相当，同时通过稀疏路由激活更少参数。在M5数据集微调时，路由几何更可解释，专家专业化比标准MoE更稳定。
AI.conclusion: 结构感知的路由是实现稀疏专家模型在时间序列预测中优势的有效且可靠方式。

title: Credit Assignment with Resets in Language Model Reasoning
summary: Contemporary reinforcement learning with verifiable reward methods post-train language models on multi-step reasoning by assigning a single outcome reward uniformly across all tokens in a trajectory. Such uniform assignment ignores which steps contributed to success or failure. Improving credit assignment can address this limitation by enabling targeted refinement of faulty reasoning steps, rather than updating entire trajectories uniformly. Resets are one such simple mechanism, enabling more precise credit assignment by returning to an intermediate state and resampling counterfactual continuations, so that outcome differences can be attributed to decisions made at that point. We propose two such methods: Random-Reset Policy Optimization (RRPO), where reset states are drawn randomly from reasoning steps, and Self-Reset Policy Optimization (SRPO), where the model self-localizes the erroneous step in an incorrect trajectory and resets there. We analyze these methods within the Conservative Policy Iteration (CPI) framework. Extending CPI with a credit-assignment oracle that targets improvable states yields provable improvements over random resets. Across models and reasoning benchmarks, SRPO consistently outperforms standard GRPO and RRPO by sampling multiple suffix continuations at a self-localized reset and learning from their rewards, using only the model itself with no external supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种基于重置的强化学习方法（RRPO和SRPO）来改进语言模型多步推理中的信用分配问题，其中SRPO通过模型自定位错误步骤并重采样后续轨迹，在多个推理基准上优于标准GRPO方法。
AI.motivation: 现有带可验证奖励的强化学习方法在多步推理中对所有token分配统一的结果奖励，忽略了各步骤对成功或失败的贡献，导致信用分配不精确。
AI.method: 提出Random-Reset Policy Optimization (RRPO) 和 Self-Reset Policy Optimization (SRPO) 两种方法。RRPO从推理步骤中随机抽取重置状态；SRPO让模型自我定位错误步骤并在此重置。在Conservative Policy Iteration (CPI)框架下分析，扩展CPI引入信用分配oracle可证明改进。
AI.result: 在多个模型和推理基准上，SRPO通过自定位重置点采样多个后缀延续并从中学习奖励，一致优于标准GRPO和RRPO，且无需外部监督。
AI.conclusion: 通过重置机制实现更精确的信用分配，尤其SRPO的自定位能力能有效改进错误推理步骤，提升多步推理性能。

title: What Gets Cited: Competitive GEO in AI Answer Engines
summary: AI answer engines generate answers from retrieved pages but cite only a few sources. This makes visibility depend not just on ranking, but on being cited. We study competitive Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): when two retrieved candidates compete, what makes one more likely to be cited first? We build a controlled two-document retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) testbed that injects exactly two candidate sources into the model context and measures which source is referenced by the first citation marker in the output. Across six LLMs we execute 252,000 trials, repeated paired comparisons under one factorial program over 18 content factors. In each trial the two sources differ in exactly one factor; we use brand anonymization and counterbalanced source order to separate content effects from position bias. Mixed-effects models show that topical relevance and list position are the biggest drivers of being cited first. Including explicit price information and a recent timestamp also helps consistently. Completeness and trust cues add smaller gains, while formatting-only edits have little impact. We release a reproducible evaluation protocol and a prioritized GEO checklist for practitioners, and we exercised it in an early internal pilot at Sprinklr, where teams reported positive qualitative feedback on workflow usability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了生成式搜索引擎优化（GEO）中，当两个检索候选来源竞争时，哪些因素决定哪个来源被AI答案引擎优先引用。通过构建受控双文档RAG测试平台，在六个LLM上执行252,000次试验，发现主题相关性和列表位置是最大驱动因素，价格信息和时效性也有帮助，格式编辑影响最小。
AI.motivation: AI答案引擎从检索页面生成答案但仅引用少数来源，导致可见性不仅取决于排名，还取决于是否被引用。因此需要系统研究生成式搜索引擎优化（GEO）中影响被引用优先级的因素。
AI.method: 构建受控双文档RAG测试平台，向模型上下文中注入恰好两个候选来源，测量输出中第一个引用标记引用了哪个来源。在六个LLM上执行252,000次试验，进行成对比较，采用18个内容因素的析因设计。每次试验两个来源仅在一个因素上不同，使用品牌匿名化和反平衡源顺序分离内容效应和位置偏差。使用混合效应模型分析。
AI.result: 主题相关性和列表位置是被优先引用的最大驱动因素；包含明确价格信息和近期时间戳也有一致帮助；完整性和信任线索增加较小收益；仅格式编辑影响甚微。
AI.conclusion: 提供了可复现的评估协议和优先级的GEO检查清单供实践者使用，并在Sprinklr内部初步试用中获得积极的定性反馈。

title: Grow-Prune-Freeze Networks: Adaptive & Continual Learning Technique for Olfactory Navigation
summary: Training data for olfaction is scattered through disparate, non-standardized datasets that limit the ability to build representative world models. Olfactory navigation is a highly dynamic and non-stationary task that benefits from real-time continual learning. We introduce an adaptive framework called Grow-Prune-Freeze (GPF) networks that enable an agent to continually learn through growing, pruning, and freezing early layers of its policy in response to world complexity. Grounding GPFs in non-linear random matrix theory, we show that the work of Pennington & Worth (2017) can be extended from single hidden layers to n-layer continual-learning models, and that eigenvalue composition of network weights is preserved as successive layers are added. We show that GPFs based on Expected SARSA achieve a 94% success rate on turbulent plume navigation - a partially observable, non-stationary task representative of the "big world" challenges that motivate adaptive learning in robotics - and provide supporting methodology for applying GPFs in other world models. Further experiments amount evidence that GPFs may generalize well to other machine learning tasks such as reinforcement learning in Atari, image classification, and autoregressive language models. We open source all code and data to encourage improvements on and more research in olfactory robotics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Grow-Prune-Freeze (GPF)网络，一种在动态非平稳任务（如嗅觉导航）中实现智能体持续学习的自适应框架。基于非线性随机矩阵理论扩展了Pennington & Worth (2017)的工作，证明了网络权重特征值在逐层添加时的保持性。基于Expected SARSA的GPF在湍流羽流导航任务上达到94%的成功率，并展示了在Atari强化学习、图像分类和自回归语言模型上的泛化潜力。
AI.motivation: 嗅觉训练数据分散在非标准化的数据集中，限制了代表性世界模型的构建；嗅觉导航是高度动态和非平稳的任务，需要实时持续学习能力。
AI.method: 提出GPF（Grow-Prune-Freeze）自适应网络框架：通过增长、剪枝和冻结策略网络早期层来实现持续学习。将非线性随机矩阵理论从单隐层扩展到n层持续学习模型。
AI.result: 基于Expected SARSA的GPF在湍流羽流导航任务上达到94%的成功率；在Atari、图像分类和自回归语言模型上展现出良好的泛化表现。
AI.conclusion: GPF为嗅觉机器人及其他需要自适应学习的领域提供了一种有效的持续学习框架，且具有良好的泛化能力；代码和数据已开源以促进该领域研究。

title: StructBreak: Structural Cognitive Overload-Induced Safety Failures in MLLMs
comment: 23 pages; accepted to Findings of ACL 2026. This paper contains examples of harmful content
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel at structural reasoning yet suffer from a sharp logical brittleness in structural consistency. We term this phenomenon Structural Cognitive Overload (SCO), a byproduct of the contention between deep reasoning and safety alignment. However, prior work has predominantly targeted typographic and pixel-level perturbations, leaving the study of SCO largely unexplored. To this end, we propose StructBreak, an automated end-to-end framework designed to quantify SCO. By leveraging StructBreak, we uncover a novel higher-order cognitive overload attack paradigm; notably, this attack operates under a practical black-box setting, requiring no internal model access. Consequently, we utilize this framework to establish a comprehensive benchmark spanning ten diverse threat scenarios. Empirical evaluations on six leading MLLMs reveal that SCO readily triggers toxic generation, yielding a 92% average ASR (up to 97% on Gemini 2.5). To elucidate the mechanism of SCO, we further conduct model-level interpretations spanning attention dynamics, latent space topology, and geometric analysis. Our findings reveal that StructBreak acts as a novel structural channel to circumvent safety filters. Furthermore, the limited efficacy of inherent safety mechanisms underscores that current alignment paradigms are insufficient for the era of complex multimodal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出StructBreak框架，揭示了多模态大语言模型在结构推理中存在"结构认知过载"(SCO)现象，该现象源于深度推理与安全对齐之间的冲突。StructBreak是一种自动化黑盒攻击框架，能在无需模型内部访问权限的情况下触发有害生成，在六个主流MLLM上平均攻击成功率达92%（Gemini 2.5上高达97%）。研究通过注意力动态、潜在空间拓扑和几何分析揭示了SCO机制，表明现有安全对齐范式不足以应对复杂多模态推理时代。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注字形和像素级扰动，而对结构推理中的认知过载（SCO）现象缺乏系统研究。作者旨在量化并揭示多模态大语言模型中深度推理与安全对齐之间的根本性冲突。
AI.method: 提出StructBreak，一个自动化端到端框架，通过在黑盒设置下构造结构性扰动来量化SCO。利用该框架建立涵盖10种威胁场景的基准，并在6个主流MLLM上评估。此外，通过注意力动态、潜在空间拓扑和几何分析进行模型级解释。
AI.result: StructBreak在六个主流MLLM上平均ASR达92%，Gemini 2.5上高达97%。模型级分析表明StructBreak通过新的结构通道绕过安全过滤器。
AI.conclusion: 当前安全对齐范式在复杂多模态推理场景下存在根本性不足，SCO是安全对齐与深度推理之间冲突的产物，亟需新的安全机制应对。

title: Directional Alignment Mitigates Reward Hacking in Reinforcement Learning for Language Models
summary: Reward hacking arises when a model improves a proxy reward by exploiting shortcuts rather than solving the intended task. We study this failure mode through the geometry of reinforcement learning updates in language models and argue that hacking emerges when optimization drifts away from a stable low-dimensional learning trajectory. We analyze this drift through dominant singular directions of parameter updates and show that reward-hacking runs exhibit substantially larger directional change than clean runs. Motivated by this observation, we introduce trusted-direction projection, which constrains gradients to remain within a clean reference subspace. Across reward-hacking experiments on mathematical reasoning, the proposed approach delays shortcut exploitation and better preserves task performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过强化学习更新的几何分析，发现奖励黑客（reward hacking）源于优化偏离稳定的低维学习轨迹，并提出通过信任方向投影（trusted-direction projection）将梯度约束在干净参考子空间内，从而延迟捷径利用并保持任务性能。
AI.motivation: 研究奖励黑客（reward hacking）这一失败模式，即模型通过利用捷径而非解决目标任务来提升代理奖励分数的问题。
AI.method: 通过参数更新的主导奇异方向分析优化漂移，提出信任方向投影（trusted-direction projection），将梯度约束在干净参考子空间内。
AI.result: 奖励黑客实验在数学推理任务中表现出显著更大的方向性变化；所提方法能够延迟捷径利用并更好地保持任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 奖励黑客源于优化偏离稳定低维学习轨迹，信任方向投影能有效缓解该问题。

title: Personalize-then-Store: Benchmarking and Learning Personalized Memory for Long-horizon Agents
summary: Existing large language model (LLM) based memory systems apply universal, static policies that overlook a fundamental reality: the contexts that are worth storing in memory are different across users. This misalignment wastes limited memory budget on transient interactions while failing to preserve critical context for long horizon tasks. To address this gap, we investigate an underexplored question: can LLM based memory systems learn personalized memory policies? We introduce PerMemBench, the first benchmark for evaluating personalized memory systems, featuring multi year, multi domain interaction histories across diverse user personas. We further present the first empirical study of memory personalization, proposing session level storage gating, a lightweight framework that selectively bypasses memory operations for transient sessions. Our study confirms that personalization yields substantial retention gains under perfect gating, yet reveals that accurate gating remains an open and critical challenge.

AI.tldr: 现有基于LLM的记忆系统采用通用静态策略，忽略了不同用户需要存储不同上下文这一基本事实。本文提出PerMemBench基准和会话级存储门控框架，首次探索记忆个性化，发现个性化能显著提升保留效果，但精确门控仍是开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的记忆系统对所有用户采用统一、静态的策略，没有考虑不同用户值得存储的上下文各不相同，导致有限记忆被浪费在短暂交互上，同时无法保留长期任务所需的关键上下文。
AI.method: 提出PerMemBench基准（包含多年、多领域的跨用户交互历史）和会话级存储门控（session-level storage gating）轻量框架，通过选择性绕过短暂会话的记忆操作实现个性化。
AI.result: 在完美门控条件下，个性化能带来显著的保留增益；但精确门控仍然是一个开放且关键的挑战。
AI.conclusion: 记忆个性化是提升LLM记忆系统效率的重要方向，但如何实现准确的门控决策仍需进一步研究。

title: Localization then Neutralization: Gradient-guided Token Suppression against Visual Prompt Injection Attack
summary: Adversarial images pose a severe security threat to multimodal large language models through prompt injection. Existing defenses largely lack a principled understanding of the underlying mechanisms and struggle to balance efficiency and defense utility. In this work, we show that successful adversarial attacks do not rely on the entire image uniformly but instead depend on a small subset of critical image tokens. Based on this insight, we propose Gradient Token Masking (GTM), which localizes these tokens via gradient analysis and neutralizes them through masking. We find that attribution based on the first generated token's output probability fails when attacks preserve the predicted token. To overcome this, GTM utilizes the Hidden-State Gradient Norm score for generation-influence attribution under adversarial inputs. We prove that its ranking is consistent with that of the full adversarial loss gradient, providing a theoretical guarantee for accurate localization. Our method requires only a single forward-backward pass to identify and zero out a small number of high-scoring tokens, effectively disrupting the adversarial attack path. Extensive experiments on prompt injection and multimodal jailbreak attacks demonstrate that our approach reduces attack success rates (ASR) to near zero while preserving model utility with negligible computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出梯度令牌掩码方法(GTM)，基于对抗攻击仅依赖少量关键图像令牌的发现，通过梯度分析定位并遮蔽这些令牌，以接近零的攻击成功率防御多模态大语言模型上的提示注入和越狱攻击，同时保持模型效用和极低计算开销。
AI.motivation: 对抗图像对多模态大语言模型构成严重安全威胁，现有防御缺乏对底层机制的原则性理解，且在效率和防御效用之间难以平衡。
AI.method: 提出梯度令牌掩码(GTM)，利用隐态梯度范数分数进行生成影响归因，通过单次前向-反向传播识别并清零少量高分令牌，理论证明其排序与完整对抗损失梯度一致。
AI.result: 在提示注入和多模态越狱攻击上，GTM将攻击成功率降至接近零，同时保持模型效用，计算开销可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: 对抗攻击仅依赖少量关键图像令牌，GTM通过精确定位并遮蔽这些令牌可有效防御，且具有理论保证和高效性。

title: ADMFormer: An Adaptive-Decomposition Transformer with Time-Varying Masked Spatial Attention for Traffic Forecasting
summary: Accurate traffic forecasting is essential for intelligent transportation systems, supporting a wide range of real-world applications. However, it remains challenging due to two key factors:~(1) Traffic series contain heterogeneous temporal patterns, where stable periodic regularities coexist with event-driven fluctuations. Existing methods often treat them within a unified representation, limiting their ability to capture fine-grained temporal dynamics.~(2)Spatial dependencies among nodes are inherently dynamic and sparse, while dense all-pairs attention often introduces redundant interactions and amplifies noise. To address these issues, we propose ADMFormer, an Adaptive-Decomposition Transformer with Time-Varying Masked Spatial Attention. Specifically, ADMFormer first employs a time-node adaptive gating mechanism to decouple traffic signals into dominant regularities and residual fluctuations that vary across time and nodes. A dual-branch temporal module is then designed to separately capture global periodic dependencies and high-frequency irregular variations from these two decomposed components. Furthermore, ADMFormer introduces a time-varying masked spatial attention that sparsifies spatial interactions based on real-time traffic states, thereby effectively preserving dynamic and informative dependencies. Extensive experiments on four real-world datasets demonstrate that ADMFormer achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 提出ADMFormer，通过自适应分解机制将交通信号解耦为稳定周期规律与残差波动，并采用时变掩码空间注意力实现动态稀疏的空间依赖建模，在四个真实数据集上达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有交通预测方法将交通序列中的稳定周期规律与事件驱动波动统一表示，难以捕捉细粒度时间动态；且全对注意力机制引入冗余交互并放大噪声，无法有效处理动态稀疏的空间依赖。
AI.method: (1) 时间-节点自适应门控机制将交通信号解耦为主导规律与残差波动；(2) 双分支时间模块分别捕获全局周期依赖与高频不规则变化；(3) 时变掩码空间注意力基于实时交通状态稀疏化空间交互。
AI.result: 在四个真实数据集上达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: ADMFormer通过自适应分解与动态稀疏注意力有效解决了交通预测中异质时间模式与动态空间依赖的挑战。

title: Hide to Guide: Learning via Semantic Masking
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a powerful paradigm for improving language models on reasoning-intensive tasks, but its effectiveness is often limited by exploration. For example, models often fail on hard problems, leaving little useful reward signal. External expert traces offer a natural source of guidance, yet they may also expose reward-relevant content along the critical path to the verifier target, such as final answers, intermediate values, executable implementations, or answer-related entities. This content can create an unintended reward hacking channel, allowing the policy to obtain reward by copying the trace rather than learning the underlying reasoning or agentic behavior. Existing guided-RL methods reduce this risk by using partial trajectories, but they mainly control how much expert information is shown heuristically rather than which parts should be hidden. To this end, we propose Semantic Masked Expert Policy Optimization (SMEPO), a fine-grained semantic masking strategy for expert-guided RLVR. Instead of truncating traces coarsely or revealing them unchanged, SMEPO masks reward-relevant semantic spans along the critical path while preserving the expert's decomposition, plan, and procedural structure. This turns hard problems from reasoning from scratch into a fill-in-the-blank process: the policy can follow the expert's problem-solving route, but must still reconstruct the missing values, code, or entities by itself. SMEPO is simple to apply and requires no changes to the reward function or RL objective. Across diverse domains, including math, code, and agentic search, SMEPO improves accuracy by up to 3.2 points over GRPO and reduces training time by up to 4.2x. The code is available at https://github.com/mit-han-lab/SMEPO.

AI.tldr: 提出SMEPO，一种细粒度语义掩码策略，用于专家引导的RLVR训练。通过掩码奖励相关的语义片段（如最终答案、中间值、代码等），迫使模型跟随专家的解题路径但自行重构关键内容，从而避免奖励黑客行为。在数学、代码和智能体搜索任务上最高提升3.2个准确率点，训练时间减少4.2倍。
AI.motivation: RLVR在推理密集型任务中有效，但探索受限（难问题上奖励信号稀疏）。外部专家轨迹虽能提供引导，但会暴露奖励相关内容（如最终答案），导致策略通过复制轨迹而非学习推理获得奖励，形成奖励黑客漏洞。现有引导RL方法仅粗粒度截断轨迹，缺乏对"应该隐藏哪些部分"的精细控制。
AI.method: 提出语义掩码专家策略优化（SMEPO）：在专家轨迹的关键路径上，精细地掩码奖励相关的语义跨度（最终答案、中间值、可执行代码、答案相关实体），同时保留专家的分解结构、计划和过程框架。将难题从"从头推理"转化为"填空"过程——策略跟随专家解题路径，但需自行重构被掩码的关键内容。无需修改奖励函数或RL目标。
AI.result: 在数学、代码和智能体搜索等多个领域上，SMEPO相比GRPO最高提升3.2个准确率点，训练时间最高减少4.2倍。
AI.conclusion: SMEPO是一种简单有效、即插即用的专家引导RLVR方法，通过语义级掩码避免奖励黑客，提升学习效率和模型性能。

title: PHGNet: Prototype-Guided Hypergraph Construction for Heterogeneous Spatiotemporal Forecasting
summary: As a core task in intelligent transportation systems, traffic forecasting plays a critical role in urban traffic management. Accurate traffic forecasting relies on modeling complex spatiotemporal dependencies, which is inherently challenging due to spatial heterogeneity in traffic systems.Despite significant progress, most existing methods are still limited to pairwise spatial dependency modeling, making it difficult to capture dynamic high-order interactions among nodes with similar traffic patterns. To address this issue, we propose PHGNet, a novel spatiotemporal forecasting framework based on prototype-guided hypergraph construction. At the core of PHGNet, a prototype learning mechanism is designed to adaptively assign pattern-similar nodes to hyperedges, thereby capturing high-order interactions with time-varying structures. To improve the reliability of dynamic hypergraph construction, we further develop a global-local node representation module to extract time-consistent features. For forecasting, iterative residual refinement and Temporal Query Attention are introduced to improve forecasting accuracy while supporting efficient parallel decoding. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world datasets demonstrate that PHGNet achieves superior predictive performance compared with state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PHGNet，一种基于原型引导超图构建的时空预测框架，通过原型学习机制将模式相似的节点动态分配到超边中以捕获高阶交互，并引入全局-局部节点表示模块、迭代残差细化与时间查询注意力机制，在多个真实交通数据集上取得了优于现有方法的预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有交通预测方法大多局限于成对空间依赖建模，难以捕获具有相似交通模式的节点间动态高阶交互，而交通系统存在空间异质性，亟需能够建模高阶、时变依赖关系的方法。
AI.method: 1) 原型引导超图构建：通过原型学习机制将模式相似的节点自适应分配到超边，捕获具有时变结构的高阶交互；2) 全局-局部节点表示模块：提取时间一致性特征以增强动态超图构建的可靠性；3) 迭代残差细化与时间查询注意力机制：提升预测精度并支持高效并行解码。
AI.result: 在多个真实交通数据集上的大量实验表明，PHGNet在预测性能上优于当前最先进的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: PHGNet通过原型引导的超图建模有效捕获了交通系统中的高阶、时变空间依赖关系，为交通预测提供了一种新的高效框架。

title: Influence-Inspired Spectral Rotations for Extreme Low-Bit LLM Quantization
comment: 14 pages, no figures. Companion application paper to arXiv:2605.01637 (theory). Code and pinned eval stack: https://github.com/gogipav14/spectral-llm
summary:
We apply the influence-adaptive Walsh geometry of a companion theory paper (arXiv:2605.01637) to extreme low-bit weight-only LLM quantization. The recipe is one math-invariant transformation: WHT-rotate each linear layer's weight matrix and rescale its columns by per-coordinate Walsh-basis activation energy before handing off to a reconstruction-error quantizer (Intel auto-round). This biases per-group integer rounding toward high-spectral-energy channels.
  On four pretrained decoder-only models from 135M to 1.5B parameters, BBT-spectral reduces wikitext-2 perplexity by 15-58% relative to vanilla auto-round at W2A16; we also report a TinyLlama-1.1B auxiliary data point. Three extensions transfer the recipe to families it failed on: a per-head PCA matrix-Gamma replacement of q_norm/k_norm for Qwen3 attention (PPL 136.76 -> 88.99 on Qwen3-0.6B); an SO(2) per-pair rotation that commutes with RoPE (PPL 36.93 -> 21.84 on Qwen2.5-1.5B); and an MoE-aware input-side absorption fix identified by architectural fuzzing of Laguna-style fused-expert layouts.
  A W2-vs-W4 ablation gives a deliberate negative control: the redistribution payoff falls within the +/-0.5 PPL noise floor at W4, consistent with the Schur-convexity intuition that the cost of unconcentrated influence vanishes as the noise budget shrinks. All quantized weights export to OpenVINO IR and run on Intel NPU + Arc dGPU + CPU with PPL invariant to device within +/-0.1.
  We do not claim a formal Boolean-to-real-valued transfer of the theory paper's majorization argument: the WHT activation energy used here is not the Boolean influence of the theory paper, the link is intuitive, and the contribution is engineering value rather than a transferred theorem. Head-to-head benchmarks against SpinQuant, QuaRot, QuIP-sharp, AQLM, OmniQuant, and ButterflyQuant at matched calibration are the main future-work item.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BBT-spectral方法，利用Walsh几何的谱自适应变换进行极端低位权重量化（W2A16）。通过WHT旋转和按谱能量缩放权重矩阵，结合Intel auto-round量化器，在多个模型上实现了15-58%的困惑度降低。还提出了三种扩展以处理特定架构（Qwen3注意力、RoPE兼容旋转、MoE融合专家布局）。W4消融实验显示收益在噪声底噪内消失（符合Schur-凸性直觉）。所有量化权重可导出到OpenVINO IR并在Intel NPU/GPU/CPU上运行。
AI.motivation: 将影响自适应Walsh几何从理论推广到实际的极端低位LLM权重量化场景，利用谱能量偏置来提高量化精度，特别是对高谱能量通道的保护。
AI.method: 对每个线性层的权重矩阵进行WHT旋转，然后按Walsh基激活能量的每个坐标缩放列，再传递给重构误差量化器（Intel auto-round）。通过每组的整数舍入偏向高谱能量通道来实现量化。三个扩展：Qwen3注意力中每头PCA矩阵-Gamma替换、与RoPE交换的SO(2)每对旋转、MoE感知的输入侧吸收修复。
AI.result: 在135M到1.5B参数的四个预训练解码器模型上，W2A16困惑度相对降低15-58%。Qwen3-0.6B困惑度从136.76降至88.99，Qwen2.5-1.5B从36.93降至21.84。W4量化时收益在±0.5噪声底噪内。所有量化权重可在Intel NPU、Arc dGPU、CPU上运行，困惑度设备间差异±0.1。
AI.conclusion: BBT-spectral在极端低位量化（W2）上效果显著，但在更宽松的量化预算（W4）下收益有限，符合Schur-凸性理论预期。工程价值为主，非严格的布尔到实值理论转移。与主流方法的头对头基准测试是未来工作。

title: Beyond Query Memorization: Large Language Model Routing with Query Decomposition and Historical Matching
summary: Optimizing the trade-off among predictive performance and computational cost is a central focus in the deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs). Current routing methods primarily rely on direct mapping from queries to models based on surface-level features, making them susceptible to the memorization trap and leading to poor generalizability on out-of-distribution (OOD) data. In this paper, we propose DecoR, a novel routing framework that recasts the routing task as a matching process of sifting similar queries from historical logs, effectively mitigating the memorization trap. To enhance matching accuracy, we introduce a query capability deconstruction method that decouples linguistic surface forms from task-intrinsic requirements, directing matching toward capability dimensions to ground decisions in essential task attributes.
