AI.tldr: 提出L2IR框架，利用大语言模型揭示图数据中欺诈行为的潜在意图，通过区分支持性连接与误导性连接，并结合自适应自训练，在强伪装场景下提升欺诈检测鲁棒性，AUPRC提升最高达8.27%。
AI.motivation: 现有GNN图欺诈检测方法面临欺诈者伪装连接导致信号稀释的问题，LLM虽被引入但未充分挖掘可疑连接的潜在意图，且标注样本稀缺使得检测器难以在重伪装下保持鲁棒。
AI.method: 提出L2IR框架：1) 利用LLM从用户行为轨迹和可疑连接中提取潜在意图感知表征；2) 推理每条连接的真实目的，区分支持性链接与误导性链接；3) 引入自适应自训练机制增强有限监督下的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在富含伪装的两个真实数据集上，L2IR超越强基线方法，可作为即插即用增强模块提升多种GNN检测器性能，AUPRC最高提升8.27%。
AI.conclusion: 揭示潜在意图是应对图欺诈检测中伪装问题的有效策略，LLM驱动的意图推理与自适应自训练相结合的方式能显著提升检测鲁棒性。

title: Capture-Calibrate-Coach: A Graph-Based Framework for Knowledge Monitoring Estimation and Adaptive Feedback
comment: To be published in Proceedings of the 27th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education (AIED 2026)
summary: Effective learning support requires understanding not only what learners know but also how accurately they perceive their own understanding. This metacognitive dimension, known as knowledge monitoring, fundamentally influences self-regulated learning, yet this dimension remains underexplored in current systems. This paper introduces the Capture-Calibrate-Coach (3C) framework for adaptive learning support. The Capture phase extracts learners' perceived knowledge states from open-ended self-reports to construct a heterogeneous graph linking learners and knowledge concepts. The Calibrate phase applies a heterogeneous graph neural network to infer latent perceived states for concepts not explicitly mentioned, enabling systematic knowledge monitoring assessment. The Coach phase classifies learners into five metacognitive patterns and delivers personalized feedback addressing both knowledge gaps and calibration errors. Evaluation with 684 students demonstrates 85.21% AUC in predicting latent perceived states, significantly outperforming baseline methods. A user study with 47 participants shows positive reception of feedback quality, with participants particularly valuing concrete feedback on knowledge gaps and actionable study guidance. These findings advance AI-based learning support toward metacognitive teammates that foster accurate self-awareness while supporting knowledge growth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Capture-Calibrate-Coach (3C)框架，通过异构图表征学习者的自我报告知识状态，并利用异构GNN推断未明确提及的概念状态，最终将学习者分为五种元认知模式并提供个性化反馈。在684名学生评估中，潜在状态预测AUC达85.21%，用户研究表明反馈质量获得积极评价。
AI.motivation: 现有学习支持系统缺乏对学习者元认知维度的建模，特别是知识监测（即学习者对其理解程度的自我感知准确性）这一影响自我调节学习的关键因素未被充分探索。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：(1) Capture：从开放型自我报告中提取感知知识状态，构建连接学习者与知识概念的异构图；(2) Calibrate：使用异构GNN推断未明确提及概念的潜在感知状态，实现系统性知识监测评估；(3) Coach：将学习者分为五种元认知模式，针对知识缺口和校准误差提供个性化反馈。
AI.result: 684名学生评估中，潜在状态预测AUC达85.21%，显著优于基线方法；47名参与者的用户研究显示，反馈质量获得积极评价，参与者特别重视关于知识缺口的具体反馈和可操作的学习指导。
AI.conclusion: 3C框架推动了AI学习支持系统向元认知协作者方向发展，能够在促进知识增长的同时培养准确的自我认知能力。

title: Retrying vs Resampling in AI Control
summary: AI coding scaffolds like Claude Code and Codex use \textit{retrying}: blocking actions flagged as risky and continuing the trajectory. We study retrying from an AI control perspective, which treats the model as potentially adversarial. We find that while retrying reduces honest suspicion scores, the untrusted model can exploit monitor rationale to construct sneakier attacks, negating safety gains. We also study \textit{resampling}: drawing multiple samples from the same context, which does not leak exploitable information. We disentangle design choices that previous work on resampling had bundled together. In BashArena, with Claude Opus 4.6 as the untrusted model and MiMo-V2-Flash as the trusted monitor, drawing five samples per step and auditing on the maximum suspicion score raises safety from 61\% to 71\% at a 0.3\% audit budget, at no cost to usefulness. Selectively resampling only the steps that look suspicious on the first draw recovers 6.2 percentage points of the gain while drawing only 10\% as many extra samples. Two of our findings in this setting contradict earlier work on resampling. The first is that auditing based on the maximum across resampled suspicion scores outperforms using the minimum, which is the opposite of what Ctrl-Z found. The second is that executing the least suspicious sample, which is the central mechanism in earlier defer-to-resample protocols, gives only a small empirical safety gain in our setting (+3.9 pp, with the confidence interval overlapping zero).

AI.tldr: 本文从AI控制视角研究编码脚手架中的重试（retrying）和重采样（resampling）机制。重试虽然降低可疑分数，但模型可利用监控理由构造更隐蔽攻击；重采样不泄露可被利用信息，且选择最大可疑分数审计可提升安全性。研究发现与Ctrl-Z等工作相反：最大分审计优于最小分，执行最不可疑样本仅带来微小提升。
AI.motivation: 现有AI编码脚手架（如Claude Code、Codex）使用重试机制来阻止风险行为，但其安全性在对抗性模型假设下尚未被充分研究。本文希望从AI控制视角系统评估重试和重采样的安全影响，并厘清先前研究中混杂的设计选择。
AI.method: 在BashArena环境中，以Claude Opus 4.6为不可信模型、MiMo-V2-Flash为可信监控器，比较重试与重采样的安全效果。重采样方面，对比每步抽取5个样本并对最大（vs最小）可疑分数审计、选择性重采样可疑步骤等策略。
AI.result: 重试降低了诚实可疑分数但模型可利用监控理由发动更隐蔽攻击。重采样（最大分审计）将安全性从61%提升至71%（审计预算0.3%），不牺牲有用性。选择性重采样仅需10%额外样本即可恢复6.2个百分点的安全增益。最大分审计优于最小分（与Ctrl-Z结论相反）；执行最不可疑样本仅带来+3.9pp（非显著）的增益。
AI.conclusion: 重试机制存在被对抗性模型利用的安全风险，而重采样（尤其是基于最大可疑分数的审计策略）是一种更安全且高效的替代方案。此前工作中关于最小分审计和执行最不可疑样本的核心机制在本研究中未得到复现。

title: SeqRoute: Global Budget-Aware Sequential LLM Routing via Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Existing LLM routing frameworks treat queries as independent events, neglecting the sequential nature of real-world user sessions constrained by global computational budgets. This mismatch inevitably leads to budget bankruptcy: myopic routing policies exhaust resources on early interactions, forcing subsequent and often more complex queries onto inadequate models. We introduce SeqRoute, a framework that formulates multi-turn routing as a finite-horizon Markov Decision Process and solves it via offline reinforcement learning. By incorporating the remaining budget into the state space and training with Conservative Q-Learning (CQL), SeqRoute learns delayed gratification to strategically preserve resources for high-stakes turns later in the session. To overcome data starvation, we propose Hindsight Budget Relabeling (HBR). This technique retrospectively simulates historical trajectories under diverse hypothetical budgets, expanding 10,000 raw sessions into 2.38 million transitions enriched with critical bankruptcy signals. At deployment, a dynamic $λ$-sweep mechanism enables zero-shot navigation of the cost-quality Pareto frontier without retraining. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that SeqRoute reduces operational costs by 6.0-73.5% while maintaining or improving quality, and suppresses bankruptcy rates to under 1%, strictly dominating behavior cloning, budget-aware heuristics, and static baselines across the entire Pareto frontier.

AI.tldr: SeqRoute是一个将多轮LLM路由问题建模为有限时域马尔可夫决策过程，并利用离线强化学习（CQL）和Hindsight Budget Relabeling（HBR）技术解决预算破产问题的框架，在降低成本6.0-73.5%的同时将破产率压制在1%以下。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM路由框架将查询视为独立事件，忽略了真实用户会话的序列性质及全局计算预算约束，导致短视路由策略在早期交互中耗尽预算，使后续复杂查询被迫使用不充分模型，造成预算破产问题。
AI.method: 将多轮路由建模为有限时域MDP，通过离线强化学习（CQL）求解；将剩余预算纳入状态空间；提出Hindsight Budget Relabeling（HBR）技术，在多种假设预算下回顾性模拟历史轨迹以扩展训练数据；部署时采用动态λ-sweep机制实现成本-质量帕累托前沿的零样本导航。
AI.result: 将10,000条原始会话扩展为238万条富含破产信号的转移样本；运营成本降低6.0-73.5%的同时维持或提升质量；破产率压制至1%以下；在整个帕累托前沿上严格优于行为克隆、预算感知启发式方法和静态基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过延迟满足策略战略性保留资源用于后续高价值交互，SeqRoute有效解决了预算破产问题，实现了成本与质量之间的帕累托最优权衡。

title: VeriTrace: Evolving Mental Models for Deep Research Agents
summary: Deep research agents face vast, interdependent, and pervasively uncertain information. Existing systems explore what evolving intermediate representations should look like, but leave their evolution to the LLM's implicit reasoning. Without explicit regulation, the intermediate layer is easily contaminated by mixed-quality information and propagates errors along its dependencies, so model scale often ends up substituting for absent regulation. We argue that an agent's mental model should instead evolve through explicit feedback that continuously aligns task understanding with reality, and identify three regulatory loops: interpretive update, deviation feedback, and schema revision. We realise this in VeriTrace, a cognitive-graph framework that explicitly implements the three loops. Using matched Qwen3.5-27B backbones, VeriTrace improves over the strongest matched baseline by 4.22 pp on DeepResearch Bench (DRB) Insight (1.49 pp Overall) and by 5.9 pp Overall win rate on DeepConsult. With Config-DeepSeek, it achieves the strongest reproducible open-source result on DRB.

AI.tldr: VeriTrace是一种认知图谱框架，通过三种显式反馈循环（解释性更新、偏差反馈、模式修正）来监管深度研究智能体的中间表征进化，在DeepResearch Bench和DeepConsult基准上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有深度研究智能体的中间表征依赖LLM隐式推理，缺乏显式监管，导致混合质量信息污染和错误级联传播，模型规模被用于替代缺失的监管机制。
AI.method: 提出三种显式反馈循环（解释性更新、偏差反馈、模式修正），并基于认知图谱框架VeriTrace实现这三种循环，对智能体的心智模型进行持续对齐现实世界的显式调控。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-27B骨干网络上，VeriTrace在DeepResearch Bench Insight上提升4.22个百分点（总体1.49个百分点），在DeepConsult上总体胜率提升5.9个百分点；结合Config-DeepSeek获得DRB上最强的可复现开源结果。
AI.conclusion: 显式的反馈监管循环能有效替代模型规模扩大的隐性补偿机制，提升深度研究智能体的信息处理质量与任务表现。

title: Rethinking Feature Alignment in Generalist Graph Anomaly Detection: A Relational Fingerprint-based Approach
summary: Generalist graph anomaly detection (GAD) aims to detect anomalies on unseen graphs without graph-specific retraining. Nevertheless, existing approaches primarily focus on aligning heterogeneous features across different data domains via PCA-based projection, which harmonizes feature dimensions ignores feature semantics. As a result, GAD models fail to learn transferable semantic knowledge, and even exhibit negative transfer on unseen graphs. To address this issue, we propose a Relational Fingerprint-based generalist GAD approach (ReFi-GAD for short), aligning heterogeneous raw features with a universal and semantics-aware Relational Fingerprint (ReFi) that encodes anomaly-indicative cues from both contextual and structural perspectives. Building on ReFi, we design a fingerprint-grounded generalist GAD model, which combines a transformer-based encoder to capture domain-invariant knowledge with an SNR-guided refinement module for domain-specific adaptation. Extensive experiments on 14 datasets demonstrate that ReFi-GAD significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于关系指纹（ReFi）的通用图异常检测方法ReFi-GAD，通过语义感知的指纹编码上下文和结构异常线索，结合Transformer编码器和SNR引导的细化模块，在14个数据集上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有通用图异常检测方法主要基于PCA投影对齐异构特征，忽略了特征语义，导致无法学习可迁移的语义知识，甚至在新图上出现负迁移。
AI.method: 提出ReFi（关系指纹），从上下文和结构两个维度编码异常指示性线索，实现语义感知的异构特征对齐；在此基础上设计基于指纹的通用GAD模型，包含Transformer编码器（捕获域不变知识）和SNR引导的细化模块（域特定适应）。
AI.result: 在14个数据集上的大量实验表明，ReFi-GAD显著优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过语义感知的指纹对齐代替PCA式的特征维度对齐，可以有效解决通用图异常检测中的负迁移问题，提升跨域泛化能力。

title: Claw-Anything: Benchmarking Always-On Personal Assistants with Broader Access to User's Digital World
summary: Large language model agents are increasingly envisioned as always-on personal assistants with access to anything relevant in the user's digital world. Yet current systems operate over only narrow slices of that world, limiting context-sensitive reasoning and effective assistance. Existing benchmarks similarly provide only partial user state and therefore fail to capture performance in such a broad, always-on setting. To address this gap, we introduce Claw-Anything, a benchmark that expands agent context along three dimensions: long-horizon activity histories, interdependent backend services, and integrated GUI and CLI interaction across multiple devices. To instantiate this setting, we simulate months of user activity through multi-round event injection, producing complex world states and realistic noise, including irrelevant events and conflicting signals. Agents must reason over rich contextual environments while remaining robust to such noise. This expanded scope also enables the evaluation of proactive assistance, requiring agents to anticipate user needs and deliver timely recommendations. Experiments show that GPT-5.5 achieves only 34.5% pass@1, substantially below prior benchmarks, underscoring a gap between current agent capabilities and the demands of always-on personal assistance. Alongside the benchmark, we release an automated data-generation pipeline that yields 2,000 training environments and improves the base model by 23.7%, demonstrating its utility of scalable data infrastructure.

AI.tldr: Claw-Anything是一个针对始终在线个人助手场景的基准测试，从长期活动历史、相互依赖的后端服务、多设备GUI/CLI交互三个维度扩展智能体上下文。通过多轮事件注入模拟数月的用户活动。GPT-5.5仅达34.5% pass@1，远低于先前基准。同时发布自动化数据生成流水线，生成2000个训练环境，将基础模型提升23.7%。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型智能体系统仅能操作用户数字世界的狭窄片段，限制了上下文敏感推理和有效协助。现有基准也只提供部分用户状态，无法捕捉始终在线场景下的性能表现。
AI.method: 沿三个维度扩展智能体上下文：长期活动历史、相互依赖的后端服务、多设备集成GUI/CLI交互。通过多轮事件注入模拟数月用户活动，产生复杂世界状态和现实噪声（无关事件和冲突信号），同时支持主动协助评估。
AI.result: GPT-5.5在Claw-Anything上仅达34.5% pass@1，显著低于先前基准。自动化数据生成流水线产生2000个训练环境，将基础模型提升23.7%。
AI.conclusion: 当前智能体能力与始终在线个人助手需求之间存在显著差距，而可扩展的数据基础设施（如自动化数据生成流水线）是弥合这一差距的有效途径。

title: Missing Pattern Recognized Diffusion Imputation Model for Missing Not At Random
summary: Missing data frequently arises across diverse domains, including time-series and image domains. In the real world, missing occurrences often depend on the unobservable values themselves, which are referred to as Missing Not at Random (MNAR). In this work, we introduce the Missing Pattern Recognized Diffusion Imputation Model (PRDIM), a novel framework that explicitly captures the missing pattern and precisely imputes unobserved values. PRDIM iteratively maximizes the likelihood of the joint distribution for observed values and missing mask under an Expectation-Maximization (EM) algorithm. In this sense, we first employ a pattern recognizer, which approximates the underlying missing pattern and provides guidance during every inference toward more plausible imputations with respect to the missing information. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that PRDIM consistently achieves strong imputation performance under MNAR settings across multiple data modalities.

AI.tldr: 提出缺失模式识别扩散插补模型（PRDIM），通过显式捕捉缺失模式并在EM算法框架下最大化观测值和缺失掩码的联合分布似然，实现对非随机缺失数据的高质量插补。
AI.motivation: 真实世界中缺失数据常为非随机缺失（MNAR），即缺失概率依赖于未观测值本身，现有方法难以有效处理此类复杂缺失模式。
AI.method: PRDIM框架：1）引入模式识别器（pattern recognizer）近似底层缺失模式；2）基于期望最大化（EM）算法迭代最大化观测值与缺失掩码的联合分布似然；3）在每次推理中利用缺失模式指导插补过程。
AI.result: 在多种数据模态（时间序列、图像等）的MNAR设置下，PRDIM一致性地实现了优异的插补性能。
AI.conclusion: PRDIM通过显式建模缺失模式并融入扩散生成过程，有效解决了非随机缺失数据的插补问题，在多个领域具有广泛应用潜力。

title: From Model Scaling to System Scaling: Scaling the Harness in Agentic AI
summary: This paper studies the next major bottleneck in agentic AI as system scaling, not only model scaling: the design of auditable, persistent, modular, and verifiable architectures around foundation models. We refer to this shift as scaling the harness: treating the structured execution layer around a foundation model as a first-class object of design, evaluation, and optimization. Although recent large language models enable agents to use tools, retrieve information, maintain memory, and execute long-horizon workflows, evaluation remains largely model-centric, often reducing agents to final-task success while treating memory, retrieval, tool use, orchestration, verification, and governance as secondary implementation details. This framing is increasingly inadequate because agent performance emerges from the interaction among the foundation model, memory substrate, context constructor, skill-routing layer, orchestration loop, and verification-and-governance layer. Together, these components form the agent harness, which translates model capability into long-horizon agent behavior. We study scaling the harness through three core bottlenecks: context governance, trustworthy memory, and dynamic skill routing, together with the orchestration and governance mechanisms that coordinate and constrain them. We further outline a research agenda for harness-level benchmarks that go beyond one-shot task success to measure trajectory quality, memory hygiene, context efficiency, communication fidelity, verification cost, and safe evolution over time. To make the discussion concrete, we develop CheetahClaws: https://github.com/SafeRL-Lab/cheetahclaws, a Python-native reference harness, and compare it with Claude Code and OpenClaw. Our main claim is that future progress in agentic AI will depend as much on system design as on stronger foundation models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出智能体AI的下一个瓶颈是系统扩展（即"工具链扩展"），而非仅模型扩展，强调将基础模型周围的结构化执行层作为一等设计对象，并通过CheetahClaws开源框架进行论证。
AI.motivation: 当前智能体评估过度以模型为中心，将记忆、检索、工具使用、编排、验证和治理视为次要实现细节，忽略了智能体性能实际来源于基础模型与各系统组件的交互，这种框架已不足以支撑长期任务的智能体行为。
AI.method: 提出"工具链扩展"概念，将智能体工具链（含记忆基板、上下文构建器、技能路由层、编排循环、验证治理层）作为一等设计对象；识别三大核心瓶颈（上下文治理、可信记忆、动态技能路由）；开发Python原生参考工具链CheetahClaws，并与Claude Code和OpenClaw对比。
AI.result: 构建了CheetahClaws开源参考工具链，提出了超越单次任务成功率的工具链级基准评估维度（轨迹质量、记忆卫生、上下文效率、通信保真度、验证成本、安全演化）。
AI.conclusion: 未来智能体AI的进步将同等依赖于系统设计（工具链）和基础模型能力的提升，工具链层面的设计、评估与优化应成为核心研究方向。

title: BigMac: Breaking the Pareto Frontier of Compute and Memory in Multimodal LLM Training
summary: Training multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is challenged by both model and data heterogeneity. Existing systems redesign the training pipeline to address these challenges, but remain bound by a Pareto frontier between compute and memory efficiency, improving one only at the expense of the other. We present BigMac, a new training pipeline for multimodal LLMs. The core idea of BigMac is to elegantly nest the encoder and generator computation into the original LLM pipeline, forming a dependency-safe nested pipeline structure. With this design, BigMac reduces the activation memory complexity of the encoder and generator to O(1) while keeping the activation memory complexity of the LLM unchanged. At the same time, it achieves the same computational efficiency as the idealized setting with unlimited memory. As a result, BigMac breaks the Pareto frontier between computational efficiency and memory usage, enabling simultaneous optimization of both computation and memory in MLLM training. We evaluate BigMac on multiple MLLMs and training workloads. Experimental results show that BigMac achieves a 1.08$\times$-1.9$\times$ training speedup over baseline systems while maintaining stable memory usage as batch size increases.

AI.tldr: BigMac提出了一种新的嵌套流水线训练架构，通过将编码器和生成器的计算优雅地嵌套到原始LLM流水线中，将编码器和生成器的激活内存复杂度降至O(1)，同时保持LLM内存不变，打破了MLLM训练中计算效率与内存使用之间的帕累托边界，实现了1.08×-1.9×的加速比且内存随batch size增加保持稳定。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM训练系统受限于计算效率与内存效率之间的帕累托边界，提升一方必然以牺牲另一方为代价，无法同时优化。
AI.method: BigMac的核心是将多模态编码器和生成器的计算嵌套到原始LLM流水线中，形成依赖安全的嵌套流水线结构，从而将编码器和生成器的激活内存复杂度降为O(1)，同时保持LLM的激活内存复杂度不变。
AI.result: 在多种MLLM和训练负载上，BigMac相比基线系统实现了1.08×-1.9×的训练加速比，且内存使用随batch size增大保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: BigMac成功打破了MLLM训练中计算效率与内存使用之间的帕累托边界，实现了计算和内存的同步优化。

title: MobileGym: A Verifiable and Highly Parallel Simulation Platform for Mobile GUI Agent Research
summary: We present MobileGym, a browser-hosted, lightweight, fully controllable environment for everyday mobile use, targeting interaction fidelity without replicating proprietary backends. It enables two capabilities previously out of reach for everyday apps: verifiable outcome signals through deterministic state-based judging over structured JSON state, and scalable online RL through low-cost parallel rollouts. The full environment state is captured, configured, forked, and compared as structured JSON, and a single server can host hundreds of parallel instances, with about 400 MB memory per instance and about 3 s cold start. A layered state model and a declarative task-definition framework keep state programmability and task creation practical at scale, and a single programmatic judging mechanism delivers both deterministic evaluation verdicts and dense RL rewards. The accompanying MobileGym-Bench provides 416 parameterized task templates, including 256 test and 160 train templates, over 28 apps, with deterministic judges and a structured AnswerSheet protocol that avoids free-text matching failures. In a Sim-to-Real case study, GRPO on Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct gains +12.8 percentage points on the 256-task test set, and on a 59-task real-device signal subset, real-device execution retains 95.1% of the simulation-side training gain. Project page: https://mobilegym.github.io.

AI.tldr: MobileGym 是一个轻量级、完全可控的浏览器端移动环境，支持基于结构化 JSON 状态的可验证结果信号和低成本并行 rollouts 的可扩展在线强化学习。配套的 MobileGym-Bench 包含 416 个参数化任务模板，实验表明 GRPO 训练可将测试集性能提升 12.8 个百分点，且模拟到现实的迁移保留率达 95.1%。
AI.motivation: 现有移动环境（如 AndroidEnv、MiniWoB++）在可验证结果信号和可扩展在线强化学习方面存在局限，要么依赖专有后端难以复现，要么缺乏确定性评估机制，限制了日常应用场景下的交互保真度和规模化训练能力。
AI.method: 提出分层状态模型（layered state model）和声明式任务定义框架（declarative task-definition framework），将完整环境状态捕获为结构化 JSON 以实现状态的可配置、可分支和可比较；采用统一的确定性状态评判机制，同时输出判定结果和密集强化学习奖励；支持单服务器数百实例并行，每实例约 400 MB 内存、约 3 秒冷启动。
AI.result: MobileGym-Bench 提供 416 个参数化任务模板（256 测试 + 160 训练），覆盖 28 个应用，附带结构化 AnswerSheet 协议避免自由文本匹配失败。在 Sim-to-Real 案例中，GRPO 在 Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct 上实现 256 任务测试集 +12.8 个百分点提升，59 任务真实设备信号子集的模拟-真实迁移保留率达 95.1%。
AI.conclusion: MobileGym 通过结构化 JSON 状态和确定性评判机制，实现了可验证、可扩展的移动端在线强化学习训练框架，在模拟到真实设备迁移中展现出极高的训练增益保留率，为日常移动应用的交互学习提供了可靠的基础设施。

title: From Simulation to Enaction: Post-trained language models recognize and react to their own generations
comment: Anthropic fellows project mentored by Jack Lindsey
summary: Language models are pretrained as passive predictors with no incentive to model the consequences of their own outputs. Post-training changes this: a model producing its own responses can benefit from recognizing that it is on-policy. We present evidence that post-trained models recognize their on-policy generations, and this recognition is implicitly encoded in their output distributions. In particular, on-policy output distribution entropy is 3--4$\times$ lower than off-policy entropy, across model families and size classes. We trace part of this effect to an internal representation of input surprise, tracking the unlikeliness of the most recent input token according to the model's prior predictions, that causally modulates output entropy. One example of these phenomena can be observed in response to open-ended prompts; post-trained models (unlike pretrained models) collapse their uncertainty over the topic of their upcoming response before the first output token; violating this cached intention with a different-topic prefill results in higher output entropy. We also tested whether models can distinguish on-policy contexts from prefills via explicit verbal report. We find that they can, but that interestingly, this explicit recognition routes through a different mechanism than implicit recognition.

AI.tldr: 论文发现，经过后训练（如RLHF/指令微调）的语言模型能够隐式识别自己的生成（on-policy），表现为on-policy输出的熵比off-policy低3-4倍；这种隐式识别部分源于模型内部对输入惊讶程度的表征，且与显式识别（如通过言语报告）经由不同的机制。
AI.motivation: 探究语言模型在post-training后是否及如何识别自己的生成（on-policy vs off-policy），理解这种隐式识别背后的内部机制。
AI.method: 通过比较on-policy和off-policy条件下的输出分布熵差异，分析内部表征（如输入惊讶程度）的因果作用，并利用显式言语报告对比隐式识别与显式识别的机制差异。
AI.result: on-policy输出熵比off-policy低3-4倍；部分效应可归因于内部对输入惊讶程度的表征；后训练模型会在首个输出token前坍缩不确定性（cached intention），被违反时熵升高；显式识别与隐式识别通过不同机制实现。
AI.conclusion: 后训练模型具备隐式的on-policy识别能力，这种能力内嵌于输出分布中，且与显式识别解耦，对理解模型行为对齐有重要意义。

title: LETS Forecast: Learning Embedology for Time Series Forecasting
comment: Accepted at International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2025
summary: Real-world time series are often governed by complex nonlinear dynamics. Understanding these underlying dynamics is crucial for precise future prediction. While deep learning has achieved major success in time series forecasting, many existing approaches do not explicitly model the dynamics. To bridge this gap, we introduce DeepEDM, a framework that integrates nonlinear dynamical systems modeling with deep neural networks. Inspired by empirical dynamic modeling (EDM) and rooted in Takens' theorem, DeepEDM presents a novel deep model that learns a latent space from time-delayed embeddings, and employs kernel regression to approximate the underlying dynamics, while leveraging efficient implementation of softmax attention and allowing for accurate prediction of future time steps. To evaluate our method, we conduct comprehensive experiments on synthetic data of nonlinear dynamical systems as well as real-world time series across domains. Our results show that DeepEDM is robust to input noise, and outperforms state-of-the-art methods in forecasting accuracy. Our code is available at: https://abrarmajeedi.github.io/deep_edm.

AI.tldr: DeepEDM是一个将非线性动力系统建模与深度神经网络相结合的时序预测框架，受经验动力建模和Takens定理启发，通过延迟嵌入学习潜在空间，利用核回归近似底层动力学，并采用高效的softmax注意力机制实现高精度预测，在合成数据和真实数据上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现实世界时间序列通常受复杂非线性动力学支配，理解这些动力学对精确预测至关重要，而现有深度学习方法大多未显式建模动力学。
AI.method: 基于Takens定理和EDM，构建深度模型从时间延迟嵌入中学习潜在空间，使用核回归近似底层动力学，并通过softmax注意力机制的高效实现进行未来时间步预测。
AI.result: 在非线性动力系统合成数据及各领域真实时间序列上，DeepEDM对输入噪声具有鲁棒性，且在预测精度上优于最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: DeepEDM将非线性动力系统建模融入深度学习框架，为时间序列预测提供了一种鲁棒且高精度的解决方案。

title: JacQuant: STE-Free Quantization-Aware Training via Learned Jacobian Surrogates
summary: Quantization-aware training (QAT) is widely deployed but typically relies on the Straight-Through Estimator (STE), which passes gradients through non-differentiable quantizers by fiat. This often makes training brittle near bin boundaries and weakly aligned with the actual behavior of the low-precision model. We introduce JacQuant, a QAT framework that learns a lightweight surrogate of the model's local sensitivity to parameter changes and uses it to stabilize and accelerate training within standard variance-reduced optimizers. The surrogate is inexpensive (diagonal or block-diagonal), data-driven, and compatible with common weight and activation quantizers. On code-preserving training phases, we prove convergence for non-convex objectives and obtain linear rates under a PL condition, and we relate the learned sensitivity to end-to-end output fidelity via a simple calibration argument. Across LLM benchmarks at $\leq 2$ bits, JacQuant consistently reaches higher accuracy than STE-based QAT, and the runtime analyses on various models show that the added cost remains negligible under practical group sizes. The method is drop-in and requires no changes to the forward quantizers; our empirical claims are scoped to ultra-low-bit LLM QAT.

AI.tldr: JacQuant提出了一种基于雅可比矩阵的轻量级替代方法，用于替代量化感知训练（QAT）中常用的直通估计器（STE），通过在标准方差缩减优化器中学习模型参数变化的局部敏感性，从而在超低位宽（≤2比特）的大型语言模型（LLM）量化中稳定并加速训练，同时取得了比STE更高的精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的量化感知训练（QAT）广泛依赖直通估计器（STE），但STE在不可微分的量化器上强行传递梯度，导致训练在量化边界附近不稳定，且与低精度模型的实际行为对齐较差，影响最终模型精度。
AI.method: 提出JacQuant框架，学习一个轻量级（对角或块对角）、数据驱动的模型局部敏感性替代函数，用于衡量参数变化对输出的影响，并将其集成到标准方差缩减优化器中，以稳定和加速训练过程。该方法不需要修改前向量化器，是一种即插即用的方案。
AI.result: 在≤2比特的LLM基准测试中，JacQuant一致地达到比基于STE的QAT更高的精度；运行时分析表明，在实际分组大小下，该方法增加的计算成本可忽略不计。同时，在保留编码的训练阶段，证明了非凸目标下的收敛性和PL条件下的线性收敛速率。
AI.conclusion: JacQuant是一种有效的STE替代方案，特别适用于超低位宽LLM的量化感知训练，能够在不增加显著计算开销的前提下提升模型精度，并通过理论分析保证了收敛性。

title: Check Your LLM's Secret Dictionary! Five Lines of Code Reveal What Your LLM Learned (Including What It Shouldn't Have)
summary:
We show that singular value decomposition of the lm_head} weight matrix of a transformer-based large language model -- requiring only five lines of PyTorch and no model inference -- reveals interpretable semantic subspaces directly from the model weights. Each left singular vector identifies the vocabulary tokens most readily selected when the hidden state aligns with the corresponding singular direction; inspecting these clusters exposes the model's training data composition and curation philosophy.
  Analysing GPT-OSS-120B, Gemma-2-2B, and Qwen2.5-1.5B, we find that singular value spectra and vocabulary cluster structures differ systematically across models: GPT exhibits a graduated hierarchy of functionally differentiated subspaces; Gemma is dominated by pre-nineteenth-century English orthography, forming a stepwise clustering structure that may contribute to high output controllability; and Qwen exhibits broad multilingual coverage alongside subspaces whose vocabulary the authors have determined to be ethically inappropriate for direct publication.
  Base-instruct comparison reveals that ethically concerning subspaces originate in pretraining and are not removed by post-training alignment. We introduce the Vocabulary Cluster Score (VCS) to quantify subspace coherence, and the Weighted Projection Score (WPS) as a static glitch token detector; applying WPS to GPT-OSS-120B recovers shokubutsu-hyakka-tsu (ID 137606), a well-known glitch token widely reported in the CJK language community, without any model inference. We propose a taxonomy of root causes for problematic vocabulary content and call for lm_head} SVD analysis to be adopted as a standard pre-release safety auditing step. Our findings further suggest directions toward SVD-guided tokenizer optimisation and more controllable LLM design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出对大型语言模型的lm_head权重矩阵进行奇异值分解（SVD），仅需五行PyTorch代码且无需模型推理，即可直接从模型权重中揭示可解释的语义子空间。通过对GPT-OSS-120B、Gemma-2-2B和Qwen2.5-1.5B的分析，发现不同模型的奇异值谱和词汇簇结构存在系统性差异。研究还引入词汇簇得分（VCS）和加权投影得分（WPS），并发现伦理问题子空间源于预训练且无法被后训练对齐消除，建议将lm_head SVD分析作为发布前安全审计的标准步骤。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常依赖模型推理或黑盒测试来理解LLM的内部表征和潜在风险，缺乏一种直接从模型权重中高效、可解释地分析语义子空间和检测安全隐患的方法。本文旨在填补这一空白，通过轻量级的SVD分析揭示模型训练数据构成、语义组织结构和潜在伦理问题。
AI.method: 对transformer LLM的lm_head权重矩阵进行奇异值分解（SVD）；通过左奇异向量识别与特定语义方向对齐的词汇簇；引入词汇簇得分（VCS）量化子空间一致性；引入加权投影得分（WPS）作为静态故障标记（glitch token）检测器。
AI.result: GPT-OSS-120B呈现功能分化子空间的渐进层次结构；Gemma-2-2B以19世纪前英语正字法主导，形成阶梯状聚类结构；Qwen2.5-1.5B展现广泛多语言覆盖但包含伦理不适切的子空间。WPS成功检测到已知故障标记shokubutsu-hyakka-tsu（ID 137606）。伦理问题子空间源于预训练且后训练对齐无法移除。
AI.conclusion: lm_head SVD分析是一种高效、可解释的模型审计工具，应作为标准发布前安全审计步骤；研究为SVD引导的tokenizer优化和更可控的LLM设计提供了方向，并提出了问题词汇内容的根源分类体系。

title: SafetyRepro: Configuration-Conditional Rank Instability on Alignment Benchmarks
summary: Pairwise model comparisons drawn from foundation-model benchmarks ("A is safer than B") are read as quantitative verdicts but hinge on harness choices benchmark papers under-specify. We close one theory-benchmark loop on this primitive: a finite-envelope proposition tying a measurable pairwise-disagreement rate to whether the strict ordering admits a configuration-pair reversal, paired with a commit-stamped evaluation protocol that operationalises it on widely cited alignment benchmarks. On every benchmark we test, configuration choice alone can flip the pairwise verdict; the proposition isolates this strict-reversal failure mode.

AI.tldr: 配置选择可以完全翻转模型安全排序的结论，本文通过有限包络命题和提交戳协议揭示了这一失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有基础模型基准测试中，模型对比的结论（如“A比B更安全”）被视为量化判决，但严重依赖于基准论文未明确规定的配置选择，导致结论不可靠。
AI.method: 提出了一个有限包络命题，将可测量的成对分歧率与严格排序是否存在配置对翻转联系起来；并设计了一个提交戳评估协议，在广泛引用的对齐基准上付诸实践。
AI.result: 在每个测试的基准上，单独改变配置就足以翻转成对排序结论；该命题成功隔离了这种严格反转失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 模型安全比较的排序结论对配置选择高度敏感，现有基准测试协议需要补充提交戳机制以确保结论的可重复性和可靠性。

title: Accelerated Dynamic Importance Weighting with Versatile Divergence-Minimizing Estimators
summary: Importance weighting (IW) is a golden solver for joint distribution shift, where the joint distributions differ between the training and test data. To solve this problem, IW estimates test-to-training density ratios as importance weights and reweights the training losses accordingly. Recent advances in dynamic IW (DIW) integrate weight estimation into model training, enabling scalable IW for deep models and achieving strong performance on large modern datasets. Despite its promise, DIW remains limited in two aspects. First, it incurs substantial computational overhead by solving a kernel mean matching (KMM)-induced optimization problem to convergence in every mini-batch. Second, it relies solely on KMM for weight estimation, whereas the IW literature contains diverse estimation methods based on different divergence measures. In this paper, we propose accelerated DIW (ADIW), a unified and efficient IW framework for deep learning under joint distribution shift. ADIW performs a few lightweight projected gradient descent updates that warm-start from previously updated weights, substantially improving efficiency. Moreover, ADIW generalizes DIW into a unified divergence-minimization framework that supports diverse weight-estimation methods in a plug-and-play manner, including those based on the Kullback-Leibler divergence, squared distance, and Wasserstein-1 distance. We establish convergence guarantees for ADIW under mild conditions, and empirical results demonstrate that ADIW achieves state-of-the-art IW performance while being substantially more efficient.

AI.tldr: 提出加速动态重要性加权（ADIW）框架，通过轻量级投影梯度下降和统一散度最小化框架，在联合分布偏移下实现高效且支持多种权重估计方法的深度重要性加权，在显著提升效率的同时达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有动态重要性加权（DIW）方法存在两大局限：(1) 每个mini-batch需迭代求解核均值匹配（KMM）优化问题直至收敛，计算开销大；(2) 仅依赖KMM进行权重估计，而IW文献中尚有基于不同散度度量的多种估计方法未被利用。
AI.method: 提出ADIW框架：(1) 采用少量投影梯度下降更新，从先前更新的权重热启动，大幅提升效率；(2) 将DIW推广为统一的散度最小化框架，支持KL散度、平方距离、Wasserstein-1距离等多种权重估计方法的即插即用；(3) 在温和条件下建立收敛性保证。
AI.result: 经验结果表明ADIW在实现SOTA重要性加权性能的同时，效率显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: ADIW是一个统一且高效的深度学习联合分布偏移IW框架，通过轻量级热启动更新和统一散度框架解决了DIW的效率瓶颈和多样性局限。

title: Relative Repairability: A Calibration-Based Diagnostic for High-Sparsity Post-Pruning Allocation
summary: At very high sparsity, neural network pruning does more than decide which weights remain. It also determines where pruning induced damage is placed across the network, and whether that damage can be recovered by a fixed lightweight repair procedure. We study this problem through the lens of repair conditioned sparsity allocation. We introduce Relative Repairability (RR), a calibration based diagnostic that compares the raw activation distortion caused by layerwise pruning with the residual distortion left after channelwise variance matching repair. RR estimates the fraction of local damage that remains after repair, using only unlabeled calibration data. Across ResNet18, ResNet34, and VGG16 BN on CIFAR10 and CIFAR100, we find that RR is not a universally dominant allocation rule. Instead, it is most useful near an architecture dependent recoverability transition, where standard structural or magnitude based allocation priors begin to lose reliability but post repair recovery has not yet fully collapsed. On CIFAR100 ResNet18, a fine grained sweep shows that RR improves over ERK across the central transition band and surpasses LAMP near the upper part of this band. A projection forced ablation further shows that capped ERK can over protect projection layers, shifting excessive sparsity onto regular convolutions and reducing post repair recovery. These results suggest that high sparsity pruning should allocate not only retained weights, but also repairable damage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出相对可修复性（RR）诊断指标，通过比较逐层剪枝引起的原始激活失真与通道方差匹配修复后的残余失真，评估网络层在修复后仍残留的损伤比例。研究发现RR并非普适最优的稀疏分配规则，而是在架构相关的可恢复性转变区间（即标准分配先验开始失效但修复后恢复尚未完全崩溃的区域）最为有效。实验表明RR在CIFAR100 ResNet18的中间过渡带优于ERK和部分LAMP，且投影层过度保护会损害修复效果。
AI.motivation: 在高稀疏度下，剪枝不仅决定哪些权重保留，还决定了剪枝诱导的损伤在网络中的分布位置以及这些损伤能否通过固定的轻量修复过程恢复。现有方法缺乏对这种"可修复性"差异的系统性评估，需要一种能估计各层损伤可修复程度的诊断工具。
AI.method: 提出Relative Repairability (RR)诊断指标，基于校准数据计算逐层剪枝引起的原始激活失真与通道方差匹配修复后残余失真的比值，评估各层损伤的可修复性。在ResNet18/34和VGG16 BN上使用CIFAR10/100进行实验验证。
AI.result: RR并非普适最优分配规则，在架构相关的恢复性转变区间最有效；CIFAR100 ResNet18上RR在中间过渡带优于ERK，接近过渡带上限时优于LAMP；投影层过度保护（如capped ERK）会将过多稀疏度转移至常规卷积层，降低修复后恢复效果。
AI.conclusion: 高稀疏度剪枝不仅要分配保留的权重，还应分配可修复的损伤。RR在可恢复性转变区间提供有价值的信息，帮助更合理地分配稀疏度以最大化修复后恢复效果。

title: SAE-FD: Sparse Autoencoder Feature Distillation for Continual Learning of Large Language Models
summary: Continual learning enables large language models to adapt to evolving tasks without retraining from scratch, yet catastrophic forgetting remains a central obstacle. Among continual learning methods, regularization-based approaches are widely used to constrain model updates and reduce forgetting, operating in weight space, gradient space, or output space. However, these dense representation spaces suffer from feature superposition, where multiple concepts are encoded in overlapping dimensions, making it difficult to selectively protect previously learned knowledge without impeding new-task learning. To address this issue, we propose \method (Sparse Autoencoder Feature Distillation), which anchors model representations in the sparse feature space of a pre-trained Sparse Autoencoder, where dense activations are decomposed into a sparse overcomplete basis that reduces representational entanglement, enabling more targeted regularization with less interference to new-task learning. Experiments on two continual learning benchmarks across three model architectures show that \method consistently outperforms existing regularization-based methods, achieving up to 52.70% average accuracy with only -0.46 backward transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAFE方法，利用稀疏自编码器将稠密表示分解为稀疏过完备基，从而在稀疏特征空间中进行知识蒸馏，缓解持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题。实验表明该方法在多个基准和模型上优于现有正则化方法，平均准确率最高达52.70%，后向迁移仅-0.46。
AI.motivation: 现有基于正则化的持续学习方法在权重空间、梯度空间或输出空间上约束模型更新，但这些稠密表示空间存在特征叠加问题（多个概念编码在重叠维度中），使得难以在不阻碍新任务学习的前提下选择性保护已学知识。
AI.method: 提出SAFE（Sparse Autoencoder Feature Distillation），使用预训练的稀疏自编码器将稠密激活分解为稀疏过完备基，在稀疏特征空间中进行知识蒸馏正则化，从而减少表示纠缠，实现更有针对性的约束。
AI.result: 在两个持续学习基准和三种模型架构上的实验表明，SAFE一致优于现有正则化方法，最高达到52.70%的平均准确率，后向迁移仅为-0.46。
AI.conclusion: 在稀疏特征空间中进行正则化能够有效缓解特征叠加问题，在保护已有知识与学习新任务之间取得更好平衡，为持续学习提供了一种新的正则化范式。

title: DeepSeekMath Meets Order Book: Group-Aware Policy Optimization for High-Frequency Directional Trading
summary: This paper studies reinforcement learning for high-frequency trading on limit order books by pairing an Order-Flow-based state model with policy-gradient methods. Instead of value-based RL techniques like tabular Q-learning, our approach deploys policy-based methods like vanilla PPO and DeepSeekMath-inspired variants like GRPO and GSPO, that use group-normalized updates and downside-aware shaping. On backtests with financial assets AMZN, AAPL, and GOOG under a simplified backtesting setup based on spread-scaled rewards, these new policies improve net average PnL, profitability, and drawdown over the Q-Learning baseline. Our results show that (1) Order-Flow signals are an adequate state for policy RL and (2) group-aware PPO surrogates are preferable over value-based baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文研究高频交易中的强化学习，将基于订单流的状态模型与策略梯度方法（如PPO、GRPO、GSPO）结合，在回测中相比Q-learning基线提升了净平均盈亏、盈利能力和回撤表现。
AI.motivation: 探索基于策略的强化学习方法（而非传统的基于值的方法）在高频限价订单簿交易中的应用，以提升交易决策性能。
AI.method: 采用基于订单流的状态模型，结合策略梯度方法（vanilla PPO、GRPO、GSPO），使用组归一化更新和下行风险感知塑造，在简化回测设置下基于价差缩放奖励进行训练。
AI.result: 在AMZN、AAPL、GOOG三个金融资产上，策略方法相比Q-learning基线显著提升了净平均盈亏、盈利能力和回撤指标。
AI.conclusion: 订单流信号足以作为策略强化学习的状态表示；基于组感知的PPO代理优于基于值的基线方法。

title: 'Si'multaneous 'S'patial-'T'emporal Message Passing for Dynamic Graph Representation Learning
summary: Dynamic graph neural networks (DGNNs) that operate on snapshot sequences typically fall into one of two categories. \emph{Temporal-first} approaches build per-node temporal embeddings and only afterwards perform spatial aggregation, whereas \emph{Spatial-first} approaches invert this order, feeding the output of a graph convolution into a downstream temporal module. In either case, the rigid sequencing forces the second stage to consume an already-compressed summary produced by the first, ruling out joint reasoning over topology and evolution; concretely, the message-passing operator never gets to weight a neighbor's contribution by that neighbor's \emph{past} trajectory. This paper introduces \textbf{SiST-GNN} (\textbf{Si}multaneous \textbf{S}patial-\textbf{T}emporal \textbf{GNN}), which fuses the two signals inside a single message-passing operation rather than chaining them. Concretely, at each snapshot we maintain a recurrent hidden state per node that summarises its history, pair it with the node's current feature vector, and treat the pair as two nodes joined by a cross-time edge; running a standard graph convolution on this temporally augmented graph yields the updated representation. Our empirical study spans nine public baselines and fourteen model-dataset combinations, covering both fixed-split and live-update evaluation regimes. Across every public benchmark, SiST-GNN sets a new state of the art in link prediction task over the strongest prior method by $109$--$277\%$ in the fixed-split setting and by $68$--$194\%$ in the live-update setting. We additionally construct three dynamic node-classification tasks by discretising the underlying continuous-time event streams; here SiST-GNN beats the leading discrete-time (DTDG) baseline by $7$--$22\%$ and matches continuous-time (CTDG) methods that consume the raw events directly.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SiST-GNN，通过在同一消息传递操作中融合空间和时间信号，而非像传统DGNN那样将两者顺序处理，在链路预测任务上相比最强基线提升68-277%，并在动态节点分类任务上超越离散时间方法7-22%，媲美连续时间方法。
AI.motivation: 传统DGNN采用时序优先或空间优先的串行处理方式，导致后一阶段只能消费前一阶段已压缩的摘要，无法进行拓扑与演化的联合推理——消息传递算子无法根据邻居的历史轨迹来加权其贡献。
AI.method: 在每个快照上为每个节点维护一个循环隐状态（总结历史），将其与当前特征向量配对，并通过跨时间边连接构成一个时域增强图；在此增强图上运行标准图卷积，即可同时融合时空信息。
AI.result: 在14个模型-数据集组合上，SiST-GNN在固定切分设置下超越最强基线109-277%，在实时更新设置下超越68-194%；在离散化动态节点分类任务上超越DTDG基线7-22%，媲美CTDG方法。
AI.conclusion: SiST-GNN通过同时进行空间和时间信息融合，克服了传统串行架构的局限性，在多个动态图任务上取得了显著更优的性能。

title: Learning Permutation from Structure Without Supervision
summary: Many learning problems require uncovering a hidden ordering that reveals structure in unordered data, such as monotonicity in sorting or spatial continuity in jigsaw reconstruction. In these settings, permutations can be learned as latent operators by optimizing objectives defined directly on the reordered output, often without access to ground-truth orderings. Differentiable relaxations such as Gumbel-Sinkhorn make this approach practical by approximating permutation matrices with doubly stochastic matrices. However, learning from structure without supervision induces a non-uniform uncertainty: some assignments become confident early, while others remain ambiguous. Existing methods control this process using a single global temperature, forcing all assignments to sharpen or diffuse simultaneously and leading to instability at scale. We introduce an entropy-adaptive formulation of Gumbel-Sinkhorn that locally modulates temperature based on assignment uncertainty. This allows confident assignments to discretize early while preserving exploration where uncertainty remains. Across sorting and jigsaw reconstruction tasks and in routing-style settings, adaptive entropy control improves training stability and final permutation quality relative to fixed-temperature baselines, particularly as problem size and assignment ambiguity increase.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种熵自适应Gumbel-Sinkhorn方法，根据分配不确定性局部调节温度，使自信的分配早期离散化，同时在不确定性高时保持探索，从而在排序、拼图重建和路由类任务中提升训练稳定性和排列质量。
AI.motivation: 现有方法使用单一全局温度控制排列矩阵的锐化与扩散，导致所有分配同时锐化或扩散，在规模增大时产生不稳定性。问题在于无监督学习排列时不确定性是非均匀的——部分分配很快变得自信，而其他分配仍保持模糊。
AI.method: 提出熵自适应Gumbel-Sinkhorn公式，根据分配不确定性局部调节温度，自信分配提前离散化，不确定性高的区域维持探索。
AI.result: 在排序、拼图重建和路由类任务中，相比固定温度基线，自适应熵控制提升了训练稳定性和最终排列质量，尤其是在问题规模和分配模糊性增加时效果更显著。
AI.conclusion: 熵自适应Gumbel-Sinkhorn通过局部温度调节有效应对排列学习中非均匀不确定性问题，在无监督场景下具有更好的可扩展性和稳定性。

title: RotMoLE: Enhancing Mixture of Low-Rank Experts through Rotational Gating Mechanism
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) are commonly fine-tuned to handle domain-specific tasks before being applied to vertical applications, adapting them to complex scenarios with diverse specialized knowledge remains challenging. Meanwhile, Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture has risen as a crucial paradigm for training LLMs, and some recent works have also incorporated MoE into Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) to propose the Mixture of Low-rank Experts (MoE-LoRA), to enhance the power of low-rank adapters for learning complicated knowledge. However, conventional gating mechanisms in MoE typically apply only a scalar reweighing to selected experts, thereby limiting their underlying capacity of representation and generalization. Motivated and enabled by the low-rank structures in MoE-LoRA, we propose RotMoLE, a specialized MoE framework for low-rank experts featuring an additional rotation gate. Beyond simple scaling, RotMoLE implements a rotation mechanism for each selected expert, enabling superior expert exploitation and specialization for learning diverse data, especially when expert candidates are limited. Empirical results on complex multi-task and multilingual training scenarios validate our effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 针对MoE-LoRA中传统门控机制仅对专家进行标量加权导致表征能力受限的问题，提出RotMoLE框架，通过引入旋转门控机制对低秩专家进行旋转操作，在有限专家条件下实现更优的专家利用与专业化，在多任务和多语言场景中验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有MoE-LoRA的门控机制仅对选中的专家进行标量重加权，限制了低秩适配器在复杂场景下的表征能力和泛化能力，亟需一种更强的专家融合机制。
AI.method: 提出RotMoLE，利用MoE-LoRA中低秩结构的特性，在传统门控之外引入额外的旋转门控（rotation gate），对每个选中的专家执行旋转操作，而非简单的标量缩放。
AI.result: 在复杂的多任务训练和多语言训练场景中，RotMoLE相比基线方法取得了更优的实验结果。
AI.conclusion: 旋转门控机制能够提升低秩专家的利用效率和专业化程度，尤其在专家候选数量有限时效果显著，为MoE与PEFT的结合提供了新的改进方向。

title: Geometric Flow Matching for Molecular Conformation Generation via Manifold Decomposition
summary: The generation of accurate 3D molecular conformations is a pivotal challenge in computational chemistry and drug discovery. Recently, diffusion and flow matching models have achieved remarkable success. However, there is a critical misalignment between their mathematical formulation and the physical reality of molecules. Existing approaches predominantly treat molecules as unstructured point clouds in Cartesian space, overlooking the intrinsic hierarchical mechanics where bond lengths and bond angles are relatively stiff, whereas torsion angles constitute the dominant flexible degrees of freedom. This lack of manifold awareness forces models to relearn fundamental geometric constraints from scratch, often leading to physically implausible intermediate structures. To address this, we propose GO-Flow that aligns generative modeling with molecular geometry via manifold decomposition. Instead of forcing motion through Euclidean space, GO-Flow decomposes the generation process into three physically motivated subspaces: translation space with linear optimal transport, rotation space with geodesic flows on $SO(3)$, and conformation space with entropic optimal transport. This decomposition injects geometric inductive biases and makes the generative paths better aligned with molecular degrees of freedom. When combined with equivariant neural architectures, it encourages rotation-consistent generation and improves geometric validity. Extensive experiments on GEOM-Drugs and GEOM-QM9 demonstrate that GO-Flow achieves state-of-the-art generation quality. Notably, by learning straighter probability paths on the correct manifolds naturally, our method enables high-fidelity sampling with as few as 50 steps, effectively bridging the gap between structural precision and computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: GO-Flow通过将分子生成过程分解为平移、旋转和构象三个物理子空间，解决了现有扩散/流匹配模型忽略分子层次几何约束的问题，在GEOM数据集上实现了SOTA质量，仅需50步即可生成高保真构象。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散和流匹配模型将分子视为笛卡尔空间中的无结构点云，忽略了分子内在的层次化力学结构（键长键角刚硬、扭转角柔性），导致模型需从头学习基本几何约束，产生物理上不可信的中间结构。
AI.method: 提出GO-Flow，将生成过程分解为三个物理子空间：平移空间（线性最优传输）、旋转空间（SO(3)上的测地流）、构象空间（熵最优传输）。该分解注入了几何归纳偏置，使生成路径与分子自由度对齐，并结合等变神经网络实现旋转一致的生成。
AI.result: 在GEOM-Drugs和GEOM-QM9数据集上达到SOTA生成质量。通过在正确流形上学习更直的概率路径，仅需50步即可实现高保真采样，兼顾了结构精度与计算效率。
AI.conclusion: GO-Flow通过流形分解对齐生成建模与分子几何，有效弥合了数学公式与物理现实之间的差距，为分子构象生成提供了兼具物理合理性与计算高效性的新范式。

title: Learning Latent Dynamical Causal Processes for Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction
summary: Single-cell perturbation prediction aims to infer how cells respond to unseen interventions and to achieve out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization, providing a computational route to understanding how perturbations reshape cellular programs over time. Existing machine learning methods have made important progress, but typically capture only one side of the response. Latent causal approaches seek mechanisms that support generalization and interpretation, yet often treat perturbation effects as static outcomes. Temporal models describe how gene expression changes across time, but usually do not explicitly recover the latent causal generative mechanisms driving these changes. In practice, perturbation effects are both latent and dynamical: interventions act through unobserved cellular programs, whose states evolve over time and give rise to observed expression profiles. Motivated by this view, we propose a latent dynamical causal generative model for single-cell perturbation data that jointly captures latent cellular programs, perturbation-conditioned mechanisms, and temporal evolution. We further provide an identifiability analysis showing that, under suitable conditions, the latent causal variables are recoverable up to standard equivalence classes. Guided by this analysis, we develop CITE-VAE, a learning framework for recovering latent cellular programs and their perturbation-driven dynamics from single-cell sequencing data. Experiments on Causal-3DIdent validate the theoretical results and the effectiveness of the proposed method in controlled settings. Additional experiments on real-world CRISPR-based single-cell perturbation data show improved generalization to unseen perturbations compared with state-of-the-art baselines, highlighting the practical robustness of our approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CITE-VAE，一个潜变量动态因果生成模型，用于单细胞扰动预测。该模型联合捕捉潜在细胞程序、扰动条件机制和时间演化，并提供了可识别性分析。在合成数据和真实CRISPR单细胞扰动数据上，该方法相比现有基线在未见过扰动上实现了更好的泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有方法存在两方面局限：潜变量因果方法将扰动效应视为静态结果，而时序模型虽描述基因表达随时间变化，但未显式恢复驱动这些变化的潜因果生成机制。实际中扰动效应既是潜变量的又是动态的，因此需要联合建模潜在细胞程序、扰动条件机制和时间演化。
AI.method: 提出潜变量动态因果生成模型，联合建模潜在细胞程序、扰动条件机制和时间演化；提供可识别性分析，证明在适当条件下潜因果变量可恢复至标准等价类；基于此开发CITE-VAE框架，从单细胞测序数据中恢复潜在细胞程序及其扰动驱动动力学。
AI.result: 在Causal-3DIdent合成数据上验证了理论结果和方法有效性；在真实CRISPR单细胞扰动数据上，相比最先进基线在未见过扰动泛化上取得改进，展示了方法的实际鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: CITE-VAE通过联合建模潜在因果结构、扰动条件和时间动态，有效实现了单细胞扰动预测的分布外泛化，兼具理论可识别性和实际鲁棒性。

title: Extreme Region Policy Distillation
summary: Reinforcement learning for large language models faces a fundamental trade-off between sample efficiency and asymptotic performance: strictly on-policy methods discard trajectories after a single update, while off-policy reuse introduces distribution mismatch that existing trust-region techniques mitigate primarily by enforcing conservative optimization, often leaving rich training signals underutilized. To investigate this, we perform extensive off-policy updates on fixed data. Our experiments reveal that aggressive multi-step optimization brings rapid initial gains, but excessive updates cause trajectory probabilities to deviate and entropy to collapse, with performance plateauing early. Tightening KL constraints merely lowers the ceiling without resolving the degradation. This motivates Extreme Region Policy Distillation (ERPD), a two-stage framework that decouples sample efficiency from KL efficiency. The first stage performs weakly constrained off-policy optimization on fixed data to maximally extract training signals. The resulting policy provides token-level supervision. In the second stage, we distill these signals into the base policy under trust-region constraints, filtering harmful drift while preserving useful signals. The distilled policy achieves comparable or better performance with substantially smaller KL divergence, indicating that much of the first-stage divergence was spent on unnecessary drift rather than genuine improvement. Crucially, ERPD accommodates both strong and weak teachers: when aggressive optimization yields no stronger policy, even degenerate teachers provide effective supervision via alternative signal construction strategies. We validate ERPD on mathematical reasoning, showing gains for strong base models where on-policy training plateaus, and reliable improvements with weak teachers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出极端区域策略蒸馏（ERPD）框架，通过解耦样本效率与KL效率，先对固定数据进行弱约束离线优化以最大化提取训练信号，再在信任区域约束下将这些信号蒸馏回基础策略，在数学推理任务上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型的强化学习面临样本效率与渐近性能之间的根本权衡：纯在线策略方法在单次更新后丢弃轨迹，而离线复用策略引入分布偏移，现有信任区域技术主要通过保守优化来缓解，但未能充分利用丰富的训练信号。
AI.method: ERPD两阶段框架：第一阶段在固定数据上执行弱约束离线优化以最大化提取训练信号；第二阶段在信任区域约束下将这些token级监督信号蒸馏回基础策略，过滤有害漂移同时保留有用信号。支持强教师和弱教师两种场景。
AI.result: 实验表明，激进的离线优化能带来快速初始收益，但过度更新会导致轨迹概率偏移和熵崩溃，性能早期停滞；收紧KL约束只是降低天花板而非解决退化。ERPD蒸馏策略以显著更小的KL散度达到可比或更好的性能。在数学推理任务上，强基础模型在在线策略训练停滞时仍有提升，弱教师也能提供可靠改进。
AI.conclusion: 第一阶段的大部分KL散度消耗在非必要的偏移而非真正的改进上。ERPD成功解耦了样本效率与KL效率，为离线策略优化提供了更有效的利用框架。

title: Generalized Evidential Deep Learning: From a Bayesian Perspective
summary: Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) has emerged as an efficient, sampling-free strategy for uncertainty estimation. A series of EDL variants have been proposed to address specific limitations of the original framework, achieving notable success. However, the underlying theoretical structure of EDL and the relationships among these variants have received limited systematic investigation. In this work, we establish a principled theoretical foundation for EDL by interpreting it within a generalized Bayesian framework that includes prior specification, posterior update, and training objective. We further characterize evidential uncertainty from a Bayesian distributional uncertainty viewpoint, established via asymptotic analysis. Building on this perspective, we further propose Generalized Evidential Deep Learning (GEDL), a unified and extensible framework that explicitly disentangles the roles of individual components and systematically relates GEDL to existing variants. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GEDL yields comparable results on classification, uncertainty estimation and OOD detections, with theoretical grounding.

AI.tldr: 本文系统建立了证据深度学习（EDL）的理论基础，将其置于广义贝叶斯框架下解释，并提出了统一可扩展的广义证据深度学习（GEDL）框架，明确解耦各组件作用并关联现有变体，实验证明其在分类、不确定性估计和OOD检测上表现良好。
AI.motivation: EDL变体虽多，但缺乏对EDL理论结构及变体间关系的系统研究。
AI.method: 在广义贝叶斯框架（先验规范、后验更新、训练目标）下解释EDL，通过渐近分析从贝叶斯分布不确定性角度刻画证据不确定性，并提出GEDL统一框架解耦组件作用。
AI.result: GEDL在分类、不确定性估计和OOD检测上取得了与现有方法相当的结果，且具有理论支撑。
AI.conclusion: GEDL为EDL提供了统一的理论基础，能系统关联并解释现有变体，同时保持良好性能。

title: Towards the Connection between Activation Sparsity and Flat Minima
summary: The observation that activation sparsity emerges in MLP blocks of standardly trained Transformers offers an opportunity to drastically reduce computation costs without sacrificing performance. To theoretically explain this phenomenon, existing works have shown that activation sparsity does not result from the data properties or data fitting but from the implicit bias of the training process. However, these connections are obtained with strong assumptions, which cannot be applied to deep models standardly trained with a large number of steps. Different from these works, we find that the flatness of loss landscapes is also closely related to the MLP activation sparsity and can serve as a weaker and naturally emerging assumption standard deep networks. Specifically, we find that 1) the MLP activation sparsity equals a ratio between "augmented flatness" (a weighted sum of flatness measures) and the product of the input norm and activation gradient of the MLP. We empirically find that this ratio decreases during training, leading to sparse activations. 2) We also propose the notion of derivative sparsity, which reduces to activation sparsity under ReLU, but further enables pruning in the backward propagation and is more stable than activation sparsity. With the theoretical findings, we can further encourage activation sparsity by decreasing the numerator and increasing the denominator of the ratio using three methods. These plug-and-play modifications can effectively reduce the ratio and produce sparser activations. Experiments on ImageNet-1K and C4 demonstrate relative improvements of at least 36% on inference sparsity and at least 50% on training sparsity over vanilla Transformers, indicating further potential cost reduction in both inference and training

AI.tldr: 本文发现Transformer的MLP激活稀疏性与损失景观的平坦度密切相关，推导出激活稀疏性等于"增强平坦度"与输入范数和激活梯度乘积的比值，并提出导数稀疏性概念，通过三种方法降低该比值，在ImageNet-1K和C4上实现推理稀疏性提升至少36%、训练稀疏性提升至少50%。
AI.motivation: 现有工作仅在高假设条件下解释Transformer MLP激活稀疏性的隐式偏置，无法推广到标准训练的深层模型，需要更普适的理论解释。
AI.method: 1) 推导激活稀疏性与损失景观平坦度的比值关系；2) 提出导数稀疏性概念；3) 设计三种即插即用方法通过减小分子、增大分母来降低比值以鼓励稀疏性。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1K和C4数据集上，推理稀疏性提升至少36%，训练稀疏性提升至少50%。
AI.conclusion: 损失景观平坦度是解释和进一步促进MLP激活稀疏性的有效且普适的理论依据，可为训练和推理提供进一步的计算成本降低潜力。

title: Analogies between Transformer Layers and Power Method
summary: In the paper we show that there is an analogy between the operations occurring in a layer of a transformer (projections and layer normalizations, disregarding the feedforward neural network) and a step in the power method. Coherently with this analogy, we show that passing through a layer the tokens tend to be tilted towards the principal eigenvector of a matrix which is the product of the output and value weight matrices of that layer. In the special case of a transformer with shared weights (i.e., in which all layers have identical weights) then the alignment with this principal eigenvector is particularly evident empirically, and can also be shown analytically. The analogy also suggests a method to steer the output of the transformer towards an arbitrary desired direction in token space.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了Transformer层中的操作（投影和层归一化，忽略前馈网络）与幂法迭代步骤之间的类比关系。研究表明，经过一层处理后，token会倾向于对齐到该层输出权重矩阵与值权重矩阵乘积的主特征向量方向。在权重共享的Transformer（所有层权重相同）中，这种对齐现象在实验和理论上都尤为明显。该类比还提出了一种将Transformer输出引导至token空间中任意目标方向的方法。
AI.motivation: 探索Transformer层内部操作（投影和层归一化）的数学本质，试图从幂法的角度理解token表示在层间传递时的演化规律，并寻找可控输出方向的理论依据。
AI.method: 通过建立Transformer层操作与幂法步骤之间的形式类比，理论推导token会向输出权重矩阵与值权重矩阵乘积的主特征向量方向倾斜；在权重共享的Transformer中给出分析证明，并通过实验验证该现象。
AI.result: 1) 证明了Transformer层操作与幂法步骤之间存在类比关系；2) token经过层处理后倾向于对齐到某矩阵的主特征向量方向；3) 在权重共享的Transformer中该对齐现象显著且可解析证明；4) 提出了基于该类比引导输出方向的可行方法。
AI.conclusion: Transformer层中的投影和归一化操作可类比为幂法迭代，token表示在层间传递时自发地向某一主特征向量方向收敛，这为理解Transformer内部表示机制提供了新视角，并为可控生成提供了理论指导。

title: Closed-Form Node Classification with Exact Graph Unlearning
summary:
Graph neural networks for node classification are typically trained by gradient descent over hundreds or thousands of epochs. Recent work has shown that, when properly tuned, classic GCN/SAGE/GAT architectures can match graph transformers on many node-classification benchmarks. We ask a complementary question: how much of this performance can be recovered by deterministic closed-form solvers, and what guarantees does this enable?
  We introduce a routed closed-form framework selected by adjusted homophily. For assortative graphs, we use SGC-style propagation followed by Ridge regression; for heterophilous graphs, we introduce LCF-Net, a layer-wise closed-form graph feature-refinement network whose per-layer Ridge solves are capped by a Gaussian kernel-Ridge head. Across 14 benchmarks, including ogbn-arxiv and ogbn-proteins, our closed-form predictors match or beat the best vanilla 2-layer GCN/SAGE/GAT on 9 of 9 measured datasets, tie tuned deep recipes within one standard deviation on 9 of 12 small benchmarks, and exceed the OGB-leaderboard plain GCN on both large graphs. The remaining heterophilous gap closely tracks the gain from vanilla 2-layer to deep SAGE, suggesting that the residual difference is primarily architectural.
  Because our predictors are explicit solutions of deterministic linear systems, modified graph inputs can be re-solved to obtain retrain-equivalent parameters. We formalize exact graph-object unlearning for label, feature, edge, node, and subgraph modifications, prove K-hop locality for Ridge components, and verify exactness across 109 configurations. On ogbn-arxiv, localized updates give $21$--$45\times$ speedups over full re-solving and roughly $10^{6}\times$ speedups over gradient retraining. Structural-inversion experiments further quantify the privacy floor of exact retraining and the additional leakage of approximate graph-unlearning methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于封闭形式求解器的图节点分类框架，通过调整同质性选择路由策略：同质图使用SGC+Ridge回归，异质图使用LCF-Net（逐层Ridge求解+高斯核Ridge头）。在14个基准上，该方法匹配或超越经典2层GCN/SAGE/GAT在9/9个数据集上的表现，与深度方法在9/12个小基准上差距在一个标准差内，并在两个大图上超过OGB排行榜的普通GCN。由于预测器是确定性线性系统的显式解，可支持精确的图对象遗忘（标签/特征/边/节点/子图修改），证明Ridge组件的K跳局部性，在ogbn-arxiv上实现21-45倍加速（vs重新求解）和约10^6倍加速（vs梯度重训练）。
AI.motivation: 探索封闭形式（非梯度下降）的确定性求解器在图节点分类任务上能达到多好的性能，以及这种确定性方法能提供哪些理论保证（如精确遗忘、局部性等）。
AI.method: 提出路由封闭形式框架，根据调整同质性选择策略：同质图用SGC风格传播+Ridge回归；异质图用LCF-Net（逐层封闭形式图特征精炼网络，每层Ridge求解后接高斯核Ridge头）。利用封闭形式解实现精确图对象遗忘。证明Ridge组件的K跳局部性。进行结构反转实验量化隐私泄露。在14个基准上评估。
AI.result: 在9/9个数据集上匹配或超越最佳普通2层GCN/SAGE/GAT；在9/12个小基准上与深度方法差距在一个标准差内；在两个大图上超过OGB排行榜普通GCN。精确遗忘在ogbn-arxiv上比重新求解快21-45倍，比梯度重训练快约10^6倍。剩余异质图差距主要来自架构而非优化。
AI.conclusion: 封闭形式方法在图节点分类上能达到与基于梯度的GCN/SAGE/GAT相当的性能，同时提供精确遗忘、局部更新等梯度方法难以实现的理论保证。异质图上的剩余差距主要源于架构差异而非优化方式。

title: Opportunistic Target Selection: Early Directional Commitment for Query-Efficient Black-Box Adversarial Attacks
comment: 13 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables; code available at https://github.com/Tariolle/opportunistic-target-selection
summary:
Black-box adversarial attacks that minimize only the ground-truth confidence suffer from class drift: perturbations wander through the feature space without committing to a specific adversarial class, wasting queries on diffuse, undirected progress. We introduce Opportunistic Target Selection (OTS), a lightweight wrapper that switches an untargeted attack to a targeted objective early in its trajectory, locking onto whichever non-true class currently leads. OTS requires no architectural modification to the underlying attack, no gradient access, and no a priori target-class knowledge.
  We validate OTS on three score-based attacks (SimBA, Square Attack with cross-entropy loss, and Bandits) across five standard ImageNet classifiers (4,500 runs). On random-search attacks, OTS closely tracks oracle performance, with gains up to +27 pp in success rate and 43% relative reduction in censored-mean iterations on ResNet-50. On gradient-estimation attacks (Bandits) and attacks with margin loss, OTS is redundant, a negative result that reinforces our interpretation of OTS as a margin-loss surrogate. On adversarially-trained models, a bimodal difficulty distribution eliminates the regime where targeting helps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Opportunistic Target Selection (OTS)，一种轻量级方法，通过将未定向攻击在早期切换为定向目标（锁定当前置信度最高的非真实类别），以缓解黑盒对抗攻击中的类漂移问题。实验表明OTS对随机搜索攻击效果显著（成功率提升高达27个百分点，迭代次数减少43%），但对梯度估计攻击和对抗训练模型效果有限。
AI.motivation: 黑盒对抗攻击在仅最小化真实类别置信度时存在类漂移问题：扰动在特征空间中漫无目的地游走，难以锁定特定的对抗类别，导致查询浪费在弥散、无方向的进展上。
AI.method: OTS是一种轻量级包装器，在攻击轨迹早期将未定向攻击切换为定向目标，锁定当前置信度最高的非真实类别。该方法无需修改底层攻击架构、无需梯度访问、无需先验目标类别知识。
AI.result: 在三种基于分数的攻击（SimBA、Square Attack with cross-entropy loss、Bandits）和五个ImageNet分类器上（4,500次运行），OTS在随机搜索攻击中表现优异：成功率提升高达27个百分点，ResNet-50上删除均值迭代次数相对减少43%。在梯度估计攻击（Bandits）和margin loss攻击上OTS效果冗余。在对抗训练模型上，双峰难度分布消除了OTS发挥作用的区间。
AI.conclusion: OTS作为margin loss的替代方案，在随机搜索攻击中能有效缓解类漂移问题，但对梯度估计攻击和对抗训练模型效果有限，验证了其作为margin loss替代物的本质。

title: Stochastic Estimation of the Layer-wise Hessian Trace for Monitoring Neural-network Training
summary: The loss and the norm of its gradient separate the healthy and the pathological regimes of neural-network training only weakly, whilst the curvature of the empirical risk differs qualitatively between them but is inaccessible explicitly at parameter counts $P\sim 10^{6}-10^{8}$. We present a stochastic estimator of the trace of the diagonal blocks of the Hessian matrix of the empirical risk of a neural network. The procedure combines the Hutchinson stochastic trace estimator with a single Hessian-vector product over the whole parameter vector and recovers unbiased estimates of every per-layer trace in one backward pass through the computational graph. We show that correctness under weight sharing requires the layer-wise Hessian to be assembled before the second differentiation: unrolling shared weights into independent coordinates introduces a systematic bias whose sign and magnitude are governed by the cross-instance blocks of the unrolled Hessian. A closed-form expression for the variance of the estimator at a fixed Hessian is derived, together with a decomposition of the total variance under the mini-batch sampling distribution. This decomposition yields a critical probe count $K^{\star}$ that balances the two sources of randomness and supports the practical recommendation $K\in[5,10]$ in the on-line monitoring regime. The estimator is applied to the detection of the label-memorisation regime of ResNet-18, ResNet-34, and VGG-11 on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, where a calibrated cumulative-sum decision rule attains an empirical detection power of $179/180$ at a false-alarm rate of $16/120$.

AI.tldr: 提出一种随机估计神经网络每层Hessian对角块迹的方法，结合Hutchinson估计和单次Hessian-向量积，在单个反向传播中无偏估计所有层的迹。推导了方差闭式解和mini-batch方差分解，得出最优探测次数K*∈[5,10]。在ResNet和VGG上应用于标签记忆检测，达到179/180的检测率。
AI.motivation: 损失和梯度范数难以区分神经网络的健康与病态训练状态，而经验风险曲率具有定性差异但无法在百万至亿级参数规模下显式计算，因此需要高效的Hessian迹估计方法。
AI.method: 将Hutchinson随机迹估计与单次Hessian-向量积结合，在参数向量上整体计算后解耦为逐层迹的无偏估计。推导了固定Hessian下方差闭式解以及mini-batch采样下的方差分解，得到平衡两种随机性的临界探测数K*。分析了权重共享场景下正确处理方式：需在二次微分前组装逐层Hessian，否则引入系统偏差。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10/100上对ResNet-18/34和VGG-11进行标签记忆检测实验，校准的累积和决策规则在180次测试中达到179次检测成功，虚警率为16/120。
AI.conclusion: 该方法高效、无偏，能在大规模神经网络中实用地估计逐层Hessian迹，并有效检测标签记忆化等病态训练现象。

title: Don't Retrain, Just Reuse: Recovering Dual-Target Molecules from Single-Target Diffusion Models
summary: Designing a single molecule that modulates two targets is a promising strategy for polypharmacology, but it remains substantially harder than standard single-target generation because one candidate must satisfy two binding requirements while preserving drug-likeness and synthesizability. Existing dual-target generative methods typically introduce dual-target capability by either retraining the generator or intervening in the diffusion process during sampling. The former can be costly and difficult to stabilize when dual-target supervision is sparse, while the latter may be sensitive to denoising-time target balancing and competing update directions. These limitations motivate a generator-preserving alternative that keeps the pretrained prior intact: can dual-target candidates instead be recovered from the input space of a frozen single-target diffusion model, without modifying its parameters or denoising dynamics? We formulate this task as a constrained multi-objective optimization problem and propose REUSE, a hierarchical evolutionary input-space search framework that combines pair-conditioned exploration with structured multi-stage selection to enforce dual-target affinity, chemical quality, and diversity. Experiments show that, compared with methods that modify the diffusion process, REUSE consistently improves dual-target affinity and balance, achieving a 20.9-percentage-point gain in Dual High Affinity over the strongest prior baseline while maintaining competitive molecular quality.

AI.tldr: 提出REUSE框架，通过分层进化输入空间搜索，在保持预训练单目标扩散模型不变的前提下，无需修改参数或去噪过程即可生成双靶点分子，相比修改扩散过程的方法，双靶点高亲和力提升20.9个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有双靶点生成方法要么需要重新训练生成器（成本高且稀疏监督下不稳定），要么在采样时干预扩散过程（靶点平衡敏感、更新方向竞争），因此需要一种保持预训练先验模型不变、不修改参数或去噪动力学的替代方案。
AI.method: 将双靶点生成视为约束多目标优化问题，提出REUSE分层进化输入空间搜索框架，结合配对条件探索和结构化多阶段选择，强制执行双靶点亲和力、化学质量和多样性。
AI.result: 相比修改扩散过程的方法，REUSE在双靶点亲和力和平衡性上持续改进，双靶点高亲和力指标比最强基线提升20.9个百分点，同时保持竞争力的分子质量。
AI.conclusion: REUSE验证了在冻结单目标扩散模型的输入空间中通过进化搜索即可有效恢复双靶点候选分子，为多靶点药物设计提供了一种低成本、高稳定性的新范式。

title: Evaluating passing decision-making in professional football: An enhanced MPNN approach to Receiver Selection
summary: The process of decision-making in football is characterized by a complex interplay between spatial positioning, opponent pressure, and player intent. This work introduces a Graph Neural Network (GNN) framework designed to predict Receiver Selection, the optimal passing target, by modeling on-field interactions as dynamic graphs. Each player is represented as a node with positional and contextual features, while potential passing lines form weighted edges characterized by distance, angle, and pressure metrics. A Message-Passing Neural Network (MPNN) has been developed and trained using a combination of tracking data and event data from professional matches, synchronized through a robust pipeline based on an optimized version of the Needleman-Wunsch Algorithm. The model achieves competitive accuracy in identifying the actual chosen receiver and state-of-the-art accuracy within its top three suggestions. Our model further offers quantification of each option's likelihood, threat, and creativity, enabling performance analysts to evaluate over 1,000 passes in seconds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于图神经网络（GNN）的框架，通过将足球场上球员交互建模为动态图（节点为球员，边为传球线路特征），利用消息传递神经网络（MPNN）预测最优传球目标选择。模型在专业比赛追踪与事件数据上训练（使用改进的Needleman-Wunsch算法同步数据），在识别实际接球者及Top-3建议准确率上达到当前最优水平，并能快速量化每个传球选项的似然性、威胁性和创造性。
AI.motivation: 足球决策过程涉及空间定位、对手压力和球员意图的复杂交互，现有方法难以有效捕捉这种动态图结构关系，因此需要一种能够建模球员间复杂交互的模型来预测最优传球选择。
AI.method: 1) 将场上交互建模为动态图：球员为节点（含位置与上下文特征），传球线为加权边（距离、角度、压力指标）；2) 采用消息传递神经网络（MPNN）进行学习；3) 使用改进的Needleman-Wunsch算法同步追踪数据与事件数据构建训练管线。
AI.result: 模型在识别实际接球者方面达到有竞争力的准确率，Top-3建议准确率达到当前最优水平；能够快速评估上千次传球（每选项量化似然性、威胁性和创造性）。
AI.conclusion: 基于GNN的传球预测框架有效建模了足球动态交互，不仅准确预测传球目标，还提供可解释的量化指标（似然性、威胁性、创造性），具备实际比赛分析应用价值。

title: How Should LLMs Consume High-Quality Data? Optimal Data Scheduling via Quality-Aware Functional Scaling Laws
summary: High-quality data is scarce in large language model (LLM) training, yet how to schedule its use jointly with training dynamics lacks theoretical guidance. We extend functional scaling laws by incorporating a data-quality dimension, and solve the joint data-quality and batch-size scheduling problem in asymptotic closed form. The solution reveals two regimes and a dual role of high-quality data. In the noise-limited regime, high-quality data should be used as a signal amplifier: lowering the batch size converts cleaner data into more signal without amplifying noise. In the signal-limited regime, it should be used as a noise suppressor: late placement reduces terminal noise without sacrificing signal accumulation. Existing curriculum-style pipelines primarily exploit the second role by placing cleaner data late, but miss the first role because conventional decay schedules reduce update intensity exactly when high-quality data becomes available. Guided by this, we propose Drop-Stable-Rampup for LLM midtraining: upon the quality transition, drop the batch size, hold it stable to accumulate signal, then ramp up to suppress terminal noise. On a 15B Mixture-of-Experts model midtrained on 108B tokens, Drop-Stable-Rampup improves average accuracy over Warmup-Stable-Decay (WSD) by +1.70 and over Cosine-decay by +2.98, with particularly large gains on mathematical reasoning benchmarks such as GSM8K (+4.23) and MATH (+2.80).

AI.tldr: 本文通过引入数据质量维度扩展了功能标度律，解决了联合数据质量与批次大小调度问题，并提出了Drop-Stable-Rampup调度策略。在15B MoE模型上，该策略相比WSD和Cosine-decay分别提升平均准确率+1.70和+2.98，尤其在数学推理任务上表现显著。
AI.motivation: 高质量数据在LLM训练中稀缺，但其与训练动态的联合调度缺乏理论指导。
AI.method: 扩展功能标度律引入数据质量维度，求解联合调度问题的渐近闭式解，据此提出Drop-Stable-Rampup调度策略：在质量转换点骤降批次大小、保持稳定以积累信号、再逐步提升以抑制终端噪声。
AI.result: 在15B MoE模型、108B token的中间训练实验中，Drop-Stable-Rampup相比WSD平均提升+1.70，相比Cosine-decay提升+2.98；GSM8K提升+4.23，MATH提升+2.80。
AI.conclusion: 高质量数据具有双重作用：在噪声受限区作为信号放大器（降低批次大小），在信号受限区作为噪声抑制器（延迟放置）。现有课程式流程主要利用后者，而Drop-Stable-Rampup同时利用了两种作用。

title: Latent Representation Alignment for Offline Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) provides a practical framework for obtaining goal-reaching policies from fixed datasets. However, learning a reliable goal-conditioned value function in long-horizon tasks remains challenging. In this paper, we identify erroneous generalization in goal-conditioned value functions as a fundamental bottleneck, and demonstrate that appropriate inductive bias in the value function is crucial for addressing the bottleneck. Building on these findings, we propose Latent-Aligned Value Learning (LAVL), an offline GCRL algorithm that integrates latent-representation-based value generalization with hierarchical planning in a unified framework. Extensive experiments on OGBench demonstrate that LAVL consistently outperforms existing offline GCRL methods, achieving the highest performance on 20 out of 22 datasets. Notably, LAVL exhibits strong performance in long-horizon tasks and trajectory stitching datasets, where prior methods suffer significant performance degradation. Our code is available at https://github.com/oh-lab/LAVL.git.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为LAVL的离线目标条件强化学习算法，通过引入基于潜在表征的值函数泛化和层次化规划，有效解决了长视野任务中价值函数的错误泛化问题，在OGBench基准的22个数据集上取得了20个最高性能。
AI.motivation: 离线目标条件强化学习（GCRL）在长视野任务中学习可靠的目标条件价值函数仍然具有挑战性。论文识别出价值函数的错误泛化是根本瓶颈，并证明适当的归纳偏置对解决该瓶颈至关重要。
AI.method: 提出Latent-Aligned Value Learning (LAVL)算法，将基于潜在表征的价值泛化与层次化规划整合到一个统一框架中。
AI.result: 在OGBench的22个数据集中，LAVL在20个上取得了最优性能，尤其在长视野任务和轨迹拼接数据集上表现优异，而此前方法在这些场景中性能显著下降。
AI.conclusion: LAVL通过引入合适的归纳偏置有效缓解了价值函数的错误泛化问题，为离线GCRL在长视野任务中提供了实用且高性能的解决方案。

title: Invariant-Based Weight Sharing for Message Passing
comment: 13 pages main paper + 30 pages references and appendix
summary: Message-passing neural networks (MPNNs) are a powerful framework for learning representations of graph-structured domains. However, weights in MPNNs act on features only, limiting their ability to capture structural patterns. We introduce a novel structure-aware weight sharing principle that explicitly incorporates information inherent to the graph structure. Weights are indexed directly by user-chosen graph invariants, i.e., functions preserved under node permutations, enabling systematic reuse across structurally equivalent subgraphs. We present ShareGNNs, which instantiate this principle within a simple encoder-decoder architecture, resulting in an MPNN with learnable adjacency and transformer-like connectivity. We show that their expressivity is at least as strong as the discriminative power of the chosen invariants, providing explicit control over the model complexity. Experiments on synthetic and real-world data, as well as subgraph counting tasks, demonstrate consistent improvements over standard MPNNs, competitive expressivity beyond the 1-WL test, and scalability to large datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于结构感知权重共享的MPNN框架ShareGNNs，通过图不变量直接索引权重，实现了超越1-WL测试的表达能力，并在多个任务上取得一致改进。
AI.motivation: 标准MPNN的权重仅作用于节点特征，缺乏对图结构模式的显式建模能力，限制了模型捕获结构信息的能力。
AI.method: 提出结构感知权重共享原则，权重由用户选择的图不变量（节点置换下保持不变的函数）直接索引，实现结构等价子图间的系统化权重复用。基于此设计ShareGNNs编码器-解码器架构，形成具有可学习邻接和Transformer式连接的MPNN。
AI.result: 在合成数据、真实世界数据以及子图计数任务上，相比标准MPNN取得一致改进；表达能力超越1-WL图同构测试；可扩展到大规模数据集。
AI.conclusion: ShareGNNs的表达能力至少与所选图不变量的区分能力相当，提供了对模型复杂度的显式控制，是一种兼具理论保证和实际效果的结构感知图神经网络。

title: MDGMIX: Boundary-Aware Subgraph Mixing for Multi-Domain Graph Pre-Training
summary: Multi-domain graph pre-training is a crucial step in constructing foundational graph models with cross-domain generalization capabilities. However, existing methods predominantly rely on jointly training all source domain graphs, resulting in high computational costs. Furthermore, it remains unclear whether all source domain graph data contribute equally to effective transfer. This paper empirically reveals significant data redundancy in multi-domain graph pre-training. Based on this finding, we propose the Multi-domain Graph Pre-training Framework, MDGMIX, which combines boundary-aware subgraph mixing with hierarchical discrimination. By selecting boundary nodes to construct challenging mixed-domain subgraphs, MDGMIX employs coarse-grained domain discrimination and fine-grained domain decomposition losses to decouple shared patterns from domain-specific patterns. During adaptation, MDGMIX employs a lightweight prompt weighting mechanism to transfer source domain knowledge. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MDGMIX consistently outperforms strong baselines in few-shot classification tasks while exhibiting superior time and memory efficiency. The code is available at: https://github.com/zhengziyu77/MDGMIX.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MDGMIX，一种结合边界感知子图混合与层次化区分的多领域图预训练框架，通过选择边界节点构建混合域子图，利用粗粒度域区分和细粒度域分解损失解耦共享模式与领域特定模式，在少量样本分类任务中超越强基线，同时具有更优的时间和内存效率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于多领域图联合预训练的方法计算成本高，且不清楚所有源域图数据是否对有效迁移有同等贡献。本文实证发现多领域图预训练中存在显著数据冗余，因此需要更高效且能有效解耦共享与领域特定模式的方法。
AI.method: 1) 边界感知子图混合：选择边界节点构建具有挑战性的混合域子图；2) 层次化区分：利用粗粒度域区分损失和细粒度域分解损失解耦共享模式与领域特定模式；3) 轻量级提示权重机制：在适配阶段迁移源域知识。
AI.result: 在少量样本分类任务中，MDGMIX一致超越强基线方法，同时展现出更优的时间和内存效率。
AI.conclusion: 多领域图预训练中存在显著数据冗余，MDGMIX通过边界感知子图混合与层次化区分有效解决了这一问题，实现了高效且可迁移的图基础模型预训练。

title: NPSolver: Neural Poisson Solver with Iterative Physics Supervision
summary: Efficiently solving Poisson equations on complex, irregular domains remains a fundamental challenge in scientific computing, as classical iterative solvers often suffer from prohibitive runtime due to ill-conditioned systems. While neural operators offer a fast alternative, they typically rely on large-scale labeled datasets or struggle with unstable training dynamics when using physics-informed residual losses. We propose \textsc{NPSolver}, a neural Poisson solver trained without solution labels via iterative physics supervision. Instead of relying on fully converged numerical solutions or raw PDE residuals, \textsc{NPSolver} utilizes a small number of preconditioned conjugate gradient (PCG) steps to refine its own predictions, providing a more stable and well-scaled training signal. Theoretical analysis confirms that this iterative supervision serves as a well-conditioned error proxy and that a stop-gradient design is essential for optimization stability. To better capture boundary-driven features under mixed boundary conditions, we further introduce the Boundary-Aware Transolver (\textsc{BA-Transolver}) architecture that explicitly separates interior and boundary tokenization. Extensive evaluations on 2D and 3D irregular geometries demonstrate that \textsc{NPSolver} outperforms both physics-informed and data-driven baselines. Furthermore, a downstream thermal control task highlights the model's capability for conducting efficient and reliable gradient-based boundary control. We will release our codes and data at https://github.com/intell-sci-comput/NPSolver.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NPSolver，一种无需标签数据、通过迭代物理监督训练的神经常微分方程求解器，结合BA-Transolver架构在复杂不规则域上高效求解泊松方程，在2D/3D任务上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 经典迭代求解器在复杂不规则域上求解泊松方程因病态系统而耗时巨大；神经算子方法虽快但依赖大规模标注数据或面临物理信息残差训练的不稳定问题。
AI.method: 提出NPSolver，利用少量预处理共轭梯度（PCG）步迭代优化自身预测，提供稳定且尺度良好的训练信号；引入边界感知的BA-Transolver架构，显式分离内部和边界token化以捕捉混合边界条件下的边界驱动特征；采用停止梯度设计保证优化稳定性。
AI.result: 在2D和3D不规则几何上的广泛评估表明，NPSolver优于物理信息和数据驱动的基线方法；下游热控制任务验证了模型在高效可靠的基于梯度的边界控制方面的能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过迭代物理监督和边界感知架构，NPSolver在无需标签数据的情况下实现了对复杂域上泊松方程的高效准确求解，并在下游控制任务中展现出应用潜力。

title: On Reliability of Efficient Membership Inference Vulnerability Evaluation
summary: Membership inference attacks (MIAs) are popular methods for empirically assessing the leakage of sensitive information in the training data through models or statistics learned from the data. The MIA vulnerability is often evaluated through false positive rate (FPR) and true positive rate (TPR) of a binary classifier that tries to predict whether a particular sample was in the training data. However, in order to reliably estimate the TPR especially for low FPR values, a lot of observations are needed, which in case of MIA translates to many target models, leading to large computational cost. To avoid excessive compute requirements, the MIA scores are often averaged over multiple individuals and multiple targeted models. We demonstrate two key weaknesses in this efficient MIA evaluation pipeline. First, we show that evaluating the TPR based on MIA scores concatenated across multiple individuals, commonly used to study vulnerabilities in the very low FPR regime, is not calibrated across the per-sample FPRs. This makes it unreliable as a tool for auditing differential privacy. To solve this, we propose a post-processing method to effectively calibrate the FPR across different samples. Second, we identify a finite population bias in the commonly used efficient likelihood-ratio attack (LiRA) implementation proposed by Carlini et al. 2022, leading to a positive bias in the per-sample vulnerability.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了现有成员推理攻击（MIA）评估流程中的两个关键缺陷：1）基于跨个体拼接的MIA分数计算TPR的方法在不同样本间FPR未校准，导致低FPR区域评估不可靠；2）高效LiRA实现存在有限总体偏差，导致样本级脆弱性被正向高估。
AI.motivation: 现有MIA评估为降低计算成本，通常将多个个体和多个目标模型的分数进行平均，但这种高效评估流程可能存在未被注意的统计偏差，导致对隐私泄露的评估不准确，尤其在差分隐私审计等需要精确控制FPR的场景。
AI.method: 1）提出一种后处理方法对跨样本的FPR进行有效校准；2）识别并分析了LiRA实现中因有限总体导致的偏差问题。
AI.result: 证明基于跨个体拼接MIA分数评估TPR的方法在低FPR区间不可靠，且高效LiRA实现存在正向偏差。
AI.conclusion: 需要校准跨样本FPR并纠正有限总体偏差，才能使MIA评估成为差分隐私审计等任务的可信工具。

title: Visual-Redundancy-Controlled Parallel Decoding for Diffusion-Based Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Diffusion-based multimodal large language models (dMLLMs) decode by iteratively predicting tokens at multiple masked positions in parallel. This turns each decoding step into a position-selection problem: the model must choose not only which predictions are reliable in isolation, but also which positions should be committed together as context for later decoding steps.
