Existing confidence-based decoding ranks masked positions independently and commits the top-K positions, largely ignoring whether the committed tokens provide complementary visual grounding. We identify a step-level limitation of this strategy in multimodal settings: high-confidence tokens selected in the same step can rely on overlapping visual grounding, introducing visual redundancy among the committed tokens and leaving less complementary visual grounding available for later decoding. To quantify this effect, we introduce the Visual Redundancy Index (VRI), which measures visual grounding overlap among tokens committed in parallel. To control this redundancy during decoding, we propose Visual-Redundancy-Controlled Decoding (VRCD), a training-free inference-time decoding method that uses token-to-image attention to prioritize visually complementary positions. Across diverse multimodal benchmarks, VRCD reduces visual redundancy and remaining-position entropy with modest runtime overhead. In longer decoding experiments, it also achieves relative accuracy gains of up to 18.8% on M^3CoT and 6.9% on MMBench over confidence-based decoding. Code will be released at https://github.com/infiniteYuanyl/VRCD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出视觉冗余控制解码（VRCD），一种无需训练、推理时使用的解码方法，通过利用token到图像的注意力来优先选择视觉互补的位置，从而解决扩散式多模态大语言模型（dMLLMs）中并行解码时因高置信度token依赖重叠视觉基础导致的视觉冗余问题。实验表明VRCD能降低视觉冗余和剩余位置熵，在长序列解码中相比基于置信度的解码在M^3CoT和MMBench上分别获得最高18.8%和6.9%的相对准确率提升。
AI.motivation: 扩散式多模态大语言模型（dMLLMs）在并行解码时，现有基于置信度的解码方法独立对掩码位置排序并选择top-K提交，忽略了并行提交的token之间可能存在重叠的视觉基础，导致视觉冗余，使得后续解码可用的互补视觉基础减少，限制了模型在多模态任务上的表现。
AI.method: 1) 提出视觉冗余指数（VRI），用于量化并行提交token之间视觉基础的重叠程度；2) 提出视觉冗余控制解码（VRCD），一种无需训练、推理时使用的解码方法，利用token到图像的注意力分数来选择视觉上互补的位置，而非仅依赖置信度。
AI.result: 在多个多模态基准上，VRCD相比基于置信度的解码降低了视觉冗余和剩余位置熵，运行时开销适中。在长序列解码实验中，VRCD在M^3CoT上获得最高18.8%的相对准确率提升，在MMBench上获得6.9%的相对准确率提升。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了扩散式多模态大语言模型中并行解码存在视觉冗余问题，并提出了有效的无需训练的解决方案VRCD，通过考虑视觉互补性来选择解码位置，能够显著提升多模态任务性能。

title: Context-Instrumental Data Distillation for Kubernetes Manifest Generation: Method and Experimental Evaluation
summary: This paper examines the specialization of Small Language Models (SLMs) with up to 4 billion parameters for generating artifacts in domain-specific languages (DSL). Kubernetes manifests are chosen as the target domain. We propose the context-instrumental data distillation method: the source corpus is formed through synthetic generation and, in an extended scheme, through reverse instruction generation from real Kubernetes YAML files, with pairs included in training only upon passing external validators and matching the domain context model. Unlike classical KL-divergence knowledge distillation, the baseline implementation reduces to supervised fine-tuning on instrumentally verified examples. The experimental section presents a pilot implementation under resource-constrained conditions: the DeepSeek-V4 Flash API serves as the teacher for synthetic generation, while Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct is fine-tuned via LoRA on CPU. On the K8s-Distill-Pilot corpus (train_1200, validation_100, test_200), we achieved full-pass@1 = 91.5% (183/200) with a stricter prompt formulation and max_new_tokens=768. The key empirical finding is that for Kubernetes YAML, result quality in the pilot depended more on strict output format requirements than on simply increasing the number of training examples.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向领域特定语言（DSL）的小语言模型（SLM）专精化方法——上下文指导数据蒸馏（context-instrumental data distillation），通过合成生成和反向指令生成构建语料，结合外部验证器和领域上下文模型过滤，在资源受限条件下对Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct进行LoRA微调，在Kubernetes YAML生成任务上达到91.5%的pass@1准确率，并发现输出格式的严格性比增加训练数据量更关键。
AI.motivation: 探索小语言模型（≤4B参数）在领域特定语言（DSL）生成任务上的专精化能力，以Kubernetes清单为目标领域，研究在资源受限条件下如何有效提升SLM的生成质量。
AI.method: 提出上下文指导数据蒸馏方法：通过教师模型（DeepSeek-V4 Flash API）合成生成和从真实K8s YAML文件反向指令生成构建源语料，仅当生成样本通过外部验证器且匹配领域上下文模型时才纳入训练集。基线实现为对经过工具验证的样本进行监督微调（非经典KL散度知识蒸馏），使用LoRA在CPU上微调Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct。
AI.result: 在K8s-Distill-Pilot语料库（训练1200，验证100，测试200）上，采用更严格的提示公式和max_new_tokens=768时，full-pass@1达到91.5%（183/200）。关键实证发现：对于K8s YAML生成，结果质量更依赖于严格的输出格式要求，而非单纯增加训练样本数量。
AI.conclusion: 上下文指导数据蒸馏方法能有效提升SLM在DSL生成任务上的表现；在资源受限的K8s YAML生成场景下，输出格式的严格约束比增加训练数据量更能提升生成质量。

title: Geometric Evolution Maps: Extracting Stable Concept Probes from Transformer Residual Streams
comment: 24 pages, 3 figures. Reference implementation: rosetta_tools v1.3.1 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.20361433)
summary: Concept probes extracted from transformer residual streams are only as reliable as the layer from which they are extracted. The common practice of probing at a fixed late layer or at the peak of a separation score function ignores a fundamental structural feature: concept representations undergo substantial directional rotation during their assembly phase, and do not settle into a stable direction until a characteristic handoff layer after the primary Concept Allocation Zone (CAZ). We introduce Geometric Evolution Maps (GEMs), which track the full directional trajectory of a concept through residual stream activations, identify the handoff layer where rotation ceases, and extract the settled probe direction from that layer. Across 23 architectures spanning 70M to 14B parameters and 17 concept types, the entry-to-exit cosine similarity within CAZs has a mean of 0.233, showing that probe direction at CAZ entry does not reliably predict probe direction at exit. Ablation experiments across 391 concept x model pairs (23 models x 17 concepts) show that GEM-extracted probes are at least as precise as peak-layer probes in 268/391 trials (68.5%), and strictly outperform in 259/391 (66.2%). The architecture split is pronounced: MHA models favour the handoff in 173/221 trials (78.3%); GQA models favour the handoff in only 56/119 trials (47.1%). Model-level Wilcoxon: W=214, N=23, p=0.010 (one-sided). An adaptive ablation width rule targets the 79/391 near-final-layer cases: it improves probe quality in 60/79 triggered cases (75.9%), mean gain +7.44pp. A direction-specificity control confirms the ablation effect is concept-direction specific: median 377x suppression rate versus random-direction ablation (99.1% of concept directions beat all 10 random seeds). Reference implementation: rosetta_tools v1.3.1 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.20361433).

AI.tldr: 本文揭示transformer残差流中概念探针的可靠性取决于提取层，提出几何演化图（GEM）追踪概念方向轨迹，识别旋转停止的交接层并提取稳定探针方向。实验表明，概念分配区（CAZ）内方向变化剧烈（平均余弦相似度0.233），GEM探针在68.5%的测试中优于或持平峰值层探针，自适应消融规则在触发案例中提升75.9%的探针质量。
AI.motivation: 现有在固定晚期层或分离度峰值层提取概念探针的做法忽略了概念表征在组装阶段经历显著方向旋转这一基本结构特征，导致探针方向不稳定、不可靠。
AI.method: 提出几何演化图（GEM），追踪概念在残差流激活中的完整方向轨迹，识别旋转停止的交接层，从该层提取稳定探针方向。在23种架构（70M-14B参数）和17种概念类型上进行验证，并设计自适应消融宽度规则和方向特异性控制实验。
AI.result: CAZ内入口到出口余弦相似度均值仅0.233；GEM探针在68.5%的试验中优于或持平峰值层探针，66.2%严格更优；MHA模型优势显著（78.3%），GQA模型优势较弱（47.1%）；自适应消融在79例触发案例中提升75.9%探针质量；方向特异性控制显示中位数377倍抑制率。
AI.conclusion: 概念探针的可靠性高度依赖提取层，GEM方法通过识别方向稳定层显著提升探针质量，但效果因架构类型（MHA vs GQA）而异，提示不同注意力机制对概念表征动力学的影响不同。

title: When Self-Belief Misleads: Active Label Acquisition for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable advancements in reasoning capabilities empowered by Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR). Nonetheless, RLVR intrinsically relies on ground-truth labels for reward computation, the acquisition of which is often prohibitively expensive in real-world scenarios. While unsupervised RLVR paradigms attempt to circumvent this by training on pseudo-labels, they are notoriously susceptible to training collapse. Moreover, different samples often exhibit varying annotation values. In this paper, we propose Reinforcement Learning with Active Verifiable Rewards (RLAVR), which actively acquires ground-truth labels for a small set of selected samples and integrates them with pseudo-labels, thereby stabilizing training dynamics and improving performance under limited annotation budgets. To identify valuable samples, we propose the Corrective Advantage Gap (CAG) metric and analyze the sample-level supervision value. Building on this, we introduce Correction-Aware Reliability Estimation for RLAVR (CARE), which translates the oracle CAG criterion into a practical pre-query acquisition policy to substantially improve training stability. Extensive experiments across diverse domains, model families, and model scales demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of our approach. Our code is available at https://github.com/Lumina04/CARE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RLAVR框架，通过主动选择少量高价值样本获取真实标签并与伪标签结合，在有限标注预算下稳定强化学习训练；同时提出CARE策略，基于矫正优势差距（CAG）指标实现预查询样本选择，提升训练稳定性。实验验证了其有效性和泛化性。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR依赖真实标签，获取成本高昂；无监督RLVR使用伪标签易导致训练崩溃；不同样本的标注价值差异大。
AI.method: 提出RLAVR框架：主动获取少量高价值样本的真实标签，与伪标签融合训练。提出CAG指标量化样本级监督价值，并设计CARE策略将其转化为可操作的预查询采集策略。
AI.result: 在多个领域、模型家族和模型尺度上的实验证明了该方法在有限标注预算下的有效性和泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 通过主动选择高价值样本获取真实标签可以显著提升RLVR训练稳定性与性能，CAG和CARE为样本选择提供了理论指导与实用方案。

title: UNATE: UNsupervised ATomic Embedding for crystal structures property prediction
summary: Accurately predicting crystal properties is critical for accelerating materials discovery, but it is often limited by scarce labeled data and costly theoretical calculations. To alleviate this, we propose UNATE (Unsupervised Atomic Embedding), a framework that leverages structural information extracted from unlabeled crystal structures. UNATE integrates an unsupervised denoising autoencoder with self-supervised contrastive learning to learn robust atomic representations, which are then used as input features for downstream property prediction. Experimental results show that replacing raw atomic numbers with UNATE-pretrained node embeddings yields a 2.7\% improvement over the full-data baseline. Notably, the benefits become more pronounced in scenarios with limited labeled data, reaching improvements of up to 10\% when only 25\% of the labeled data is used.

AI.tldr: 提出UNATE框架，利用无监督去噪自编码器和自监督对比学习从无标签晶体结构中学习原子表征，用于提升下游属性预测性能，尤其在标签数据稀缺时效果显著。
AI.motivation: 晶体属性预测受限于标注数据稀缺和理论计算昂贵，需要利用无标签晶体结构信息来提升预测性能。
AI.method: 结合无监督去噪自编码器与自监督对比学习，从无标签晶体结构中学习鲁棒的原子表示，作为下游属性预测的输入特征。
AI.result: 全数据基线提升2.7%；仅用25%标注数据时提升高达10%。
AI.conclusion: UNATE框架能有效利用无标签数据学习原子嵌入，显著缓解标注数据稀缺问题，在数据有限场景下优势更突出。

title: The Quantization Benefits of Residual-Free Transformers
summary: Large-scale transformer training and deployment are increasingly constrained by the transfer of activations, gradients, and optimizer states across accelerators. Low-bit quantization offers a natural remedy, but transformer activations are often heavy-tailed and outlier-dominated, making simple quantization highly lossy. We show that this difficulty is not only a property of the quantizer, but also of the architecture. Specifically, residual connections can drive transformer activations away from Gaussianity during training. Using controlled comparisons between residual and residual-free transformers, we demonstrate that this effect leads to substantially higher quantization error and accuracy degradation at low precision in residual models. We explain the phenomenon through an excess kurtosis analysis, showing that residual mixing can amplify non-Gaussianity, whereas dense mixing in residual-free contracts non-Gaussianity. We then show that residual-free transformers can be made trainable using orthogonal initialization, spectral or second-order optimization, and depth-aware scaling of attention temperature. In language tasks, while there is a small drop in full precision performance, these models retain near-Gaussian activations and exhibit significantly improved robustness to low-bit quantization. Our results identify an accuracy--compressibility trade-off in transformer design and motivate architecture-level approaches to quantization-friendly foundation models.

AI.tldr: 本文发现Transformer中的残差连接会导致激活值偏离高斯分布、呈现重尾和离群值主导的特性，从而加剧低比特量化误差。相比之下，无残差Transformer在正交初始化等训练技巧下保持近似高斯激活，虽在全精度下有轻微性能损失，但对低比特量化具有显著更强的鲁棒性。研究揭示了Transformer设计中存在精度与可压缩性之间的权衡，并推动了面向量化友好的架构级方法。
AI.motivation: 大规模Transformer训练和部署中，跨加速器传输激活值、梯度和优化器状态的开销日益成为瓶颈。低比特量化是自然解决方案，但Transformer激活值常呈现重尾和离群值主导的特性，导致简单量化损失严重。本文旨在探究这一困难的根源——不仅是量化器属性，更是架构属性，并寻找量化友好的替代架构设计。
AI.method: 通过残差与无残差Transformer的受控对比实验，分析激活值的高斯性差异及其对量化误差的影响。利用超额峰度（excess kurtosis）分析解释残差混合会放大非高斯性，而无残差网络中的稠密混合会收缩非高斯性。对无残差Transformer采用正交初始化、谱优化或二阶优化、以及深度感知注意力温度缩放等技巧使其可训练。
AI.result: 在语言任务中，无残差Transformer在全精度下性能略有下降，但保持了近似高斯激活值，对低比特量化表现出显著提升的鲁棒性。残差模型则因激活值偏离高斯分布而导致更高的量化误差和精度退化。
AI.conclusion: Transformer设计中存在精度与可压缩性（量化友好度）之间的权衡。残差连接虽有利于全精度性能，但会加剧激活值非高斯性从而损害量化效果。这启示应通过架构层面的设计（如去除残差连接并辅以适当的训练技巧）来构建量化友好的基础模型。

title: Conformalised imprecise inference for robust extrapolation under limited data
summary: Recent advances in uncertainty quantification increasingly emphasise the distinction between aleatory and epistemic uncertainty in machine learning, motivating the need for more unified frameworks. However, despite much progress in producing reliable predictions, existing methods often lack rigorous guarantees when generalising beyond the training domain. We propose a conformalised imprecise inference framework for robust extrapolation, which is model-agnostic and augments predictive models with imprecision and distance awareness. The proposed approach yields imprecise predictions (probability boxes) that remain valid under distributional shift, maintaining coverage while adaptively expanding uncertainty in extrapolation regimes. Experiments on synthetic and benchmark datasets demonstrate improved robustness and reliable coverage compared to standard probabilistic approaches, particularly under limited data.

AI.tldr: 提出一种共形化不精确推断框架，通过融合不精度和距离感知实现模型无关的鲁棒外推，在分布偏移下仍能保持有效覆盖并自适应扩展不确定性。
AI.motivation: 现有不确定性量化方法在区分偶然不确定性和认知不确定性方面取得进展，但在训练域外泛化时缺乏严格保证，需要更统一的框架以提供鲁棒的外推能力。
AI.method: 提出共形化不精确推断框架，模型无关，通过不精度（概率盒）和距离感知机制增强预测模型，在分布偏移下维持覆盖并自适应扩展不确定性。
AI.result: 在合成数据集和基准数据集上的实验表明，与标准概率方法相比，该方法在有限数据条件下具有更优的鲁棒性和可靠的覆盖性能。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为外推场景下的不确定性量化提供了具有理论保证的实用方案，有效平衡了可靠性与表达能力。

title: Merge-Bench: Resolve Merge Conflicts with Large Language Models
summary: This paper applies machine learning to the difficult and important task of version control merging. (1) We constructed a dataset, Merge-Bench, of 7938 real-world merge conflict hunks from 1439 GitHub repositories. The ground truth is the merge resolution that developers committed to the repository. Our dataset construction methodology is scalable to arbitrary amounts of data since no manual labeling is required. (2) We trained a model, LLMergeJ, to resolve merge conflicts in Java programs. Our approach uses Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), an online reinforcement learning method, to train a Large Language Model (LLM). (3) We performed two evaluations of the performance of LLMs on resolving merge conflicts. On Java programs, LLMergeJ with 14B parameters outperforms 3 commercial LLMs, trailing only Gemini 2.5 Pro. Across 11 programming languages, commercial LLM performance is largely stable from language to language. The best models correctly resolve less than 60% of merge conflicts.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了包含7938个真实合并冲突的数据集Merge-Bench，并训练了基于GRPO强化学习的14B参数模型LLMergeJ，其在Java合并冲突解决上超越多数商业LLM，但最佳模型正确率仍不足60%。
AI.motivation: 版本控制合并是软件开发中的重要任务，但现有方法难以有效解决合并冲突，需要更智能的自动化解决方案。
AI.method: (1) 构建Merge-Bench数据集：从1439个GitHub仓库收集7938个真实合并冲突，使用开发者提交的合理解作为真实标注，无需人工标注；(2) 训练LLMergeJ模型：采用组相对策略优化(GRPO)这一在线强化学习方法对大型语言模型进行微调；(3) 评估：在Java程序上对比商业LLM，并在11种编程语言上测试商业LLM性能。
AI.result: LLMergeJ(14B参数)在Java合并冲突解决上优于3个商业LLM，仅次于Gemini 2.5 Pro；商业LLM在11种编程语言上表现稳定；最佳模型正确解决率<60%。
AI.conclusion: 基于GRPO强化学习的LLM在合并冲突解决任务上展现出潜力，但当前最佳模型性能仍有较大提升空间，该问题尚未被充分解决。

title: Predicting Stock Price Direction on Earnings Announcement Days using Multi-modal Deep Learning
summary: Predicting stock price movements during Earnings Announcements (EAs) is a significant challenge due to market noise and high-impact price discontinuities. In this study, we evaluate whether pre-announcement news sentiment, firm fundamentals, and recent market dynamics jointly predict the directional price movement of equities on EA days. We construct a multi-modal feature space combining 15 fundamental metrics, 3 price-based technical indicators and sentiment scores derived from financial news articles processed using FinBERT. We compare a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network and a Transformer-based architecture against a logistic regression baseline, and further assess all models with and without sentiment features to quantify their incremental value. Our results indicate that while the LSTM demonstrates higher precision through a conservative safe-bet strategy, the Transformer model exhibits superior sensitivity in identifying volatile movements, achieving a higher macro F1-score, with ablation experiments showing a consistent benefit from incorporating news sentiment.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建结合基本面、技术指标和新闻情感的多模态特征，比较LSTM、Transformer和逻辑回归在财报公告期间预测股票价格方向性运动的效果。结果表明LSTM精度更高但保守，Transformer敏感性更强且宏观F1更优，引入新闻情感特征一致提升模型性能。
AI.motivation: 财报公告期间股票价格预测面临市场噪声和高影响价格不连续性的重大挑战，现有方法难以有效整合多源信息进行准确预测。
AI.method: 构建多模态特征空间，包含15个基本面指标、3个基于价格的技术指标以及使用FinBERT处理财经新闻得到的情感分数。对比LSTM网络、Transformer架构和逻辑回归基线模型，并通过消融实验评估情感特征的增量价值。
AI.result: LSTM通过保守策略实现更高精度；Transformer在识别波动性运动方面敏感性更强，取得更高宏观F1分数；消融实验一致表明引入新闻情感特征带来性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 多模态特征融合能有效预测财报公告期间股价方向性运动，深度学习模型优于逻辑回归基线，且新闻情感特征具有一致的增量价值。Transformer在敏感性和整体平衡性上优于LSTM。

title: Reading the Finetuning Prior: Verbatim Content Recovery via Contrastive Decoding Diffing
summary: Narrowly finetuned language models memorize implanted content verbatim, but auditing what a deployed model has been taught, without access to its weights or training data, remains an open challenge. Recent work shows that activation differences between base and finetuned models carry readable traces of the finetuning domain; the state-of-the-art Activation Difference Lens (ADL) recovers a vague domain-level description but requires full "white-box" access to model internals. We introduce Contrastive Decoding Diffing (CDD), a model diffing method that operates on output-level logit distributions only, with no weight access, no layer selection, and no per-model tuning, yet recovers implanted facts. CDD consists of three ideas: bypassing the chat template to expose the raw finetuning prior, seeding generation with maximally vague pre-fills, and amplifying the logit-space difference between finetuned and base models at each decoding step. A single default configuration recovers implanted facts verbatim -- exact drug names, vote counts, physical measurements, and procedural details -- across four architectures (1B--32B parameters), uniformly outperforming ADL despite less access and running ~170x faster. Furthermore, CDD surfaces unintended data pipeline artifacts: a fictional persona introduced by the LLM data generator via mode collapse leaked into model weights and was extracted by CDD, constituting to our knowledge the first demonstrated end-to-end fingerprinting chain from data generator artifact to model weights to recovered output. We validate on real-domain finetuning settings, achieving near-perfect recovery across all single-dataset non-CoT variants and correctly identifying all four datasets in the mixed-dataset setting. CDD's success as a grey-box method outperforming white-box baselines underscores its practical utility for transparency and accountability in AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出对比解码差异分析（CDD），一种仅需输出层logit分布、无需权重访问或层选择的模型差异分析方法，能从微调模型中逐字恢复植入事实，性能优于白盒方法ADL约170倍，并首次展示了从数据生成器伪影到模型权重的端到端指纹追踪链。
AI.motivation: 当前缺乏一种无需访问模型权重或训练数据、却能有效审计已部署模型所学内容的方法。现有方法如ADL需要完全白盒访问模型内部，恢复效果模糊且计算成本高。
AI.method: CDD包含三个核心思路：1）绕过聊天模板暴露原始微调先验；2）用最大模糊前缀引导生成；3）在每个解码步骤放大微调模型与基础模型在logit空间的差异。仅需输出层logit分布，无需权重访问、层选择或逐模型调参。
AI.result: 在四种架构（1B-32B参数）上，CDD能逐字恢复植入事实（药物名称、投票数、物理测量值等），统一优于ADL且运行速度快约170倍。在真实领域微调设置中，单数据集非CoT变体上实现近乎完美的恢复，混合数据集设置中正确识别全部四个数据集。
AI.conclusion: CDD作为灰盒方法超越白盒基线，证明了其在AI系统透明度和问责性方面的实用价值。同时发现了数据生成器模式崩溃导致虚构人格痕迹泄露到模型权重并能被CDD提取的现象，构成了首个端到端指纹追踪链的实证。

title: Joint Optimization of Training and Inference in Federated Edge Learning via Constrained Multi-Objective Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Federated edge learning (FEEL) has recently emerged as a promising paradigm for achieving edge intelligence (EI) via enabling collaborative model training across edge devices while protecting data privacy. In this paper, we put forth an online optimization framework that jointly manages federated training and inference on resource-constrained edge devices. We introduce a tandem-queue-inspired conversion mechanism that bridges inference requests and training data, and further incorporate both data and model freshness into the accuracy formulation to capture temporal dynamics in real-world environments. To maximize inference accuracy while minimizing latency and energy consumption, the mode selections, communication, and computation resource allocations of edge devices are jointly optimized. We formulate this optimization as a multi-objective optimization problem, which is NP-hard and further complicated by the online setting. To address these challenges, we transform the problem into a multi-objective Markov decision process (MOMDP) and develop a \underline{c}onstrained \underline{m}ulti-\underline{o}bjective \underline{p}roximal \underline{p}olicy \underline{o}ptimization (C-MOPPO) algorithm. Specifically, C-MOPPO first learns a set of policies with different preferences across three objectives, then leverages constrained policy optimization to enrich the Pareto front and obtain high-quality, dense solutions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that C-MOPPO achieves well-balanced trade-offs among objectives and significantly outperforms baselines under various system configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出C-MOPPO算法，通过多目标马尔可夫决策过程联合优化联邦边缘学习中的训练与推理，平衡推理精度、时延和能耗三者间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 在资源受限的边缘设备上，联邦边缘学习需要同时管理训练和推理，且真实环境中的数据与模型新鲜度存在时序动态变化，现有方法缺乏对三者（精度、时延、能耗）的联合在线优化框架。
AI.method: 提出串联队列转换机制桥接推理请求与训练数据；将数据与模型新鲜度纳入精度建模；将多目标优化问题建模为MOMDP；设计C-MOPPO算法，先学习不同偏好下的策略集，再利用约束策略优化丰富Pareto前沿。
AI.result: C-MOPPO在各系统配置下实现了目标间良好的平衡权衡，显著优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提在线优化框架和C-MOPPO算法能有效联合优化FEEL中的训练与推理，在精度、时延和能耗间取得高质密集的Pareto最优解。

title: Quantitative Evaluation of the Severity of Posttraumatic Stress Disorder through Transfer Learning from Specific Phobia Data
comment: Submitted to a peer-reviewed journal, comments welcome
summary: Posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) is a prevalent and debilitating mental health condition with significant personal and societal impacts. Current clinical assessments of PTSD often rely on subjective evaluations, which can be time-consuming, costly, and prone to human bias. This study proposes a machine learning (ML) approach based on multivariate kernel density estimation (MKDE) technique for the objective evaluation of PTSD severity. We collected heart rate (HR) and galvanic skin response (GSR) signals as well as PTSD Checklist - Military Version (PCL-M) labels from 21 participants during an immersive simulation. A fear-response model was trained on a public arachnophobia dataset, and predictive features of PTSD were extracted from the fear-response curves estimated on the military dataset. The model achieved an accuracy of 86\% in classifying PTSD status, effectively distinguishing participants with and without PTSD (PCL-M threshold of 36). The average mean absolute error (MAE) of the models is 5.6, and it estimated a clinical PTSD severity scale with a mean absolute percentage error of 17\%. Our algorithm demonstrates promising potential for enhancing estimation of PTSD severity and followup by offering an objective and low-effort evaluation approach using physiology. These findings suggest clinical utility in both screening and follow-up settings.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出基于多变量核密度估计（MKDE）的机器学习方法，通过心率（HR）和皮肤电反应（GSR）信号客观评估PTSD严重程度。在21名军事人员的沉浸式模拟数据中，模型对PTSD分类准确率达86%，平均绝对误差（MAE）为5.6，平均绝对百分比误差为17%。该方法提供了一种客观、低成本的PTSD评估方案，在筛查和随访中具有临床潜力。
AI.motivation: 当前PTSD临床评估依赖主观方法，耗时、昂贵且易受人为偏差影响。研究旨在开发一种基于生理信号（HR和GSR）的客观机器学习方法，以高效、低成本地评估PTSD严重程度。
AI.method: 采用多变量核密度估计（MKDE）技术，利用心率（HR）和皮肤电反应（GSR）生理信号。先以公开蜘蛛恐惧症数据集训练恐惧响应模型，再从军事数据集的恐惧响应曲线中提取PTSD预测特征，结合PCL-M标签进行分类与回归。
AI.result: 在21名参与者数据上，PTSD分类准确率为86%（PCL-M阈值36）；平均绝对误差（MAE）为5.6；临床PTSD严重程度量表估计的平均绝对百分比误差为17%。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的MKDE-ML算法能够通过生理信号客观、低负担地评估PTSD严重程度，在临床筛查和随访中具有应用前景。

title: From Latent Space to Training Data: Explainable Specialization in Minimal MLPs
summary: We here study whether training biases can make hidden neurons specialize in minimal one-hidden-layer MLPs, and whether such specialization improves prototype-based reconstruction of the training dataset from the learned weights. We consider Gaussianactivation MLPs of width equal to dataset size and compare three structural losses that respectively encourage coverage of the training samples, separation between neuron-induced prototypes, and low overlap of hidden responses, against the standard fitting baseline. Experiments on uniformly sampled one-dimensional datasets show a stable pattern from N = 3 to N = 100 across 480 controlled runs. Coverage regularization gives the lowest mean reconstruction error at every tested size and raises the prototype-usage specialization ratio relative to the standard baseline, while separation has mixed effects and overlap penalties are systematically harmful. We show that the harm is not an optimization failure: overlap-active approaches fit the data as well as overlap-free ones but route the optimizer to a degenerate equilibrium in which prototype centers are pushed outside the convex hull of the training inputs. Coverage cannot reward this expulsion and acts as an attractor: separation admits it only at large temperature and overlap admits it at the nominal hyperparameter choice. A direct τ-sweep on the separation-only mask and a prototype-position visualization at N = 100 confirm the mechanism. The findings yield a simple design principle for prototype-recoverability-aware training: every repulsive structural loss must be compensated by a compatible attractor, or it will collapse the latent geometry it was meant to refine.

AI.tldr: 本研究探究单隐藏层MLP中隐藏神经元是否因训练偏差而产生特化，以及特化能否改善基于原型的训练集重建。覆盖正则化能稳定提升原型使用率和重建精度，而分离和重叠惩罚会导致原型中心被推出训练数据凸包，造成潜在几何塌缩。
AI.motivation: 验证训练偏差能否使隐藏神经元在最小单隐藏层MLP中自然形成特化，以及这种特化是否有利于从学习权重中以原型方式重建训练数据集。
AI.method: 使用高斯激活函数的MLP（宽度等于数据集大小），在标准拟合基线之上比较三种结构损失：覆盖正则化（鼓励覆盖训练样本）、分离正则化（鼓励神经元原型间分离）、低重叠正则化（降低隐藏响应重叠），在N=3到N=100的一维均匀采样数据集上进行480次受控实验。
AI.result: 覆盖正则化在所有规模下均取得最低的平均重建误差，并提高原型使用特化比；分离正则化效果混合；重叠惩罚系统性有害。重叠惩罚并非优化失败——其拟合效果与无重叠方法相当，但将原型中心推向训练输入凸包之外，形成退化均衡。覆盖正则化阻止这种驱逐，充当吸引子；分离正则化仅在高温下允许驱逐；重叠正则化在名义超参数下直接允许驱逐。
AI.conclusion: 可恢复原型感知训练的设计原则：任何排斥性结构损失必须与兼容的吸引子补偿，否则会塌缩其所要精炼的潜在几何结构。

title: STaT: Resolving Shape Distortion in Non-Stationary Time Series via Tri-Modal Synergy
summary: Recent research in time series forecasting frequently investigates the integration of textual and visual modalities with numerical models to better navigate non-stationary environments. Despite delivering solid numerical results, existing multi-modal approaches usually encounter a dilemma: prioritizing the minimization of average errors can result in excessively smooth forecasts that overlook essential fluctuations. To resolve this limitation, we introduce STaT, an innovative multimodal architecture for Symbolic-Temporal-Textual Alignment, which seamlessly unites three synergistic modalities. Specifically, the symbolic modality converts continuous time series into discrete tokens, facilitating the accurate identification of structural patterns and turning points; the temporal modality extracts inherent sequential dependencies; and the textual modality leverages domain semantics to steer the macroscopic forecasting trends. Comprehensive evaluations on eight real-world benchmarks indicate that STaT delivers exceptional performance, enhancing conventional magnitude indicators by up to 8.9% while simultaneously decreasing shape distortion by up to 8.5%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STaT多模态架构，通过符号-时间-文本三模态对齐，在保持低平均误差的同时减少形状失真，在8个基准数据集上提升幅度指标达8.9%、降低形状失真达8.5%。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列多模态方法在最小化平均误差时会产生过度平滑的预测，忽略关键波动（即"误差-形状失真"困境）。
AI.method: 提出STaT架构，包含三个协同模态：符号模态（将连续时间序列离散化为符号token，识别结构模式与转折点）、时间模态（提取序列依赖关系）、文本模态（利用领域语义引导宏观趋势），通过三模态对齐实现联合预测。
AI.result: 在8个真实世界基准上，幅度指标提升最高8.9%，形状失真降低最高8.5%。
AI.conclusion: STaT通过引入符号模态和文本模态的语义引导，有效缓解了多模态时间序列预测中平均误差与形状保真度的权衡问题。

title: Small Models, Strong Priors: Architectural Inductive Bias for Parameter-Efficient Neural PDE Solvers
summary: Neural PDE solvers have followed the scaling trajectory of vision and language, with recent foundation models reaching billions of parameters. We argue that scale is a poor substitute for architectural inductive bias in this domain: structured priors deliver outsized parameter efficiency, and the pattern of where they succeed and fail is itself informative about what they capture. We instantiate this argument in WaveLiT, an architecture combining a discrete wavelet transform for lossless multi-resolution tokenization, an augmented linear attention block, a shared-weight multiscale feature pyramid, and a wavelet-domain auxiliary loss. Bespoke 1-10M-parameter WaveLiT models compete with foundation models of 100-1000$\times$ their size across eight TheWell benchmarks, with the largest gains on wave and acoustic-dominated benchmarks where the wavelet-multiscale prior fits the dominant dynamical structure and small per-step errors do not compound geometrically under rollout. Trained jointly across all eight benchmarks, a 10M-parameter foundation variant exhibits a structured, physically interpretable transfer pattern -- strongest where the wavelet-multiscale prior matches the dynamics, weakest on chaotic advection-dominated flows. The entire pipeline trains on a single GPU. The results suggest that small-model PDE performance is shaped by architectural inductive bias rather than scale, and that the structure of a prior's failures is a useful empirical signal about its content.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WaveLiT架构，通过离散小波变换、线性注意力、多尺度特征金字塔和小波域辅助损失等结构化先验，仅用1-10M参数即可在8个TheWell基准上与100-1000倍大小的基础模型竞争，证明在偏微分方程求解中，架构归纳偏置比规模更重要。
AI.motivation: 现有神经PDE求解器盲目追随视觉和语言领域的规模扩展路径，模型参数达到数十亿级别。本文质疑这一趋势，认为在该领域中，架构性归纳偏置比单纯扩大规模更有效，且先验的成功与失败模式本身能揭示其捕获的内容。
AI.method: 提出WaveLiT架构，包含：(1) 离散小波变换实现无损多分辨率分词；(2) 增强线性注意力模块；(3) 共享权重的多尺度特征金字塔；(4) 小波域辅助损失。训练策略涵盖单基准训练和多基准联合训练两种范式。
AI.result: 1-10M参数的WaveLiT在8个TheWell基准上与100-1000倍大小的基础模型竞争。在波动和声学主导的基准上增益最大，因为小波-多尺度先验匹配了主导动力学结构，且小步误差在展开时不会几何放大。10M参数的基础变体在联合训练中展现出结构化的、物理可解释的迁移模式。
AI.conclusion: 小型模型在PDE任务上的性能由架构归纳偏置而非规模决定；先验的失败模式本身就是关于其内容的有用经验信号。整个流程可在单GPU上完成训练。

title: Step-TP: A Grounded, Step-Level Dataset with Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for LLM-Guided Tensor Program Optimization
summary: Despite the strong reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), optimizing the execution efficiency of tensor programs remains challenging due to the need for precise, composable transformation decisions. Recent LLM-guided approaches frame tensor program optimization as an iterative decision process, but existing datasets provide only end-to-end optimized program pairs using token-inefficient representations, lacking verifiable step-level supervision and interpretability. As a result, LLMs struggle to make reliable single-step decisions in large combinatorial optimization spaces. We introduce Step-TP, a post-training dataset for tensor program optimization that provides grounded, atomic, step-level supervision with structured chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning. Step-TP forms a closed reasoning loop over intermediate program states, enabling reliable multi-step optimization rather than outcome imitation. Its design is guided by four principles: (i) a token-efficient, verifiable intermediate representation (IR) that deterministically lowers to TVM TIR; (ii) atomic and composable optimization strategies that decompose complex trajectories into interpretable single-step decisions; (iii) structured CoT supervision coupled with explicit IR-to-IR state transitions; and (iv) strategy filtering to balance coverage while preventing shortcut exploitation. The dataset and implementation are available at a GitHub link, https://github.com/LIUMENGFAN-gif/StepTP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Step-TP，一个为张量程序优化提供的后训练数据集，通过结构化思维链推理和原子级步骤监督，使大语言模型能够进行可靠的多步优化决策，而非简单的结果模仿。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM引导的张量程序优化方法仅提供端到端的优化程序对，缺乏可验证的步骤级监督和可解释性，导致LLM在大型组合优化空间中难以做出可靠的单步决策。
AI.method: Step-TP基于四个设计原则：(i) 令牌高效、可验证的中间表示(IR)，可确定性降级到TVM TIR；(ii) 原子化且可组合的优化策略，将复杂轨迹分解为可解释的单步决策；(iii) 结构化CoT监督与显式IR-to-IR状态转换耦合；(iv) 策略过滤以平衡覆盖范围同时防止捷径利用。
AI.result: Step-TP在中间程序状态上形成闭环推理，支持可靠的多步优化而非结果模仿，提供了可验证的步骤级监督和可解释性。
AI.conclusion: Step-TP通过提供原子化、步骤级的结构化CoT监督，显著提升了LLM在张量程序优化中的单步决策可靠性，为复杂组合优化问题提供了可解释、可验证的解决方案。

title: Hidden in Plain Tokens: Simply Robust, Gradient-Free Watermark for Synthetic Audio
summary: As policy catches up with the capabilities of generative AI, watermarking is central to content provenance efforts. Inference-time watermarks for autoregressive models are unfit for continuous modalities due to discretization inconsistencies. Existing methods overcome this by finetuning the modality tokenizers, nullifying the watermark's training-free advantage. In this work, motivated by the vocabulary redundancy of discretization, we propose an elegant solution for powerful and robust watermarking of synthetic audio. We theoretically analyze the impact of token errors on watermark detection, and effectively mitigate them using a reduced vocabulary obtained via community detection. Thorough experiments showcase that our gradient-free method can boost detectability by several orders of magnitude, while also achieving built-in robustness to audio modifications. Broadly, we discover a new state-of-the-art for token-level watermarks in multimedia, which simply arises from the nature of discrete representation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于社区检测缩减词汇量的免训练音频水印方法，利用离散化表示中的词汇冗余性，在不微调解码器的情况下实现更强的可检测性和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有推理时水印方法因离散化不一致不适用于连续模态，而微调分词器会丧失水印的免训练优势，亟需一种既保持免训练特性又适用于连续模态的鲁棒水印方案。
AI.method: 利用离散化中的词汇冗余性，通过社区检测缩减词汇量，消除离散化过程中的令牌错误对水印检测的影响。
AI.result: 可检测性提升数个数量级，并具有对音频修改的内建鲁棒性，达到多媒体令牌级水印的最优性能。
AI.conclusion: 基于离散表示学习的本质特性——词汇冗余性，即可自然实现免训练的强鲁棒水印，无需额外微调。

title: Fuzzy PyTorch: Rapid Numerical Variability Evaluation for Deep Learning Models
comment: 19 pages, 8 figures, Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (01/2026)
summary: We introduce Fuzzy PyTorch, a framework for rapid evaluation of numerical variability in deep learning (DL) models. As DL is increasingly applied to diverse tasks, understanding variability from floating-point arithmetic is essential to ensure robust and reliable performance. Tools assessing such variability must be scalable, efficient, and integrate seamlessly with existing frameworks while minimizing code modifications. Fuzzy PyTorch enables this by integrating stochastic arithmetic into PyTorch through Probabilistic Rounding with Instruction Set Management, a novel library interfacing with Verificarlo, a numerical analysis compiler. The library offers stochastic rounding mode and a novel mode; up-down rounding. Comparative evaluations show Fuzzy PyTorch maintains model performance and achieves runtime reductions of 5x to 60x versus Verrou, a state-of-the-art tool. We further demonstrate scalability by running models from 1 to 341 million parameters, confirming applicability across small and large DL architectures. Overall, Fuzzy PyTorch provides an efficient, scalable, and practical solution for assessing numerical variability in deep learning, enabling researchers and practitioners to quantify and manage floating-point uncertainty without compromising performance or computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: Fuzzy PyTorch是一个将随机算术集成到PyTorch中的框架，通过概率舍入与指令集管理实现深度学习模型数值变异性的快速评估，相比Verrou实现了5倍到60倍的运行加速，并支持从1到3.41亿参数的模型规模。
AI.motivation: 随着深度学习被广泛应用于多样化任务，理解浮点算术带来的数值变异性对于确保模型的鲁棒性和可靠性至关重要，需要可扩展、高效且易于集成到现有框架中的评估工具。
AI.method: 通过概率舍入与指令集管理（Probabilistic Rounding with Instruction Set Management）将随机算术集成到PyTorch中，利用与数值分析编译器Verificarlo交互的新型库，提供随机舍入模式和新的上下舍入模式。
AI.result: 与最先进工具Verrou相比，运行时减少5倍至60倍；支持从1百万到3.41亿参数的模型，验证了在小型和大型深度学习架构中的适用性。
AI.conclusion: Fuzzy PyTorch提供了一个高效、可扩展且实用的解决方案，使研究人员和从业者能够在不牺牲性能或计算效率的情况下量化和管理浮点不确定性。

title: Causal methods for LLM development and evaluation
summary: Large language model (LLM) development is currently driven by large-scale empirical iteration over data mixtures, reward models, routing strategies, and evaluation pipelines. Here, we argue that many central questions in LLM development and evaluation are inherently causal: What is the effect of adding a data domain during pretraining? How do annotator preferences change when LLMs generate text in a different style? Should a prompt be routed to a larger or smaller model given inference cost constraints? In general, causal methods are well-suited to such settings where interventions change outcomes but, surprisingly, are underrepresented in LLM development. Our contribution is threefold: (1) We explain how causal methods can help develop modern LLM development and evaluation: LLM development relies heavily on logged data, which are often subject to confounding and distribution shifts; evaluation uses learned but potentially biased judges; and deployment environments are non-stationary. These conditions make purely predictive approaches fragile and create opportunities for principled identification and estimation methods from causal inference. (2) We further map opportunities for causal methods in the entire LLM development pipeline, including pretraining, alignment, routing, agentic workflows, and evaluation. (3) We discuss new research opportunities around leveraging causal methods for LLM development and evaluation. Overall, we argue that causal methods are potentially underutilized for the LLM development and evaluation pipeline, despite the fact that such methods can ensure a reliable and scientifically grounded design.

AI.tldr: 本文论证因果方法在LLM开发与评估中未被充分利用，指出其可解决数据混杂、评估偏差、环境非平稳等核心问题，并系统梳理了因果方法在预训练、对齐、路由、智能体工作流及评估等全流程中的应用机会。
AI.motivation: LLM开发目前依赖大规模经验性迭代（数据混合、奖励模型、路由策略等），但许多核心问题本质上是因果性的（如添加数据域的效果、标注者偏好变化、模型路由决策等）。现有纯预测方法在处理混杂、分布漂移、有偏评估器和非平稳环境时存在局限，亟需引入因果推断的识别与估计方法。
AI.method: 本文为观点性文章，通过三方面贡献展开：1）论证因果方法如何解决LLM开发中的混杂、分布偏移、评估偏差与非平稳部署问题；2）系统映射因果方法在LLM全流程（预训练、对齐、路由、智能体工作流、评估）中的机会；3）讨论利用因果方法推动LLM开发与评估的新研究方向。
AI.result: 明确指出因果方法在LLM开发与评估管道中潜力巨大但未被充分使用，相较纯预测方法，因果方法能提供更可靠和科学的设计保证。
AI.conclusion: 因果方法在LLM开发与评估中具有重要但未被充分利用的价值，该方法能够确保LLM开发过程更加可靠且具科学基础。

title: Learning in Low-Dimensional Subspaces: Orthogonal Bottlenecks for Reinforcement Learning
summary: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) agents commonly rely on high-dimensional neural representations, despite growing evidence that task-relevant value and policy structure may be intrinsically low-dimensional. In this work, we present a simple yet effective representation-level prior that inserts a fixed orthonormal projection to constrain encoder features to a low-dimensional subspace, requiring no auxiliary objectives, pretraining, or changes to the underlying RL algorithm. Under a linear realizability assumption, we prove that when the bottleneck dimension exceeds the intrinsic rank of the optimal value function in feature space, the bottleneck preserves expressivity and leaves the induced gradient dynamics unchanged up to an equivalent low-dimensional parameterization. Empirically, we find that across both single and multi-task benchmarks, baseline performance is either matched or improved once the bottleneck dimension exceeds a small task-dependent threshold; in many cases, value representations can be compressed to extremely low dimensions without loss, and the minimal sufficient dimension depends far more on environment complexity than encoder width. In addition, we analyze representation geometry and find that orthogonal bottlenecks stabilize feature norms and are associated with higher effective rank. Together, these results support a representation-space interpretation of the manifold hypothesis in reinforcement learning and position orthogonal bottlenecks as a lightweight, architecture-agnostic mechanism for shaping RL representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种简单的正交瓶颈（orthogonal bottleneck）表示层先验，通过固定正交投影将编码器特征约束到低维子空间，无需额外目标或预训练。理论证明在线性可实现假设下，当瓶颈维度超过最优价值函数的固有秩时，表达性和梯度动力学保持不变。实验表明，在单任务和多任务基准中，该方法可在极小维度下匹配或提升基线性能，且所需最小维度主要取决于环境复杂性而非编码器宽度。正交瓶颈还能稳定特征范数并提高有效秩，支持强化学习中的流形假设。
AI.motivation: 深度强化学习智能体通常使用高维神经网络表示，但越来越多的证据表明任务相关的价值和策略结构本质上是低维的。现有方法往往需要辅助目标、预训练或改变底层RL算法，本文旨在提出一种轻量级、架构无关的方法来约束表示到低维子空间。
AI.method: 在编码器后插入固定的正交投影矩阵，将特征约束到低维子空间。在线性可实现假设下，理论分析证明了当瓶颈维度超过最优价值函数在特征空间中的固有秩时，正交瓶颈保持表达性且梯度动力学不变。在多种强化学习基准上进行单任务和多任务实验验证。
AI.result: 1) 当瓶颈维度超过任务依赖的小阈值时，基线性能被匹配或提升；2) 价值表示可压缩至极低维度而不损失性能；3) 最小充分维度主要取决于环境复杂度而非编码器宽度；4) 正交瓶颈稳定了特征范数并与更高有效秩相关。
AI.conclusion: 正交瓶颈是一种轻量级、架构无关的表示塑造机制，支持强化学习中流形假设的表示空间解释。

title: AdvantageFlow: Advantage-Weighted Least Squares for RL in Flow Models
summary: We introduce AdvantageFlow, a forward-process reinforcement learning algorithm for rectified flow models. Unlike Flow-GRPO, which optimizes the reverse process, we optimize an advantage-weighted forward-process prediction loss. This optimization problem is unstable when advantages are negative and the loss becomes non-convex. We stabilize it by rollout policy regularization, which reduces variance and arises from fitting a local reward-improving target distribution. We evaluate AdvantageFlow on image generation tasks with Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium. It outperforms both Flow-GRPO and a state-of-the-art forward-process RL baseline based on negative-aware fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出AdvantageFlow，一种前向过程强化学习算法用于整流流模型，通过优势加权前向过程预测损失和推出策略正则化来稳定训练，在图像生成任务上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有Flow-GRPO优化反向过程，而直接优化优势加权前向过程预测损失存在负优势导致的不稳定和非凸性问题，需要稳定的优化方法。
AI.method: 提出AdvantageFlow算法：1) 优化优势加权前向过程预测损失；2) 通过推出策略正则化（rollout policy regularization）降低方差并稳定训练，该正则化源于拟合局部奖励改进目标分布。
AI.result: 在Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium图像生成任务上，AdvantageFlow优于Flow-GRPO和基于负感知微调的前向过程RL基线方法。
AI.conclusion: AdvantageFlow通过前向过程优化和推出策略正则化有效解决了整流流模型的强化学习训练稳定性问题，在图像生成中取得了更优性能。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Detection of Potentially Abusive Clauses in Chilean Terms of Service
summary: Online Terms of Service often function as contracts of adhesion, creating asymmetries that may expose consumers to potentially abusive clauses. In Chile, assessing such clauses is legally challenging because some provisions clearly violate mandatory consumer law, whereas others depend on broader standards such as good faith and contractual imbalance. We present a retrieval-augmented generation framework for the automated detection and classification of potentially abusive clauses in Chilean Terms of Service. Designed for local execution, it combines efficient clause detection, hybrid dense--sparse retrieval, reranking, and prompt augmentation to support medium-sized open-weight language models. We also introduce the Chilean Abusive Terms of Service Extended corpus, comprising 100 contracts and 10,029 annotated clauses in 24 legally grounded categories spanning illegal, dark, and gray clauses. Experiments comparing commercial and open-weight language models, fine-tuned encoders, and traditional baselines show that retrieval-augmented prompting substantially improves performance and enables local models to approach larger cloud-based systems at lower computational and token cost. The study also contributes a refined legal annotation scheme and a practical design for AI-assisted consumer contract review.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个检索增强生成（RAG）框架，用于自动检测和分类智利在线服务条款中的潜在滥用条款，并构建了包含100份合同、10,029条注释的智利滥用条款扩展语料库。实验表明RAG能显著提升本地中等规模开源模型的性能，使其接近大型云模型，同时降低计算和token成本。
AI.motivation: 智利在线服务条款常作为附合合同存在，造成信息不对称，消费者可能面临滥用条款。然而，法律评估存在挑战：部分条款明显违反强制性消费者法，其他条款则依赖诚信和合同失衡等更广泛标准进行判断。因此需要自动化工具辅助消费者合同审查。
AI.method: 构建RAG框架，结合高效条款检测、混合稠密-稀疏检索、重排序和提示增强，支持中等规模开源语言模型的本地执行。同时构建了Chilean Abusive Terms of Service Extended语料库，涵盖100份合同和10,029条注释，分为24个法律分类（包括非法条款、暗黑模式和灰色条款）。实验对比了商业模型、开源模型、微调编码器和传统基线。
AI.result: 检索增强提示显著提升了模型性能，使本地中等模型接近大型云模型的效果，同时降低了计算和token成本。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提供了一个精细的法律注释方案和实用的AI辅助消费者合同审查设计，验证了RAG在合同滥用条款检测中的有效性。

title: Length Generalization with Log-Depth Recurrent Units
summary: Length generalization remains a persistent challenge for neural networks: recurrent models tend to suffer from positional biases, while transformers are constrained by fixed computational depth. Regular languages provide a frequently used testbed for evaluating length generalization, as label prediction can be checked for any sequence length. We propose MLP-LDRU, a type of Log-Depth Recurrent Unit, which captures a class of associativity-biased operators designed to approximate recurrence through parallel reduction. We evaluate MLP-LDRU on 21 regular-language tasks, consisting of standard benchmarks and new prefix languages, where it achieves 100% out-of-distribution accuracy on 18 tasks and at least 99.9% on the remaining 3 when increasing max training length, outperforming comparable recurrent and attention-based models. We further evaluate MLP-LDRU beyond regular languages on ListOps and NLP classification benchmarks, where it performs competitively.

AI.tldr: 提出MLP-LDRU（对数深度递归单元），通过可结合性偏置的并行归约算子逼近递归，在21个正则语言任务中18个实现100%的分布外准确率，并在ListOps和NLP分类任务上表现具有竞争力。
AI.motivation: 神经网络在长度泛化上存在持久挑战：递归模型易受位置偏差影响，而Transformer受限于固定计算深度。正则语言作为评估长度泛化的常用测试平台，需要能有效处理任意序列长度的模型。
AI.method: 提出MLP-LDRU（Log-Depth Recurrent Unit），设计一类可结合性偏置的算子，通过并行归约来近似递归计算，实现对序列的对数深度处理。
AI.result: 在21个正则语言任务中，MLP-LDRU在18个任务上达到100%的分布外准确率，剩余3个任务在增加最大训练长度后也达到至少99.9%，优于可比递归和注意力模型；在ListOps和NLP分类基准上也表现具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: MLP-LDRU通过可结合性偏置的并行归约有效解决了长度泛化问题，在正则语言任务上实现了近乎完美的分布外泛化，并在更复杂的任务上展现了竞争力。

title: Neuronal Stochastic Attention Circuit (NSAC) for Probabilistic Representation Learning
summary: Reliable quantification of uncertainty estimates in continuous-time (CT) representation learning remains nascent, particularly within CT attention architectures. We introduce the Neuronal Stochastic Attention Circuit (NSAC), a novel biologically-inspired CT attention architecture that reformulates attention logit computation as the solution of an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck stochastic differential equation modulated by input-dependent, nonlinear interlinked gates derived from repurposed C.elegans Neuronal Circuit Policies (NCPs) wiring mechanism. It induces Gaussian distribution over logits that propagates principled stochasticity through logistic-normal distribution over attention weights to yield probabilistic output. A two-term objective function combining Gaussian negative log-likelihood with an epistemic-separation regularizer enforces higher predictive variance and enables joint quantification of aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty. Empirically, we implement NSAC in a diverse set of learning tasks including: (i) irregular CT function approximation; (ii) multivariate regression; (iii) long-range forecasting; (iv) Industry 4.0; and (v) the lane-keeping of autonomous vehicles. We observe that the NSAC remains competitive against several baselines in terms of accuracy and produces reasonably well-calibrated uncertainty estimates while being interpretable at the neuronal cell level.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NSAC，一种受生物启发的连续时间注意力架构。它将注意力logits计算建模为Ornstein-Uhlenbeck随机微分方程的解，通过从秀丽隐杆线虫神经回路策略（NCPs）改写的输入依赖非线性互连环门驱动。该方法在logits上诱导高斯分布，通过逻辑正态传播随机性到注意力权重，产生概率输出。结合高斯负对数似然与认知分离正则化的双目标函数，实现偶然不确定性和认知不确定性的联合量化。实验在5类任务上验证了其竞争力、校准良好的不确定性估计及神经元级别的可解释性。
AI.motivation: 连续时间表示学习中的不确定性量化仍不成熟，尤其是在连续时间注意力架构中缺乏可靠的不确定性估计方法。
AI.method: 将注意力logits计算重构为Ornstein-Uhlenbeck SDE的解，由基于NCPs的输入依赖非线性互连环门调控，在logits上引入高斯分布并通过逻辑正态分布传播至注意力权重；采用高斯NLL与认知分离正则化组成的双目标损失函数。
AI.result: 在间断CT函数逼近、多元回归、长程预测、工业4.0及自动驾驶车道保持5类任务中，NSAC在准确性上与多个基线方法保持竞争力，同时产生良好校准的不确定性估计，并在神经元细胞层面具有可解释性。
AI.conclusion: NSAC为连续时间注意力架构提供了有效的概率建模框架，能够同时量化偶然不确定性和认知不确定性，兼具性能竞争力与生物可解释性。

title: Conditional KRR: Injecting Unpenalized Features into Kernel Methods with Applications to Kernel Thresholding
summary:
Conditionally positive definite (CPD) kernels are defined with respect to a function class $\mathcal{F}$. It is well known that such a kernel $K$ is associated with its native space (defined analogously to an RKHS), which in turn gives rise to a learning method -- called conditional kernel ridge regression (conditional KRR) due to its analogy with KRR -- where the estimated regression function is penalized by the square of its native space norm. This method is of interest because it can be viewed as classical linear regression, with features specified by $\mathcal{F}$, followed by the application of standard KRR to the residual (unexplained) component of the target variable. Methods of this type have recently attracted increasing attention.
  We study the statistical properties of this method by reducing its behavior to that of KRR with another fixed kernel, called the residual kernel. Our main theoretical result shows that such a reduction is indeed possible, at the cost of an additional term in the expected test risk, bounded by $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{N})$, where $N$ is the sample size and the hidden constant depends on the class $\mathcal{F}$ and the input distribution.
  This reduction enables us to analyze conditional KRR in the case where $K$ is positive definite and $\mathcal{F}$ is given by the first $k$ principal eigenfunctions in the Mercer decomposition of $K$. We also consider the setting where $\mathcal{F}$ consists of $k$ random features from a random feature representation of $K$. It turns out that these two settings are closely related. Both our theoretical analysis and experiments confirm that conditional KRR outperforms standard KRR in these cases whenever the $\mathcal{F}$-component of the regression function is more pronounced than the residual part.

AI.tldr: 本文研究条件正定核的统计性质，通过将其简化为带有残差核的KRR问题，证明了在期望测试风险上额外项以O(1/√N)为界。实验表明，当回归函数的F分量比残差部分更显著时，条件KRR优于标准KRR。
AI.motivation: 条件正定核对应的学习方法（条件KRR）近年来受到越来越多的关注，但其统计性质尚不明确，需要从理论上进行系统分析。
AI.method: 将条件KRR的行为简化为另一个固定核（残差核）的KRR问题，并证明这种简化在期望测试风险上只需付出O(1/√N)的额外代价。分别研究了K的Mercer分解中前k个主特征函数作为F，以及F由k个随机特征构成这两种情况。
AI.result: 证明了条件KRR可简化为残差核KRR，额外误差项以O(1/√N)为界。两种设置（主特征函数和随机特征）密切相关。理论和实验均表明，当回归函数的F分量强于残差部分时，条件KRR优于标准KRR。
AI.conclusion: 条件KRR是一种有效的学习方法，在特定条件下可以超越标准KRR，且其统计性质可通过残差核的KRR理论进行分析。

title: Rethinking Weak Supervision in Anomaly Detection: A Comprehensive Benchmark
comment: Accepted at KDD 2026 Datasets and Benchmarks Track (Cycle 2)
summary: Weakly supervised anomaly detection (WSAD) has developed in three primary directions: incomplete, inexact, and inaccurate supervision. However, these directions remain isolated, lacking a unified framework to assess whether they address unique challenges or share fundamental mechanics. This paper introduces WSADBench, the first benchmark that unifies evaluation across distinct weakly supervised scenarios, benchmarking diverse approaches from specialized WSAD methods to advanced tabular foundation models. WSADBench establishes standardized protocols to evaluate 36 algorithms across 4 modalities by systematically varying label quantity, granularity, and quality, revealing the performance boundaries of various methods. Based on over 700K experiments, WSADBench reveals four critical insights: (i) Strong intrinsic correlations exist between these weak supervision scenarios, challenging the isolation of current research directions. (ii) Specialized WSAD algorithms excel only in extreme label-scarcity regimes but are quickly dominated by tabular foundation models and general classification methods as supervision increases or in OOD scenarios. (iii) Unlabeled data shows inconsistent utility across settings, with marginal gains compared to label refinement. (iv) Models exhibit asymmetric sensitivity to different types of label noise. We release WSADBench as an open-source benchmark with code and datasets to facilitate future WSAD research: https://github.com/SUFE-AILAB/WSADBench.

AI.tldr: WSADBench是首个统一评估弱监督异常检测（WSAD）中不完全、不精确和不准确三种监督场景的基准，通过70万+实验评估36种算法在4种模态下的表现，揭示了各弱监督场景间存在强关联，专用WSAD方法仅在极端标签稀疏时有效，而表格基础模型和通用分类方法在更多监督下表现更优。
AI.motivation: 现有弱监督异常检测研究在不完全、不精确和不准确监督三个方向上相互孤立，缺乏统一评估框架来判断这些方向是否处理独特挑战或共享基本机制。
AI.method: 构建WSADBench基准，建立标准化协议，通过系统变化标签数量、粒度和质量，在4种模态上评估36种算法（包括专用WSAD方法和先进表格基础模型），进行超70万次实验。
AI.result: (i)弱监督场景间存在强内在关联；(ii)专用WSAD仅在极端标签稀缺时占优，随监督增强被基础模型和通用分类方法超越；(iii)无标签数据效用不一致，提升有限；(iv)模型对不同类型标签噪声具有非对称敏感性。
AI.conclusion: WSADBench为WSAD研究提供了统一评估基准，揭示了现有研究方向孤立性的问题，并为方法选择提供了指导。

title: Active Query Synthesis for Preference Learning
summary: Efficient learning of user preferences is crucial for many modern decision making systems but typically requires costly labeled data. Active learning reduces this cost, yet standard methods are computationally expensive due to pool-based evaluation. Further, most methods assume all query feedback is equally reliable, ignoring that pairwise queries between nearly identical or entirely dissimilar items yield ambiguous, low-confidence responses. To address the issue of feedback reliability, we introduce a novel confidence aware response model that explicitly accounts for these ambiguous comparisons. To overcome the computational bottleneck of pool-based evaluation, we propose an active query synthesis framework, Info-Synth that generates optimal queries by maximizing a mutual information-based objective within a continuous space. Moreover, we propose two strategies, Pair M-dist and Pair Opt-dist, that extend Info-Synth to select effective queries even when restricted to finite query pools. We demonstrate our framework's versatility and performance across synthetic preference learning, constrained text summary datasets, and subjective, continuous-space controller gain tuning for a simulated mobile robot.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Info-Synth的主动查询合成框架，通过置信度感知模型解决反馈可靠性问题，并在连续空间中生成最优查询，显著提升了偏好学习的效率和性能。
AI.motivation: 传统主动学习方法存在两个关键问题：(1)多数方法假设所有查询反馈 equally reliable，忽略了相似或完全不同项目之间的模糊比较会产生低置信度响应；(2)基于池的评估方法计算开销大。本文旨在同时解决反馈可靠性和计算效率问题。
AI.method: 提出Info-Synth框架：(1)引入置信度感知的响应模型，显式建模模糊比较；(2)在连续空间中最大化基于互信息的目标函数以生成最优查询；(3)针对有限查询池场景，提出两种扩展策略Pair M-dist和Pair Opt-dist。
AI.result: 在合成偏好学习、受限文本摘要数据集以及模拟移动机器人控制器增益调优三个任务上验证了框架的通用性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: Info-Synth通过置信度感知建模和连续空间查询合成，有效降低了标注成本，提高了偏好学习效率，并适用于多种实际应用场景。

title: Global Convergence of Wasserstein Policy Gradient for Entropy-Regularized Reinforcement Learning
summary:
Wasserstein policy gradient (WPG) is a policy optimization method for reinforcement learning (RL) that exploits the optimal-transport geometry of action distributions. For the entropy-regularized RL objective, WPG evolves each state-conditional policy by transporting it along the action gradient of the soft Q-function together with a Langevin-type diffusion. Despite its appeal for continuous-control problems, its global convergence properties remain poorly understood. Standard Langevin analyses do not directly apply, because the RL objective depends on the policy through the Bellman recursion rather than through a static convex functional, and the Langevin drift is determined by the soft Q-function, whose regularity must be controlled along the policy iterates.
  In this paper, we develop a global convergence theory for WPG by exploiting the Bellman structure of entropy-regularized RL. We show that the role usually played by convexity can be replaced by a Bellman-based argument: the soft Bellman residual admits a statewise KL representation with respect to a Gibbs policy; Bellman contraction relates this residual to the global optimality gap; and a Bellman resolvent identity connects value improvement to relative Fisher information. Combined with a uniform log-Sobolev inequality (LSI) for the evolving Gibbs family, these ingredients yield a distributional Polyak--Łojasiewicz condition. We further establish the regularity and uniform bounds needed to control the discretization error, thereby obtaining geometric contraction up to a discretization bias. Conceptually, our analysis shows that although entropy-regularized RL is not convex in the usual flat sense, the Bellman recursion induces a favorable Polyak--Lojasiewicz-type (PL) geometry that supports global convergence of WPG.

AI.tldr: 本文为Wasserstein策略梯度（WPG）方法建立了全局收敛性理论，通过利用熵正则化强化学习中的Bellman结构，证明了Bellman递归可以诱导出Polyak-Łojasiewicz型几何结构，从而支持WPG的全局收敛，并量化了离散化偏差下的几何收缩率。
AI.motivation: WPG在连续控制问题中表现出色，但其全局收敛性质尚不清楚。标准Langevin分析不直接适用，因为RL目标通过Bellman递归依赖于策略，而非静态凸泛函，且Langevin漂移由软Q函数决定，其正则性在策略迭代过程中需要控制。
AI.method: 利用熵正则化RL的Bellman结构，证明软Bellman残差具有关于Gibbs策略的状态级KL表示；通过Bellman压缩将残差与全局最优性差距关联；利用Bellman预解恒等式连接值改进与相对Fisher信息；结合Gibbs族的均匀对数Sobolev不等式，导出分布Polyak-Łojasiewicz条件；进一步建立正则性和均匀界以控制离散化误差。
AI.result: 获得了直到离散化偏差的几何收缩率。证明了熵正则化RL虽非通常意义下的凸问题，但Bellman递归诱导出有利于WPG全局收敛的PL型几何结构。
AI.conclusion: 本文为WPG方法建立了首个全局收敛理论，揭示了Bellman结构在非凸RL优化中扮演的关键角色，为理解策略梯度方法的收敛性提供了新视角。

title: OrpQuant: Geometric Orthogonal Residual Projection for Multiplier-Free Power-of-Two Transformer Quantization
summary:
The deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision Transformers (ViTs) on edge devices is significantly constrained by memory limitations and the critical timing bottlenecks introduced by dense Multiply-Accumulate (MAC) arrays. In the ultra-low bit regime, logarithmic Power-of-Two (PoT) quantization provides a hardware-efficient alternative by replacing MAC operations with bit-shifts. However, the non-uniform exponential lattice is inherently limited by a \textbf{Low Angular Resolution Regime}, a structural flaw that becomes particularly pronounced at sub-4-bit thresholds, leading to a notable degradation of high-dimensional feature manifolds.
  To address this geometric limitation, we propose Orthogonal Residual Projection (ORP), an algorithm-hardware co-design framework. By formulating quantization as a dual-basis geometric projection, ORP adaptively synthesizes a higher-resolution residual lattice using strictly shift-and-add operations. Furthermore, ORP's analytical solver offers a practical alternative to computationally intensive gradient-based optimization, reducing the full-model calibration time for LLaMA-2-7B to approximately \textbf{15 minutes}.
  Extensive evaluations demonstrate ORP's applicability across modalities and its hardware efficiency. Under the 3-bit (W3/A16) constraint, ORP achieves a perplexity of 6.10 on LLaMA-2-7B, comparing favorably to conventional MAC-intensive baselines like AWQ without relying on asymmetric scaling, while maintaining competitive accuracy in 4-bit scenarios. At the silicon level, standard-cell RTL synthesis at a 28nm node indicates that ORP effectively mitigates the timing bottlenecks associated with dense multiplier trees.

AI.tldr: 针对大语言模型和视觉Transformer在边缘设备部署时面临的低比特量化精度损失问题，提出正交残差投影(ORP)算法-硬件协同设计框架，通过双基几何投影构建高分辨率残差格点，在3-bit权重量化下达到6.10 perplexity，并将校准时间缩短至约15分钟。
AI.motivation: 在超低比特(≤4-bit)下，对数量化(PoT)由于非均匀指数格点存在低角分辨率缺陷，导致高维特征流形严重退化，同时传统MAC密集型方法在边缘设备上面临时序瓶颈和内存限制。
AI.method: 提出ORP框架：(1) 将量化建模为双基几何投影问题；(2) 使用严格的移位加操作自适应合成高分辨率残差格点；(3) 采用解析求解器替代梯度优化，实现快速校准。
AI.result: 在3-bit (W3/A16)下，LLaMA-2-7B达到6.10 perplexity，优于AWQ等MAC密集型基线；无需非对称缩放即可在4-bit场景下保持竞争力；28nm工艺RTL综合表明ORP有效缓解了乘法器树的时序瓶颈；LLaMA-2-7B全模型校准仅需15分钟。
AI.conclusion: ORP作为一种算法-硬件协同设计方法，在超低比特量化场景下兼顾了精度保持与硬件效率，为边缘端部署LLM和ViT提供了可行方案。

title: Forgetting in Language Models: Capacity, Optimization, and Self-Generated Replay
summary: Models trained on a new task typically degrade on prior tasks, a phenomenon known as forgetting. Traditionally, mitigating forgetting has required replaying stored exemplars from prior tasks, which is often impractical. By contrast, language models can sample from their own training distribution, and we show that these self-generated samples serve as effective replay data, nearly eliminating forgetting. We find that forgetting nonetheless persists when the model has little remaining capacity: models pretrained close to saturation cannot absorb new information without overwriting prior knowledge. When capacity is not the limiting factor, low learning rates reduce forgetting but require substantially more training steps. Replay breaks this tradeoff, enabling fast, high-learning-rate finetuning without forgetting.

AI.tldr: 语言模型可利用自身生成的样本作为回放数据，几乎消除灾难性遗忘。但当模型容量接近饱和时，遗忘仍然存在；低学习率可减少遗忘但需要更多训练步数，而回放技术打破了这一权衡。
AI.motivation: 传统上缓解灾难性遗忘需要存储先前任务的样本，这在实际中往往不可行。本文探索语言模型是否可以利用自身生成的训练分布样本来替代真实样本回放，从而更高效地缓解遗忘问题。
AI.method: 让语言模型从自身的训练分布中采样，将自生成样本作为回放数据，与当前任务数据联合微调，以此减轻对先前任务的遗忘。
AI.result: 自生成样本作为回放数据可几乎消除遗忘；但当模型预训练接近饱和（容量不足）时，遗忘仍然存在；低学习率虽能减少遗忘但需要大量额外训练步数，而回放方法能同时实现快速、高学习率的微调且不产生遗忘。
AI.conclusion: 自生成回放是一种有效且实用的灾难性遗忘缓解方法，它打破了学习率与遗忘之间的传统权衡，但模型容量仍是一个关键限制因素。

title: Looped Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive models for language modeling, yet the effective design of transformer architectures for MDMs remains underexplored. In this paper, we show that selectively looping the early-middle transformer layers significantly improves both training efficiency and model performance in MDMs. We call this approach LoopMDM(Looped Masked Diffusion Model), which brings two key benefits: looping layers at training-time yields a depth-scaling effect without adding parameters, while varying the number of loops at inference-time enables flexible compute scaling. Despite the simplicity, the results are striking: across multiple pre-training corpora, LoopMDM matches the performance of same-size MDMs with up to 3.3 fewer training FLOPs, while its final performance outperforms them on various reasoning benchmarks, including up to 8.5 points on GSM8K. It even surpasses deeper non-looped MDMs trained with comparable per-step compute, indicating that selective looping is more effective than naive depth scaling. Furthermore, LoopMDM can scale inference-time compute by increasing the number of loops. Adaptively adjusting the number of loops throughout the sampling process further yields additional gains in compute efficiency while maintaining performance. Lastly, with attention analysis, we provide evidence that looping is effective in MDMs by promoting interactions among masked positions. Our code and weights will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LoopMDM，通过在掩码扩散模型中选择性循环中间层，在训练时实现深度缩放效果（不增加参数），在推理时灵活扩展计算量，以更少的训练FLOPs匹配甚至超越更大模型性能，并在推理时通过自适应循环进一步提升计算效率。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散模型已成为自回归模型的有前景替代方案，但针对MDMs的Transformer架构有效设计尚未充分探索。
AI.method: 提出LoopMDM，在训练时选择性循环早期-中间Transformer层，推理时可变循环次数实现计算量灵活缩放，并通过自适应调整采样过程中的循环次数进一步提升效率。
AI.result: 相比同尺寸MDM，训练FLOPs减少至多3.3倍即达相同性能；在GSM8K等推理基准上性能提升高达8.5分；超越使用相当计算量训练的更深非循环MDM；推理时可通过增加循环次数扩展计算量；自适应循环进一步提升计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 选择性循环比简单深度缩放更有效，且循环机制通过促进掩码位置间的交互发挥作用。

title: Prism: A Plug-in Reproducible Infrastructure for Scalable Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve versatility by reformulating diverse tasks into a unified instruction-following framework via instruction tuning. However, real-world deployment requires continuous adaptation to emerging tasks, motivating Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT). Despite its growing importance, current MCIT research is hindered by severe engineering bottlenecks. Existing methods are typically implemented by directly modifying the base MLLM codebase, which imposes substantial implementation overhead and yields method-specific architectures that severely limit code reuse and fair comparison. To address this, we introduce Prism, a plug-in reproducible codebase specifically designed for scalable MCIT research. It separates algorithmic development from the backbone implementation via a lightweight plugin registration mechanism, enabling new strategies to be integrated as independent plugins without modifying the underlying MLLM codebase, thereby eliminating structural fragmentation and accelerating method development. Prism natively supports widely used large-scale training pipeline, thereby enabling reproducible and scalable MCIT experimentation. Code is available at https://github.com/LAMDA-CL/Prism.

AI.tldr: Prism是一个面向多模态持续指令微调（MCIT）的可插拔、可复现代码库，通过轻量级插件注册机制将算法开发与骨干实现解耦，无需修改底层MLLM代码库即可集成新策略，支持大规模训练流程，加速方法开发并促进公平比较。
AI.motivation: 现有MCIT研究存在严重的工程瓶颈：方法通常直接修改基础MLLM代码库，导致实现开销大、架构特定性强、代码复用率低、公平比较困难。
AI.method: 提出Prism可插拔代码库，核心是轻量级插件注册机制，将算法开发与骨干实现分离，新策略以独立插件形式集成，无需修改底层MLLM代码库，原生支持大规模训练流程。
AI.result: 消除了结构碎片化，加速了方法开发，实现了可复现、可扩展的MCIT实验。
AI.conclusion: Prism为MCIT研究提供标准化、可复现的基础设施，有望推动该领域的系统化发展。
